-- [[ executor startup and teleport execution ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules autoexecute

local AutoExecute = {}
local utils, observer, channel
local settings = { allGames = false, games = {} }
local environment, queue, startupDirectory
local syncing, armed = false, false
local mode = "Desativado"
local PATH = "Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json"
local SCRIPT = "Exodus Hub/auto_execute.luau"
local function gameKey() return game.GameId ~= 0 and game.GameId ~= nil and ("u:" .. tostring(game.GameId)) or ("p:" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)) end
local function anyEnabled() return settings.allGames or next(settings.games) ~= nil end
local function bootstrap()
  return [[local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted then return end
if game.PlaceId == 0 and not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local ok, state = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json")) end)
if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" then return end
if state.allGames ~= true and (type(state.games) ~= "table" or next(state.games) == nil) then return end
local key = game.GameId ~= 0 and game.GameId ~= nil and ("u:" .. tostring(game.GameId)) or ("p:" .. tostring(game.PlaceId))
local allowed = state.allGames == true or (type(state.games) == "table" and state.games[key] == true)
if not allowed then
  local queue = env.queue_on_teleport or env.queueonteleport or (env.syn and env.syn.queue_on_teleport) or (env.fluxus and env.fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
  if type(queue) == "function" then pcall(queue, readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.luau")) end
  return
end
if type(state.entryURL) ~= "string" or not state.entryURL:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/") then return end
env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted = true
local attempt = 0
local function start()
  local valid, current = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("Exodus Hub/auto_execute.json")) end)
  if not valid or type(current) ~= "table" or not (current.allGames == true or (type(current.games) == "table" and current.games[key] == true)) then
    env.ExodusAutoExecuteStarted = nil
    return
  end
  local success, reason = pcall(function()
    local owner, repo, _, path = state.entryURL:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/(.+)$")
    local revision = current.revision
    local urls = {{url=state.entryURL}}
    if owner and type(revision)=="string" and #revision==40 and revision:match("^[%x]+$") then
      local prefix, suffix = owner .. "/" .. repo, owner .. "/" .. repo .. "@" .. revision .. "/" .. path
      for _, host in ipairs({"cdn.jsdelivr.net", "fastly.jsdelivr.net", "gcore.jsdelivr.net", "testingcf.jsdelivr.net", "quantil.jsdelivr.net"}) do
        urls[#urls+1]={url="https://" .. host .. "/gh/" .. suffix}
      end
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://cdn.statically.io/gh/" .. suffix}
      table.insert(urls,3,{url="https://rawcdn.githack.com/" .. prefix .. "/" .. revision .. "/" .. path})
      table.insert(urls,4,{url="https://raw.githack.com/" .. prefix .. "/" .. revision .. "/" .. path})
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://github.com/" .. prefix .. "/raw/" .. revision .. "/" .. path}
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://api.github.com/repos/" .. prefix .. "/contents/" .. path .. "?ref=" .. revision,headers={Accept="application/vnd.github.raw+json"}}
      urls[#urls+1]={url="https://api.github.com/repos/" .. prefix .. "/contents/" .. path .. "?ref=" .. revision,headers={Accept="application/vnd.github.object+json"},json=true}
    end
    local fetchers, seen = {}, {}
    local function add(fn)
      if type(fn)=="function" and not seen[fn] then seen[fn]=true; fetchers[#fetchers+1]=fn end
    end
    add(env.request); add(env.http_request)
    for _, name in ipairs({"syn","fluxus","http"}) do if type(env[name])=="table" then add(env[name].request) end end
    add(function(options) return {StatusCode=200,Body=game:HttpGet(options.Url)} end)
    add(function(options) return {StatusCode=200,Body=game:HttpGetAsync(options.Url)} end)
    local chunk, failure
    for _, target in ipairs(urls) do
      for _, fetch in ipairs(fetchers) do
        local ok, response = pcall(fetch,{Url=target.url,Method="GET",Headers=target.headers,Timeout=1})
        if ok and type(response)=="table" then
          local status=tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.status_code) or 200
          local source=response.Body or response.body or response.ResponseBody
          if status>=200 and status<300 and type(source)=="string" then
            if target.json then
              local ok, data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(source) end)
              if ok and type(data)=="table" and data.encoding=="base64" and type(data.content)=="string" then
                local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
                local bytes,value,bits={},0,0
                for char in data.content:gmatch(".") do
                  if char=="=" then break end
                  if not char:match("%s") then
                    local position=alphabet:find(char,1,true)
                    if not position then error("Base64 inválido") end
                    value,bits=value*64+position-1,bits+6
                    if bits>=8 then bits-=8; local divisor=2^bits; bytes[#bytes+1]=string.char(math.floor(value/divisor)); value%=divisor end
                  end
                end
                source=table.concat(bytes)
              else source="" end
            end
            chunk, failure=source~="" and loadstring(source) or nil
            if chunk then env.ExodusCachedLoader={url=state.entryURL,source=source}; break end
          else
            failure="HTTP " .. tostring(status)
            if status==403 or status==429 then break end
          end
        else failure=tostring(response) end
      end
      if chunk then break end
    end
    if not chunk and type(env.ExodusCachedLoader)=="table" and env.ExodusCachedLoader.url==state.entryURL then
      chunk, failure=loadstring(env.ExodusCachedLoader.source)
    end
    assert(chunk,failure or "Todas as fontes do loader falharam")
    chunk()
  end)
  if success then return end
  attempt += 1
  local delay = math.min(60, 5 * 2 ^ math.min(attempt - 1, 4))
  if delay > 5 then
    warn("[Exodus Auto Execute] Erro: " .. tostring(reason) .. "; nova tentativa em " .. delay .. "s.")
    pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title="Exodus · Erro", Text="Falha ao carregar. Nova tentativa em " .. delay .. "s.", Duration=5}) end)
  end
  task.delay(delay, start)
end
start()
]]
end
local function filesAvailable()
  return type(environment.readfile) == "function"
    and type(environment.writefile) == "function"
    and type(environment.isfile) == "function"
    and type(environment.isfolder) == "function"
    and type(environment.makefolder) == "function"
end
local function sync()
  if not channel then
    return
  end
  if not filesAvailable() then
    mode = "Executor sem persistência"
    return false
  end
  if not environment.isfolder("Exodus Hub") then
    environment.makefolder("Exodus Hub")
  end
  settings.entryURL = channel.entryURL()
  settings.revision = channel.revision
  environment.writefile(PATH, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(settings))
  local source = bootstrap()
  environment.writefile(SCRIPT, source)
  if startupDirectory then
    if not environment.isfolder(startupDirectory) then
      environment.makefolder(startupDirectory)
    end
    if anyEnabled() then
      local installed = pcall(environment.writefile, startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau", source)
      if not installed then
        startupDirectory = nil
      end
    elseif type(environment.delfile) == "function" and environment.isfile(startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau") then
      pcall(environment.delfile, startupDirectory .. "/ExodusHub.luau")
    end
  end
  if anyEnabled() and queue and not armed then
    queue(source)
    armed = true
  end
  mode = not anyEnabled() and "Desativado"
    or (startupDirectory and "Ao entrar e após teleporte" or (queue and "Após teleporte; inicializador salvo" or "Inicializador salvo"))
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.setup(deps)
  AutoExecute.teardown()
  mode, syncing = "Desativado", false
  utils = deps.Utils
  environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  queue = environment.queue_on_teleport
    or environment.queueonteleport
    or (environment.syn and environment.syn.queue_on_teleport)
    or (environment.fluxus and environment.fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
  if type(queue) ~= "function" then
    queue = nil
  end
  startupDirectory = nil
  local directoryAPI = environment.getautoexecpath or environment.getautoexecfolder
  if type(directoryAPI) == "function" then
    local ok, path = pcall(directoryAPI)
    if ok and type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" then
      startupDirectory = path
    end
  elseif type(environment.delta) == "table" and type(environment.delta.AddTab) == "function" then
    startupDirectory = "DeltaPlugins"
  end
  settings = { allGames = false, games = {} }
  if filesAvailable() then
    local ok, saved = pcall(function()
      if environment.isfile(PATH) then
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(environment.readfile(PATH))
      end
    end)
    if ok and type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.games) == "table" then
      settings.allGames = saved.allGames == true
      for key, value in pairs(saved.games) do
        if type(key) == "string" and value == true then
          settings.games[key] = true
        end
      end
    end
  end
  utils.setConfig({ AutoExecuteOnJoin = settings.allGames or settings.games[gameKey()] == true, AutoExecuteAllGames = settings.allGames })
  observer = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if syncing or (changes.AutoExecuteOnJoin == nil and changes.AutoExecuteAllGames == nil) then
      return
    end
    local previous = { allGames = settings.allGames, games = table.clone(settings.games), entryURL = settings.entryURL }
    if utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecuteOnJoin") ~= true then
      if settings.allGames then
        settings.games = {}
      end
      settings.allGames = false
      settings.games[gameKey()] = nil
    elseif changes.AutoExecuteAllGames ~= nil then
      settings.allGames = changes.AutoExecuteAllGames == true
      if not settings.allGames then
        settings.games = { [gameKey()] = true }
      end
    else
      settings.games[gameKey()] = true
      settings.allGames = utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecuteAllGames") == true
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(sync)
    if not ok or result == false then
      utils.recordError("AutoExecute", ok and mode or result)
      settings = previous
      if filesAvailable() then
        pcall(function() environment.writefile(PATH, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(previous)) end)
      end
    end
    syncing = true
    utils.setConfig({ AutoExecuteOnJoin = settings.allGames or settings.games[gameKey()] == true, AutoExecuteAllGames = settings.allGames })
    syncing = false
  end)
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.start(transport)
  channel = transport
  if anyEnabled() then
    local ok, reason = pcall(sync)
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("AutoExecute", reason)
    end
  end
  return true
end
function AutoExecute.getStatus() return { mode = mode, startup = startupDirectory ~= nil, teleport = queue ~= nil } end
function AutoExecute.teardown()
  if observer then
    observer:Disconnect()
    observer = nil
  end
  utils, channel, armed = nil, nil, false
  return true
end
AutoExecute.__config =
  { schema = { AutoExecuteOnJoin = "boolean", AutoExecuteAllGames = "boolean" }, defaults = { AutoExecuteOnJoin = false, AutoExecuteAllGames = false } }
AutoExecute.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { getStatus = "internal.read" } },
  provides = { "setup", "start", "teardown", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "setConfig", "getConfigValue", "observeConfig", "recordError" } },
}
return AutoExecute

-- [[ session bootstrap ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules bootstrap

local Bootstrap = {}
function Bootstrap.setup() return true end
function Bootstrap.start(loaded, order, urls, profile, transport)
  loaded.gamecontext.configure(profile)
  loaded.hubapi.configure(loaded)
  local utils = loaded.utils
  utils.configure(loaded.permissions.resolve("utils", loaded))
  utils.start()
  if type(_G.Exodus) == "table" then
    _G.Exodus.Utils = utils
  end
  loaded.status.configure(loaded, utils.recordError)
  utils.setLifecyclePhase("configuring")
  for name, module in pairs(loaded) do
    if module.__config then
      assert(loaded.config.register(name, module.__config), "Invalid configuration schema: " .. name)
    end
  end
  utils.setConfigModule(loaded.config)
  utils.setConfig(loaded.config.defaults())
  utils.loadConfig()
  utils.setModuleURLs(urls)
  local binds = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(order) do
    local module = loaded[name]
    if module.__contract.bindCharacter then
      assert(type(module.bindCharacter) == "function" and type(module.detachCharacter) == "function", "Incomplete character contract: " .. name)
      binds[#binds + 1] = { name = name, bind = module.bindCharacter, detach = module.detachCharacter }
    end
  end
  utils.setLifecyclePhase("initializing")
  for _, name in ipairs(order) do
    local module = loaded[name]
    if name ~= "utils" and name ~= "config" and name ~= "uiconfig" then
      local deps = loaded.permissions.resolve(name, loaded)
      if name == "character" then
        deps.characterBinds = binds
      end
      -- Register before setup so partial initialization is also cleaned up.
      if type(module.teardown) == "function" then
        local cleanup = { Connected = true }
        function cleanup:Disconnect()
          if not self.Connected then
            return
          end
          self.Connected = false
          module.teardown()
        end
        utils.trackGlobal(cleanup)
      end
      local ok, reason = module.setup(deps)
      assert(ok == true, name .. ".setup: " .. tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  utils.setDiagnosticsModules(loaded)
  local runtime, reason = loaded.runtime.bind(loaded, order, game:GetService("HttpService"), transport.report)
  assert(type(runtime) == "table", tostring(reason))
  local controls = loaded.hubapi.getControls()
  controls.onClose = function()
    _G.ExodusLoaderRecoveryToken = nil
    return utils.stop()
  end
  controls.onReload = transport.reload
  controls.onUniversalToggle = function(feature, enabled)
    local module = loaded[string.lower(feature)]
    if module and module.setEnabled then
      local ok, err = module.setEnabled(enabled)
      if ok == false then
        utils.recordError(feature, err)
      end
    end
  end
  controls.onUniversalValue = function(feature, value)
    local module = loaded[string.lower(feature)]
    if module and module.setValue then
      local ok, err = module.setValue(value)
      if ok == false then
        utils.recordError(feature, err)
      end
    end
  end
  for action, method in pairs({ onRejoin = "rejoin", onServerHop = "hop" }) do
    controls[action] = function()
      local function report(message) loaded.ui.notify(message, "server_navigation", "info", 5) end
      local ok, err = loaded.servers[method](report)
      if ok == false then
        utils.recordError("Servers", err)
        report(err)
      end
    end
  end
  local dependencies = loaded.permissions.resolve("ui", loaded)
  dependencies.Controls = controls
  local ok, err = loaded.ui.setup(dependencies)
  assert(ok == true, tostring(err))
  loaded.updates.start(transport)
  loaded.autoexecute.start(transport)
  return true, runtime
end
Bootstrap.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "start" }, requires = {} }
return Bootstrap

-- [[ character ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules character

-- module
local Character = {}
local utils
local spam
local binds
local added
local removing
local currentLife
local generation = 0
local setupEpoch = 0
local phase = "stopped"
local workerRunning = false
local startWorker

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  BIND_TIMEOUT = 10,
  ROOT_POLL_INTERVAL = 0,
}

-- state-tracking
local function setPhase(value, reason)
  if phase == value then
    return
  end
  local previous = phase
  phase = value
  if utils then
    utils.recordTransition("Character", previous, value, reason)
  end
end

-- lifecycle
local function detach(entry)
  local ok, err = pcall(entry.detach)
  if not ok and utils then
    utils.recordError("Character", ("%s: falha ao desvincular: %s"):format(entry.name or "bind", tostring(err)))
  end
end
local function clearLife()
  local life = currentLife
  currentLife = nil
  if life then
    for i = #life.bound, 1, -1 do
      detach(life.bound[i])
      life.bound[i] = nil
    end
  end
  if not utils then
    return
  end
  utils.disconnectCharacterConnections()
  utils.setAutoSpamActive(false)
  if spam then
    spam.resetState()
  end
end
local function deactivate(life, reason)
  if currentLife ~= life then
    return
  end
  generation += 1
  setPhase("cleaning", reason)
  clearLife()
  setPhase("stopped", "character_cleaned")
end
local function valid(life) return currentLife == life and utils ~= nil and utils.isActive() and life.character.Parent ~= nil end
local function bindLife(life)
  life.attempted = true
  if not valid(life) then
    return
  end
  setPhase("binding", "character_bind_start")
  local root = life.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local deadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.BIND_TIMEOUT
  while valid(life) and (not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not root.Parent) and os.clock() < deadline do
    task.wait(CONFIG.ROOT_POLL_INTERVAL)
    root = life.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  end
  if not valid(life) then
    return
  end
  if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not root.Parent then
    life.attempted = false
    setPhase("waiting", "root_unavailable")
    return
  end
  for index, entry in ipairs(binds) do
    if not valid(life) then
      return
    end
    local ok, result, detail = pcall(entry.bind, life.character)
    if not ok then
      detail, result = result, false
    end
    if not valid(life) then
      detach(entry)
      return
    end
    if result ~= true then
      utils.recordError("Character", ("%s não vinculou o personagem: %s"):format(entry.name or ("bind_" .. index), tostring(detail or result)))
      detach(entry)
      for i = #life.bound, 1, -1 do
        detach(life.bound[i])
        life.bound[i] = nil
      end
      life.attempted = false
      setPhase("waiting", "bind_failed")
      return
    end
    life.bound[#life.bound + 1] = entry
  end
  if valid(life) then
    setPhase("bound", "character_bound")
  end
end
startWorker = function()
  if workerRunning then
    return
  end
  workerRunning = true
  task.spawn(function()
    local life = currentLife
    local ok, reason = xpcall(function()
      if life then
        bindLife(life)
      end
    end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
    workerRunning = false
    if not ok and currentLife == life and utils then
      utils.recordError("Character", reason)
      deactivate(life, "bind_error")
      setPhase("invalid", "bind_error")
    end
    if currentLife and not currentLife.attempted then
      local retryLife = currentLife
      task.delay(0.25, function()
        if currentLife == retryLife and utils then
          startWorker()
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end
local function setupCharacter(character)
  if not character or not utils or (currentLife and currentLife.character == character) then
    return
  end
  generation += 1
  clearLife()
  local life = { character = character, bound = {}, attempted = false, humanoids = {} }
  currentLife = life
  utils.trackCharacter(character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    if not parent then
      deactivate(life, "character_removed")
    end
  end))
  local function watchHumanoid(humanoid)
    if currentLife ~= life or life.humanoids[humanoid] then
      return
    end
    life.humanoids[humanoid] = true
    utils.trackCharacter(humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
      if humanoid.Parent == life.character then
        deactivate(life, "character_died")
      end
    end))
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
      deactivate(life, "character_died")
    end
  end
  local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if humanoid then
    watchHumanoid(humanoid)
  end
  if currentLife ~= life then
    return
  end
  utils.trackCharacter(character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
      watchHumanoid(child)
    end
  end))
  if character.ChildRemoved then
    utils.trackCharacter(character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
      if currentLife == life and child.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
        deactivate(life, "root_removed")
        if utils and utils.isActive() and character.Parent then
          setupCharacter(character)
        end
      end
    end))
  end
  startWorker()
end
function Character.setup(deps)
  if
    type(deps) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Hub) ~= "table"
    or type(deps.Hub.resetState) ~= "function"
    or type(deps.characterBinds) ~= "table"
  then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils, Spam ou characterBinds"
  end
  for index, entry in ipairs(deps.characterBinds) do
    if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.bind) ~= "function" or type(entry.detach) ~= "function" then
      return false, ("characterBinds[%d] inválido"):format(index)
    end
  end
  Character.teardown()
  utils, spam, binds = deps.Utils, deps.Hub, deps.characterBinds
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not player then
    setPhase("invalid", "player_unavailable")
    return false, "Players.LocalPlayer indisponível"
  end
  setPhase("ready", "character_controller_ready")
  local owner = setupEpoch
  added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if owner == setupEpoch then
      setupCharacter(character)
    end
  end)
  removing = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
    if owner == setupEpoch and currentLife and currentLife.character == character then
      deactivate(currentLife, "character_removing")
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(added)
  utils.trackGlobal(removing)
  if player.Character then
    setupCharacter(player.Character)
  end
  return true
end
function Character.teardown()
  generation += 1
  setupEpoch += 1
  if utils then
    if added then
      utils.untrackGlobal(added)
    end
    if removing then
      utils.untrackGlobal(removing)
    end
  end
  if added then
    added:Disconnect()
  end
  if removing then
    removing:Disconnect()
  end
  added, removing = nil, nil
  setPhase("cleaning", "character_controller_teardown")
  clearLife()
  setPhase("stopped", "character_controller_stopped")
  utils, spam, binds = nil, nil, nil
end

-- public-api
function Character.getStatus() return { schema = utils and utils.apiVersion() or nil, phase = phase, generation = generation } end

-- contract
Character.__contract = {
  requires = { Hub = "hubapi", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = {
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "isActive",
      "apiVersion",
      "trackGlobal",
      "untrackGlobal",
      "trackCharacter",
      "disconnectCharacterConnections",
      "setAutoSpamActive",
      "recordTransition",
      "recordError",
    },
    Hub = { "resetState" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "getStatus" },
}

return Character

-- [[ config ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules config

-- module
local Config = {}
local Registry = {}
local Keys = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  RATE_MIN = 0,
  DELAY_MIN = 0,
  DELAY_MAX = 5,
  DELAY_MS_MAX = 400,
  POSITION_MIN = -10000,
  POSITION_MAX = 10000,
  ERRORS = {
    boolean = "flag inválida: %s",
    rate = "taxa inválida: %s",
    delay = "atraso inválido: %s",
    delayMs = "tempo inválido: %s",
    position = "posição inválida: %s",
    keyCode = "keybind inválido: %s",
    rateMode = "SpamRateMode inválido",
    clickMethod = "ClickMethod inválido",
    miniScale = "tamanho do Manual Spam inválido",
    spamActivation = "ManualSpamMode inválido",
  },
}

-- validation
local function isFiniteNumber(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value < math.huge and value > -math.huge end
local function validKeyCode(value)
  return typeof(value) == "EnumItem"
    and (
      value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or value == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    )
end
local validationErrors = CONFIG.ERRORS
local validators = {
  boolean = function(value) return type(value) == "boolean" end,
  rate = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.RATE_MIN end,
  delay = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.DELAY_MIN and value <= CONFIG.DELAY_MAX end,
  delayMs = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.DELAY_MIN and value <= CONFIG.DELAY_MS_MAX end,
  position = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= CONFIG.POSITION_MIN and value <= CONFIG.POSITION_MAX end,
  keyCode = validKeyCode,
  rateMode = function(value) return value == "CPS" or value == "CPF" or value == "MS" or value == "Auto" end,
  clickMethod = function(value) return value == "Deflect" or value == "Direct" or value == "Input" end,
  miniScale = function(value) return isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0.5 and value <= 2 end,
  spamActivation = function(value) return value == "Toggle" or value == "Hold" end,
}

local function validateValue(key, kind, value)
  local validator = validators[kind]
  if validator and validator(value) then
    return true
  end
  local message = validationErrors[kind] or "valor inválido: %s"
  return false, message:find("%s", 1, true) and message:format(key) or message
end
local function copy(source)
  local result = {}
  for key, value in pairs(source or {}) do
    result[key] = value
  end
  return result
end

-- registration
function Config.register(name, definition)
  if type(name) ~= "string" or type(definition) ~= "table" or Registry[name] then
    return false
  end
  local schema = type(definition.schema) == "table" and definition.schema or {}
  local defaults = type(definition.defaults) == "table" and definition.defaults or {}
  for key, kind in pairs(schema) do
    if type(key) ~= "string" or not validators[kind] or Keys[key] then
      return false
    end
  end
  for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
    local kind = schema[key]
    if not kind or not validateValue(key, kind, value) then
      return false
    end
  end
  for key, kind in pairs(schema) do
    Keys[key] = kind
  end
  Registry[name] = { schema = copy(schema), defaults = copy(defaults) }
  return true
end

-- defaults
function Config.defaults()
  local result = {}
  for _, definition in pairs(Registry) do
    for key, value in pairs(definition.defaults) do
      result[key] = value
    end
  end
  return result
end

-- validation-api
function Config.validatePatch(patch)
  if type(patch) ~= "table" then
    return false, "configuração não é uma tabela"
  end
  for key, value in pairs(patch) do
    local kind = Keys[key]
    if not kind then
      return false, "chave de configuração desconhecida: " .. tostring(key)
    end
    local ok, reason = validateValue(key, kind, value)
    if not ok then
      return false, reason
    end
  end
  return true
end
function Config.normalizePatch(patch)
  local ok, reason = Config.validatePatch(patch)
  if not ok then
    return nil, reason
  end
  return copy(patch)
end
function Config.validate(config)
  if type(config) ~= "table" then
    return false, "configuração não é uma tabela"
  end
  local ok, reason = Config.validatePatch(config)
  if not ok then
    return false, reason
  end
  return true
end

-- public-api
function Config.getRegistry()
  local result = {}
  for name, definition in pairs(Registry) do
    result[name] = { schema = copy(definition.schema), defaults = copy(definition.defaults) }
  end
  return result
end

-- contract
Config.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "internal.read",
    methods = { register = "infrastructure.write" },
  },
  provides = { "register", "defaults", "validate", "validatePatch", "normalizePatch", "getRegistry" },
  requires = {},
}

return Config

-- [[ diagnostics ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules profiler, status, diagnostics

-- code
local __part_status = (function()
  local Status = {}
  local active
  function Status.setup() return true end
  function Status.create(providers, reportError)
    local names, failures, reading = {}, {}, {}
    for name, provider in pairs(providers) do
      if type(provider) == "table" and type(provider.getStatus) == "function" then
        names[#names + 1] = name
      end
    end
    table.sort(names)
    local reader = {}
    function reader.get(name)
      local provider = providers[name]
      if reading[name] or type(provider) ~= "table" or type(provider.getStatus) ~= "function" then
        return nil
      end
      reading[name] = true
      local ok, value = pcall(provider.getStatus)
      reading[name] = nil
      if ok and type(value) == "table" then
        failures[name] = nil
        return value
      end
      if not failures[name] then
        failures[name] = true
        if type(reportError) == "function" then
          pcall(reportError, "Status", name .. ": " .. tostring(ok and "invalid status" or value))
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    function reader.collect(selected)
      local result = {}
      for _, name in ipairs(selected or names) do
        local value = reader.get(name)
        if value then
          result[name] = value
        end
      end
      return result
    end
    return reader
  end
  function Status.configure(providers, reportError)
    if type(providers) ~= "table" then
      return false, "provedores de status inválidos"
    end
    active = Status.create(providers, reportError)
    return true
  end
  function Status.get(name) return active and active.get(name) or nil end
  function Status.collect(selected) return active and active.collect(selected) or {} end
  Status.__contract = {
    access = {
      default = "internal.read",
      methods = { configure = "infrastructure.write" },
    },
    provides = { "setup", "create", "configure", "get", "collect" },
    requires = {},
  }
  return Status
end)()
local __part_diagnostics = (function()
  local Diagnostics = {}
  function Diagnostics.setup() return true end
  function Diagnostics.create(deps)
    local collector = {}
    local state, CONFIG = deps.state, deps.config
    local snapshot, lifecycleSnapshot = deps.snapshot, deps.lifecycleSnapshot
    local refreshPending = false
    local function append(list, value)
      list[#list + 1] = value
      if #list > CONFIG.HISTORY_LIMIT then
        table.remove(list, 1)
      end
    end
    local function refreshNamespace() deps.refresh() end
    local function diagnosticsSnapshot(includeModules)
      local statuses = {}
      local source = deps.getModules().status
      if includeModules ~= false and type(source) == "table" and type(source.collect) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(source.collect)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then
          statuses = snapshot(result)
        end
      end
      local diagnostics = state.diagnostics
      return {
        schema = CONFIG.API_VERSION,
        generatedAt = os.clock(),
        lastError = snapshot(diagnostics.lastError),
        lastTransition = snapshot(diagnostics.lastTransition),
        lastTransitionAt = diagnostics.lastTransitionAt,
        errors = snapshot(diagnostics.errors),
        transitions = snapshot(diagnostics.transitions),
        lifecycle = lifecycleSnapshot(),
        runtime = {
          active = state.active,
          manualSpamActive = state.manualSpam,
          autoSpamActive = state.autoSpam,
        },
        modules = statuses,
      }
    end
    local function recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason)
      local item = {
        source = tostring(source or "Unknown"),
        from = tostring(fromState or ""),
        to = tostring(toState or ""),
        reason = tostring(reason or ""),
        at = os.clock(),
      }

      state.diagnostics.lastTransition, state.diagnostics.lastTransitionAt = item, item.at
      append(state.diagnostics.transitions, item)
      if state.active and not refreshPending then
        refreshPending = true
        local generation = state.lifecycle.generation
        task.delay(0.1, function()
          refreshPending = false
          if state.active and state.lifecycle.generation == generation then
            refreshNamespace()
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    function collector.recordError(source, message)
      source, message = tostring(source or "Unknown"), tostring(message or "")
      local previous = state.diagnostics.lastError
      if previous and previous.source == source and previous.message == message and os.clock() - previous.at < 1 then
        previous.count = (previous.count or 1) + 1
        return true
      end
      local item = { source = tostring(source or "Unknown"), message = tostring(message or ""), at = os.clock() }
      state.diagnostics.lastError = item
      append(state.diagnostics.errors, item)
      warn(("[%s] %s"):format(item.source, item.message))
      refreshNamespace()
      return true
    end
    collector.snapshot = diagnosticsSnapshot
    collector.recordTransition = recordTransition
    return collector
  end
  Diagnostics.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }
  return Diagnostics
end)()
local __part_profiler = (function()
  local Profiler = {}
  local enabled = false
  local samples = {}
  local CONFIG = {
    LIMIT = 64,
  }

  local LIMIT = CONFIG.LIMIT
  function Profiler.setup() return true end
  function Profiler.setEnabled(value)
    enabled = value == true
    table.clear(samples)
  end
  function Profiler.isEnabled() return enabled end
  function Profiler.begin(name)
    if not enabled then
      return nil
    end
    if debug.profilebegin then
      debug.profilebegin(name)
    end
    return os.clock()
  end
  function Profiler.count(name, amount)
    if not enabled then
      return
    end
    local item = samples[name]
    if not item then
      local size = 0
      for _ in pairs(samples) do
        size += 1
      end
      if size >= LIMIT then
        return
      end
      item = { calls = 0, total = 0, maximum = 0 }
      samples[name] = item
    end
    item.calls += amount or 1
  end
  function Profiler.finish(name, started)
    if not started then
      return
    end
    if debug.profileend then
      debug.profileend()
    end
    if not enabled then
      return
    end
    local item = samples[name]
    if not item then
      local count = 0
      for _ in pairs(samples) do
        count += 1
      end
      if count >= LIMIT then
        return
      end
      item = { calls = 0, total = 0, maximum = 0 }
      samples[name] = item
    end
    local elapsed = os.clock() - started
    item.calls += 1
    item.total += elapsed
    item.maximum = math.max(item.maximum, elapsed)
  end
  function Profiler.getStatus()
    local result = {}
    for name, item in pairs(samples) do
      result[name] = table.clone(item)
    end
    return { enabled = enabled, samples = result }
  end
  function Profiler.teardown()
    enabled = false
    table.clear(samples)
  end
  Profiler.__contract = {
    access = {
      default = "diagnostics.write",
      methods = {
        getStatus = "internal.read",
        isEnabled = "internal.read",
        setEnabled = "infrastructure.write",
      },
    },
    requires = {},
    provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "isEnabled", "begin", "finish", "count", "getStatus" },
  }
  return Profiler
end)()

return { __bundle = { status = __part_status, diagnostics = __part_diagnostics, profiler = __part_profiler } }

-- [[ game_integration ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules gamecontext, hubapi, runtime

-- code
local __part_gamecontext = (function()
  local GameContext = {}
  local profile = { id = "universal", title = "Universal", author = "deltapolinha_2915" }
  function GameContext.setup() return true end
  function GameContext.configure(value)
    profile = table.clone(value)
    return true
  end
  function GameContext.getProfile() return table.clone(profile) end
  function GameContext.supportsModule() return true end
  GameContext.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "configure", "getProfile", "supportsModule" }, requires = {} }
  return GameContext
end)()
local __part_hubapi = (function()
  local HubAPI = {}
  local api = {}
  function HubAPI.setup() return true end
  function HubAPI.configure(loaded)
    api = loaded.gameruntime and loaded.gameruntime.createAPI(loaded) or {}
    return true
  end
  function HubAPI.teardown()
    api = {}
    return true
  end
  function HubAPI.areAbilitiesEnabled() return api.areAbilitiesEnabled and api.areAbilitiesEnabled() or false end
  function HubAPI.getAbilityAvailability(name)
    if api.getAbilityAvailability then
      return api.getAbilityAvailability(name)
    end
    return false, "Recurso indisponível neste jogo"
  end
  function HubAPI.getUIConfig() return api.getUIConfig and api.getUIConfig() or {} end
  function HubAPI.getGameContext() return api.getGameContext and api.getGameContext() or {} end
  function HubAPI.observeAbilityMode(callback)
    if api.observeAbilityMode then
      return api.observeAbilityMode(callback)
    end
    return { Disconnect = function() end }
  end
  function HubAPI.hasClashPrediction() return api.hasClashPrediction and api.hasClashPrediction() or false end
  function HubAPI.resetState()
    if api.resetState then
      api.resetState()
    end
  end
  function HubAPI.isNativeVisualAvailable() return api.createVisualAdapter ~= nil end
  function HubAPI.applyVisualPolicy(...)
    if api.applyVisualPolicy then
      return api.applyVisualPolicy(...)
    end
    local _, target, watch = ...
    return target, watch
  end
  function HubAPI.createVisualAdapter(...) return api.createVisualAdapter and api.createVisualAdapter(...) end
  function HubAPI.getReadouts() return api.readouts or {} end
  function HubAPI.getJumpButton() return api.getJumpButton and api.getJumpButton() end
  function HubAPI.createActions(context) return api.createActions and api.createActions(context) or {} end
  function HubAPI.getControls() return api.controls or {} end
  function HubAPI.canUpdate()
    for _, blocked in ipairs(api.updateBlockers or {}) do
      local ok, value = pcall(blocked)
      if not ok then
        return false, tostring(value)
      end
      if value then
        return false, "Aguardando um estado seguro do jogo"
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function HubAPI.getMiniVisibility()
    local result = {}
    for key, rule in pairs(api.miniVisibility or {}) do
      local ok, visible = pcall(rule)
      if ok then
        result[key] = visible == true
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  function HubAPI.migrateConfig(data)
    if api.migrateConfig then
      return api.migrateConfig(data)
    end
    return false
  end
  HubAPI.__contract = {
    access = {
      default = "internal.read",
      methods = {
        configure = "infrastructure.write",
        resetState = "combat.runtime",
        createActions = "game.inventory",
        applyVisualPolicy = "render.write",
        createVisualAdapter = "render.write",
      },
    },
    provides = {
      "getReadouts",
      "getJumpButton",
      "createActions",
      "getControls",
      "canUpdate",
      "getMiniVisibility",
      "migrateConfig",
      "setup",
      "configure",
      "teardown",
      "areAbilitiesEnabled",
      "getAbilityAvailability",
      "getUIConfig",
      "getGameContext",
      "observeAbilityMode",
      "hasClashPrediction",
      "resetState",
      "isNativeVisualAvailable",
      "applyVisualPolicy",
      "createVisualAdapter",
    },
    requires = {},
  }
  return HubAPI
end)()
local __part_runtime = (function()
  local Runtime = {}
  function Runtime.setup() return true end
  function Runtime.bind(loaded, ...)
    if loaded.gameruntime then
      return loaded.gameruntime.bind(loaded, ...)
    end
    return {
      mode = loaded.gamecontext.getProfile().id,
    }
  end
  Runtime.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "bind" }, requires = {} }
  return Runtime
end)()

return { __bundle = { gamecontext = __part_gamecontext, hubapi = __part_hubapi, runtime = __part_runtime } }

-- [[ resource lifetime ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules lifetime

-- code
local Lifetime = {}
function Lifetime.setup() return true end
function Lifetime.scope()
  local scope = { alive = true }
  local resources, last = {}, nil
  local function unlink(resource)
    local entry = resources[resource]
    if not entry then
      return nil
    end
    resources[resource] = nil
    if entry.previous then
      entry.previous.next = entry.next
    end
    if entry.next then
      entry.next.previous = entry.previous
    else
      last = entry.previous
    end
    return entry.cleanup
  end
  function scope.add(resource, dispose)
    local cleanup = dispose
      or function()
        if type(resource) == "function" then
          resource()
        else
          resource:Disconnect()
        end
      end
    if not scope.alive then
      cleanup()
      return resource
    end
    if resources[resource] then
      return resource
    end
    local entry = { resource = resource, cleanup = cleanup, previous = last }
    if last then
      last.next = entry
    end
    resources[resource], last = entry, entry
    return resource
  end
  function scope.forget(resource) unlink(resource) end
  function scope.remove(resource)
    local cleanup = unlink(resource)
    if cleanup then
      cleanup()
    end
  end
  function scope.connect(signal, callback)
    return scope.add(signal:Connect(function(...)
      if scope.alive then
        callback(...)
      end
    end))
  end
  function scope.child()
    local child = Lifetime.scope()
    scope.add(child, child.destroy)
    child.add(function() scope.forget(child) end)
    return child
  end
  function scope.destroy()
    if not scope.alive then
      return
    end
    scope.alive = false
    while last do
      local cleanup = unlink(last.resource)
      local ok, reason = pcall(cleanup)
      if not ok then
        warn("[Exodus] Cleanup failed: " .. tostring(reason))
      end
    end
  end
  return scope
end
function Lifetime.connections(utils)
  local scope = Lifetime.scope()
  local pool = { connections = {} }
  function pool.disconnect(name)
    local connection = pool.connections[name]
    pool.connections[name] = nil
    if connection then
      scope.remove(connection)
    end
  end
  function pool.connect(name, signal, callback)
    pool.disconnect(name)
    local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
    pool.connections[name] = connection
    utils.trackGlobal(connection)
    scope.add(connection, function()
      utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
      connection:Disconnect()
    end)
    return connection
  end
  function pool.destroy()
    scope.destroy()
    table.clear(pool.connections)
  end
  return pool
end
Lifetime.__contract = {
  access = { default = "lifetime.manage" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "scope", "connections" },
}

return Lifetime

-- [[ internal permissions: generic action categories ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules permissions

local Permissions = {}
local CONFIG = { RESERVED = { __contract = true, __config = true } }
local readonly
local POLICY = { base = {}, types = {}, rules = {}, modules = {}, defaults = {} }
local function contains(items, value)
  for _, item in ipairs(items or {}) do
    if item == value then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function configure(policy)
  assert(type(policy) == "table" and type(policy.types) == "table", "Missing internal permission policy")
  POLICY =
    readonly({ base = policy.base or {}, types = policy.types, rules = policy.rules or {}, modules = policy.modules or {}, defaults = policy.defaults or {} })
  return true
end
local function familyFor(name, path)
  local kind = POLICY.modules[name]
  if not kind then
    for _, rule in ipairs(POLICY.rules) do
      if path and type(rule.prefix) == "string" and path:sub(1, #rule.prefix) == rule.prefix then
        kind = rule.type
        break
      end
    end
  end
  assert(kind and POLICY.types[kind], "Module has no authorized type: " .. name)
  return kind
end
local function hasFunctions(value, seen)
  if type(value) == "function" then
    return true
  end
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return false
  end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[value] then
    return false
  end
  seen[value] = true
  for _, item in pairs(value) do
    if hasFunctions(item, seen) then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function capability(provider, method, data)
  if data then
    return provider.commandData[method] and (provider.access.default or POLICY.defaults[provider.family] or "internal.write") or "internal.read"
  end
  if provider.access.methods and provider.access.methods[method] then
    return provider.access.methods[method]
  end
  if method == "setup" or method == "teardown" or method == "bindCharacter" or method == "detachCharacter" then
    return "lifecycle.write"
  end
  for _, prefix in ipairs({ "get", "is", "has", "are", "uses", "normalize", "validate", "decode", "format", "should" }) do
    if method:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      return "internal.read"
    end
  end
  for _, prefix in ipairs({ "observe", "track", "untrack" }) do
    if method:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      return "lifetime.manage"
    end
  end
  return provider.access.default or POLICY.defaults[provider.family] or "internal.write"
end
local function allowed(entry, permission)
  local grants = POLICY.types[entry.family]
  return contains(grants, "*") or contains(grants, permission) or contains(POLICY.base, permission)
end
local function canConsume(entry, provider, method, data)
  local permission = capability(provider, method, data)
  if allowed(entry, permission) then
    return true, permission
  end
  if not data and contains(provider.access.scoped, method) and allowed(entry, "config.own") then
    return true, "config.own"
  end
  return false, permission
end

-- registry
local registry = {}

-- validation
local function deny(name, action) error(("Permissão negada: %s -> %s"):format(name, action), 3) end
local function namedSet(owner, field, items)
  if type(items) ~= "table" then
    error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " inválido", 3)
  end
  local result, count = {}, 0
  for index, name in pairs(items) do
    if type(index) ~= "number" or index < 1 or index % 1 ~= 0 or type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or result[name] then
      error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " contém entrada inválida ou duplicada", 3)
    end
    result[name] = true
    count += 1
  end
  if count ~= #items then
    error(owner .. ": " .. field .. " deve ser uma lista contínua", 3)
  end
  return result
end
local function validate(name, module, path)
  if type(name) ~= "string" or type(module) ~= "table" then
    error("Permissions: módulo inválido", 2)
  end
  local contract = module.__contract
  if type(contract) ~= "table" then
    error(name .. ": contrato ausente", 2)
  end
  local provides = namedSet(name, "provides", contract.provides)
  local data = namedSet(name, "data", contract.data or {})
  for field in pairs(data) do
    if provides[field] or type(module[field]) ~= "table" then
      error(name .. ": dado público inválido: " .. field, 2)
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(provides) do
    if type(module[field]) ~= "function" then
      error(name .. ": API declarada ausente: " .. field, 2)
    end
  end
  for field, value in pairs(module) do
    if type(value) == "function" and not provides[field] then
      error(name .. ": função não declarada no contrato: " .. tostring(field), 2)
    end
    if type(value) == "table" and not CONFIG.RESERVED[field] and not data[field] then
      error(name .. ": tabela pública não declarada: " .. tostring(field), 2)
    end
  end
  if contract.bindCharacter == true and (not provides.bindCharacter or not provides.detachCharacter) then
    error(name .. ": contrato bindCharacter incompleto", 2)
  end
  if contract.onBallSync == true and not provides.onBallSync then
    error(name .. ": contrato onBallSync incompleto", 2)
  end
  local requires = contract.requires or {}
  local methods = contract.requiresMethods or {}
  local fields = contract.requiresData or {}
  local versions = contract.requiresVersions or {}
  if type(requires) ~= "table" or type(methods) ~= "table" or type(fields) ~= "table" or type(versions) ~= "table" then
    error(name .. ": dependências inválidas", 2)
  end
  local uses, sources = {}, {}
  for alias, source in pairs(requires) do
    if type(alias) ~= "string" or type(source) ~= "string" or alias == "" or source == "" or sources[source] or source == name then
      error(name .. ": dependência inválida ou duplicada: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
    sources[source] = true
    uses[alias] = {
      source = source,
      methods = namedSet(name, alias .. ".requiresMethods", methods[alias] or {}),
      data = namedSet(name, alias .. ".requiresData", fields[alias] or {}),
    }
    for field in pairs(uses[alias].methods) do
      if uses[alias].data[field] then
        error(name .. ": método e dado duplicados: " .. field, 2)
      end
    end
  end
  for alias in pairs(methods) do
    if not uses[alias] then
      error(name .. ": requiresMethods sem dependência: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
  end
  for alias in pairs(fields) do
    if not uses[alias] then
      error(name .. ": requiresData sem dependência: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
  end
  for alias, minimum in pairs(versions) do
    if not uses[alias] or type(minimum) ~= "number" or minimum < 0 or minimum ~= minimum or minimum == math.huge then
      error(name .. ": versão de dependência inválida: " .. tostring(alias), 2)
    end
    uses[alias].minimum = minimum
  end
  if
    contract.version ~= nil
    and (type(contract.version) ~= "number" or contract.version < 0 or contract.version ~= contract.version or contract.version == math.huge)
  then
    error(name .. ": versão do contrato inválida", 2)
  end
  local commandData = {}
  for field in pairs(data) do
    commandData[field] = hasFunctions(module[field])
  end
  registry[name] = {
    name = name,
    path = path,
    family = familyFor(name, path),
    module = module,
    provides = provides,
    data = data,
    commandData = commandData,
    uses = uses,
    version = contract.version,
    access = readonly(contract.access or {}),
    owned = readonly(module.__config and module.__config.schema or {}),
  }
  return true
end
readonly = function(value, visited)
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return value
  end
  visited = visited or {}
  if visited[value] then
    return visited[value]
  end
  local copy = {}
  visited[value] = copy
  for key, item in pairs(value) do
    copy[readonly(key, visited)] = readonly(item, visited)
  end
  return table.freeze(copy)
end
local function wrap(consumer, source, provider)
  local entry, exposed = registry[consumer], registry[source]
  if not entry or not exposed or exposed.module ~= provider then
    error("Permissions: módulo não validado: " .. tostring(source), 2)
  end
  local use
  for _, dependency in pairs(entry.uses) do
    if dependency.source == source then
      use = dependency
      break
    end
  end
  if not use then
    error("Dependência interna não declarada: " .. consumer .. " -> " .. source, 2)
  end
  for method in pairs(use.methods) do
    if not exposed.provides[method] then
      error(consumer .. ": API ausente: " .. source .. "." .. method, 2)
    end
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, method, false)
    if not ok then
      deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(use.data) do
    if not exposed.data[field] then
      error(consumer .. ": dado ausente: " .. source .. "." .. field, 2)
    end
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, field, true)
    if not ok then
      deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
    end
  end
  local members = {}
  for method in pairs(exposed.provides) do
    local ok, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, method, false)
    if ok then
      local callback = provider[method]
      if permission == "config.own" then
        members[method] = function(patch)
          if type(patch) ~= "table" then
            error("Config patch inválido", 2)
          end
          for key in pairs(patch) do
            if not entry.owned[key] then
              deny(consumer, "config.write outside owned settings: " .. tostring(key))
            end
          end
          return callback(patch)
        end
      else
        members[method] = function(...)
          local result = table.pack(callback(...))
          if permission == "internal.read" and not contains(exposed.access.references, method) then
            for i = 1, result.n do
              if type(result[i]) == "table" then
                result[i] = readonly(result[i])
              end
            end
          end
          return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  for field in pairs(exposed.data) do
    if canConsume(entry, exposed, field, true) then
      members[field] = readonly(provider[field])
    end
  end
  table.freeze(members)
  local view = {}
  setmetatable(view, {
    __index = function(_, field)
      local value = members[field]
      if value ~= nil then
        return value
      end
      if exposed.provides[field] or exposed.data[field] then
        local _, permission = canConsume(entry, exposed, field, exposed.data[field] == true)
        deny(consumer, entry.family .. " -> " .. permission)
      end
      error("API interna ausente: " .. source .. "." .. tostring(field), 2)
    end,
    __newindex = function(_, field) deny(consumer, "api.write." .. source .. "." .. tostring(field)) end,
  })
  local metatable = getmetatable(view)
  table.freeze(view)
  metatable.__metatable = "locked"
  table.freeze(metatable)
  return view
end

-- resolution
local function resolve(consumer, loaded)
  local entry = registry[consumer]
  if type(loaded) ~= "table" or not entry or entry.module ~= loaded[consumer] then
    error("Permissions: módulo não validado: " .. tostring(consumer), 2)
  end
  local dependencies = {}
  for alias, use in pairs(entry.uses) do
    local provider, source = loaded[use.source], registry[use.source]
    if not source or source.module ~= provider then
      error(("API interna ausente: dependência %s (%s)"):format(alias, use.source), 2)
    end
    if use.minimum and (type(source.version) ~= "number" or source.version < use.minimum) then
      error(("API incompatível: %s requer versão %s; encontrada %s"):format(alias, tostring(use.minimum), tostring(source.version)), 2)
    end
    dependencies[alias] = wrap(consumer, use.source, provider)
  end
  return dependencies
end

-- introspection
local function policy(name)
  local entry = registry[name]
  if not entry then
    error("Permissions: módulo não registrado: " .. tostring(name), 2)
  end
  local result = { family = entry.family, capabilities = table.clone(POLICY.base), provides = {}, dependencies = {} }
  for _, permission in ipairs(POLICY.types[entry.family]) do
    result.capabilities[#result.capabilities + 1] = permission
  end
  table.sort(result.capabilities)
  for method in pairs(entry.provides) do
    result.provides[#result.provides + 1] = method
  end
  table.sort(result.provides)
  for _, use in pairs(entry.uses) do
    result.dependencies[#result.dependencies + 1] = use.source
  end
  table.sort(result.dependencies)
  return result
end

-- public-api
Permissions.configure = configure
Permissions.validate = validate
Permissions.wrap = wrap
Permissions.resolve = resolve
Permissions.policy = policy

-- contract
Permissions.__contract = {
  provides = { "configure", "validate", "wrap", "resolve", "policy" },
  requires = {},
}

return Permissions

-- [[ configuration persistence and recovery ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules persistence

-- code
local Persistence = {}
function Persistence.setup() return true end
function Persistence.create(deps)
  local store = {}
  local state, CONFIG, http = deps.state, deps.config, game:GetService("HttpService")
  local savePending, saveToken, saveDirty, saveRevision, persistenceReady = false, 0, false, 0, false
  function store.ensureDataFolder()
    if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
      error("API externa ausente: makefolder", 2)
    end
    if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
      error("API externa ausente: isfolder", 2)
    end
    local current = ""
    for part in CONFIG.FOLDER:gmatch("[^/]+") do
      current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part
      if not isfolder(current) then
        makefolder(current)
      end
    end
    return true, CONFIG.FOLDER
  end
  local function isPersistentConfigKey(key)
    if key == "AutoExecuteOnJoin" or key == "AutoExecuteAllGames" then
      return false
    end
    return type(key) == "string" and key:sub(1, #CONFIG.SESSION_ONLY_PREFIX) ~= CONFIG.SESSION_ONLY_PREFIX
  end
  local function serializeConfig(config)
    local data = {}
    for key, value in pairs(config) do
      if isPersistentConfigKey(key) then
        if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
          data[key] = value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode and { keyCode = value.Name } or { mouseButton = value.Name }
        else
          data[key] = value
        end
      end
    end
    return http:JSONEncode(data)
  end
  local function persistenceAvailable()
    return type(isfile) == "function"
      and type(readfile) == "function"
      and type(writefile) == "function"
      and type(isfolder) == "function"
      and type(makefolder) == "function"
  end
  local function decodeKeyCode(value)
    if type(value) == "table" and type(value.mouseButton) == "string" then
      local buttons = {
        MouseButton1 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
        MouseButton2 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
        MouseButton3 = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,
      }

      return buttons[value.mouseButton]
    end
    if type(value) ~= "table" or type(value.keyCode) ~= "string" then
      return value
    end
    local name = value.keyCode
    local ok, keyCode = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
    if ok and keyCode then
      return keyCode
    end
    warn("Config ignorada: KeyCode inválido " .. tostring(name))
    return nil
  end
  local function migrateConfig(data)
    local migrated = deps.migrate and deps.migrate(data) or false
    local patch = {}
    for key, value in pairs(data) do
      if not isPersistentConfigKey(key) then
        migrated = true
      else
        value = decodeKeyCode(value)
        if value ~= nil then
          local valid, reason = deps.getConfigModule().validatePatch({ [key] = value })
          if valid then
            patch[key] = value
          else
            warn("Config ignorada: " .. tostring(reason))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return patch, migrated
  end
  local function readSavedConfig(path)
    local checked, exists = pcall(isfile, path)
    if not checked then
      return nil, nil, "inaccessible"
    end
    if not exists then
      return nil, nil, "missing"
    end
    local readOk, raw = pcall(readfile, path)
    if not readOk or type(raw) ~= "string" then
      return nil, nil, "inaccessible"
    end
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not decoded or type(data) ~= "table" or next(data) == nil then
      return nil, nil, "invalid"
    end
    return raw, data, "valid"
  end
  local function writeVerified(path, body)
    local ok = pcall(writefile, path, body)
    if not ok then
      return false
    end
    local raw = readSavedConfig(path)
    return raw == body
  end
  local function backupPath(folder, index) return folder .. "/config_backup_" .. index .. ".json" end
  local function backupAtStartup(folder, body)
    for index = 5, 2, -1 do
      local old = readSavedConfig(backupPath(folder, index - 1))
      if old and not writeVerified(backupPath(folder, index), old) then
        return false
      end
    end
    return writeVerified(backupPath(folder, 1), body)
  end
  local function writeConfig()
    if not persistenceReady or not saveDirty then
      return
    end
    local revision = saveRevision
    local _, folder = store.ensureDataFolder()
    local path = folder .. "/config.json"
    local body = serializeConfig(state.config)
    local decoded, data = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(body) end)
    if not decoded or type(data) ~= "table" or next(data) == nil then
      warn("Configuração vazia ou inválida; arquivo anterior preservado")
      return
    end
    local previous, _, status = readSavedConfig(path)
    if status == "inaccessible" then
      warn("Configuração inacessível; salvamento suspenso")
      return
    end
    if status == "invalid" then
      warn("Configuração inválida; salvamento suspenso para evitar perda")
      return
    end
    if previous and not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", previous) then
      warn("Falha ao proteger configuração anterior; salvamento suspenso")
      return
    end
    if not previous then
      local recovery, _, recoveryStatus = readSavedConfig(folder .. "/config_recovery.json")
      if not recovery and recoveryStatus ~= "missing" then
        warn("Backup de recuperação inacessível ou inválido; salvamento suspenso")
        return
      end
      if not recovery and not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", body) then
        warn("Falha ao criar proteção inicial; salvamento suspenso")
        return
      end
    end
    if not writeVerified(path, body) then
      warn("Falha ao salvar configuração; cópia anterior preservada")
      return
    end
    if saveRevision == revision then
      saveDirty = false
    end
  end
  local saveRunning = false
  local queueSave
  local function saveConfig()
    if saveRunning then
      return
    end
    saveRunning = true
    local revision = saveRevision
    local ok, reason = pcall(writeConfig)
    saveRunning = false
    if not ok then
      warn("Falha ao salvar configuração: " .. tostring(reason))
    end
    if saveDirty and saveRevision ~= revision and persistenceReady then
      queueSave()
    end
  end
  queueSave = function()
    if not persistenceReady then
      return
    end
    saveDirty = true
    saveRevision += 1
    if savePending then
      return
    end
    savePending = true
    saveToken += 1
    local token = saveToken
    task.delay(0.25, function()
      if token ~= saveToken then
        return
      end
      savePending = false
      saveConfig()
    end)
  end
  local function flushSave()
    saveToken += 1
    savePending = false
    saveConfig()
  end
  function store.load()
    if not persistenceAvailable() then
      warn("Persistência indisponível; usando configuração da sessão")
      return true
    end
    local ok, folder = pcall(function()
      local _, path = store.ensureDataFolder()
      return path
    end)
    if not ok then
      warn("Persistência indisponível: " .. tostring(folder))
      return true
    end
    local path = folder .. "/config.json"
    local raw, data, status = readSavedConfig(path)
    local recovered, anyStored = false, status ~= "missing"
    if not raw then
      for index = 0, 5 do
        local backup = index == 0 and (folder .. "/config_recovery.json") or backupPath(folder, index)
        local saved, value, backupStatus = readSavedConfig(backup)
        if backupStatus ~= "missing" then
          anyStored = true
        end
        if saved then
          raw, data, recovered = saved, value, true
          break
        end
      end
    end
    if not raw then
      if anyStored then
        warn("Nenhuma configuração válida pôde ser recuperada; salvamento suspenso para preservar os arquivos")
        return true
      end
      persistenceReady = true
      return true
    end
    if recovered then
      if status == "inaccessible" then
        warn("Configuração recuperada em memória; arquivo principal inacessível, salvamento suspenso")
        local patch = migrateConfig(data)
        deps.setConfig(patch)
        return true
      end
      if not writeVerified(path, raw) then
        warn("Configuração recuperada em memória; falha ao restaurar arquivo, salvamento suspenso")
        local patch = migrateConfig(data)
        deps.setConfig(patch)
        return true
      end
      warn("Configuração restaurada de um backup")
    end
    if not backupAtStartup(folder, raw) then
      warn("Falha ao criar backup de entrada; salvamento suspenso")
      local patch = migrateConfig(data)
      deps.setConfig(patch)
      return true
    end
    if not writeVerified(folder .. "/config_recovery.json", raw) then
      warn("Falha ao preparar recuperação; salvamento suspenso")
      local patch = migrateConfig(data)
      deps.setConfig(patch)
      return true
    end
    local patch, migrated = migrateConfig(data)
    deps.setConfig(patch)
    persistenceReady = true
    if migrated then
      queueSave()
    end
    return true
  end
  store.isPersistentKey = isPersistentConfigKey
  store.queue = queueSave
  store.flush = flushSave
  function store.stop()
    flushSave()
    persistenceReady, saveDirty = false, false
    saveToken += 1
    savePending = false
  end
  return store
end
Persistence.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }

return Persistence
