-- [[ server location sources ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules serverlocation

local Location = {}
local scope, result, failure
-- Region codes identify the datacenter area, not precise street coordinates.
local regions = {
  AMS = { "Países Baixos", "Amsterdã" },
  BOM = { "Índia", "Mumbai" },
  CDG = { "França", "Paris" },
  DFW = { "Estados Unidos", "Dallas" },
  FRA = { "Alemanha", "Frankfurt" },
  GRU = { "Brasil", "São Paulo" },
  HKG = { "Hong Kong", "Hong Kong" },
  IAD = { "Estados Unidos", "Ashburn" },
  LAX = { "Estados Unidos", "Los Angeles" },
  LHR = { "Reino Unido", "Londres" },
  MIA = { "Estados Unidos", "Miami" },
  NRT = { "Japão", "Tóquio" },
  ORD = { "Estados Unidos", "Chicago" },
  SEA = { "Estados Unidos", "Seattle" },
  SIN = { "Singapura", "Singapura" },
  SJC = { "Estados Unidos", "San Jose" },
  SYD = { "Austrália", "Sydney" },
  WAW = { "Polônia", "Varsóvia" },
}
local function text(value)
  if type(value) == "string" and value:match("%S") then
    return value
  end
  return nil
end
local function publicIP(value)
  if type(value) ~= "string" then
    return nil
  end
  local ip = value:match("^(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)[|:]?%d*$")
  if not ip then
    return nil
  end
  local octets = {}
  for part in ip:gmatch("%d+") do
    local n = tonumber(part)
    if not n or n > 255 then
      return nil
    end
    octets[#octets + 1] = n
  end
  local a, b = octets[1], octets[2]
  if
    a == 0
    or a == 10
    or a == 127
    or a >= 224
    or (a == 100 and b >= 64 and b <= 127)
    or (a == 169 and b == 254)
    or (a == 172 and b >= 16 and b <= 31)
    or (a == 192 and b == 168)
    or (a == 192 and b == 0)
    or (a == 198 and (b == 18 or b == 19 or b == 51))
    or (a == 203 and b == 0)
  then
    return nil
  end
  return ip
end
local function attribute(object, name)
  local ok, value = pcall(function()
    local current = object:GetAttribute(name)
    if current ~= nil then
      return current
    end
    local child = object:FindFirstChild(name)
    return child and child:IsA("StringValue") and child.Value or nil
  end)
  return ok and text(value) or nil
end
function Location.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  return true
end
function Location.setup(deps)
  Location.teardown()
  scope, result, failure = deps.Lifetime.scope(), {}, nil
  local owner = scope
  local environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local request = environment.request or environment.http_request or (environment.syn and environment.syn.request)
  local function fetch(url)
    local raw
    if type(request) == "function" then
      local response = request({ Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 5 })
      assert(type(response) == "table" and (response.StatusCode == nil or response.StatusCode == 200), "HTTP lookup failed")
      raw = response.Body
    else
      raw = game:HttpGet(url)
    end
    return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw)
  end
  local resolving, peer = false, nil
  local samples, localCountry = {}, nil
  local function resolve(value)
    local ip = publicIP(value)
    if not owner.alive or not ip or resolving or (result.country and result.city) then
      return
    end
    resolving, peer = true, ip
    -- Always pass the verified peer address. An empty URL would locate the user.
    for _, url in ipairs({ "https://ipwho.is/" .. ip, "https://ipapi.co/" .. ip .. "/json/" }) do
      task.spawn(function()
        if not owner.alive then
          return
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(fetch, url)
        if not owner.alive or not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or data.ip ~= ip or data.success == false or data.error then
          return
        end
        if result.estimated then
          result = {}
        end
        result.source = "Geolocalização do endereço do servidor"
        result.country = result.country or text(data.country_name) or text(data.country)
        result.city = result.city or text(data.city)
        if result.country and result.city then
          failure = nil
        end
      end)
    end
    task.delay(10, function()
      if owner.alive and not (result.country and result.city) then
        resolving = false
      end
    end)
  end
  local function readMetadata()
    local ok, code = pcall(function() return game.ServerRegion end)
    local native = ok and text(code) and regions[string.upper(code)]
    if native then
      result = { country = native[1], city = native[2], source = "Região publicada pelo servidor" }
    end
    for _, object in ipairs({ game, game:GetService("Workspace"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") }) do
      if result.estimated and (attribute(object, "ServerCountry") or attribute(object, "ServerRegion")) then
        result = {}
      end
      result.country = result.country or attribute(object, "ServerCountry")
      result.city = result.city or attribute(object, "ServerCity")
      local region = attribute(object, "ServerRegion")
      local mapped = region and regions[string.upper(region)]
      if mapped then
        result.country, result.city = result.country or mapped[1], result.city or mapped[2]
      end
      if result.country and result.city then
        failure = nil
      end
    end
  end
  pcall(readMetadata)
  task.spawn(function()
    if not owner.alive then
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      local network = game:GetService("NetworkClient")
      owner.connect(network.ConnectionAccepted, function(peer) resolve(peer) end)
    end)
    -- Logs are useful only when they identify this exact session. Never use an
    -- arbitrary IP from output, an old join, player country, or a join-ticket API.
    pcall(function()
      local logs = game:GetService("LogService"):GetLogHistory()
      local current = false
      for _, record in ipairs(logs) do
        local message = record.message or ""
        local job = message:match("! Joining game '([^']*)'")
        if job then
          current = job == game.JobId
        end
        if current then
          local address = message:match("UDMUX Address = (%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
            or message:match("Connecting to UDMUX server (%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
            or message:match("Connection accepted from (%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)")
          if address then
            resolve(address)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end)
  for _, service in ipairs({ "Workspace", "ReplicatedStorage" }) do
    pcall(function()
      local object = game:GetService(service)
      for _, name in ipairs({ "ServerCountry", "ServerCity", "ServerRegion" }) do
        owner.connect(object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name), readMetadata)
      end
    end)
  end
  -- Client geolocation is only a fallback country hint, never server-city evidence.
  local function estimate()
    if not owner.alive or (result.country and not result.estimated) then
      return
    end
    local stable = #samples >= 20
    local low, high = math.huge, 0
    for _, ping in ipairs(samples) do
      low, high = math.min(low, ping), math.max(high, ping)
    end
    stable = stable and high <= 60 and high - low <= 15
    if stable and localCountry then
      result = { country = localCountry, estimated = true, source = "Estimativa: país da conexão e ping baixo estável" }
      failure = nil
    elseif result.estimated then
      result = {}
    end
  end
  pcall(function()
    local elapsed = 0
    owner.connect(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(dt)
      elapsed += dt
      if elapsed < 1 then
        return
      end
      elapsed = 0
      local ok, ping = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
      if ok and type(ping) == "number" and ping == ping and ping > 0 and ping < math.huge then
        samples[#samples + 1] = ping
        if #samples > 20 then
          table.remove(samples, 1)
        end
      else
        table.clear(samples)
      end
      estimate()
    end)
  end)
  task.delay(8, function()
    if owner.alive and not (result.country and result.city) then
      failure = "Localização ainda não confirmada."
      task.spawn(function()
        for _, url in ipairs({ "https://ipwho.is/", "https://ipapi.co/json/" }) do
          if not owner.alive then
            return
          end
          local ok, data = pcall(fetch, url)
          if owner.alive and ok and type(data) == "table" and data.success ~= false and not data.error then
            localCountry = text(data.country_name) or text(data.country)
            if localCountry then
              estimate()
              break
            end
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  local function retryMetadata()
    if not owner.alive then
      return
    end
    pcall(readMetadata)
    if peer then
      resolve(peer)
    end
    task.delay(30, retryMetadata)
  end
  task.delay(30, retryMetadata)
  return true
end
function Location.snapshot() return table.clone(result or {}), failure end
Location.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { snapshot = "internal.read" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "snapshot" },
  requires = { Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = { Lifetime = { "scope" } },
}
return Location
sources.core/session.luau:
-- [[ session ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules state, utils

-- code
local __part_state = (function()
  local State = {}
  function State.setup() return true end
  function State.create()
    return {
      active = false,
      config = {},
      urls = {},
      globalConnections = {},
      characterConnections = {},
      dynamicSpam = false,
      manualSpam = false,
      autoSpam = false,
      lifecycle = {
        phase = "stopped",
        generation = 0,
        startedAt = 0,
        stoppedAt = 0,
      },
      diagnostics = { errors = {}, transitions = {}, lastTransitionAt = 0 },
    }
  end
  local function copy(value, visited)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
      return value
    end
    visited = visited or {}
    if visited[value] then
      return visited[value]
    end
    local result = {}
    visited[value] = result
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
      result[copy(key, visited)] = copy(item, visited)
    end
    return result
  end
  function State.copy(value) return copy(value) end
  State.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create", "copy" } }
  return State
end)()
local __part_utils = (function()
  local Utils = {}
  local players = game:GetService("Players")
  local replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
  local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
  local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
  local state
  local stateModule
  local persistence
  local diagnostics
  local refreshNamespace
  local configModule, modules = nil, {}
  local connectionIndexes = { global = {}, character = {} }
  local observerIndexes = { spam = {}, config = {} }
  local spamObservers, configObservers = {}, {}
  local CONFIG = {
    API_VERSION = 1,
    VERSION = "2.0.0",
    NAME = "Exodus Hub",
    AUTHOR = "deltapolinha_2915",
    FOLDER = "Exodus Hub",
    HISTORY_LIMIT = 32,
    SESSION_ONLY_PREFIX = "Universal",
  }

  local function snapshot(value) return type(value) == "table" and stateModule.copy(value) or {} end
  local function setValues(target, source)
    for key, value in pairs(source or {}) do
      target[key] = value
    end
  end
  local function connectObserver(list, indexMap, observer)
    if type(observer) ~= "function" then
      error("Observer precisa ser uma função", 2)
    end
    local connection = { Connected = true, callback = observer }
    list[#list + 1] = connection
    indexMap[connection] = #list
    function connection:Disconnect()
      if not self.Connected then
        return
      end
      self.Connected = false
      local index = indexMap[self]
      if not index then
        return
      end
      local lastIndex = #list
      local last = list[lastIndex]
      list[index] = last
      list[lastIndex] = nil
      indexMap[self] = nil
      if last and last ~= self then
        indexMap[last] = index
      end
    end
    return connection
  end
  local function notify(list, value)
    if #list == 0 then
      return
    end
    for _, observer in ipairs(table.clone(list)) do
      if observer.Connected then
        local ok, err = pcall(observer.callback, value)
        if not ok and type(warn) == "function" then
          warn("Falha ao notificar observador: " .. tostring(err))
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function Utils.observeSpam(observer) return connectObserver(spamObservers, observerIndexes.spam, observer) end
  function Utils.observeConfig(observer) return connectObserver(configObservers, observerIndexes.config, observer) end
  local function track(list, indexMap, connection)
    if not connection or type(connection.Disconnect) ~= "function" then
      error("Conexão inválida", 2)
    end
    if not indexMap[connection] then
      list[#list + 1] = connection
      indexMap[connection] = #list
    end
    return connection
  end
  local function untrack(list, indexMap, connection)
    local index = indexMap[connection]
    if not index then
      return false
    end
    local lastIndex = #list
    local last = list[lastIndex]
    list[index] = last
    list[lastIndex] = nil
    indexMap[connection] = nil
    if last and last ~= connection then
      indexMap[last] = index
    end
    return true
  end
  local function disconnectAll(list, indexMap)
    while #list > 0 do
      local connection = list[#list]
      untrack(list, indexMap, connection)
      local ok, err = pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
      if not ok and type(warn) == "function" then
        warn("Falha ao desconectar: " .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
  local function lifecycleSnapshot()
    local result = snapshot(state.lifecycle)
    result.schema, result.generatedAt = CONFIG.API_VERSION, os.clock()
    return result
  end
  local function stateSnapshot()
    return {
      schema = CONFIG.API_VERSION,
      generatedAt = os.clock(),
      active = state.active,
      manualSpamActive = state.manualSpam,
      autoSpamActive = state.autoSpam,
      lifecycle = snapshot(state.lifecycle),
      config = snapshot(state.config),
      moduleURLs = snapshot(state.urls),
      connectionCounts = {
        global = #state.globalConnections,
        character = #state.characterConnections,
      },
    }
  end
  local function diagnosticsSnapshot() return diagnostics.snapshot() end
  refreshNamespace = function()
    if not state then
      return
    end
    local namespace = type(_G.Exodus) == "table" and _G.Exodus or {}
    namespace.Name, namespace.InternalName, namespace.Version, namespace.ApiVersion, namespace.Author =
      CONFIG.NAME, "Exodus", CONFIG.VERSION, CONFIG.API_VERSION, CONFIG.AUTHOR
    namespace.State, namespace.Config, namespace.ModuleURLs, namespace.Diagnostics =
      stateSnapshot(), snapshot(state.config), snapshot(state.urls), diagnostics.snapshot(false)
    _G.Exodus = namespace
  end
  local function recordTransition(...) return diagnostics.recordTransition(...) end
  function Utils.ensureDataFolder() return persistence.ensureDataFolder() end
  function Utils.loadConfig() return persistence.load() end
  function Utils.configure(deps)
    local profile = deps.GameContext.getProfile()
    CONFIG.AUTHOR = profile.author or "deltapolinha_2915"
    CONFIG.FOLDER = profile.dataFolder or "Exodus Hub/hubs/" .. (profile.id or "universal")
    stateModule = deps.State
    state = stateModule.create()
    diagnostics = deps.Diagnostics.create({
      state = state,
      config = CONFIG,
      snapshot = snapshot,
      lifecycleSnapshot = lifecycleSnapshot,
      getModules = function() return modules end,
      refresh = function() refreshNamespace() end,
    })
    persistence = deps.Persistence.create({
      state = state,
      config = CONFIG,
      getConfigModule = function() return configModule end,
      setConfig = Utils.setConfig,
      migrate = deps.Hub.migrateConfig,
    })
    return true
  end
  function Utils.start()
    _G.ExodusStop = Utils.stop
    local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
    state.active = true
    state.lifecycle.generation += 1
    state.lifecycle.startedAt, state.lifecycle.stoppedAt, state.lifecycle.phase = os.clock(), 0, "starting"
    recordTransition("Utils", previous, "starting", "start")
    refreshNamespace()
    return stateSnapshot()
  end
  function Utils.stop()
    if not state or not state.active then
      return true
    end
    local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
    local wasActive = state.active
    local shutdownReason = _G.ExodusShutdownReason
    state.active = false
    if type(_G.ExodusUIFadeOut) == "function" then
      local ok, err = pcall(_G.ExodusUIFadeOut, shutdownReason == "update" or shutdownReason == "reload")
      if not ok then
        warn("Falha ao animar fechamento: " .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
    state.lifecycle.generation += 1
    state.active, state.manualSpam, state.autoSpam, state.dynamicSpam = false, false, false, false
    local notified, notifyError = pcall(notify, spamObservers)
    if not notified then
      warn("Failed to notify observers: " .. tostring(notifyError))
    end
    local saved, saveError = pcall(persistence.stop)
    if not saved then
      warn("Failed to save configuration: " .. tostring(saveError))
    end
    state.lifecycle.stoppedAt = os.clock()
    if type(_G.ExodusUICleanup) == "function" then
      local cleaned, cleanupError = pcall(_G.ExodusUICleanup)
      if not cleaned then
        warn("Falha ao limpar interface: " .. tostring(cleanupError))
      end
    end
    disconnectAll(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character)
    disconnectAll(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global)
    state.config, state.urls, modules = {}, {}, {}
    disconnectAll(spamObservers, observerIndexes.spam)
    disconnectAll(configObservers, observerIndexes.config)
    if type(_G.Exodus) == "table" then
      local exodus = _G.Exodus
      exodus.Started, exodus.UIReady, exodus.Runtime, exodus.UI, exodus.Context = false, false, nil, nil, nil

    end
    state.lifecycle.phase = "stopped"
    recordTransition("Utils", previous, "stopped", "stop")
    if wasActive and shutdownReason ~= "update" and shutdownReason ~= "restart" and type(print) == "function" then
      print("[Exodus] Closed.")
    end
    refreshNamespace()
    return true
  end
  function Utils.isActive() return state.active end
  function Utils.getStateSnapshot() return stateSnapshot() end
  function Utils.getConfig() return snapshot(state.config) end
  function Utils.getConfigValue(key) return state.config[key] end
  function Utils.getConfigSnapshot() return snapshot(state.config) end
  function Utils.getModuleURLsSnapshot() return snapshot(state.urls) end
  function Utils.getLifecycle() return lifecycleSnapshot() end
  function Utils.getDiagnostics() return diagnosticsSnapshot() end
  function Utils.setDiagnosticsModules(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
      error("Módulos de diagnóstico inválidos", 2)
    end
    modules = table.clone(value)
    refreshNamespace()
    return true
  end
  function Utils.setLifecyclePhase(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
      return false
    end
    local previous = state.lifecycle.phase
    if previous ~= value then
      state.lifecycle.phase = value
      recordTransition("Lifecycle", previous, value, "phase_change")
    end
    return true
  end
  function Utils.recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason) recordTransition(source, fromState, toState, reason) end
  function Utils.recordError(source, message) return diagnostics.recordError(source, message) end
  function Utils.isManualSpamActive() return state.manualSpam end
  function Utils.isAutoSpamActive() return state.autoSpam end
  function Utils.isDynamicSpamActive() return state.dynamicSpam end
  function Utils.isSpamActive() return state.manualSpam or state.autoSpam or state.dynamicSpam end
  local function setSpam(key, value, source, reason)
    value = value == true
    if state[key] == value then
      return false
    end
    local previous = state[key]
    state[key] = value
    notify(spamObservers)
    recordTransition(source, previous and "active" or "inactive", value and "active" or "inactive", reason)
    return true
  end
  function Utils.setManualSpamActive(value) return setSpam("manualSpam", value, "Spam", "manual_toggle") end
  function Utils.setDynamicSpamActive(value) return setSpam("dynamicSpam", value, "DynamicParry", "manual_gesture") end
  function Utils.setAutoSpamActive(value) return setSpam("autoSpam", value, "AutoSpam", "automatic_toggle") end
  function Utils.stopAllSpam()
    local changed = state.manualSpam or state.autoSpam or state.dynamicSpam
    state.manualSpam, state.autoSpam, state.dynamicSpam = false, false, false
    if changed then
      notify(spamObservers)
    end
    return true
  end
  function Utils.isFiniteNumber(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
  function Utils.isNonNegativeFiniteNumber(value) return Utils.isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0 end
  function Utils.normalizeSpamRate(value, fallback)
    local rate = tonumber(value)
    if not Utils.isFiniteNumber(rate) then
      rate = tonumber(fallback)
    end
    if not Utils.isFiniteNumber(rate) then
      rate = 0
    end
    return math.max(rate, 0)
  end
  function Utils.setConfig(patch)
    if type(patch) ~= "table" then
      error("Config patch inválido: esperado table", 2)
    end
    local normalized
    if configModule then
      local result, reason = configModule.normalizePatch(patch)
      if type(result) ~= "table" then
        error("Config inválida: " .. tostring(reason), 2)
      end
      normalized = result
    else
      normalized = snapshot(patch)
    end
    local changes, persistentChanged = {}, false
    for key, value in pairs(normalized) do
      if state.config[key] ~= value then
        state.config[key], changes[key] = value, value
        if persistence.isPersistentKey(key) then
          persistentChanged = true
        end
      end
    end
    if next(changes) == nil then
      return true
    end
    notify(configObservers, changes)
    if changes.SpamRateMode ~= nil or changes.CPS ~= nil or changes.CPF ~= nil or changes.MS ~= nil then
      notify(spamObservers)
    end
    refreshNamespace()
    if persistentChanged then
      persistence.queue()
    end
    return true
  end
  function Utils.resetConfig()
    if not configModule or type(configModule.defaults) ~= "function" then
      error("Config defaults indisponíveis", 2)
    end
    local defaults = configModule.defaults()
    local normalized, reason = configModule.normalizePatch(defaults)
    if type(normalized) ~= "table" then
      error("Config defaults inválidos: " .. tostring(reason), 2)
    end
    state.config = normalized
    notify(configObservers, snapshot(normalized))
    notify(spamObservers)
    refreshNamespace()
    persistence.queue()
    persistence.flush()
    return true
  end
  function Utils.setConfigModule(module)
    if
      type(module) ~= "table"
      or type(module.normalizePatch) ~= "function"
      or type(module.validate) ~= "function"
      or type(module.validatePatch) ~= "function"
      or type(module.defaults) ~= "function"
    then
      error("API interna ausente: Config.normalizePatch/validate/validatePatch/defaults", 2)
    end
    configModule = module
    return true
  end
  function Utils.setModuleURLs(urls)
    if type(urls) ~= "table" then
      error("URLs de módulos inválidas", 2)
    end
    setValues(state.urls, urls)
    refreshNamespace()
    return true
  end
  function Utils.trackGlobal(connection) return track(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global, connection) end
  function Utils.untrackGlobal(connection) return untrack(state.globalConnections, connectionIndexes.global, connection) end
  function Utils.trackCharacter(connection) return track(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character, connection) end
  function Utils.untrackCharacter(connection) return untrack(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character, connection) end
  function Utils.disconnectCharacterConnections() disconnectAll(state.characterConnections, connectionIndexes.character) end
  function Utils.getPlayers() return players end
  function Utils.getReplicatedStorage() return replicated end
  function Utils.getRunService() return runService end
  function Utils.getWorkspace() return workspace end
  function Utils.getLocalPlayer() return players.LocalPlayer end
  function Utils.now() return os.clock() end
  function Utils.name() return CONFIG.NAME end
  function Utils.version() return CONFIG.VERSION end
  function Utils.apiVersion() return CONFIG.API_VERSION end
  function Utils.author() return CONFIG.AUTHOR end
  Utils.__contract = {
    access = {
      default = "infrastructure.write",
      methods = {
        now = "internal.read",
        apiVersion = "internal.read",
        name = "internal.read",
        author = "internal.read",
        version = "internal.read",
        setConfig = "config.write",
        resetConfig = "config.write",
        loadConfig = "config.write",
        setManualSpamActive = "manual.input.write",
        setAutoSpamActive = "combat.runtime",
        setDynamicSpamActive = "combat.runtime",
        stopAllSpam = "input.stop",
        stop = "hub.control",
        start = "hub.control",
        ensureDataFolder = "tooling.execute",
        disconnectCharacterConnections = "lifecycle.write",
        recordError = "diagnostics.write",
        recordTransition = "diagnostics.write",
      },
      scoped = { "setConfig" },
    },
    requires = {
      GameContext = "gamecontext",
      Hub = "hubapi",
      State = "state",
      Persistence = "persistence",
      Diagnostics = "diagnostics",
    },
    requiresMethods = {
      GameContext = { "getProfile" },
      Hub = { "migrateConfig" },
      State = { "create", "copy" },
      Persistence = { "create" },
      Diagnostics = { "create" },
    },
    provides = {
      "configure",
      "start",
      "stop",
      "ensureDataFolder",
      "loadConfig",
      "getDiagnostics",
      "getLifecycle",
      "isFiniteNumber",
      "isNonNegativeFiniteNumber",
      "isActive",
      "getConfig",
      "getConfigValue",
      "setConfig",
      "resetConfig",
      "setConfigModule",
      "setModuleURLs",
      "setDiagnosticsModules",
      "setLifecyclePhase",
      "getStateSnapshot",
      "getConfigSnapshot",
      "getModuleURLsSnapshot",
      "getPlayers",
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "getRunService",
      "getReplicatedStorage",
      "getWorkspace",
      "now",
      "apiVersion",
      "name",
      "author",
      "version",
      "trackGlobal",
      "untrackGlobal",
      "trackCharacter",
      "untrackCharacter",
      "disconnectCharacterConnections",
      "recordError",
      "recordTransition",
      "isSpamActive",
      "isDynamicSpamActive",
      "setDynamicSpamActive",
      "isManualSpamActive",

      "setManualSpamActive",
      "setAutoSpamActive",

  }

-- [[ automatic updates ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules updates

local Updates = {}
local utils, hub
local transport
local generation = 0
local checking = false
local pending
local CONFIG = { POLL_SECONDS = 300, SAFE_SECONDS = 0.4, STATE_INTERVAL = 0.1 }

function Updates.teardown()
  generation += 1
  checking, pending, transport = false, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Updates.setup(deps)
  Updates.teardown()
  utils, hub = deps.Utils, deps.Hub
  return true
end
function Updates.awaitSafe(isCurrent)
  local safeSince
  while utils and utils.isActive() and (not isCurrent or isCurrent()) do
    if hub.canUpdate() then
      safeSince = safeSince or os.clock()
      if os.clock() - safeSince >= CONFIG.SAFE_SECONDS then
        return true
      end
    else
      safeSince = nil
    end
    task.wait(CONFIG.STATE_INTERVAL)
  end
  return false
end
function Updates.check()
  if checking or not transport or not utils.isActive() then
    return false
  end
  checking = true
  local owner, channel = generation, transport
  local function current() return owner == generation and utils.isActive() end
  local ok, reason = xpcall(function()
    local revision, err = channel.latest()
    if not current() then
      return
    end
    if not revision then
      error(err, 0)
    end
    if revision == _G.ExodusLastLoadedRevision then
      return
    end
    pending = revision
    local chunk, prepareError = channel.prepare(revision)
    if not chunk then
      error(prepareError, 0)
    end
    if not current() then
      return
    end
    -- The replacement downloads first, then rechecks the policy before stopping this session.
    _G.ExodusRequestedRevision = { revision = revision, automatic = true }
    chunk()
  end, function(err) return debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2) end)
  if owner == generation then
    checking = false
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("Updates", reason)
    end
  end
  return ok
end
function Updates.start(channel)
  assert(type(channel.latest) == "function" and type(channel.prepare) == "function", "Missing update transport")
  transport = channel
  local owner = generation
  local function schedule()
    task.delay(CONFIG.POLL_SECONDS, function()
      if owner ~= generation or not utils.isActive() then
        return
      end
      if utils.getConfigValue("AutoExecute") == true then
        Updates.check()
      end
      if owner == generation and utils.isActive() then
        schedule()
      end
    end)
  end
  schedule()
  return true
end
function Updates.getStatus() return { checking = checking, revision = pending } end
Updates.__config = { schema = { AutoExecute = "boolean" }, defaults = { AutoExecute = true } }
Updates.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "start", "check", "awaitSafe", "getStatus" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Hub = "hubapi" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "isActive", "getConfigValue", "recordError" }, Hub = { "canUpdate" } },
}
return Updates

-- [[ uiactions ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiactions

-- module
local Actions = {}
local Utils
local GameInfo
local Dumper

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  AFK_INTERVAL = 20,
  CONFIRM_SECONDS = 3,
}

-- setup
function Actions.setup(deps)
  Utils, GameInfo, Dumper = deps.Utils, deps.Hub, deps.Dumper
  return true
end

-- actions
function Actions.create(context)
  local scope, controls = context.scope, context.controls
  local shortcuts = {}
  local handles, callbacks, states = {}, {}, {}
  local antiConnection, antiGeneration = nil, 0
  local resetPending, resetGeneration = false, 0
  local function notify(message, important)
    if scope.alive then
      context.notify(message, important)
    end
  end
  local function persistent(message, kind, duration)
    if scope.alive then
      context.persistent(message, "dumper", kind, duration)
    end
  end
  local function invoke(name, ...)
    if type(controls[name]) == "function" then
      return controls[name](...)
    end
  end
  callbacks.panic = function()
    context.setSpam(false)
    invoke("onPanic")
  end
  callbacks.upDash = function()
    local available, reason = GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability("dash")
    if not available then
      notify(reason)
      return
    end
    invoke("onUpDash")
  end
  callbacks.rejoin = function() invoke("onRejoin") end
  callbacks.serverHop = function() invoke("onServerHop") end
  callbacks.resetCharacter = function()
    local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
      humanoid.Health = 0
    else
      notify("Personagem indisponível", true)
    end
  end
  callbacks.resetSettings = function()
    local handle = handles.resetSettings
    if not resetPending then
      resetPending = true
      resetGeneration += 1
      local revision = resetGeneration
      handle.setText("Tap again to confirm")
      task.delay(CONFIG.CONFIRM_SECONDS, function()
        if scope.alive and revision == resetGeneration then
          resetPending = false
          handle.setText("Reset settings")
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    resetPending = false
    resetGeneration += 1
    local ok, result = pcall(Utils.resetConfig)
    if not ok or not result then
      notify("Reset failed", true)
      warn("[Exodus] Reset settings: " .. tostring(result))
      handle.setText("Reset settings")
      return
    end
    context.rebuild(true)
  end
  callbacks.dumper = function()
    persistent("Dumping...", "info")
    if Dumper.isRunning() then
      return
    end
    local accepted, reason = Dumper.start({
      onStatus = function(message) persistent(tostring(message), "info") end,
      onProgress = function(processed, total) persistent(("Dumping... %d/%d"):format(processed, total), "info") end,
      onComplete = function(result)
        persistent(
          ("Dump completed: %d saved, %d failed (%d recovered)."):format(result.saved, result.failed, result.recovered or 0),
          result.failed > 0 and "warning" or "success",
          5
        )
      end,
      onCanceled = function() persistent("Dumping canceled.", "warning", 1.5) end,
      onError = function(message)
        warn("[Exodus Dumper] " .. tostring(message))
        persistent("Dumper failed. Check the console.", "critical", 2.5)
      end,
    })
    if not accepted then
      warn("[Exodus Dumper] " .. tostring(reason))
      persistent("Dumper is already running.", "warning", 2)
    end
  end
  states.antiAFK = function() return antiConnection ~= nil end
  callbacks.antiAFK = function(enabled)
    if enabled == (antiConnection ~= nil) then
      return true
    end
    antiGeneration += 1
    if antiConnection then
      scope.remove(antiConnection)
      antiConnection = nil
    end
    if not enabled then
      return true
    end
    local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local ok, virtualUser = pcall(game.GetService, game, "VirtualUser")
    if not player then
      Utils.recordError("AntiAFK", "Player unavailable")
      return false
    end
    local function pulse()
      local inputOk, err = pcall(function()
        if not ok or not virtualUser then
          error("VirtualUser unavailable")
        end
        virtualUser:CaptureController()
        virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0, 0))
      end)
      if not inputOk then
        local fallback, fallbackErr = pcall(function()
          local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
          vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, true, game, 0)
          vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, false, game, 0)
        end)
        if not fallback then
          Utils.recordError("AntiAFK", tostring(err) .. " | " .. tostring(fallbackErr))
        end
      end
    end
    antiConnection = scope.connect(player.Idled, pulse)
    local generation = antiGeneration
    task.spawn(function()
      while scope.alive and generation == antiGeneration and Utils.isActive() do
        task.wait(CONFIG.AFK_INTERVAL)
        if scope.alive and generation == antiGeneration and Utils.isActive() then
          pulse()
        end
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  local gameActions = GameInfo.createActions(context)
  for name, callback in pairs(gameActions.callbacks or {}) do
    assert(not callbacks[name], "Duplicate game action: " .. name)
    callbacks[name] = callback
  end
  for name, read in pairs(gameActions.states or {}) do
    states[name] = read
  end
  callbacks.manualSpam = function(enabled)
    if context.desktop then
      if Utils.getConfigValue("ManualSpamMode") ~= "Hold" then
        context.setSpam(enabled)
      end
    else
      context.showMini(enabled)
    end
    return true
  end
  states.manualSpam = function()
    if context.desktop then
      return Utils.isManualSpamActive()
    end
    return Utils.getConfigValue("MiniSpamVisible") == true
  end
  local after = {
    AutoDark = function() invoke("onAutoDarkChanged") end,
    AutoJump = function() invoke("onAutoJumpChanged") end,
    ForcePCUI = function() context.rebuild() end,
  }

  local result = {}
  function result.resolve(definition)
    definition.toast = false
    definition.expandedDescription = context.desktop and definition.desktopExpanded == true
    if not context.desktop then
      definition.shortcutKey = nil
    end
    if definition.action == "notifications" then
      definition.key = context.desktop and "DesktopNotifications" or "MobileNotifications"
    end
    if definition.action == "manualSpam" and not context.desktop then
      definition.key = "MiniSpamVisible"
    end
    if definition.action then
      assert(definition.action == "notifications" or callbacks[definition.action], "Unknown UI action: " .. tostring(definition.action))
      definition.onClick = callbacks[definition.action]
      definition.onChange = callbacks[definition.action]
      definition.getState = states[definition.action]
    end
    if definition.feature then
      definition.onChange = function(value) invoke(definition.kind == "toggle" and "onUniversalToggle" or "onUniversalValue", definition.feature, value) end
    elseif after[definition.key] then
      definition.onChange = after[definition.key]
    end
    return definition
  end
  function result.attach(definition, handle)
    if gameActions.attach then
      gameActions.attach(definition, handle)
    end
    if definition.action then
      handles[definition.action] = handle
    end
    if definition.shortcutKey then
      local entry = { definition = definition, handle = handle }
      if definition.action == "panic" then
        table.insert(shortcuts, 1, entry)
      else
        shortcuts[#shortcuts + 1] = entry
      end
    end
  end
  function result.validateShortcut(key, binding)
    if binding == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      return true
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      local definition = entry.definition
      if definition.shortcutKey ~= key and Utils.getConfigValue(definition.shortcutKey) == binding then
        return false, "Shortcut already used: " .. definition.title
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function result.triggerShortcut(binding)
    if binding == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      return false
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(shortcuts) do
      local definition, handle = entry.definition, entry.handle
      if Utils.getConfigValue(definition.shortcutKey) == binding then
        if definition.abilityOnly and context.abilitiesEnabled and not context.abilitiesEnabled() then
          return false
        end
        if not handle.activate or not handle.activate() then
          return false
        end
        if definition.action ~= "manualSpam" and definition.action ~= "upDash" then
          local message = definition.title
          if definition.kind == "toggle" then
            message = message .. (handle.getValue() and " On" or " Off")
          end
          context.notify(message, false, { category = "shortcut", topic = definition.action or definition.key })
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  function result.refreshManual()
    if handles.manualSpam then
      handles.manualSpam.setValue(states.manualSpam())
    end
  end
  scope.add(function()
    antiGeneration += 1
    resetGeneration += 1
  end)
  scope.add(Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.AntiAFK ~= nil then
      callbacks.antiAFK(changes.AntiAFK == true)
    end
  end))
  callbacks.antiAFK(Utils.getConfigValue("AntiAFK") == true)
  return result
end

-- contract
Actions.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Hub = "hubapi", Dumper = "dumper" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "isManualSpamActive", "observeConfig", "resetConfig", "recordError" },
    Hub = { "createActions", "getAbilityAvailability" },
    Dumper = { "start", "isRunning" },
  },
}

return Actions

-- [[ shared surface appearance ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiappearance

local Appearance = {}
function Appearance.setup() return true end
function Appearance.borderColor(background, light)
  local hue, saturation, value = background:ToHSV()
  if saturation < 0.1 then
    hue, saturation = 0.69, 0.50
  end
  saturation = math.clamp(saturation, 0.45, 0.80)
  local brightness = value > 0.72 and value * 0.70 or math.clamp(value + 0.14, 0.25, 0.55)
  return Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, brightness)
end
function Appearance.interactionColor(background, pressed)
  local hue, saturation, value = Appearance.borderColor(background):ToHSV()
  return Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, math.min(0.72, value + (pressed and 0.09 or 0.05)))
end
function Appearance.borderGradient(background, strength)
  local hue, saturation = background:ToHSV()
  local color = strength and strength > 0 and Appearance.interactionColor(background, strength > 1) or Appearance.borderColor(background)
  local _, tint, value = color:ToHSV()
  if saturation < 0.1 then
    hue = 0.69
  end
  local first = (hue - 0.025) % 1
  local last = (hue + 0.025) % 1
  return ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(first, tint, value), Color3.fromHSV(last, tint, value))
end
local function instance(class, properties, parent)
  local object = Instance.new(class)
  for key, value in pairs(properties) do
    object[key] = value
  end
  object.Parent = parent
  return object
end
local function palette(kind)
  if kind == "critical" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(153, 27, 27)
  end
  if kind == "success" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(20, 92, 58)
  end
  if kind == "warning" then
    return Color3.fromRGB(100, 67, 18)
  end
  return Color3.fromRGB(45, 55, 130)
end
function Appearance.notification(parent, name)
  local card = instance("CanvasGroup", {
    Name = name,
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 18),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    GroupTransparency = 1,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    ZIndex = 100,
  }, parent)
  instance("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10) }, card)
  local outline = instance("Frame", {
    Name = "Outline",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 102,
  }, card)
  instance("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) }, outline)
  instance("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, outline)
  local content = instance("ScrollingFrame", {
    Name = "Content",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -12),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 6),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
    ScrollBarThickness = 0,
    ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
    Active = true,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    ZIndex = 101,
  }, card)
  instance("TextLabel", {
    Name = "Message",
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 11,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
    TextWrapped = true,
    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
    RichText = false,
    ZIndex = 101,
  }, content)
  return card
end
function Appearance.updateNotification(card, message, kind, viewport)
  local content = card:FindFirstChild("Content")
  -- Replace cards created by older loaders rather than retain an incompatible layout.
  assert(content and content:IsA("ScrollingFrame"), "Unsupported notification surface")
  local label = content:FindFirstChild("Message")
  local maxWidth = math.max(24, math.min(280, viewport.X - 24))
  local padding = math.min(10, math.max(2, (maxWidth - 4) / 4))
  local measure = game:GetService("TextService")
  local value = tostring(message)
  local function bounds(width) return measure:GetTextSize(value, 11, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Vector2.new(math.max(1, width), 100000)) end
  local size = bounds(maxWidth - padding * 2)
  local width = math.min(maxWidth, math.max(math.min(80, maxWidth), math.ceil(size.X) + padding * 2 + 2))
  size = bounds(width - padding * 2)
  local maxHeight = math.max(26, viewport.Y - 48)
  local height = math.min(maxHeight, math.max(26, math.ceil(size.Y) + 14))
  local overflow = size.Y + 12 > height
  if overflow then
    size = bounds(width - padding * 2 - 4)
  end
  card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
  card.BackgroundColor3 = palette(kind)
  card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  local outline = card:FindFirstChild("Outline")
  local line = outline:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  line.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  local gradient = line:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") or instance("UIGradient", { Rotation = 20 }, line)
  gradient.Color = Appearance.borderGradient(card.BackgroundColor3)
  content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(padding, 6)
  content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -padding * 2, 1, -12)
  content.ScrollingEnabled, content.ScrollBarThickness = overflow, overflow and 2 or 0
  content.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  content.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.ceil(size.Y) + 2)
  content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
  label.Text = value
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, overflow and -4 or 0, 0, math.max(height - 12, math.ceil(size.Y) + 2))
  return card
end
Appearance.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "borderColor", "interactionColor", "borderGradient", "notification", "updateNotification" }, requires = {} }
return Appearance

-- [[ basic ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidisplay, uicontrols, uiselection

-- code
local __part_uicontrols = (function()
  local Components = {}

  function Components.setup() return true end
  function Components.install(context)
    local kit = context.kit
    local Theme = context.Theme
    local options = context.options
    local components = context.components
    local C = context.C
    local inst = context.inst

    local control = context.control
    local title = context.title

    local hitbox = context.hitbox
    local commit = context.commit
    local shortcut = context.shortcut
    local bind = context.bind
    local read = context.read
    function components.keybind(parent, definition)
      assert(kit.isDesktop(), "Keybind controls are unavailable in mobile mode; enable PC UI in settings")
      local height = Theme.CARD_H
      local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
      title(handle, definition, 64, height)
      shortcut(handle, definition.key, -64)
      return handle
    end
    function components.button(parent, definition)
      definition = definition or {}
      local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
      local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
      title(handle, definition, definition.shortcutKey and 64 or 0, height)
      function handle.activate()
        if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
          return false
        end
        if definition.onClick then
          return definition.onClick() ~= false
        end
        return true
      end
      hitbox(handle, handle.activate)
      shortcut(handle, definition.shortcutKey, -64)
      function handle.setText(value) handle.Root.Title.Text = tostring(value) end
      return handle
    end
    function components.toggle(parent, definition)
      definition = definition or {}
      local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
      if definition.expandedDescription and definition.description then
        height = Theme.CARD_H + 40
      end
      local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
      title(handle, definition, definition.shortcutKey and 120 or 58, height)
      local track =
        inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 30), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, -15), BackgroundColor3 = C.toggleOff, ZIndex = 8 }, handle.Root)
      if definition.expandedDescription and definition.description then
        track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 8)
      end
      kit.corner(track, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
      kit.stroke(track)
      local thumb = inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, ZIndex = 9 }, track)
      kit.corner(thumb, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
      local value = false
      function handle.setValue(nextValue)
        value = nextValue == true
        handle.motion.play(track, "control", { BackgroundColor3 = value and C.toggleOn or C.toggleOff })
        handle.motion.play(thumb, "control", { Position = UDim2.new(0, value and 24 or 4, 0.5, -10) })
      end
      function handle.getValue() return value end
      function handle.activate()
        if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
          return false
        end
        local current = value
        if definition.getState then
          current = definition.getState()
        end
        local requested = not current
        if commit(handle, definition, requested) then
          if definition.getState then
            handle.setValue(definition.getState())
          else
            handle.setValue(requested)
          end
          if options.notify and definition.toast ~= false then
            options.notify(tostring(definition.title or definition.text or "Option") .. (handle.getValue() and " On" or " Off"))
          end
          return true
        end
        return false
      end
      hitbox(handle, handle.activate)
      shortcut(handle, definition.shortcutKey, nil, definition.expandedDescription and definition.description ~= nil)
      if definition.getState then
        handle.setValue(definition.getState())
      else
        handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
      end
      bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
      return handle
    end
  end
  Components.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
  return Components
end)()
local __part_uidisplay = (function()
  local Components = {}

  function Components.setup() return true end
  function Components.install(context)
    local kit = context.kit
    local components = context.components
    local C = context.C
    local TEXT = context.TEXT
    local inst = context.inst
    local text = context.text
    local control = context.control

    local bind = context.bind
    local read = context.read
    local finite = context.finite
    function components.label(parent, definition)
      definition = definition or {}
      definition = table.clone(definition)
      definition.kind = "label"
      local handle = control(parent, definition, 24)
      handle.Root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      local outline = handle.Root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if outline then
        outline:Destroy()
      end
      local label = text(handle.Root, definition.title or definition.text, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextSize = TEXT.caption, TextColor3 = C.accent })
      function handle.setText(value) label.Text = tostring(value) end
      return handle
    end
    function components.readout(parent, definition)
      local handle = control(parent, definition, 40)
      local value = text(handle.Root, "", {
        Name = "Value",
        RichText = true,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20),
        TextSize = TEXT.body,
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
      })
      local function resize()
        local scale, ancestor = 1, handle.Root
        while ancestor do
          local transform = ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
          if transform then
            scale *= transform.Scale
          end
          ancestor = ancestor.Parent
        end
        local width = math.max(40, handle.Root.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(0.01, scale) - 24)
        local bounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(value.Text:gsub("<[^>]->", ""), value.TextSize, value.Font, Vector2.new(width, 100000))
        local height = math.max(20, math.ceil(bounds.Y))
        value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, height)
        handle.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height + 20)
      end
      function handle.setValue(nextValue)
        local content = tostring(nextValue or "")
        if value.Text ~= content then
          value.Text = content
          resize()
        end
      end
      handle.scope.connect(handle.Root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resize)
      return handle
    end
    function components.progressBar(parent, definition)
      definition = definition or {}
      local handle = control(parent, definition, 8)
      handle.Root.ClipsDescendants = true
      local fill = inst("Frame", { Name = "Fill", BackgroundColor3 = definition.color or C.accent, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), ZIndex = 8 }, handle.Root)
      kit.corner(fill)
      local value
      function handle.setValue(nextValue)
        value = math.clamp(finite(nextValue) or 0, 0, 1)
        handle.motion.play(fill, "control", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(value, 1) })
      end
      function handle.getValue() return value end
      handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
      bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
      return handle
    end
    function components.divider(parent, definition)
      local handle = components.label(parent, definition or {})
      handle.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1)
      handle.Root.BackgroundTransparency = 0
      handle.Root.BackgroundColor3 = C.border
      return handle
    end
  end
  Components.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
  return Components
end)()
local __part_uiselection = (function()
  local Components = {}

  function Components.setup() return true end
  function Components.install(context)
    local kit = context.kit
    local Theme = context.Theme
    local UIS = context.UIS
    local options = context.options
    local components = context.components
    local C = context.C
    local FONT = context.FONT
    local TEXT = context.TEXT
    local inst = context.inst

    local control = context.control
    local title = context.title
    local button = context.button
    local commit = context.commit
    local bind = context.bind
    local read = context.read
    local finite = context.finite
    local choiceValue = context.choiceValue
    local choiceLabel = context.choiceLabel
    function components.segmented(parent, definition)
      definition = definition or {}
      local choices = definition.options or definition.choices or {}
      assert(#choices > 0, "segmented requires options")
      local handle = control(parent, definition, Theme.RATE_CARD_H)
      title(handle, definition, 0, 24)
      local track = inst(
        "Frame",
        { Name = "Track", Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 28), BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg, ZIndex = 8 },
        handle.Root
      )
      kit.corner(track)
      local thumb = inst("Frame", { Name = "Thumb", Size = UDim2.new(1 / #choices, -4, 1, -4), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, ZIndex = 9 }, track)
      kit.corner(thumb)
      local buttons, value = {}, nil
      function handle.setValue(nextValue)
        if value == nextValue then
          return
        end
        value = nextValue
        for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
          local selected = choiceValue(choice) == value
          if selected then
            local color = type(choice) == "table" and choice.color or nil
            color = color or (definition.colors and definition.colors[value]) or Theme.SELECTOR_COLORS[value] or C.accent
            handle.motion.play(thumb, "control", { Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / #choices, 2, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = color })
          end
          handle.motion.play(buttons[index], "control", { TextColor3 = selected and C.text or C.subtext })
        end
      end
      function handle.getValue() return value end
      for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        local item = button(
          track,
          choiceLabel(choice),
          { Size = UDim2.new(1 / #choices, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / #choices, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 10 }
        )
        buttons[index] = item
        handle.scope.connect(item.Activated, function()
          local nextValue = choiceValue(choice)
          if nextValue ~= value and commit(handle, definition, nextValue) then
            handle.setValue(nextValue)
          end
        end)
      end
      handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value or choiceValue(choices[1])))
      bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
      return handle
    end
    function components.rate_selector(parent, definition)
      local modes = { { value = "CPS", label = "CPS" }, { value = "CPF", label = "CPF" }, { value = "MS", label = "MS" }, { value = "Auto", label = "Auto" } }
      local handle = components.segmented(parent, { title = definition.title or "Spam Rate", key = "SpamRateMode", options = modes })
      local updateMode = handle.setValue
      local track = handle.Root.Track
      track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 30)
      local input = inst("TextBox", {
        Name = "RateInput",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
        TextColor3 = C.text,
        TextSize = TEXT.control,
        Font = FONT.strong,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        ZIndex = 11,
      }, handle.Root)
      kit.corner(input)
      kit.stroke(input)
      local function paint()
        local mode = read("SpamRateMode", "CPF")
        updateMode(mode)
        input.TextEditable = mode ~= "Auto"
        if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= input then
          input.Text = mode == "Auto" and "Auto" or tostring(read(mode, 0))
        end
      end
      for _, key in ipairs({ "SpamRateMode", "CPS", "CPF", "MS" }) do
        bind(handle, key, paint)
      end
      handle.scope.connect(input.FocusLost, function()
        local mode = read("SpamRateMode", "CPF")
        local value = finite(input.Text)
        if mode ~= "Auto" and value and value >= 0 and options.write then
          options.write(mode, value)
        end
        paint()
      end)
      paint()
      return handle
    end
  end
  Components.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }
  return Components
end)()

return { __bundle = { uicontrols = __part_uicontrols, uidisplay = __part_uidisplay, uiselection = __part_uiselection } }

-- [[ dropdown ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidropdown

-- module
local Components = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { DROPDOWN_ROWS = 4 }

-- setup
function Components.setup() return true end

-- components
function Components.install(context)
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local Runtime = context.Runtime
  local UIS = context.UIS
  local RunService = context.RunService
  local options = context.options
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst
  local text = context.text
  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title
  local button = context.button
  local commit = context.commit
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local choiceValue = context.choiceValue
  local choiceLabel = context.choiceLabel
  local popup = context.popup
  function components.dropdown(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local choices = definition.options or definition.choices or {}
    local handle = control(parent, definition, Theme.RATE_CARD_H)
    title(handle, definition, 0, 24)
    local trigger = button(handle.Root, "", { Name = "Select", Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 29) })
    local selectedLabel = text(trigger, "", {
      Name = "Selected",
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0),
      ZIndex = 11,
    })
    local arrow = kit.icon(trigger, "chevron", { Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14) })
    local value, openScope, menu, menuMotion, menuScale
    local selecting, closing, optionViews = false, false, {}
    local close
    local function finishClose(owner)
      if openScope ~= owner then
        return
      end
      if popup.close == close then
        popup.close = nil
      end
      openScope, menu, menuMotion, menuScale = nil, nil, nil, nil
      selecting, closing, optionViews = false, false, {}
      owner.destroy()
    end
    close = function(animated)
      if not openScope then
        return
      end
      handle.motion.play(arrow, "feedback", { Rotation = 0 })
      local owner = openScope
      if animated ~= false then
        if closing then
          return
        end
        closing = true
        menuMotion.play(menuScale, "feedback", { Scale = 0.96 })
        menuMotion.group(menu, "feedback", { GroupTransparency = 1 }, function() finishClose(owner) end)
        task.delay(0.5, function()
          if openScope == owner and closing then
            finishClose(owner)
          end
        end)
      else
        if popup.close == close then
          popup.close = nil
        end
        finishClose(owner)
      end
    end
    kit.feedback(
      handle.scope,
      trigger,
      function(active, pressed) trigger:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or 0) end,
      function() return handle.enabled end
    )
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = nextValue
      local label = tostring(value or definition.placeholder or "Select")
      for _, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        if choiceValue(choice) == value then
          label = choiceLabel(choice)
          break
        end
      end
      selectedLabel.Text = label
      for _, refresh in ipairs(optionViews) do
        refresh()
      end
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    local function open()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended or #choices == 0 or not options.parent or not Runtime.isVisible(handle.Root) then
        return
      end
      kit.dismiss()
      openScope = Runtime.scope()
      popup.close = close
      local portal = inst("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "ExodusDropdown",
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
        IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
      }, options.parent.Parent)
      openScope.add(Runtime.mountLayer(portal, options.parent.Parent, Theme.SCREEN_LAYERS.popup))
      menu = inst("CanvasGroup", { BackgroundColor3 = C.card, GroupTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 1 }, portal)
      kit.corner(menu)
      kit.stroke(menu)
      menuScale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.96 }, menu)
      local list = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Active = true,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
        ScrollBarThickness = Theme.SCROLLBAR,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.accent,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        ZIndex = 2,
      }, menu)
      menuMotion = kit.createMotion(openScope)
      openScope.add(portal, function() portal:Destroy() end)
      local ensureRoom = true
      local lastGeometry
      local items = {}
      local function position()
        if closing then
          return
        end
        if not trigger.Parent or not Runtime.isVisible(trigger) then
          close()
          return
        end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local pos, size = trigger.AbsolutePosition, trigger.AbsoluteSize
        local ancestor = trigger.Parent
        local scroll
        while ancestor and ancestor ~= options.parent do
          if
            ancestor:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and (pos.Y + size.Y <= ancestor.AbsolutePosition.Y or pos.Y >= ancestor.AbsolutePosition.Y + ancestor.AbsoluteSize.Y)
          then
            close()
            return
          end
          if not scroll and ancestor:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            scroll = ancestor
          end
          ancestor = ancestor.Parent
        end
        local rootPosition, rootSize = handle.Root.AbsolutePosition, handle.Root.AbsoluteSize
        local geometry = { pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y, view.X, view.Y, rootPosition.Y, rootSize.Y }
        local unchanged = lastGeometry ~= nil
        for index, coordinate in ipairs(geometry) do
          if not lastGeometry or lastGeometry[index] ~= coordinate then
            unchanged = false
            break
          end
        end
        if unchanged and not ensureRoom then
          return
        end
        lastGeometry = geometry
        local layout = Theme.DROPDOWN
        local scale = math.max(0.1, size.Y / 28)
        local row, gap, pad = layout.rowHeight * scale, layout.rowGap * scale, layout.padding * scale
        local visibleRows = math.clamp(tonumber(definition.maxVisible) or CONFIG.DROPDOWN_ROWS, 1, #choices)
        local desired = visibleRows * (row + gap) + pad * 2
        local bottom = math.max(pos.Y + size.Y, handle.Root.AbsolutePosition.Y + handle.Root.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        local margin, spacing = layout.margin, layout.gap * scale
        local below = math.max(0, view.Y - bottom - spacing - margin)
        local moved = false
        if ensureRoom and scroll and below < desired then
          local room = math.max(0, handle.Root.AbsolutePosition.Y - scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y - pad)
          local shift = math.min(desired - below, room)
          if shift > 0 then
            scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(scroll.CanvasPosition.X, scroll.CanvasPosition.Y + shift / scale)
            moved = true
          end
        end
        ensureRoom = false
        if moved then
          menu.Visible = false
          lastGeometry = nil
          return
        end
        local above = math.max(0, pos.Y - spacing - margin)
        local upward = below < desired and above > below
        local height = math.min(desired, upward and above or below)
        if height <= 0 then
          close()
          return
        end
        local width = math.min(size.X, math.max(1, view.X - margin * 2))
        menu.Visible = true
        menu.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
        menu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
        menu.Position =
          UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(pos.X, margin, math.max(margin, view.X - width - margin)), upward and pos.Y - spacing - height or bottom + spacing)
        list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #choices * (row + gap) + pad * 2)
        for index, item in ipairs(items) do
          item.Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2 - Theme.SCROLLBAR, 0, row)
          item.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pad, pad + (index - 1) * (row + gap))
          item.TextSize = math.max(10, TEXT.body * scale)
        end
      end
      local activeItem, resetActive
      for index, choice in ipairs(choices) do
        local selected = choiceValue(choice) == value
        local item = button(list, choiceLabel(choice), {
          LayoutOrder = index,
          BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
          BackgroundTransparency = 1,
          TextColor3 = selected and C.text or C.subtext,
          ZIndex = 3,
        })
        items[#items + 1] = item
        local border = kit.stroke(item)
        border.Transparency = 1
        local reset
        local refresh
        refresh, reset = kit.feedback(openScope, item, function(active, pressed)
          if active and activeItem ~= item then
            if resetActive then
              resetActive()
            end
            activeItem, resetActive = item, reset
          elseif not active and activeItem == item then
            activeItem, resetActive = nil, nil
          end
          local selectedNow = selecting and choiceValue(choice) == value
          item:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or 0)
          menuMotion.play(border, "feedback", { Transparency = (active or selectedNow) and 0 or 1 })
          menuMotion.play(item, "feedback", {
            BackgroundTransparency = selectedNow and 0.1 or 1,
            BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
            TextColor3 = (active or selectedNow) and C.text or C.subtext,
          })
        end, function() return not selecting and not closing end)
        optionViews[#optionViews + 1] = refresh
        openScope.connect(item.Activated, function()
          if selecting or closing then
            return
          end
          if not commit(handle, definition, choiceValue(choice)) then
            return
          end
          selecting = true
          handle.setValue(choiceValue(choice))
          local owner = openScope
          task.delay(Theme.DROPDOWN.selectionDelay, function()
            if owner.alive and openScope == owner then
              close(true)
            end
          end)
        end)
      end
      position()
      if not openScope then
        return
      end
      menuMotion.group(menu, "control", { GroupTransparency = 0 })
      menuMotion.play(menuScale, "control", { Scale = 1 })
      handle.motion.play(arrow, "feedback", { Rotation = 180 })
      openScope.connect(RunService.Heartbeat, position)
      openScope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
          close()
          return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          return
        end
        local function inside(root)
          local pos, size = root.AbsolutePosition, root.AbsoluteSize
          return input.Position.X >= pos.X and input.Position.X <= pos.X + size.X and input.Position.Y >= pos.Y and input.Position.Y <= pos.Y + size.Y
        end
        if not inside(menu) and not inside(trigger) then
          close()
        end
      end)
    end
    handle.scope.add(function() close(false) end)
    handle.scope.connect(trigger.Activated, function()
      if openScope then
        close()
      else
        open()
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
end

-- contract
Components.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }

return Components

-- [[ inputs ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiinputs

-- module
local Components = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { INPUT_WIDTH = 62 }

-- setup
function Components.setup() return true end

-- components
function Components.install(context)
  local drags = context.drags
  local kit = context.kit
  local Theme = context.Theme
  local Runtime = context.Runtime
  local UIS = context.UIS
  local components = context.components
  local C = context.C
  local FONT = context.FONT
  local TEXT = context.TEXT
  local inst = context.inst
  local text = context.text
  local control = context.control
  local title = context.title
  local button = context.button
  local commit = context.commit
  local bind = context.bind
  local read = context.read
  local finite = context.finite
  function components.textInput(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local height = definition.description and Theme.CARD_H + 22 or Theme.CARD_H
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, 76, height)
    local input = inst("TextBox", {
      Name = "Input",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(CONFIG.INPUT_WIDTH, 30),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0.5, -15),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.control,
      Font = FONT.strong,
      ClearTextOnFocus = false,
      PlaceholderText = definition.placeholder or "",
      ZIndex = 11,
    }, handle.Root)
    kit.corner(input)
    local border = kit.stroke(input)
    local value
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = nextValue
      if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() == input then
        return
      end
      input.Text = tostring(definition.format and definition.format(value) or value or "")
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    function handle.setText(nextText) input.Text = tostring(nextText) end
    function handle.getText() return input.Text end
    handle.scope.connect(input.Focused, function() input:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", 2) end)
    handle.scope.connect(input.FocusLost, function(enterPressed)
      input:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", 0)
      local nextValue = input.Text
      if definition.parse then
        nextValue = definition.parse(input.Text)
      end
      if definition.numeric then
        nextValue = finite(input.Text)
        if nextValue then
          nextValue = math.clamp(nextValue, definition.min or 0, definition.max or math.huge)
          nextValue = nextValue / (definition.displayScale or 1)
        end
      end
      if nextValue ~= nil and commit(handle, definition, nextValue) then
        value = nextValue
      end
      handle.setValue(read(definition.key, value))
      if definition.onSubmit then
        definition.onSubmit(input.Text, enterPressed)
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
  components.number = function(parent, definition)
    local copy = table.clone(definition)
    copy.numeric = true
    copy.format = function(value) return tostring((finite(value) or 0) * (definition.displayScale or 1)) end
    return components.textInput(parent, copy)
  end
  function components.slider(parent, definition)
    definition = definition or {}
    local minimum, maximum = finite(definition.min) or 0, finite(definition.max) or 100
    local step = finite(definition.increment or definition.step) or 1
    assert(maximum > minimum and step > 0, "slider requires max > min and increment > 0")
    local height = definition.compact and Theme.CARD_H or (definition.description and 88 or 68)
    local handle = control(parent, definition, height)
    title(handle, definition, 72, math.min(height - 24, 70))
    local label = text(handle.Root, "", {
      Name = "Value",
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 20),
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 5),
      TextSize = TEXT.caption,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    })
    local track = inst(
      "Frame",
      { Name = "Track", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -17), BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg, ZIndex = 8 },
      handle.Root
    )
    kit.corner(track, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local fill = inst("Frame", { Name = "Fill", BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, Size = UDim2.new(), ZIndex = 9 }, track)
    kit.corner(fill, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local knob =
      inst("Frame", { Name = "Thumb", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, ZIndex = 10 }, track)
    kit.corner(knob, Theme.RADIUS.pill)
    local hit = button(
      handle.Root,
      "",
      { Name = "SliderHitbox", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 11 }
    )
    hit.NextSelectionLeft, hit.NextSelectionRight = hit, hit
    local value
    local function normalize(nextValue)
      return math.clamp(minimum + math.floor(((finite(nextValue) or minimum) - minimum) / step + 0.5) * step, minimum, maximum)
    end
    function handle.setValue(nextValue)
      value = normalize(nextValue)
      local alpha = (value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum)
      fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
      knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
      label.Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000) .. (definition.valueName and " " .. definition.valueName or "")
    end
    function handle.getValue() return value end
    local function change(nextValue)
      local normalized = normalize(nextValue)
      if normalized ~= value and commit(handle, definition, normalized) then
        handle.setValue(normalized)
      end
    end
    local cancelDrag = Runtime.bindDrag(handle.scope, hit, function(input)
      if handle.enabled and track.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
        change(minimum + math.clamp((input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1) * (maximum - minimum))
      end
    end, function() return handle.enabled and not kit.suspended end)
    drags[cancelDrag] = true
    handle.scope.add(function() drags[cancelDrag] = nil end)
    handle.scope.connect(hit.InputBegan, function(input)
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
        change(value - step)
      end
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
        change(value + step)
      end
    end)
    handle.setValue(read(definition.key, definition.value))
    bind(handle, definition.key, handle.setValue)
    return handle
  end
end

-- contract
Components.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "install" }, requires = {} }

return Components

-- [[ automatic floating visibility ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiassists
local Assists = {}
function Assists.setup() return true end
function Assists.create(context)
  local utils, gameInfo = context.deps.Utils, context.deps.Hub
  local elapsed, automatic = 0, {}
  local function refresh()
    local rules = not context.state.desktop and gameInfo.getMiniVisibility() or {}
    local changed = false
    for key, visible in pairs(rules) do
      if automatic[key] ~= visible then
        changed = true
      end
    end
    for key in pairs(automatic) do
      if rules[key] == nil then
        changed = true
      end
    end
    if changed then
      automatic = rules
      context.floating.applyVisibility(rules)
    end
  end
  context.trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    elapsed += dt
    if elapsed >= 0.1 then
      elapsed = 0
      refresh()
    end
  end))
  context.scope.add(utils.observeConfig(function()
    automatic = {}
    refresh()
  end))
  refresh()
  return {}
end
Assists.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Assists
