-- [[ context ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uicontext

-- module
local Context = {}

-- configuration

-- setup
function Context.setup() return true end

-- context
function Context.create(deps, deviceDesktop)
  local CONFIG = deps.Theme.tokens
  local C = CONFIG.COLORS
  local PW, PH = CONFIG.PANEL_W, CONFIG.PANEL_H
  local UIS, RunService, Players = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("Players")
  local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
  local Utils = deps.Utils
  local UIState = {
    connections = {},
    panelOpen = false,
    spamOn = false,
    clashBallOn = false,
    btnIsDragging = function() return false end,
    panelTween = nil,
    btnTween = nil,
    miniTween = nil,
    miniFadeTween = nil,
    miniGeneration = 0,
    desktop = false,
    closing = false,
    keyCapture = false,
    manualHoldInput = nil,
  }

  local context = { deps = deps, theme = CONFIG, state = UIState, refs = {} }
  context.services = { UIS = UIS, RunService = RunService, Players = Players }
  context.scope = deps.Runtime.scope()
  context.motion = deps.Runtime.motion(context.scope)
  if type(deviceDesktop) ~= "boolean" then
    deviceDesktop = UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled or not UIS.TouchEnabled
  end
  UIState.deviceDesktop = deviceDesktop
  UIState.desktop = Utils.getConfigValue("ForcePCUI") == true or deviceDesktop
  local function trackConn(connection) return context.scope.add(connection) end
  local function untrackConn(connection) context.scope.forget(connection) end
  local function safeDisconnect(connection)
    if connection then
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
  end
  local pulseButton
  local function inst(cls, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(cls)
    if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
      o.BorderSizePixel = 0
    end
    if o:IsA("GuiButton") then
      o.AutoButtonColor = false
    end
    if props then
      for k, v in pairs(props) do
        o[k] = v
      end
    end
    if parent then
      o.Parent = parent
    end
    local buttonName = props and props.Name
    if
      cls == "TextButton"
      and pulseButton
      and buttonName ~= "CardHitbox"
      and buttonName ~= "SpamButton"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusFloatingButton"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusClashBall"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusParryBall"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusDarkBall"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusJumpBall"
      and buttonName ~= "ExodusUpDashBall"
    then
      pulseButton(o)
    end
    return o
  end
  local function corner(obj, r) return inst("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r) }, obj) end
  local function stroke(obj, col, th) return context.kit.stroke(obj, col, th) end
  local function twPlay(obj, duration, props)
    if not obj or obj.Parent == nil then
      return nil
    end
    if context.motion and context.scope.alive then
      if obj:IsA("CanvasGroup") and props.GroupTransparency ~= nil then
        return context.motion.group(obj, duration, props)
      end
      return context.motion.play(obj, duration, props)
    end
    local profile = CONFIG.MOTION[type(duration) == "string" and duration or "control"]
    local tween = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(type(duration) == "number" and duration or profile.duration, profile.style, profile.direction), props)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
  end
  local function safeCancel(t)
    if t then
      context.motion.cancel(t)
    end
  end
  local function setTextIfChanged(label, text)
    if label.Text ~= text then
      label.Text = text
    end
  end
  local function viewport()
    local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
  end
  local function canUseAbility(name)
    local available, reason = deps.Hub.getAbilityAvailability(name)
    if not available and context.notifications then
      context.notifications.toast(reason)
    end
    return available
  end
  context.canUseAbility = canUseAbility
  local function setConfigValue(key, value)
    if value == true and (context.abilityKeys or {})[key] and not canUseAbility((context.abilityKeys or {})[key]) then
      return false
    end
    return Utils.setConfig({ [key] = value })
  end
  pulseButton = function(button)
    local scale = inst("UIScale", { Name = "PressScale", Scale = 1 }, button)
    local activeTween
    trackConn(button.Activated:Connect(function()
      safeCancel(activeTween)
      scale.Scale = 1
      local tween = twPlay(scale, "press", { Scale = 0.94 })
      activeTween = tween
      if not tween then
        return
      end
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and button.Parent then
          activeTween = twPlay(scale, "feedback", { Scale = 1 })
        end
      end))
    end))
  end
  local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onDragEnd, disableOnMobile, coordinateScale, onDragMove)
    local dragInput, dragOffX, dragOffY = nil, 0, 0
    local state, wasDragged, startX, startY = "Idle", false, 0, 0
    local THRESH_SQ = CONFIG.DRAG_THRESHOLD_SQ
    trackConn(handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
      end
      if not UIState.panelOpen and target == context.refs.configPanel then
        return
      end
      if UIState.closing or not deps.Runtime.isVisible(handle) then
        return
      end
      if disableOnMobile and not UIState.desktop then
        return
      end
      if state ~= "Idle" then
        return
      end
      state, wasDragged, dragInput = "Pressed", false, input
      local abs = target.AbsolutePosition
      local anchor = target.AnchorPoint
      dragOffX, dragOffY = input.Position.X - abs.X - target.AbsoluteSize.X * anchor.X, input.Position.Y - abs.Y - target.AbsoluteSize.Y * anchor.Y
      startX, startY = input.Position.X, input.Position.Y
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
      if state == "Idle" or not dragInput then
        return
      end
      if UIState.closing or not deps.Runtime.isVisible(handle) then
        state, dragInput, wasDragged = "Idle", nil, false
        return
      end
      local isMouseDrag = dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      local isTouchDrag = dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == dragInput
      if not isMouseDrag and not isTouchDrag then
        return
      end
      local dx, dy = input.Position.X - startX, input.Position.Y - startY
      if state == "Pressed" and (dx * dx + dy * dy) >= THRESH_SQ then
        state, wasDragged = "Dragging", true
      end
      if state == "Dragging" then
        local vp, sz = viewport(), target.AbsoluteSize
        local scale = coordinateScale and coordinateScale() or (context.refs.responsiveScale and context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale or 1)
        scale = math.max(scale, 0.01)
        local parent = target.Parent
        local origin = parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") and parent.AbsolutePosition or Vector2.zero
        local anchor = target.AnchorPoint
        target.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
          (math.clamp(input.Position.X - dragOffX - sz.X * anchor.X, 0, math.max(0, vp.X - sz.X)) + sz.X * anchor.X - origin.X) / scale,
          (math.clamp(input.Position.Y - dragOffY - sz.Y * anchor.Y, 0, math.max(0, vp.Y - sz.Y)) + sz.Y * anchor.Y - origin.Y) / scale
        )
        if onDragMove then
          onDragMove()
        end
      end
    end))
    local function releaseDrag()
      if state == "Idle" then
        return
      end
      state, dragInput = "Idle", nil
      if wasDragged and onDragEnd then
        onDragEnd()
      end
      task.defer(function()
        if state == "Idle" then
          wasDragged = false
        end
      end)
    end
    trackConn(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
      if input == dragInput then
        releaseDrag()
      end
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(releaseDrag))
    trackConn(handle:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
      if not handle.Visible then
        releaseDrag()
      end
    end))
    return function() return state == "Dragging" or wasDragged end
  end
  local function makeBtn(text, x, y, w, h, parent, bg)
    local b = inst("TextButton", {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h),
      Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
      BackgroundColor3 = bg or C.btnBlue,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
      Text = text,
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = 13,
      Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
      ZIndex = 7,
      Parent = parent,
    })
    corner(b, 8)
    stroke(b, nil, 1)
    return b
  end
  context.inst = inst
  context.corner = corner
  context.stroke = stroke
  context.twPlay = twPlay
  context.safeCancel = safeCancel
  context.setTextIfChanged = setTextIfChanged
  context.viewport = viewport
  context.setConfigValue = setConfigValue
  context.trackConn = trackConn
  context.untrackConn = untrackConn
  context.safeDisconnect = safeDisconnect
  context.makeDraggable = makeDraggable
  context.makeBtn = makeBtn
  local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
  context.playerGui = playerGui
  context.refs.screenGui = inst("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "ExodusUISystem",
    DisplayOrder = CONFIG.DISPLAY_ORDER,
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
    Parent = playerGui,
  })
  context.scope.add(deps.Runtime.mountLayer(context.refs.screenGui, playerGui, CONFIG.SCREEN_LAYERS.window))
  context.kit = deps.UIKit.create({
    parent = context.refs.screenGui,
    read = Utils.getConfigValue,
    write = setConfigValue,
    observe = Utils.observeConfig,
    notify = function(...) return context.notifications.toast(...) end,
    validateShortcut = function(key, binding) return context.actions.validateShortcut(key, binding) end,
    onCapture = function(active) UIState.keyCapture = active end,
  })
  context.refs.responsiveScale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = context.refs.screenGui })
  local function updateResponsiveScale()
    local size = viewport()
    context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale = math.min(1, math.max(0.1, math.min((size.X - 20) / PW, (size.Y - 20) / PH)))
    local scale = context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale
    local names = { "configPanel", "floatingButton", "clashBall", "parryBall", "darkBall", "jumpBall", "upDashBall" }
    for _, name in ipairs(context.miniBallRefs or {}) do
      names[#names + 1] = name
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
      local object = context.refs[name]
      if object and object.Parent and object.Visible then
        local pos, dimensions = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
        if name == "configPanel" or name == "floatingButton" or pos.X + dimensions.X > 0 then
          local x = math.clamp(pos.X, 0, math.max(0, size.X - dimensions.X))
          local y = math.clamp(pos.Y, 0, math.max(0, size.Y - dimensions.Y))
          if x ~= pos.X or y ~= pos.Y then
            object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x / scale, y / scale)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if context.floating and context.refs.miniGui and context.refs.miniGui.Visible then
      context.floating.applyMiniScale(Utils.getConfigValue("MiniSpamScale"))
    end
  end
  local cameraConnection
  local function bindCamera()
    if cameraConnection then
      safeDisconnect(cameraConnection)
      untrackConn(cameraConnection)
    end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    cameraConnection = camera and trackConn(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(updateResponsiveScale)) or nil
    updateResponsiveScale()
  end
  trackConn(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(bindCamera))
  bindCamera()
  context.updateResponsiveScale = updateResponsiveScale
  function context.destroy()
    if not context.scope.alive then
      return
    end
    if UIState.manualHoldInput then
      Utils.setManualSpamActive(false)
    end
    if context.pages then
      context.pages.destroy()
    end
    if context.kit then
      context.kit.destroy()
    end
    context.scope.destroy()
    if context.refs.screenGui then
      context.refs.screenGui:Destroy()
    end
    if context.refs.informationGui then
      context.refs.informationGui:Destroy()
    end
    if context.notifications then
      context.notifications.clear("closing")
    end
    table.clear(context.refs)
  end
  return context
end

-- contract
Context.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return Context

-- [[ read-only information page ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uidetails

local Details = {}
function Details.setup() return true end
function Details.create(context)
  local reported = {}
  local function refresh()
    local ok, values = pcall(context.deps.Information.snapshot)
    if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
      values = { session = "Informações temporariamente indisponíveis. Tentando novamente…" }
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "session", "game", "server", "versions", "developers" }) do
      local rendered, reason = pcall(context.pages.setReadout, key, values[key])
      if not rendered and not reported[key] then
        warn("[Exodus Information] " .. tostring(reason))
      end
      reported[key] = not rendered
    end
    context.pages.refresh()

  end
  refresh()
  local elapsed = 0
  context.trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    elapsed += dt
    if elapsed >= 0.5 and context.state.panelOpen and context.pages.state().id == "information" then
      elapsed = 0
      refresh()
    end
  end))
  return {}
end
Details.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Details

-- [[ floating ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uifloating

-- module
local Controller = {}

-- configuration

-- setup
function Controller.setup() return true end

-- controller
function Controller.create(context)
  local Utils = context.deps.Utils
  local GameInfo = context.deps.Hub
  local Controls = context.deps.Controls
  local UIState = context.state
  local C = context.theme.COLORS
  local CLASH_SIZE = context.theme.CLASH_SIZE
  local OFFSCREEN_X = (-context.theme.CLASH_SIZE - 40)
  local MINI_W = context.theme.MINI_W
  local MINI_H = context.theme.MINI_H
  local inst = context.inst
  local corner = context.corner
  local stroke = context.stroke
  local twPlay = context.twPlay
  local safeCancel = context.safeCancel
  local viewport = context.viewport
  local setConfigValue = context.setConfigValue
  local trackConn = context.trackConn
  local untrackConn = context.untrackConn
  local safeDisconnect = context.safeDisconnect
  local makeDraggable = context.makeDraggable
  local setSpam
  local automaticVisibility = {}
  local function paintBall(ball, value, onText, offText, onColor, offColor, onSize, offSize)
    if not ball or not ball.Parent then
      return
    end
    ball.Text = value and onText or offText
    if onSize then
      ball.TextSize = value and onSize or offSize
    end
    twPlay(ball, "control", { BackgroundColor3 = value and onColor or offColor })
  end
  local function paintParryBall(value) paintBall(context.refs.parryBall, value, "PARRY\nON", "PARRY\nOFF", C.green, C.red, 14, 14) end
  local function showBall(ball, visible, visibleKey, xKey, yKey, defaultX, defaultY)
    local config = Utils.getConfig()
    local x = config[xKey] or defaultX
    local y = config[yKey] or defaultY
    local shouldShow = (visible or automaticVisibility[visibleKey] == true) and not UIState.desktop
    local ability = context.abilityKeys[visibleKey]
    if ability then
      shouldShow = shouldShow and GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability(ability)
    end
    if ball:GetAttribute("ExodusShown") == shouldShow then
      return
    end
    ball:SetAttribute("ExodusShown", shouldShow)
    local generation = (ball:GetAttribute("ExodusMotion") or 0) + 1
    ball:SetAttribute("ExodusMotion", generation)
    if shouldShow then
      if not ball.Visible then
        ball.TextTransparency, ball.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
      end
      ball.Visible = true
    end
    local tween = twPlay(ball, "panel", {
      Position = shouldShow and UDim2.fromOffset(x, y) or UDim2.fromOffset(OFFSCREEN_X, y),
      TextTransparency = shouldShow and 0 or 1,
      BackgroundTransparency = shouldShow and 0 or 1,
    })
    local outline = ball:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if outline then
      twPlay(outline, "panel", { Transparency = shouldShow and 0 or 1 })
    end
    if tween then
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and generation == ball:GetAttribute("ExodusMotion") and ball.Parent then
          ball.Visible = shouldShow
        end
      end))
    else
      ball.Visible = shouldShow
    end
  end
  local function pulseBall(ball)
    local shrink = twPlay(ball, "press", { Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE - 6, 0, CLASH_SIZE - 6) })
    if not shrink then
      return
    end
    local connection
    connection = trackConn(shrink.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
      safeDisconnect(connection)
      untrackConn(connection)
      if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and ball and ball.Parent then
        twPlay(ball, "feedback", { Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE, 0, CLASH_SIZE) })
      end
    end))
  end
  local config = Utils.getConfig()
  local function createMovementBall(name, text, color, xKey, yKey, yOffset, onClick)
    local x = config[xKey] or (CLASH_SIZE + 22)
    local y = config[yKey] or (viewport().Y / 2 + yOffset)
    local ball = inst("TextButton", {
      Name = name,
      Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE, 0, CLASH_SIZE),
      Position = UDim2.new(0, OFFSCREEN_X, 0, y),
      BackgroundColor3 = color,
      Text = text,
      TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
      TextSize = 15,
      Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
      Active = true,
      ZIndex = 8,
      Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
    })
    corner(ball, 999)
    stroke(ball, nil, 2)
    local dragging = makeDraggable(ball, ball, function()
      setConfigValue(xKey, ball.Position.X.Offset)
      setConfigValue(yKey, ball.Position.Y.Offset)
    end)
    trackConn(ball.Activated:Connect(function()
      if not dragging() then
        onClick(ball)
      end
    end))
    return ball, x, y
  end
  if context.combatUI == false then
    local function inactive() end
    local buttons = {}
    context.miniBallRefs = {}
    for index, definition in ipairs(context.miniBalls or {}) do
      local prefix = definition.prefix
      local visibleKey, xKey, yKey = prefix .. "Visible", prefix .. "X", prefix .. "Y"
      local key, label = definition.key, definition.label
      local reset = definition.action == "resetState"
      local onText, offText = label .. "\nON", label .. "\nOFF"
      if reset then
        onText, offText = label, label
      end
      local value = key ~= nil and config[key] == true
      local ball = createMovementBall("Exodus" .. prefix, value and onText or offText, value and C.green or C.red, xKey, yKey, 0, function()
        if reset then
          GameInfo.resetState()
          if context.notifications.toast then
            context.notifications.toast("PvP encerrado.")
          end
          return
        end
        local enabled = Utils.getConfigValue(key) ~= true
        if setConfigValue(key, enabled) and context.notifications.toast then
          context.notifications.toast(definition.title .. (enabled and " On" or " Off"))
        end
      end)
      ball.Visible = false
      ball.TextTransparency, ball.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
      context.refs[prefix] = ball
      context.miniBallRefs[#context.miniBallRefs + 1] = prefix
      local function show(visible)
        local scale = math.max(context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale, 0.01)
        local view = viewport() / scale
        local gap = CLASH_SIZE + 8
        local x = math.min(14 + ((index - 1) % 2) * gap, math.max(0, view.X - CLASH_SIZE))
        local rows = math.ceil(#context.miniBalls / 2)
        local y = math.clamp((view.Y - rows * gap) / 2 + math.floor((index - 1) / 2) * gap, 0, math.max(0, view.Y - CLASH_SIZE))
        showBall(ball, visible, visibleKey, xKey, yKey, x, y)
      end
      buttons[#buttons + 1] = {
        key = key,
        visibleKey = visibleKey,
        show = show,
        paint = function(enabled) paintBall(ball, enabled, onText, offText, C.green, C.red, 14, 14) end,
      }
      paintBall(ball, value, onText, offText, C.green, C.red, 14, 14)
      show(config[visibleKey] == true)
    end
    return {
      setSpam = inactive,
      showMini = inactive,
      applyMiniScale = inactive,
      showClashBall = inactive,
      showParryBall = inactive,
      showDarkBall = inactive,
      showJumpBall = inactive,
      showUpDashBall = inactive,
      sync = function(changes)
        for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do
          if button.key and changes[button.key] ~= nil then
            button.paint(changes[button.key] == true)
          end
          if changes[button.visibleKey] ~= nil then
            button.show(changes[button.visibleKey] == true)
          end
        end
      end,
      applyVisibility = inactive,
      refreshAbilities = inactive,
    }
  end
  local function showParryBall(value)
    showBall(context.refs.parryBall, value, "ParryBallVisible", "ParryBallX", "ParryBallY", 14, viewport().Y / 2 - CLASH_SIZE - 40)
  end
  local function paintClashBall() paintBall(context.refs.clashBall, UIState.clashBallOn, "ON", "OFF", C.green, C.red, 18, 16) end
  local function setClashBall(v, silent)
    if setConfigValue("AutoSpam", v) == false then
      return
    end
    UIState.clashBallOn = v
    if silent then
      return
    end
    paintClashBall()
    pulseBall(context.refs.clashBall)
    if context.notifications.toast then
      context.notifications.toast("Auto Spam " .. (v and "On" or "Off"))
    end
  end
  local function showClashBall(v) showBall(context.refs.clashBall, v, "ClashBallVisible", "ClashBallX", "ClashBallY", 14, viewport().Y / 2 - CLASH_SIZE / 2) end
  local function paintDarkBall(v) paintBall(context.refs.darkBall, v, "ON", "OFF", C.darkOn, C.darkOff, 18, 16) end
  local function showDarkBall(v) showBall(context.refs.darkBall, v, "DarkBallVisible", "DarkBallX", "DarkBallY", 14, viewport().Y / 2 + CLASH_SIZE / 2 + 8) end
  local function setDarkBall(v)
    if not setConfigValue("AutoDark", v) then
      return
    end
    if type(Controls.onAutoDarkChanged) == "function" then
      Controls.onAutoDarkChanged()
    end
    paintDarkBall(v)
    pulseBall(context.refs.darkBall)
    if context.notifications.toast then
      context.notifications.toast("Auto Dark " .. (v and "On" or "Off"))
    end
  end
  local function showMovementBall(ball, visible, visibleKey, xKey, yKey, yOffset)
    showBall(ball, visible, visibleKey, xKey, yKey, CLASH_SIZE + 22, viewport().Y / 2 + yOffset)
  end
  local function showJumpBall(v) showMovementBall(context.refs.jumpBall, v, "JumpBallVisible", "JumpBallX", "JumpBallY", -CLASH_SIZE / 2) end
  local function showUpDashBall(v) showMovementBall(context.refs.upDashBall, v, "UpDashBallVisible", "UpDashBallX", "UpDashBallY", CLASH_SIZE / 2 + 8) end
  local function paintJumpBall(v) paintBall(context.refs.jumpBall, v, "JUMP\nON", "JUMP\nOFF", C.jumpOn, C.jumpOff) end
  local function setJumpBall(v)
    if not setConfigValue("AutoJump", v) then
      return
    end
    if type(Controls.onAutoJumpChanged) == "function" then
      Controls.onAutoJumpChanged()
    end
    paintJumpBall(v)
    if context.notifications.toast then
      context.notifications.toast("Auto Jump " .. (v and "On" or "Off"))
    end
  end
  local function miniScreenScale() return context.refs.responsiveScale and context.refs.responsiveScale.Scale or 1 end
  local function miniLayout(scale)
    local view, screenScale = viewport(), math.max(miniScreenScale(), 0.01)
    local screenWidth, screenHeight = view.X / screenScale, view.Y / screenScale
    local config = Utils.getConfig()
    local width = math.min(MINI_W * scale * (tonumber(config.MiniSpamWidth) or 1), screenWidth)
    local height = math.min(MINI_H * scale * (tonumber(config.MiniSpamHeight) or 1), screenHeight)
    local x = math.clamp(config.MiniX or (screenWidth - width - 14), 0, math.max(0, screenWidth - width))
    local y = math.clamp(config.MiniY or (screenHeight / 2 - height / 2), 0, math.max(0, screenHeight - height))
    return x, y, width, height, screenWidth
  end
  local function applyMiniScale(value)
    if not context.refs.miniGui or not context.refs.miniGui.Parent then
      return
    end
    local scale = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1, 0.5, 2)
    local x, y, width, height = miniLayout(scale)
    twPlay(context.refs.miniGui, "feedback", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) })
    if context.refs.miniGui.Visible then
      twPlay(context.refs.miniGui, "feedback", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y) })
    end
  end
  local function showMini(v)
    v = (v or automaticVisibility.MiniSpamVisible == true) and not UIState.desktop
    local mini = context.refs.miniGui
    if not mini or not mini.Parent then
      return
    end
    local config = Utils.getConfig()
    local miniX, miniY, width, height, screenWidth = miniLayout(tonumber(config.MiniSpamScale) or 1)
    local targetPosition = UDim2.fromOffset(miniX, miniY)
    local hiddenPosition = UDim2.fromOffset(screenWidth + 30, miniY)
    UIState.miniGeneration += 1
    local generation = UIState.miniGeneration
    safeCancel(UIState.miniTween)
    safeCancel(UIState.miniFadeTween)
    UIState.miniTween, UIState.miniFadeTween = nil, nil
    mini.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
    if v then
      if not mini.Visible then
        mini.Position = hiddenPosition
        mini.GroupTransparency = 1
        mini.Visible = true
      end
      UIState.miniTween = twPlay(mini, "panel", { Position = targetPosition })
      UIState.miniFadeTween = twPlay(mini, "panel", { GroupTransparency = 0 })
      return UIState.miniTween or UIState.miniFadeTween
    end
    if UIState.manualHoldInput then
      UIState.manualHoldInput = nil
      setSpam(false)
    end
    if not mini.Visible then
      return
    end
    UIState.miniTween = twPlay(mini, "panel", { Position = hiddenPosition })
    local fade = twPlay(mini, "panel", { GroupTransparency = 1 })
    UIState.miniFadeTween = fade
    if fade then
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(fade.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and generation == UIState.miniGeneration and mini.Parent then
          mini.Visible = false
        end
      end))
    else
      mini.Visible = false
    end
    return fade or UIState.miniTween
  end
  setSpam = function(v, silent)
    v = v == true
    local changed = UIState.spamOn ~= v
    UIState.spamOn = v
    if Utils.isManualSpamActive() ~= v then
      Utils.setManualSpamActive(v)
    end
    local spamButton = context.refs.miniGui and context.refs.miniGui:FindFirstChild("SpamButton")
    if not spamButton then
      return
    end
    spamButton.Text = v and "ON" or "OFF"
    local color = v and C.green or C.red
    if silent or not changed then
      spamButton.BackgroundColor3 = color
      spamButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.78, -8)
      return
    end
    twPlay(spamButton, "control", { BackgroundColor3 = color })
    local shrink = twPlay(spamButton, "press", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.78, -12) })
    if shrink then
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(shrink.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if playbackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and spamButton.Parent then
          twPlay(spamButton, "feedback", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.78, -8) })
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  context.refs.clashBall = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "ExodusClashBall",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE, 0, CLASH_SIZE),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, OFFSCREEN_X, 0.5, -CLASH_SIZE / 2),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.red,
    Text = "OFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 16,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 8,
    Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
  })
  corner(context.refs.clashBall, 999)
  stroke(context.refs.clashBall, nil, 2)
  UIState.clashBallOn = config.AutoSpam or false
  context.refs.clashBall.Text = UIState.clashBallOn and "ON" or "OFF"
  context.refs.clashBall.TextSize = UIState.clashBallOn and 18 or 16
  context.refs.clashBall.BackgroundColor3 = UIState.clashBallOn and C.green or C.red
  paintClashBall()

  local parryY = config.ParryBallY or (viewport().Y / 2 - CLASH_SIZE - 40)
  context.refs.parryBall = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "ExodusParryBall",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE, 0, CLASH_SIZE),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, OFFSCREEN_X, 0, parryY),
    BackgroundColor3 = config.AutoParry and C.green or C.red,
    Text = config.AutoParry and "PARRY\nON" or "PARRY\nOFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 14,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 8,
    Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
  })
  corner(context.refs.parryBall, 999)
  stroke(context.refs.parryBall, nil, 2)
  paintParryBall(config.AutoParry == true)
  local isParryDragging = makeDraggable(context.refs.parryBall, context.refs.parryBall, function()
    setConfigValue("ParryBallX", context.refs.parryBall.Position.X.Offset)
    setConfigValue("ParryBallY", context.refs.parryBall.Position.Y.Offset)
  end)
  trackConn(context.refs.parryBall.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not isParryDragging() then
      local value = Utils.getConfigValue("AutoParry") ~= true
      if setConfigValue("AutoParry", value) and context.notifications.toast then
        context.notifications.toast("Auto Parry " .. (value and "On" or "Off"))
      end
    end
  end))
  local isClashDragging = makeDraggable(context.refs.clashBall, context.refs.clashBall, function()
    setConfigValue("ClashBallX", context.refs.clashBall.Position.X.Offset)
    setConfigValue("ClashBallY", context.refs.clashBall.Position.Y.Offset)
  end)
  trackConn(context.refs.clashBall.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not isClashDragging() then
      setClashBall(not UIState.clashBallOn)
    end
  end))

  local darkY = config.DarkBallY or (viewport().Y / 2 + CLASH_SIZE / 2 + 8)
  context.refs.darkBall = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "ExodusDarkBall",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASH_SIZE, 0, CLASH_SIZE),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, OFFSCREEN_X, 0, darkY),
    BackgroundColor3 = config.AutoDark and C.darkOn or C.darkOff,
    Text = config.AutoDark and "ON" or "OFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = config.AutoDark and 18 or 16,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 8,
    Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
  })
  corner(context.refs.darkBall, 999)
  stroke(context.refs.darkBall, nil, 2)
  paintDarkBall(config.AutoDark == true)
  local isDarkDragging = makeDraggable(context.refs.darkBall, context.refs.darkBall, function()
    setConfigValue("DarkBallX", context.refs.darkBall.Position.X.Offset)
    setConfigValue("DarkBallY", context.refs.darkBall.Position.Y.Offset)
  end)
  trackConn(context.refs.darkBall.Activated:Connect(function()
    if isDarkDragging() then
      return
    end
    setDarkBall(Utils.getConfigValue("AutoDark") ~= true)
  end))
  context.refs.jumpBall = createMovementBall(
    "ExodusJumpBall",
    config.AutoJump and "JUMP\nON" or "JUMP\nOFF",
    config.AutoJump and C.jumpOn or C.jumpOff,
    "JumpBallX",
    "JumpBallY",
    -CLASH_SIZE / 2,
    function() setJumpBall(Utils.getConfigValue("AutoJump") ~= true) end
  )
  context.refs.upDashBall = createMovementBall("ExodusUpDashBall", "DASH\n↑", C.upDash, "UpDashBallX", "UpDashBallY", CLASH_SIZE / 2 + 8, function(ball)
    if not context.canUseAbility("dash") then
      return
    end
    if type(Controls.onUpDash) == "function" then
      Controls.onUpDash()
    end
    pulseBall(ball)
    if context.notifications.toast then
      context.notifications.toast("Up Dash")
    end
  end)
  paintJumpBall(config.AutoJump == true)
  local _, miniY, miniWidth, miniHeight, miniScreenWidth = miniLayout(tonumber(config.MiniSpamScale) or 1)
  local MINI_OFF_X = miniScreenWidth + 30
  context.refs.miniGui = inst("CanvasGroup", {
    Name = "ExodusSpamMini",
    Visible = false,
    GroupTransparency = 1,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(miniWidth, miniHeight),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.header,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 15,
    Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
  })
  corner(context.refs.miniGui, 14)
  corner(
    inst("Frame", {
      Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8),
      Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0, -4),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.accent,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.92,
      BorderSizePixel = 0,
      ZIndex = 14,
      Parent = context.refs.miniGui,
    }),
    18
  )
  stroke(context.refs.miniGui, nil, 1.5)
  local miniTitleBar = inst("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.22, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 46),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 16,
    Parent = context.refs.miniGui,
  })
  corner(miniTitleBar, 14)
  inst("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 46),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 16,
    Parent = miniTitleBar,
  })
  corner(
    inst("Frame", {
      Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2),
      Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 0),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.accentPink,
      BorderSizePixel = 0,
      ZIndex = 17,
      Parent = miniTitleBar,
    }),
    1
  )
  inst("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "Spam",
    TextColor3 = C.subtext,
    TextScaled = true,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 17,
    Parent = miniTitleBar,
  })
  local spamButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "SpamButton",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.78, -8),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.22, 3),
    BackgroundColor3 = UIState.spamOn and C.green or C.red,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Text = UIState.spamOn and "ON" or "OFF",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextScaled = true,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 16,
    Parent = context.refs.miniGui,
  })
  corner(spamButton, 10)
  inst("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 30, MinTextSize = 12 }, spamButton)
  trackConn(spamButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if Utils.getConfigValue("ManualSpamMode") ~= "Hold" then
      setSpam(not UIState.spamOn)
    end
  end))
  trackConn(spamButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if Utils.getConfigValue("ManualSpamMode") ~= "Hold" or UIState.manualHoldInput then
      return
    end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
      UIState.manualHoldInput = input
      setSpam(true)
    end
  end))
  context.refs.miniGui.Position = UDim2.new(0, MINI_OFF_X, 0, miniY)
  local function saveMiniPosition() Utils.setConfig({ MiniX = context.refs.miniGui.Position.X.Offset, MiniY = context.refs.miniGui.Position.Y.Offset }) end
  makeDraggable(miniTitleBar, context.refs.miniGui, saveMiniPosition, false, miniScreenScale)
  local visibility = {
    ParryBallVisible = showParryBall,
    ClashBallVisible = showClashBall,
    DarkBallVisible = showDarkBall,
    JumpBallVisible = showJumpBall,
    UpDashBallVisible = showUpDashBall,
    MiniSpamVisible = showMini,
  }

  local function sync(changes)
    if changes.AutoSpam ~= nil then
      UIState.clashBallOn = changes.AutoSpam == true
      paintClashBall()
    end
    if changes.AutoParry ~= nil then
      paintParryBall(changes.AutoParry == true)
    end
    if changes.AutoDark ~= nil then
      paintDarkBall(changes.AutoDark == true)
    end
    if changes.AutoJump ~= nil then
      paintJumpBall(changes.AutoJump == true)
    end
    for key, show in pairs(visibility) do
      if changes[key] ~= nil then
        show(changes[key] == true)
      end
    end
    if changes.MiniSpamScale ~= nil or changes.MiniSpamWidth ~= nil or changes.MiniSpamHeight ~= nil then
      applyMiniScale(Utils.getConfigValue("MiniSpamScale"))
    end
    if changes.ManualSpamMode ~= nil then
      UIState.manualHoldInput = nil
      setSpam(false)
    end
  end
  local lastAbilityMode
  local lastDarkAvailable, lastDashAvailable
  local function updateAbilityVisibility()
    lastAbilityMode = GameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled()
    lastDarkAvailable = GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability("dark")
    lastDashAvailable = GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability("dash")
    context.pages.refresh()
    showDarkBall(Utils.getConfigValue("DarkBallVisible") == true)
    showUpDashBall(Utils.getConfigValue("UpDashBallVisible") == true)
    showJumpBall(Utils.getConfigValue("JumpBallVisible") == true)
  end
  for _, ball in ipairs({ context.refs.parryBall, context.refs.clashBall, context.refs.darkBall, context.refs.jumpBall, context.refs.upDashBall }) do
    ball.Visible = false
    ball.TextTransparency, ball.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
  end
  for key, show in pairs(visibility) do
    show(config[key] == true)
  end
  setSpam(Utils.isManualSpamActive(), true)
  return {
    setSpam = setSpam,
    showMini = showMini,
    applyMiniScale = applyMiniScale,
    showClashBall = showClashBall,
    showParryBall = showParryBall,
    showDarkBall = showDarkBall,
    showJumpBall = showJumpBall,
    showUpDashBall = showUpDashBall,
    sync = sync,
    applyVisibility = function(rules)
      automaticVisibility = rules
      for key, show in pairs(visibility) do
        show(Utils.getConfigValue(key) == true)
      end
    end,
    refreshAbilities = function()
      updateAbilityVisibility()
      trackConn(GameInfo.observeAbilityMode(updateAbilityVisibility))
      local elapsed = 0
      trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
        elapsed += delta
        if elapsed < 0.25 then
          return
        end
        elapsed = 0
        if
          GameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() ~= lastAbilityMode
          or GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability("dark") ~= lastDarkAvailable
          or GameInfo.getAbilityAvailability("dash") ~= lastDashAvailable
        then
          updateAbilityVisibility()
        end
      end))
    end,
  }
end

-- contract
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return Controller

-- [[ game readout overlays ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uitelemetry

local Controller = {}
function Controller.setup() return true end
function Controller.create(context)
  local inst, utils = context.inst, context.deps.Utils
  local gui = inst("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "ExodusInformationOverlay",
    DisplayOrder = context.theme.DISPLAY_ORDER,
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global,
    Parent = context.playerGui,
  })
  context.scope.add(context.deps.Runtime.mountLayer(gui, context.playerGui, context.theme.SCREEN_LAYERS.information))
  context.refs.informationGui = gui
  local textService = game:GetService("TextService")
  local entries = {}
  for _, definition in ipairs(context.deps.Hub.getReadouts()) do
    local label = inst("TextLabel", {
      Name = definition.id,
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
      AnchorPoint = definition.anchor,
      Position = definition.position,
      BackgroundColor3 = context.theme.COLORS.header,
      Text = "",
      TextColor3 = context.theme.COLORS.text,
      TextSize = 14,
      Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
      TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
      TextTransparency = 1,
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Visible = false,
      ZIndex = 100,
      Parent = gui,
    })
    context.corner(label, 8)
    inst("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5) }, label)
    entries[#entries + 1] = { label = label, definition = definition, shown = false, revision = 0 }
  end
  local function refresh()
    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
      local label, definition = entry.label, entry.definition
      local enabled = utils.getConfigValue(definition.key) == true
      local text = ""
      if enabled then
        local ok, value = pcall(definition.read)
        if ok then
          text = tostring(value or "")
          entry.failed = false
        elseif not entry.failed then
          utils.recordError("Readout." .. definition.id, value)
          entry.failed = true
        end
      end
      if label.Text ~= text and text ~= "" then
        label.Text = text
        local bounds = textService:GetTextSize(text, label.TextSize, label.Font, Vector2.new(1000, 1000))
        label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(bounds.X) + 16, math.ceil(bounds.Y) + 10)
      end
      local shown = text ~= ""
      if entry.shown ~= shown then
        entry.shown = shown
        entry.revision += 1
        local revision = entry.revision
        if shown then
          label.Visible = true
        end
        context.motion.play(label, "control", { TextTransparency = shown and 0 or 1, BackgroundTransparency = shown and 0.2 or 1 }, function()
          if revision == entry.revision and label.Parent then
            label.Visible = shown
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  if #entries > 0 then
    local elapsed = 0
    context.trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
      elapsed += dt
      if elapsed >= 0.05 and not context.state.closing then
        elapsed = 0
        refresh()
      end
    end))
    context.scope.add(utils.observeConfig(refresh))
    refresh()
  end
  return {}
end
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Controller

-- [[ input ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiinput

-- module
local Controller = {}

-- configuration

-- setup
function Controller.setup() return true end

-- controller
function Controller.create(context)
  local Utils = context.deps.Utils
  local UIState = context.state
  local UIS = context.services.UIS
  local trackConn = context.trackConn
  local function inputBinding(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType.Name:match("^Gamepad") then
      return input.KeyCode
    end
    if
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    then
      return input.UserInputType
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function isKey(input, binding) return input and binding and binding ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and inputBinding(input) == binding end
  local function bindInput(actions)
    trackConn(UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
      local gamepad = input.UserInputType.Name:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil
      if (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonSelect or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Menu) and not UIState.keyCapture and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        context.window.toggle()
        return
      end
      if UIState.panelOpen and gamepad and not UIState.keyCapture then
        return
      end
      if
        gameProcessed
        or UIState.keyCapture
        or context.kit.isCapturing(input)
        or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
        or (not UIState.desktop and not gamepad)
        or not inputBinding(input)
      then
        return
      end
      if UIState.closing then
        return
      end
      local config = Utils.getConfig() or {}
      if context.combatUI ~= false and config.DynamicParry == true and isKey(input, config.DynamicParryKey) then
        return
      end
      if isKey(input, config.Keybind) then
        actions.triggerShortcut(inputBinding(input))
      elseif context.combatUI ~= false and isKey(input, config.SpamKeybind) then
        if config.ManualSpamMode == "Hold" then
          if not UIState.manualHoldInput then
            UIState.manualHoldInput = input
            context.floating.setSpam(true)
          end
        else
          context.floating.setSpam(not UIState.spamOn)
        end
      else
        actions.triggerShortcut(inputBinding(input))
      end
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
      local held = UIState.manualHoldInput
      if held and (held == input or (inputBinding(held) and inputBinding(held) == inputBinding(input))) then
        UIState.manualHoldInput = nil
        context.floating.setSpam(false)
      end
    end))
    trackConn(UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
      if UIState.manualHoldInput then
        UIState.manualHoldInput = nil
        context.floating.setSpam(false)
      end
    end))
  end
  local gui = game:GetService("GuiService")
  local previousSelection = gui.SelectedObject
  local function visible(object)
    if not object or not object.Parent then
      return false
    end
    local parent = object
    while parent and parent ~= context.refs.screenGui do
      if parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not parent.Visible then
        return false
      end
      parent = parent.Parent
    end
    return parent == context.refs.screenGui
  end
  local savedNavigation = {}
  for _, property in ipairs({ "GuiNavigationEnabled", "AutoSelectGuiEnabled" }) do
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return gui[property] end)
    if ok then
      savedNavigation[property] = value
    end
  end
  local navigationOwned = false
  local function setNavigation(value)
    if value == navigationOwned then
      return
    end
    navigationOwned = value
    for property, previous in pairs(savedNavigation) do
      pcall(function() gui[property] = value and true or previous end)
    end
  end
  local controllerNavigation = UIS.GamepadEnabled
  local function focusFirst()
    local panel = context.refs.configPanel
    if not panel then
      return
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(panel:GetDescendants()) do
      if item:IsA("GuiButton") and item.Selectable and item.Active and visible(item) then
        gui.SelectedObject = item
        return
      end
    end
  end
  trackConn(
    UIS.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(kind) controllerNavigation = kind.Name:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil or kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard end)
  )
  trackConn(context.services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local selected = gui.SelectedObject
    setNavigation(UIState.panelOpen and controllerNavigation)
    if UIState.panelOpen and controllerNavigation then
      if not visible(selected) then
        focusFirst()
      end
    elseif selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(context.refs.screenGui) then
      gui.SelectedObject = nil
    end
  end))
  context.scope.add(function()
    setNavigation(false)
    local selected = gui.SelectedObject
    if selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(context.refs.screenGui) then
      gui.SelectedObject = previousSelection and previousSelection.Parent and previousSelection or nil
    end
  end)
  bindInput(context.actions)
  return {}
end

-- contract
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return Controller

-- [[ interface lifecycle ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uilifecycle

local Controller = {}
function Controller.setup() return true end
function Controller.create(context)
  local controls, state = context.deps.Controls, context.state
  local retired = false
  local function restore(message)
    if not context.scope.alive then
      return
    end
    warn("[Exodus Reload] " .. tostring(message))
  end
  local function fade()
    if retired or not context.scope.alive then
      return
    end
    retired, state.closing = true, true
    -- Visual copies finish independently while the live session releases all input and resources.
    local service = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local profile = context.theme.MOTION.panel
    for _, source in ipairs({ context.refs.screenGui, context.refs.informationGui }) do
      if source and source.Parent then
        local copy = source:Clone()
        copy.Name = "ExodusRetiringUI"
        local group = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
        group.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        group.GroupTransparency = 0
        for _, child in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do
          child.Parent = group
        end
        group.Parent = copy
        for _, object in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
          if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
            object.Active, object.Selectable = false, false
          end
        end
        copy.Parent = source.Parent
        local tween = service:Create(group, TweenInfo.new(profile.duration, profile.style, profile.direction), {
          GroupTransparency = 1,
          Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
        })
        tween:Play()
        task.delay(profile.duration, function() copy:Destroy() end)
      end
    end
  end
  local function animateClose(action)
    if state.closing then
      return
    end
    if action == "reload" then
      if controls.onReload then
        local ok, reason = controls.onReload(restore)
        if ok == false and context.notifications.toast then
          context.notifications.toast(tostring(reason), true)
        end
      end
      return
    end
    _G.ExodusShutdownReason = "close"
    if controls.onClose then
      controls.onClose()
    else
      context.deps.Utils.stop()
    end
  end
  return { restore = restore, fade = fade, animateClose = animateClose }
end
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Controller

-- [[ notifications ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uinotifications, uinotificationview

-- code
local __part_uinotifications = (function()
  local Notifications = {}
  local CONFIG = { SILENT_TOPICS = { manualSpam = true, upDash = true } }
  function Notifications.setup() return true end
  function Notifications.shouldShow(config, desktop, event)
    event = event or {}
    if event.category == "critical" or event.category == "lifecycle" then
      return true
    end
    if event.topic and CONFIG.SILENT_TOPICS[event.topic] then
      return false
    end
    local enabled = config[desktop and "DesktopNotifications" or "MobileNotifications"] == true
    if not enabled then
      return false
    end
    if event.category == "system" then
      return true
    end
    return desktop and event.category == "shortcut" and config.DesktopShortcutNotifications == true
  end
  Notifications.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "shouldShow" }, requires = {} }
  return Notifications
end)()
local __part_uinotificationview = (function()
  local Controller = {}

  function Controller.setup() return true end
  function Controller.create(context)
    local Utils, UIState = context.deps.Utils, context.state
    local Appearance, Policy = context.deps.Appearance, context.deps.NotificationPolicy
    local state = { order = {}, tweens = {} }
    local layerMount
    local function key(value) return tostring(value or "general"):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_") end
    local function layer()
      local player = context.services.Players.LocalPlayer
      local parent = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      if not parent then
        return nil
      end
      if state.layer and state.layer.Parent then
        return state.layer
      end
      state.gui = parent:FindFirstChild("ExodusPersistentNotifications")
        or context.inst("ScreenGui", {
          Name = "ExodusPersistentNotifications",
          DisplayOrder = context.theme.DISPLAY_ORDER,
          ResetOnSpawn = false,
          IgnoreGuiInset = true,
          ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global,
        }, parent)
      if layerMount then
        context.scope.remove(layerMount)
      end
      layerMount = context.scope.add(context.deps.Runtime.mountLayer(state.gui, parent, context.theme.SCREEN_LAYERS.notifications))
      state.layer = state.gui:FindFirstChild("NotificationLayer")
        or context.inst("Frame", {
          Name = "NotificationLayer",
          Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
          BackgroundTransparency = 1,
          ZIndex = 100,
        }, state.gui)
      for _, card in ipairs(state.layer:GetChildren()) do
        local id = card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKey")
        if id and not table.find(state.order, id) then
          state.order[#state.order + 1] = id
        end
      end
      return state.layer
    end
    local function reflow(animated)
      if not state.layer then
        return
      end
      local offset = 24
      for index = #state.order, 1, -1 do
        if not state.layer:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. state.order[index]) then
          table.remove(state.order, index)
        end
      end
      for _, id in ipairs(state.order) do
        local card = state.layer:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. id)
        context.safeCancel(state.tweens[id])
        state.tweens[id] = context.twPlay(card, animated and "control" or 0, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -offset), GroupTransparency = 0 })
        offset += card.Size.Y.Offset + 8
      end
    end
    local function clear(id)
      id = key(id)
      if not layer() then
        return
      end
      local card = state.layer:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. id)
      local index = table.find(state.order, id)
      if index then
        table.remove(state.order, index)
      end
      if not card then
        reflow(true)
        return
      end
      context.safeCancel(state.tweens[id])
      local generation = (card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") or 0) + 1
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration", generation)
      state.tweens[id] = context.twPlay(card, "control", {
        GroupTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, card.Position.Y.Offset + 14),
      })
      task.delay(0.35, function()
        if card.Parent and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") == generation then
          card:Destroy()
          state.tweens[id] = nil
          reflow(true)
        end
      end)
    end
    local function show(message, id, kind, duration)
      local parent = layer()
      if not parent then
        return false
      end
      id = key(id)
      local card = parent:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. id)
      if card and not card:FindFirstChild("Content") then
        card:Destroy()
        card = nil
      end
      if not card then
        card = Appearance.notification(parent, "Notification_" .. id)
      end
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKey", id)
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationMessage", tostring(message))
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKind", kind or "info")
      Appearance.updateNotification(card, message, kind, context.viewport())
      local generation = (card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") or 0) + 1
      card:SetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration", generation)
      if not table.find(state.order, id) then
        state.order[#state.order + 1] = id
      end
      reflow(true)
      if duration and duration > 0 then
        task.delay(duration, function()
          if card.Parent and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationGeneration") == generation then
            clear(id)
          end
        end)
      end
      return true
    end
    local function persistent(message, id, kind, duration)
      id = key(id or message)
      local category = (id == "update" or id == "closing" or id == "loading") and "lifecycle" or (kind == "critical" and "critical" or "system")
      if not Policy.shouldShow(Utils.getConfig(), UIState.desktop, { category = category, topic = id }) then
        return false
      end
      if duration == nil and id ~= "dumper" then
        duration = 2.5
      end
      return show(message, id, kind, duration)
    end
    local function toast(message, important, event)
      event = important and { category = "critical" } or event or { category = "interaction" }
      if not Policy.shouldShow(Utils.getConfig(), UIState.desktop, event) then
        return false
      end
      local off = tostring(message):find(" Off", 1, true)
      return show(message, "toast", important and "critical" or (off and "warning" or "info"), 2.5)
    end
    layer()
    if state.layer then
      context.scope.connect(state.layer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
        for _, id in ipairs(state.order) do
          local card = state.layer:FindFirstChild("Notification_" .. id)
          local message = card and card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationMessage")
          if message then
            Appearance.updateNotification(card, message, card:GetAttribute("ExodusNotificationKind"), context.viewport())
          end
        end
        reflow(false)
      end)
    end
    return { toast = toast, persistent = persistent, clear = clear, layer = layer, state = state }
  end
  Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
  return Controller
end)()

return { __bundle = { uinotifications = __part_uinotifications, uinotificationview = __part_uinotificationview } }

-- [[ window ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiwindow

-- module
local Controller = {}

-- configuration

-- setup
function Controller.setup() return true end

-- controller
function Controller.create(context)
  local Utils = context.deps.Utils
  local UIState = context.state
  local CONFIG = context.theme
  local C = context.theme.COLORS
  local PW = context.theme.PANEL_W
  local PH = context.theme.PANEL_H
  local TITLE_H = context.theme.TITLE_H
  local PAD = context.theme.PAD
  local BTN_SIZE = context.theme.BTN_SIZE
  local PARTICLE_COLORS = context.theme.PARTICLE_COLORS
  local inst = context.inst
  local corner = context.corner
  local stroke = context.stroke
  local twPlay = context.twPlay
  local safeCancel = context.safeCancel
  local trackConn = context.trackConn
  local untrackConn = context.untrackConn
  local safeDisconnect = context.safeDisconnect
  local makeDraggable = context.makeDraggable
  local makeBtn = context.makeBtn
  local _wait = task.wait
  local _spawn = task.spawn
  local function btnPos()
    local config = Utils.getConfig()
    local x, y = config.BtnX, config.BtnY
    if type(x) == "number" and type(y) == "number" then
      return UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    end
    return UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -28)
  end
  local function panelPos()
    local config = Utils.getConfig()
    local x, y = config.PanelX, config.PanelY
    if type(x) == "number" and type(y) == "number" then
      return UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    end
    return UDim2.new(0.5, -PW / 2, 0.5, -PH / 2)
  end
  local function spawnParticle()
    if not context.refs.particleLayer or not context.refs.particleLayer.Parent then
      return
    end
    local isFar = math.random() < 0.6
    local size = isFar and math.random(2, 3) or math.random(4, 6)
    local startTrans = isFar and 0.5 or 0.2
    local color = PARTICLE_COLORS[math.random(1, #PARTICLE_COLORS)]
    local dot = inst("Frame", {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size),
      Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, 1, 0),
      BackgroundColor3 = color,
      BackgroundTransparency = startTrans,
      ZIndex = 4,
      Parent = context.refs.particleLayer,
    })
    corner(dot, 999)
    local dur = isFar and math.random(5, 9) or math.random(3, 5)
    local endX = math.clamp(dot.Position.X.Scale + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15, 0, 1)
    local travel = twPlay(dot, dur, {
      Position = UDim2.new(endX, 0, -0.1, 0),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    })
    if not travel then
      dot:Destroy()
      return
    end
    if travel then
      local connection
      connection = trackConn(travel.Completed:Connect(function()
        safeDisconnect(connection)
        untrackConn(connection)
        if dot.Parent then
          dot:Destroy()
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  local function togglePanel()
    if
      UIState.closing
      or not context.refs.configPanel
      or not context.refs.configPanel.Parent
      or not context.refs.floatingButton
      or not context.refs.floatingButton.Parent
    then
      return
    end
    UIState.panelOpen = not UIState.panelOpen
    safeCancel(UIState.panelTween)
    safeCancel(UIState.btnTween)
    if context.kit then
      context.kit.dismiss()
    end
    if context.pages then
      context.pages.suspend()
    end
    if UIState.panelOpen then
      if not context.refs.configPanel.Visible then
        context.refs.configPanel.GroupTransparency = 1
        context.refs.configPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PW * 0.97, 0, PH * 0.97)
      end
      context.refs.configPanel.Visible = true
      context.updateResponsiveScale()
      UIState.panelTween = twPlay(context.refs.configPanel, "panel", { Size = UDim2.new(0, PW, 0, PH), GroupTransparency = 0 })
      UIState.btnTween = twPlay(context.refs.floatingButton, "control", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, TextTransparency = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 44) })
    else
      UIState.panelTween = twPlay(context.refs.configPanel, "panel", { Size = UDim2.new(0, PW * 0.97, 0, PH * 0.97), GroupTransparency = 1 })
      UIState.btnTween =
        twPlay(context.refs.floatingButton, "control", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, TextTransparency = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_SIZE, 0, BTN_SIZE) })
      if UIState.panelTween then
        local conn
        conn = trackConn(UIState.panelTween.Completed:Connect(function()
          if not UIState.panelOpen then
            context.refs.configPanel.Visible = false
            context.refs.configPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PW, 0, PH)
            context.refs.configPanel.GroupTransparency = 0
          end
          safeDisconnect(conn)
          untrackConn(conn)
        end))
      else
        context.refs.configPanel.Visible = false
        context.refs.configPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PW, 0, PH)
        context.refs.configPanel.GroupTransparency = 0
      end
    end
  end
  context.refs.floatingButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "ExodusFloatingButton",

  corner(context.refs.floatingButton, 999)
  context.refs.floatingButtonStroke = context.kit.stroke(context.refs.floatingButton, nil, 2, true)
  context.refs.floatingButtonStroke.Transparency = 1
  trackConn(
    context.refs.floatingButton
      :GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundTransparency")
      :Connect(function() context.refs.floatingButtonStroke.Transparency = context.refs.floatingButton.BackgroundTransparency end)
  )
  task.defer(function()
    if not context.refs.floatingButton or not context.refs.floatingButton.Parent then
      return
    end
    twPlay(context.refs.floatingButton, "panel", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, TextTransparency = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BTN_SIZE, BTN_SIZE) })
    -- The outline follows BackgroundTransparency through kit.stroke.
  end)
  UIState.btnIsDragging = makeDraggable(context.refs.floatingButton, context.refs.floatingButton, function()
    context.setConfigValue("BtnX", context.refs.floatingButton.Position.X.Offset)
    context.setConfigValue("BtnY", context.refs.floatingButton.Position.Y.Offset)
  end)
  trackConn(context.refs.floatingButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if UIState.btnIsDragging() then
      return
    end
    togglePanel()
  end))
  context.refs.configPanel = inst("CanvasGroup", {
    Name = "ExodusPanel",
    Active = true,
    Size = UDim2.new(0, PW, 0, PH),
    Position = panelPos(),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.bg,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.03,
    GroupTransparency = 0,
    Visible = false,
    ZIndex = context.theme.LAYERS.panel,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    Parent = context.refs.screenGui,
  })
  corner(context.refs.configPanel, 16)
  stroke(context.refs.configPanel, nil, 1.5)
  context.refs.particleLayer = inst("Frame", {
    Name = "ParticleLayer",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ZIndex = 4,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  local particlePanel = context.refs.configPanel
  _spawn(function()
    while context.scope.alive and context.refs.configPanel == particlePanel and particlePanel.Parent do
      _wait(math.random() * 0.6 + 0.15)
      if context.refs.configPanel == particlePanel and particlePanel.Parent and particlePanel.Visible and not UIState.closing then
        spawnParticle()
      end
    end
  end)
  context.refs.titleBar = inst("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TITLE_H),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.header,
    Active = true,
    ZIndex = 6,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  corner(context.refs.titleBar, 16)
  local header = context.deps.Header.create(context, context.refs.titleBar)
  makeDraggable(
    header.title,
    context.refs.configPanel,
    function() Utils.setConfig({ PanelX = context.refs.configPanel.Position.X.Offset, PanelY = context.refs.configPanel.Position.Y.Offset }) end
  )
  context.refs.minimizeButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "MinimizePanel",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 30, 0.5, -15),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 14,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 7,
    Parent = header.buttons,
  })
  context.refs.minimizeButton.LayoutOrder = 4
  corner(context.refs.minimizeButton, 8)
  stroke(context.refs.minimizeButton, nil, 1)
  context.kit.icon(context.refs.minimizeButton, "minimize")
  trackConn(context.refs.minimizeButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() twPlay(context.refs.minimizeButton, "feedback", { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end))
  trackConn(context.refs.minimizeButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() twPlay(context.refs.minimizeButton, "feedback", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }) end))
  trackConn(context.refs.minimizeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if UIState.panelOpen then
      togglePanel()
    end
  end))
  local settingsButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "HubSettingsButton",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 66, 0.5, -15),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextSize = 18,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 9,
    Parent = header.buttons,
  })
  settingsButton.LayoutOrder = 3
  corner(settingsButton, 8)
  stroke(settingsButton, nil, 1)
  context.kit.icon(settingsButton, "settings")
  local infoButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "HubInformationButton",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 102, 0.5, -15),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
    Text = "i",
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextColor3 = C.text,
    TextSize = 16,
    ZIndex = 9,
    Parent = header.buttons,
  })
  infoButton.LayoutOrder = 2
  corner(infoButton, 8)
  stroke(infoButton, nil, 1)
  trackConn(infoButton.Activated:Connect(function() context.pages.toggle("information") end))
  local assistsButton = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "HubAssistsButton",
    Visible = context.combatUI ~= false,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 138, 0.5, -15),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
    Text = "",
    ZIndex = 9,
    Parent = header.buttons,
  })
  assistsButton.LayoutOrder = 1
  corner(assistsButton, 8)
  stroke(assistsButton, nil, 1)
  context.kit.icon(assistsButton, "assists")
  trackConn(assistsButton.Activated:Connect(function() context.pages.toggle("assists") end))
  context.refs.killBtn = inst("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 124, 0, 26),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 124, 1, -PAD - 26),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.redDark,
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
    Text = "Close Script",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200),
    TextSize = 11,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 7,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  corner(context.refs.killBtn, 6)
  stroke(context.refs.killBtn, nil, 1)
  trackConn(context.refs.killBtn.Activated:Connect(function() context.lifecycle.animateClose("close") end))
  context.refs.reloadButton = makeBtn("Reload", 0, 0, 124, 26, context.refs.configPanel, C.btnBlue)
  context.refs.reloadButton.Name = "ReloadHub"
  context.refs.reloadButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -PAD - 256, 1, -PAD - 26)
  context.refs.reloadButton.TextSize = 11
  trackConn(context.refs.reloadButton.Activated:Connect(function() context.lifecycle.animateClose("reload") end))
  local previous = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "PreviousPage",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 26),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD, 1, -PAD - 26),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = C.text,
    TextSize = 20,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 7,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  local pageLabel = inst("TextLabel", {
    Name = "PageLabel",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 82, 0, 26),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD + 34, 1, -PAD - 26),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "1/5 Main",
    TextColor3 = C.text,
    TextSize = 9,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 7,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  local nextPage = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "NextPage",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 26),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD + 118, 1, -PAD - 26),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
    Text = "",
    TextColor3 = C.text,
    TextSize = 20,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    ZIndex = 7,
    Parent = context.refs.configPanel,
  })
  corner(previous, 6)
  corner(nextPage, 6)
  local previousIcon = context.kit.icon(previous, "chevron", { Rotation = 90 })
  local nextIcon = context.kit.icon(nextPage, "chevron", { Rotation = -90 })
  local function updateNavigation(state)
    assistsButton.BackgroundColor3 = state.id == "assists" and C.accent or C.btnDark
    pageLabel.Text = state.utility and state.title or tostring(state.index) .. "/" .. tostring(state.count) .. " " .. state.title
    previous.Visible = not state.utility
    nextPage.Visible = not state.utility
    previous.Active = state.index ~= nil and state.index > 1
    previous.Selectable = previous.Active
    nextPage.Active = state.index ~= nil and state.index < state.count
    nextPage.Selectable = nextPage.Active
    previousIcon.ImageTransparency = previous.Active and 0 or 0.7
    nextIcon.ImageTransparency = nextPage.Active and 0 or 0.7
    settingsButton.BackgroundColor3 = state.id == "config" and C.accent or C.btnDark
  end
  trackConn(settingsButton.Activated:Connect(function() context.pages.toggle("config") end))
  trackConn(previous.Activated:Connect(function() context.pages.step(-1) end))
  trackConn(nextPage.Activated:Connect(function() context.pages.step(1) end))
  local iconGeneration = 0
  local floatingIcon = inst("ImageLabel", {
    Name = "HubIcon",
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.68),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
    Visible = false,
    ZIndex = 11,
  }, context.refs.floatingButton)
  trackConn(
    context.refs.floatingButton
      :GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextTransparency")
      :Connect(function() floatingIcon.ImageTransparency = context.refs.floatingButton.TextTransparency end)
  )
  local function setIcon(image)
    iconGeneration += 1
    local generation = iconGeneration
    local function apply(value)
      floatingIcon.Image, floatingIcon.Visible = value or "", value ~= nil
      floatingIcon.ImageTransparency = context.refs.floatingButton.TextTransparency
      context.refs.floatingButton.Text = value and "" or "E"
      header.setIcon(value)
    end
    apply(nil)
    if not image then
      return
    end
    floatingIcon.Image, header.icon.Image = image, image
    local failed, ready = false, false
    local function success()
      if ready or failed or generation ~= iconGeneration or not context.scope.alive then
        return
      end
      ready = true
      apply(image)
      floatingIcon.ImageTransparency, header.icon.ImageTransparency = 1, 1
      twPlay(floatingIcon, "control", { ImageTransparency = context.refs.floatingButton.TextTransparency })
      twPlay(header.icon, "control", { ImageTransparency = 0 })
    end
    local function failure()
      if failed or generation ~= iconGeneration or not context.scope.alive then
        return
      end
      failed = true
      apply(nil)
      Utils.recordError("UI.Icon", "Image failed to load: " .. image)
      context.notifications.toast("Ícone: não foi possível carregar a imagem.", true)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      if generation ~= iconGeneration or not context.scope.alive then
        return
      end
      local ok = pcall(function()
        game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({ floatingIcon, header.icon }, function(_, status)
          if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
            success()
          else
            failure()
          end
        end)
      end)
      if not ok then
        failure()
      elseif floatingIcon.IsLoaded then
        success()
      end
    end)
    task.delay(8, function()
      if context.scope.alive and generation == iconGeneration and not ready then
        failure()
      end
    end)
  end
  return { toggle = togglePanel, updateNavigation = updateNavigation, setIcon = setIcon }
end

-- contract
Controller.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return Controller

-- [[ uiconfig ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiconfig

-- module
local UIConfig = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  PAGES = {
    {
      id = "information",
      title = "Informações",
      columns = 1,
      width = 360,
      utility = true,
      sections = {
        { title = "Sessão", components = { { kind = "readout", info = "session" } } },

        { title = "Servidor", components = { { kind = "readout", info = "server" } } },
        { title = "Versões", components = { { kind = "readout", info = "versions" } } },
        { title = "Desenvolvedores", components = { { kind = "readout", info = "developers" } } },
      },
    },
    {
      id = "antilag",
      title = "Anti Lag",
      columns = 1,
      width = 360,
      sections = {
        {
          title = "Anti Lag",
          components = {
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Ativar Anti Lag", key = "AntiLagEnabled" },
            {
              kind = "slider",
              title = "Distância de renderização",
              description = "Limita a renderização em studs.",
              key = "AntiLagRenderDistance",
              parentKey = "AntiLagEnabled",
              min = 300,
              max = 1200,
              increment = 1,
              valueName = "studs",
            },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Remover efeitos", key = "AntiLagRemoveEffects", parentKey = "AntiLagEnabled" },

    {
      id = "indeed",
      title = "Universals",

      width = 360,

        {
          title = "Developer Tools",
          components = {
            {
              kind = "click",
              title = "Dumper",
              description = "Salva scripts acessíveis. Depende do executor.",
              action = "dumper",
            },
          },
        },
        {
          title = "Universal Controls",
          components = {
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Auto Jump", key = "AutoJump", shortcutKey = "JumpKeybind" },
            { kind = "number", title = "Camera Sensitivity", key = "CameraSensitivity", min = 0 },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Anti AFK", key = "AntiAFK", action = "antiAFK", shortcutKey = "AntiAFKKeybind" },
            {
              kind = "toggle",
              title = "Infinite Zoom",
              description = "Libera o zoom da câmera.",
              key = "UniversalInfiniteZoom",
              feature = "InfiniteZoom",
            },
            {
              kind = "toggle",
              title = "Infinite Jump",
              description = "Pula no ar.",
              key = "UniversalInfiniteJump",
              shortcutKey = "InfiniteJumpKeybind",
              feature = "InfiniteJump",
            },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Fly", description = "Permite voar.", key = "UniversalFly", shortcutKey = "FlyKeybind", feature = "Fly" },
            {
              kind = "scroll",
              title = "Fly Speed",

              kind = "scroll",
              title = "Gravity",
              description = "Define a gravidade.",

              parentKey = "UniversalGravityEnabled",
              min = 0,
              max = 400,
              increment = 1,
              valueName = "studs/s²",
            },
            {
              kind = "toggle",
              title = "Invisicam",
              description = "Evita que o personagem cubra a câmera.",
              key = "UniversalInvisicam",
