              parentKey = "AutoExecuteOnJoin",
              description = "Off: só neste jogo. On: todos.",
            },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "Atualizar automaticamente", key = "AutoExecute", description = "Atualiza quando o jogo permite." },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "System Notifications", key = "DesktopNotifications", desktopOnly = true },
            {
              kind = "toggle",
              title = "Shortcut Notifications",
              description = "Avisa ao usar atalhos.",
              key = "DesktopShortcutNotifications",
              parentKey = "DesktopNotifications",
              desktopOnly = true,
            },
            { kind = "toggle", title = "System Notifications", key = "MobileNotifications", mobileOnly = true },
            {
              kind = "toggle",
              title = "Modo PC",
              description = "Usa a interface de PC.",
              key = "ForcePCUI",
              desktopExpanded = true,
            },
            { kind = "button", title = "Resetar personagem", description = "Reinicia o personagem.", action = "resetCharacter" },
            { kind = "button", title = "Rejoin", description = "Volta ao mesmo servidor.", action = "rejoin" },
            { kind = "button", title = "Server Hop", description = "Busca outro servidor com ping até 100 ms.", action = "serverHop" },
            { kind = "button", title = "Reset settings", action = "resetSettings" },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  SETTINGS = {
    schema = {
      MobileNotifications = "boolean",
      DesktopNotifications = "boolean",
      DesktopShortcutNotifications = "boolean",
      ForcePCUI = "boolean",
      CameraSensitivity = "rate",
      AntiAFK = "boolean",
      AutoJump = "boolean",
      JumpKeybind = "keyCode",
      BtnX = "position",
      BtnY = "position",
      PanelX = "position",
      PanelY = "position",
    },
    defaults = {
      MobileNotifications = true,
      DesktopNotifications = true,
      DesktopShortcutNotifications = true,
      ForcePCUI = false,
      CameraSensitivity = 1.5,
      AntiAFK = true,
      AutoJump = false,
      JumpKeybind = Enum.KeyCode.J,
    },
  },
}

-- shortcuts
for _, page in ipairs(CONFIG.PAGES) do
  for _, section in ipairs(page.sections) do
    for _, definition in ipairs(section.components or {}) do
      local key = definition.shortcutKey
      if key then
        CONFIG.SETTINGS.schema[key] = "keyCode"
        if CONFIG.SETTINGS.defaults[key] == nil then
          CONFIG.SETTINGS.defaults[key] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
function UIConfig.getPages(definition)
  definition = definition or {}
  local pages, byId = {}, {}
  for _, source in ipairs(CONFIG.PAGES) do
    local page = table.clone(source)
    page.sections = {}
    for _, originalSection in ipairs(source.sections) do
      local section = table.clone(originalSection)
      section.components = table.clone(originalSection.components or {})
      page.sections[#page.sections + 1] = section
    end
    byId[page.id] = page
    pages[#pages + 1] = page
  end
  for _, page in ipairs(definition.pages or {}) do
    assert(not byId[page.id], "Duplicate game page: " .. tostring(page.id))
    byId[page.id] = page
    pages[#pages + 1] = page
  end
  for _, addition in ipairs(definition.additions or {}) do
    local page = assert(byId[addition.page], "Unknown UI page")
    local section = assert(page.sections[addition.section or 1], "Unknown UI section")
    for _, component in ipairs(addition.components or {}) do
      section.components[#section.components + 1] = component
    end
  end
  local ordered, seen = {}, {}
  for _, id in ipairs(definition.pageOrder or {}) do
    if byId[id] and not seen[id] then
      ordered[#ordered + 1] = byId[id]
      seen[id] = true
    end
  end
  for _, page in ipairs(pages) do
    if not seen[page.id] then
      ordered[#ordered + 1] = page
    end
  end
  return ordered
end

-- public-api
UIConfig.pages = CONFIG.PAGES
UIConfig.__config = CONFIG.SETTINGS

-- contract
UIConfig.__contract = { provides = { "getPages" }, data = { "pages" }, requires = {} }

return UIConfig

-- [[ bounded window header ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiheader

local Header = {}
function Header.setup() return true end
function Header.create(context, parent)
  local T, inst = context.theme, context.inst
  local gap, buttonGap, buttonSize = 12, 6, 30
  local icon = inst("ImageLabel", {
    Name = "HubIcon",
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(T.PAD, (T.TITLE_H - 28) / 2),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
    Visible = false,
    ZIndex = 7,
  }, parent)
  local title = inst("Frame", { Name = "HeaderText", BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true, ZIndex = 7 }, parent)
  local brand = inst("TextLabel", {
    Name = "Brand",
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = '<font color="#D6D3DC">Exodus</font> <font color="#A45AF0">Hub</font>' .. (context.hub.version and (" | v" .. context.hub.version) or ""),
    RichText = true,
    TextColor3 = T.COLORS.text,
    TextSize = T.TITLE_TEXT_SIZE,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
    ZIndex = 7,
  }, title)
  local author = inst("TextLabel", {
    Name = "Author",
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "— " .. context.deps.Utils.author(),
    TextColor3 = T.COLORS.text,
    TextTransparency = T.AUTHOR_TRANSPARENCY,
    TextSize = T.AUTHOR_TEXT_SIZE,
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
    ZIndex = 7,
  }, title)
  local buttons = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
    Name = "HeaderButtons",
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -T.PAD, 0.5, -18),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38),
    CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
    ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
    ScrollBarThickness = 0,
    ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.COLORS.subtext,
    Active = true,
    ClipsDescendants = true,
    ZIndex = 9,
  }, parent)
  inst("UIListLayout", {
    FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
    Padding = UDim.new(0, buttonGap),
  }, buttons)
  inst("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 2) }, buttons)
  local function refresh()
    local count = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(buttons:GetChildren()) do
      if child:IsA("GuiButton") and child.Visible then
        count += 1
      end
    end
    local contentWidth = math.max(0, count * buttonSize + math.max(0, count - 1) * buttonGap + 4)
    local available = math.floor(T.PANEL_W * 0.35)
    local controlsWidth = math.min(contentWidth, available)
    buttons.Size, buttons.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(controlsWidth, 38), UDim2.fromOffset(contentWidth, 0)
    buttons.ScrollingEnabled = contentWidth > controlsWidth
    buttons.ScrollBarThickness = buttons.ScrollingEnabled and 2 or 0
    if not buttons.ScrollingEnabled then
      buttons.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    end
    local left = T.PAD + (icon.Visible and 28 + gap or 0)
    local width = math.max(0, T.PANEL_W - T.PAD - controlsWidth - gap - left)
    title.Position, title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(left, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(width, T.TITLE_H)
    local plain = "Exodus Hub" .. (context.hub.version and (" | v" .. context.hub.version) or "")
    local bounds = game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(plain, T.TITLE_TEXT_SIZE, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Vector2.new(10000, T.TITLE_H))
    local brandWidth = math.min(width, math.ceil(bounds.X) + 2)
    brand.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(brandWidth, T.TITLE_H)
    author.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(brandWidth + T.TITLE_SPACING, 0)
    author.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(0, width - brandWidth - T.TITLE_SPACING), T.TITLE_H)
    author.Visible = author.Size.X.Offset > 24
  end
  local function addButton(button)
    button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize)
    context.scope.connect(button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), refresh)
    refresh()
  end
  context.scope.connect(buttons.ChildAdded, function(child)
    if child:IsA("GuiButton") then
      addButton(child)
    end
  end)
  context.scope.connect(buttons.ChildRemoved, refresh)
  refresh()
  return {
    buttons = buttons,
    title = title,
    icon = icon,
    setIcon = function(image)
      icon.Image, icon.Visible = image or "", image ~= nil
      refresh()
    end,
    refresh = refresh,
  }
end
Header.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Header

-- [[ uiicons ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiicons

-- module
local Icons = {}
local Theme

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  VERSION = "68fcb145dc3f",
  IMAGES = {
    assists = {
      png = "",
      fallback = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Settings/MenuBarIcons/GameSettingsTab.png",
    },
    settings = {
      png = "",
      fallback = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Settings/MenuBarIcons/GameSettingsTab.png",
    },
    chevron = {
      png = "",
      fallback = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Settings/DropDown/DropDown.png",
    },
    minimize = {
      png = "",
      fallback = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Settings/Slider/Less.png",
    },
  },
}

-- setup
function Icons.setup(deps)
  Theme = deps.Theme.tokens
  return true
end

-- assets
local cache = {}
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local digits = {}
for index = 1, #alphabet do
  digits[string.byte(alphabet, index)] = index - 1
end
local function decode(payload)
  local bytes = {}
  for index = 1, #payload, 4 do
    local a, b, c, d = string.byte(payload, index, index + 3)
    local value = digits[a] * 262144 + digits[b] * 4096 + (digits[c] or 0) * 64 + (digits[d] or 0)
    bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 65536) % 256)
    if c ~= 61 then
      bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / 256) % 256)
    end
    if d ~= 61 then
      bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(value % 256)
    end
  end
  return table.concat(bytes)
end
local function resolve(name)
  local definition = assert(CONFIG.IMAGES[name], "Unknown UI icon: " .. tostring(name))
  if cache[name] then
    return cache[name]
  end
  local image = definition.fallback
  local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
  if type(writefile) == "function" and type(asset) == "function" then
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
      local folder = "exodus hub"
      if type(makefolder) == "function" and (type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder(folder)) then
        pcall(makefolder, folder)
      end
      local path = folder .. "/ui_" .. name .. "_" .. CONFIG.VERSION .. ".png"
      if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(path) then
        writefile(path, decode(definition.png))
      end
      return asset(path)
    end)
    if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
      image = result
    end
  end
  cache[name] = image
  return image
end

-- public-api
function Icons.create(parent, name, properties)
  local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
  icon.Name = "Icon_" .. name
  icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  icon.Active = false
  icon.Selectable = false
  icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
  icon.Image = resolve(name)
  icon.ImageColor3 = Theme.COLORS.text
  icon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
  icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
  icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
  icon.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
  for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
    icon[key] = value
  end
  icon.Parent = parent
  return icon
end

-- contract
Icons.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
  requires = { Theme = "uitheme" },
  requiresData = { Theme = { "tokens" } },
}

return Icons

-- [[ ui ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules ui

-- module
local ExodusUI = {}
local active
local configuredIcon, iconOverride

-- configuration

-- public-components
local Components = {}
for _, name in ipairs({
  "label",
  "button",
  "textInput",
  "number",
  "toggle",
  "divider",
  "progressBar",
  "dropdown",
  "slider",
  "segmented",
  "tabs",
  "rate_selector",
}) do
  Components[name] = function(parent, options)
    assert(active and active.kit and active.scope.alive, "Call ExodusUI.setup before creating components, or use UIKit.create for a standalone library")
    return active.kit.Components[name](parent, options)
  end
end
ExodusUI.Components = Components

-- composition
function ExodusUI.setup(deps, preview)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Controls) ~= "table" then
    return false, "missing UI dependencies"
  end
  for alias in pairs(ExodusUI.__contract.requires) do
    if type(deps[alias]) ~= "table" then
      return false, "missing UI dependency: " .. alias
    end
  end
  for alias, methods in pairs(ExodusUI.__contract.requiresMethods) do
    for _, method in ipairs(methods) do
      if type(deps[alias][method]) ~= "function" then
        return false, "missing UI method: " .. alias .. "." .. method
      end
    end
  end
  if type(_G.ExodusUICleanup) == "function" then
    if not preview and type(_G.ExodusUIFadeOut) == "function" then
      pcall(_G.ExodusUIFadeOut)
    end
    _G.ExodusUICleanup()
  else
    local playerGui = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ExodusUISystem")
    if old then
      old:Destroy()
    end
  end
  local context = deps.Context.create(deps, preview and preview.deviceDesktop)
  active = context
  context.hub = deps.GameContext.getProfile()
  local hubUI = deps.Hub.getUIConfig()
  context.combatUI = hubUI.combatUI == true
  context.abilityKeys = hubUI.abilityKeys or {}
  context.miniBalls = hubUI.miniBalls or {}
  context.notifications = deps.Notifications.create(context)
  context.notifications.layer()
  context.floating = deps.Floating.create(context)
  context.window = deps.Window.create(context)
  if iconOverride then
    context.window.setIcon(configuredIcon)
  else
    context.window.setIcon(deps.Theme.tokens.ICON)
  end
  deps.Telemetry.create(context)
  context.lifecycle = deps.Lifecycle.create(context)
  local function cleanup()
    context.destroy()
    if _G.ExodusUICleanup == cleanup then
      if active == context then
        active = nil
      end
      _G.ExodusUICleanup, _G.ExodusUIFadeOut, _G.ExodusUIRestore = nil, nil, nil
      _G.ExodusShowPersistentNotification, _G.ExodusClearPersistentNotification = nil, nil
    end
  end
  _G.ExodusUICleanup = cleanup
  _G.ExodusUIFadeOut = context.lifecycle.fade
  _G.ExodusUIRestore = context.lifecycle.restore
  _G.ExodusShowPersistentNotification = context.notifications.persistent
  _G.ExodusClearPersistentNotification = context.notifications.clear
  local rebuildQueued = false
  local function rebuild(reset)
    if rebuildQueued then
      return
    end
    rebuildQueued = true
    local owner = context.refs.screenGui
    local wasOpen, snapshot = context.state.panelOpen, context.pages.snapshot()
    task.defer(function()
      if not context.scope.alive or not owner.Parent or context.state.closing then
        return
      end
      local ok, reason = ExodusUI.setup(deps, { snapshot = not reset and snapshot or nil, open = wasOpen, deviceDesktop = context.state.deviceDesktop })
      if not ok then
        warn("[Exodus] Falha ao atualizar interface: " .. tostring(reason))
      end
    end)
  end
  context.actions = deps.UIActions.create({
    scope = context.kit.scope,
    controls = deps.Controls,
    desktop = context.state.desktop,
    notify = context.notifications.toast,
    persistent = context.notifications.persistent,
    setSpam = context.floating.setSpam,
    showMini = context.floating.showMini,
    rebuild = rebuild,
    abilitiesEnabled = deps.Hub.areAbilitiesEnabled,
  })
  context.pages = deps.UIPages.create(context.kit, context.refs.configPanel, deps.UIPages.forGame(deps.UIConfig.getPages(hubUI), context.combatUI), {
    desktop = context.state.desktop,
    capabilities = { clashPrediction = context.combatUI and deps.Hub.hasClashPrediction() },
    read = deps.Utils.getConfigValue,
    resolve = context.actions.resolve,
    onComponent = context.actions.attach,
    onError = function(name, reason, title)
      deps.Utils.recordError("UI." .. tostring(name), reason)
      context.notifications.toast("Falha ao carregar " .. tostring(title) .. ".", true)
    end,
    abilitiesEnabled = deps.Hub.areAbilitiesEnabled,
    onNavigate = context.window.updateNavigation,
  })
  deps.Details.create(context)
  context.floating.refreshAbilities()
  context.updateResponsiveScale()
  deps.Input.create(context)
  deps.Assists.create(context)
  if preview and preview.snapshot then
    context.pages.restore(preview.snapshot)
  end
  context.scope.add(deps.Utils.observeSpam(function()
    local manual = deps.Utils.isManualSpamActive()
    if context.state.spamOn ~= manual then
      context.floating.setSpam(manual)
    end
    context.actions.refreshManual()
  end))
  context.scope.add(deps.Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    context.floating.sync(changes)
    context.actions.refreshManual()
    if changes.ForcePCUI ~= nil then
      rebuild()
    end
  end))
  if preview and preview.open then
    context.window.toggle()
  end
  return true
end

function ExodusUI.notify(...)
  if active and active.scope.alive then
    active.notifications.persistent(...)
  end
end

function ExodusUI.setIcon(image)
  assert(image == nil or type(image) == "string" or type(image) == "number", "Icon must be an asset id or image URI")
  if type(image) == "number" or (type(image) == "string" and image:match("^%d+$")) then
    image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(image)
  end
  if image == "" then
    image = nil
  end
  configuredIcon, iconOverride = image, true
  if active and active.scope.alive then
    active.window.setIcon(image)
  end
  return true
end

-- contract
ExodusUI.__contract = {
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameContext = "gamecontext",
    UIConfig = "uiconfig",
    Hub = "hubapi",
    UIKit = "uikit",
    UIPages = "uipages",
    UIActions = "uiactions",
    NotificationPolicy = "uinotifications",
    Runtime = "uiruntime",
    Theme = "uitheme",
    Appearance = "uiappearance",
    Context = "uicontext",
    Window = "uiwindow",
    Header = "uiheader",
    Floating = "uifloating",
    Notifications = "uinotificationview",
    Telemetry = "uitelemetry",
    Input = "uiinput",
    Assists = "uiassists",
    Lifecycle = "uilifecycle",
    Information = "information",
    Details = "uidetails",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    GameContext = { "getProfile" },
    Utils = {
      "getConfig",
      "getConfigValue",
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "isActive",
      "isManualSpamActive",
      "setConfig",
      "resetConfig",
      "setManualSpamActive",
      "normalizeSpamRate",
      "observeConfig",
      "observeSpam",
      "recordError",
      "stop",
      "name",
      "version",
      "author",
    },
    Hub = {
      "getUIConfig",
      "getReadouts",
      "hasClashPrediction",
      "getAbilityAvailability",
      "getGameContext",
      "areAbilitiesEnabled",
      "observeAbilityMode",
    },
    Appearance = { "notification", "updateNotification" },
    UIConfig = { "getPages" },
    UIKit = { "create" },
    UIPages = { "create", "forGame" },
    UIActions = { "create" },
    NotificationPolicy = { "shouldShow" },
    Runtime = { "scope", "motion", "isVisible", "mountLayer" },
    Context = { "create" },
    Window = { "create" },
    Header = { "create" },
    Floating = { "create" },
    Notifications = { "create" },
    Telemetry = { "create" },
    Input = { "create" },
    Assists = { "create" },
    Lifecycle = { "create" },
    Information = { "snapshot" },
    Details = { "create" },
  },
  requiresData = { UIConfig = { "pages" }, Theme = { "tokens" } },
  data = { "Components" },
  provides = { "setup", "notify", "setIcon" },
}

return ExodusUI
sources.ui/pages.luau:
-- [[ uipages ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uipages

-- module
local Pages = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { COLUMNS = { [1] = true, [2] = true } }

-- setup
function Pages.setup() return true end

-- validation
function Pages.validate(definitions, components)
  assert(type(definitions) == "table" and #definitions > 0, "UI pages must be a non-empty ordered list")
  local ids, normal = {}, 0
  for _, page in ipairs(definitions) do
    assert(type(page.id) == "string" and page.id ~= "" and not ids[page.id], "UI page id must be unique")
    assert(type(page.title) == "string" and type(page.sections) == "table", "UI page requires title and sections: " .. page.id)
    assert(CONFIG.COLUMNS[page.columns], "UI page columns must be 1 or 2: " .. page.id)
    ids[page.id] = true
    if not page.utility then
      normal += 1
    end
    local keys, parents = {}, {}
    for _, section in ipairs(page.sections) do
      assert((section.column or 1) >= 1 and (section.column or 1) <= page.columns, "Invalid column in " .. page.id)
      for _, definition in ipairs(section.components or {}) do
        assert(type(components[definition.kind]) == "function", "Unknown UI component: " .. tostring(definition.kind) .. " in " .. page.id)
        if definition.key then
          assert(not keys[definition.key], "Duplicate UI key in " .. page.id .. ": " .. definition.key)
          keys[definition.key] = true
        end
        if definition.parentKey then
          parents[definition.key or definition] = definition.parentKey
        end
      end
    end
    for key, parent in pairs(parents) do
      local visited = { [key] = true }
      while parent do
        assert(keys[parent] and not visited[parent], "Missing or cyclic parentKey in " .. page.id)
        visited[parent] = true
        parent = parents[parent]
      end
    end
  end
  assert(normal > 0, "UI needs at least one primary page")
  return true
end
function Pages.forGame(definitions, integrated)
  local pages = {}
  for _, sourcePage in ipairs(definitions) do
    if sourcePage.integrationOnly and not integrated then
      continue
    end
    local page = table.clone(sourcePage)
    page.sections = {}
    for _, sourceSection in ipairs(sourcePage.sections) do
      if sourceSection.integrationOnly and not integrated then
        continue
      end
      local section = table.clone(sourceSection)
      section.components = {}
      for _, definition in ipairs(sourceSection.components or {}) do
        if not definition.integrationOnly or integrated then
          section.components[#section.components + 1] = table.clone(definition)
        end
      end
      if #section.components > 0 then
        page.sections[#page.sections + 1] = section
      end
    end
    if #page.sections > 0 then
      pages[#pages + 1] = page
    end
  end
  return pages
end

-- rendering
function Pages.create(kit, parent, definitions, context)
  context = context or {}
  context.read = context.read or kit.read
  Pages.validate(definitions, kit.Components)
  local T, inst = kit.Theme, kit.instance
  local width = T.PANEL_W - T.PAD * 2
  local height = T.PANEL_H - T.TITLE_H - 60
  local origin = UDim2.fromOffset(T.PAD, T.TITLE_H + T.PAD)
  local registry, normal, rows, bindings, readouts = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  local readoutRows, sections = {}, {}
  local active, returnId, generation = nil, nil, 0
  local tweens, transitioning = {}, false
  local alive = true
  local controller = {}
  local lifetime = kit.scope.child()
  local motion = kit.createMotion(lifetime)
  local bleed = T.CONTROL_BLEED
  local refreshDisclosure
  local function list(parent, gap)
    return inst(
      "UIListLayout",
      { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or T.CARD_GAP), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center },
      parent
    )
  end
  local function stack(parent, name, row)
    local root =
      inst("Frame", { Name = name, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 6 }, parent)
    list(root, row and math.max(0, T.CARD_GAP - bleed) or math.max(0, T.CARD_GAP - bleed * 2))
    if row then
      inst("UIPadding", { PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, bleed), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bleed) }, root)
    end
    return root
  end
  local function included(definition)
    if definition.requiresCapability and not (context.capabilities and context.capabilities[definition.requiresCapability]) then
      return false
    end
    return not (context.desktop and definition.mobileOnly) and not (not context.desktop and definition.desktopOnly)
  end
  for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
    local root = inst("CanvasGroup", {
      GroupTransparency = 1,
      Name = "Page_" .. definition.id,
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
      Position = origin,
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Visible = false,
      ClipsDescendants = true,
      ZIndex = 6,
    }, parent)
    local page = { Root = root, definition = definition, columns = {}, rows = {} }
    registry[definition.id] = page
    if not definition.utility then
      normal[#normal + 1] = definition.id
    end
    local pageWidth = definition.width or width
    local columnWidth = (pageWidth - T.GAP * (definition.columns - 1)) / definition.columns
    for column = 1, definition.columns do
      local scroll = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "Column" .. column,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(columnWidth, height),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset((width - pageWidth) / 2 + (column - 1) * (columnWidth + T.GAP), 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollBarThickness = T.SCROLLBAR,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.COLORS.accent,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Active = true,
        ZIndex = 6,
      }, root)
      inst(
        "UIPadding",
        { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, T.CARD_GAP) },
        scroll
      )
      list(scroll, math.max(0, T.CARD_GAP - bleed * 2))
      page.columns[column] = scroll
    end
    local keyed, pending = {}, {}
    for sectionIndex, section in ipairs(definition.sections) do
      if included(section) then
        local sectionRoot = stack(page.columns[section.column or 1], "Section" .. sectionIndex)
        sections[sectionRoot] = {}
        sectionRoot.LayoutOrder = sectionIndex
        if section.title then
          local label = kit.Components.label(sectionRoot, { text = section.title })
          label.Root.LayoutOrder = 0
        end
        for index, source in ipairs(section.components or {}) do
          if included(source) then
            local options = table.clone(source)
            local row = stack(sectionRoot, "Row_" .. tostring(source.key or source.action or index), true)
            row.LayoutOrder = index
            local ok, handle = pcall(function()
              if context.resolve then
                options = context.resolve(options) or options
              end
              if options.kind ~= "readout" and options.kind ~= "divider" and options.kind ~= "progressBar" then
                local caption = options.title or options.text
                assert(type(caption) == "string" and caption:match("%S"), "Component text is missing")
              end
              local control = kit.Components[options.kind](row, options)
              assert(control and control.Root and control.Root.Parent == row, "Component did not mount")
              if options.kind ~= "readout" and (options.title or options.text) then
                local title = control.Root:FindFirstChild("Title")
                assert(not title or title.Text ~= "", "Component title is empty")
              end
              return control
            end)
            if not ok then
              local reason = handle
              for _, child in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                  child:Destroy()
                end
              end
              handle = kit.Components.readout(row, { kind = "readout" })
              handle.setValue("Erro: " .. tostring(source.title or source.key or source.kind) .. " não carregou.")
              if context.onError then
                context.onError(source.key or source.info or source.kind, reason, source.title or source.text or "componente")
              end
            end
            handle.Root.LayoutOrder = 0
            local entry = { Root = row, handle = handle, definition = source, parentKey = source.parentKey }
            sections[sectionRoot][#sections[sectionRoot] + 1] = entry
            rows[#rows + 1] = entry
            page.rows[#page.rows + 1] = entry
            if source.info then
              readouts[source.info] = handle
              readoutRows[source.info] = entry
            end
            if source.key then
              keyed[source.key] = entry
              bindings[source.key] = handle
            end
            if source.parentKey then
              pending[#pending + 1] = entry
            end
            if ok and context.onComponent then
              context.onComponent(source, handle)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(pending) do
      local owner = keyed[entry.parentKey]
      assert(owner, "Visible child requires a visible parent: " .. entry.parentKey)
      if not owner.children then
        owner.children = inst("Frame", {
          Name = "Children",
          Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 0),
          BackgroundTransparency = 1,
          Visible = false,
          ClipsDescendants = true,
          LayoutOrder = 1,
          ZIndex = 6,
        }, owner.Root)
        owner.childContent = stack(owner.children, "Content")
        local layout = owner.childContent:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
        lifetime.connect(layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"), function()
          if refreshDisclosure then
            refreshDisclosure(entry.parentKey, owner)
          end
        end)
      end
      entry.Root.Parent = owner.childContent
    end
    page.keyed = keyed
  end
  local shield = inst("TextButton", {
    Name = "PageInputShield",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
    Position = origin,
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "",
    AutoButtonColor = false,
    Visible = false,
    ZIndex = 20,
  }, parent)
  local function cancel()
    generation += 1
    for _, tween in ipairs(tweens) do
      motion.cancel(tween)
    end
    tweens = {}
  end
  local function settle()
    for id, page in pairs(registry) do
      page.Root.Visible = id == active
      page.Root.Position = origin
      page.Root.GroupTransparency = id == active and 0 or 1
    end
    transitioning = false
    shield.Visible = false
  end
  local function notify()
    if context.onNavigate then
      context.onNavigate(controller.state())
    end
  end
  function controller.state()
    local index = table.find(normal, active)
    return { id = active, title = registry[active].definition.title, index = index, count = #normal, utility = index == nil, transitioning = transitioning }
  end
  function controller.select(id, animated)
    assert(registry[id], "Unknown UI page: " .. tostring(id))
    if not alive or kit.suspended or (id == active and animated ~= false) then
      return
    end
    kit.dismiss()
    cancel()
    local old = active
    local oldIndex, nextIndex = table.find(normal, old), table.find(normal, id)
    local direction = oldIndex and nextIndex and (nextIndex < oldIndex and -1 or 1) or (oldIndex and 1 or -1)
    if oldIndex and not nextIndex then
      returnId = old
    end
    local outgoing = old and registry[old].Root
    for _, page in pairs(registry) do
      if page.Root ~= outgoing and page.Root ~= registry[id].Root then
        page.Root.Visible = false
      end
    end
    active = id
    if not outgoing or animated == false or outgoing == registry[id].Root then
      settle()
      notify()
      return
    end
    transitioning = true
    shield.Visible = true
    notify()
    local revision = generation
    local incoming = registry[active].Root
    if not incoming.Visible then
      incoming.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(origin.X.Offset + T.PAGE_OFFSET * direction, origin.Y.Offset + 8)
      incoming.GroupTransparency = 1
    end
    incoming.Visible = true
    local exit = motion.play(outgoing, "page", {
      GroupTransparency = 1,
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(origin.X.Offset - T.PAGE_OFFSET * direction, origin.Y.Offset - 8),
    })
    if exit then
      tweens[#tweens + 1] = exit
    end
    local enter = motion.play(incoming, "page", { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = origin }, function()
      if alive and revision == generation then
        tweens = {}
        settle()
        notify()
      end
    end)
    if enter then
      tweens[#tweens + 1] = enter
    end
    task.delay(0.8, function()
      if alive and revision == generation and transitioning then
        cancel()
        settle()
        notify()
      end
    end)
  end
  function controller.step(direction)
    local index = table.find(normal, active)
    if index then
      controller.select(normal[math.clamp(index + direction, 1, #normal)])
    end
  end
  function controller.toggle(id)
    if active == id then
      controller.select(returnId or normal[1])
    else
      controller.select(id)
    end
  end
  local function disclosureHeight(owner)
    local layout = owner.childContent:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
    local height, count = 0, 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(rows) do
      if entry.Root.Parent == owner.childContent and entry.Root.Visible then
        local rowHeight = entry.handle.Root.Visible and entry.handle.Root.Size.Y.Offset or 0
        local nested = entry.children and context.read(entry.definition.key) == true and disclosureHeight(entry) or 0
        if nested > 0 then
          if rowHeight > 0 then
            rowHeight += T.CARD_GAP - bleed
          end
          rowHeight += nested
        end
        if rowHeight > 0 then
          if count > 0 then
            height += layout.Padding.Offset
          end
          height += rowHeight + bleed * (nested > 0 and 1 or 2)
          count += 1
        end
      end
    end
    return height
  end
  refreshDisclosure = function(key, owner, immediate)
    local expanded = context.read and context.read(key) == true or false
    local height = expanded and disclosureHeight(owner) or 0
    local padding = owner.Root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, expanded and 0 or bleed)
    if not immediate and owner.expanded == expanded and owner.targetHeight == height then
      return
    end
    owner.expanded, owner.targetHeight = expanded, height
    owner.revision = (owner.revision or 0) + 1
    local revision = owner.revision
    if owner.disclosureTween then
      motion.cancel(owner.disclosureTween)
      owner.disclosureTween = nil
    end
    if owner.disclosureSlide then
      motion.cancel(owner.disclosureSlide)
      owner.disclosureSlide = nil
    end
    if immediate then
      owner.children.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, height)
      owner.children.Visible = expanded
      owner.childContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
      return
    end
    if expanded then
      if not owner.children.Visible then
        owner.childContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -14)
      end
      owner.children.Visible = true
    end
    owner.disclosureSlide = motion.play(owner.childContent, "control", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, expanded and 0 or -14) })
    local function finish()
      if not alive or revision ~= owner.revision then
        return
      end
      owner.children.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, height)
      owner.children.Visible = expanded
      owner.disclosureTween, owner.disclosureSlide = nil, nil
    end
    owner.disclosureTween = motion.play(owner.children, "control", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, height) }, finish)
    if not owner.disclosureTween then
      finish()
    else
      task.delay(0.8, function()
        if alive and revision == owner.revision and owner.disclosureTween then
          motion.cancel(owner.disclosureTween)
          finish()
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  function controller.refresh()
    for _, entry in ipairs(rows) do
      local definition = entry.definition
      local visible = entry.available ~= false and (not definition.abilityOnly or not context.abilitiesEnabled or context.abilitiesEnabled())
      if definition.visibleWhen and context.read then
        visible = visible and context.read(definition.visibleWhen) == true
      end
      if entry.shown ~= visible then
        entry.shown = visible
        entry.visibilityRevision = (entry.visibilityRevision or 0) + 1
        local revision = entry.visibilityRevision
        if visible then
          entry.Root.Visible = true
        end
        motion.fade(entry.Root, "control", visible and 0 or 1, function()
          if alive and revision == entry.visibilityRevision then
            entry.Root.Visible = visible
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    for root, entries in pairs(sections) do
      local visible = false
      for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        visible = visible or entry.shown
      end
      root.Visible = visible
    end
    for _, page in pairs(registry) do
      local occupied = {}
      for _, entry in ipairs(page.rows) do
        if entry.shown and not entry.parentKey then
          local column = entry.Root.Parent and entry.Root.Parent.Parent
          occupied[column] = true
        end
      end
      local nextColumn = 0
      local pageWidth = page.definition.width or width
      local columnWidth = (pageWidth - T.GAP * (page.definition.columns - 1)) / page.definition.columns
      for _, column in ipairs(page.columns) do
        column.Visible = occupied[column] == true
        if column.Visible then
          column.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((width - pageWidth) / 2 + nextColumn * (columnWidth + T.GAP), 0)
          nextColumn += 1
        end
      end
      for key, owner in pairs(page.keyed) do
        if owner.children then
          refreshDisclosure(key, owner, owner.expanded == nil)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.get(id) return registry[id] end
  function controller.getControl(key) return bindings[key] end
  function controller.getReadout(key) return readouts[key] end
  function controller.setReadout(key, value)
    local entry = assert(readoutRows[key], "Missing information component: " .. tostring(key))
    entry.available = type(value) == "string" and value:match("%S") ~= nil
    if entry.available then
      entry.handle.setValue(value)
    end
  end
  function controller.snapshot()
    local snapshot = { page = active, returnId = returnId, scroll = {} }
    for id, page in pairs(registry) do
      snapshot.scroll[id] = {}
      for index, column in ipairs(page.columns) do
        snapshot.scroll[id][index] = column.CanvasPosition
      end
    end
    return snapshot
  end
  function controller.restore(snapshot)
    if not snapshot then
      return
    end
    if snapshot.page and registry[snapshot.page] then
      controller.select(snapshot.page, false)
    end
    if snapshot.returnId and registry[snapshot.returnId] then
      returnId = snapshot.returnId
    end
    for id, columns in pairs(snapshot.scroll or {}) do
      if registry[id] then
        for index, position in ipairs(columns) do
          if registry[id].columns[index] and typeof(position) == "Vector2" then
            registry[id].columns[index].CanvasPosition = position
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.suspend()
    cancel()
    settle()
    for _, page in pairs(registry) do
      for key, owner in pairs(page.keyed) do
        if owner.children then
          refreshDisclosure(key, owner, true)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.destroy()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    alive = false
    cancel()
    lifetime.destroy()
    kit.scope.remove(controller.destroy)
    for _, page in pairs(registry) do
      for _, entry in ipairs(page.rows) do
        entry.handle.destroy()
      end
      page.Root:Destroy()
    end
    shield:Destroy()
  end
  lifetime.add(kit.observe(controller.refresh))
  kit.scope.add(controller.destroy)
  controller.select(context.initialPage or normal[1], false)
  controller.refresh()
  return controller
end

-- contract
Pages.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "validate", "create", "forGame" }, requires = {} }

return Pages

-- [[ uiruntime ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uiruntime

-- module
local Runtime = {}
local Theme
local lifetime
local layerScope
local layerParent
local layers, gameLayers = {}, {}
local layerSequence, reorderQueued = 0, false
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- configuration
local CONFIG = { DEFAULT_MOTION = "control" }
-- A descendant may be animated by more than one controller. Keep its original
-- appearance outside individual motion scopes so a hidden state never becomes
-- the baseline for its next entrance.
local faded = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- setup
function Runtime.setup(deps)
  Runtime.teardown()
  Theme, lifetime = deps.Theme.tokens, deps.Lifetime
  return true
end

-- lifetime
function Runtime.scope() return lifetime.scope() end

-- PlayerGui stays below Roblox CoreGui. Equal display orders use insertion order.
local function reorderLayers()
  if reorderQueued or not layerScope or not layerScope.alive then
    return
  end
  reorderQueued = true
  local owner = layerScope
  task.defer(function()
    if layerScope ~= owner or not owner.alive then
      return
    end
    reorderQueued = false
    local ordered = {}
    for gui, entry in pairs(layers) do
      if gui.Parent == layerParent then
        ordered[#ordered + 1] = entry
      end
    end
    table.sort(ordered, function(a, b) return a.rank == b.rank and a.sequence < b.sequence or a.rank < b.rank end)
    for _, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
      entry.gui.Parent = nil
      entry.gui.Parent = layerParent
    end
  end)
end
local function watchGameLayer(gui)
  if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") or layers[gui] or gui:GetAttribute("ExodusLayer") or gameLayers[gui] then
    return
  end
  local scope = layerScope.child()
  gameLayers[gui] = scope
  scope.connect(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayOrder"), function()
    if gui.DisplayOrder >= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
      reorderLayers()
    end
  end)
  scope.add(function() gameLayers[gui] = nil end)
  if gui.DisplayOrder >= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
    reorderLayers()
  end
end
function Runtime.mountLayer(gui, parent, rank)
  assert(parent:IsA("PlayerGui"), "Hub layers must remain in PlayerGui")
  if not layerScope then
    layerParent, layerScope = parent, lifetime.scope()
    layerScope.connect(parent.ChildAdded, watchGameLayer)
    layerScope.connect(parent.ChildRemoved, function(child)
      if gameLayers[child] then
        gameLayers[child].destroy()
      end
    end)
    for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      watchGameLayer(child)
    end
  end
  assert(parent == layerParent, "Mixed PlayerGui layer owners")
  if gameLayers[gui] then
    gameLayers[gui].destroy()
  end
  layerSequence += 1
  local entry = { gui = gui, rank = rank, sequence = layerSequence, Connected = true }
  layers[gui] = entry
  gui:SetAttribute("ExodusLayer", true)
  gui.DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER
  local scope = layerScope.child()
  function entry:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then
      return
    end
    self.Connected = false
    if layers[gui] == self then
      layers[gui] = nil
    end
    scope.destroy()
  end
  scope.connect(gui.Destroying, function() entry:Disconnect() end)
  scope.connect(gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayOrder"), function()
    if gui.DisplayOrder ~= Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER then
      gui.DisplayOrder = Theme.DISPLAY_ORDER
    end
    reorderLayers()
  end)
  reorderLayers()
  return entry
end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if layerScope then
    layerScope.destroy()
  end
  for _, entry in pairs(layers) do
    entry.Connected = false
  end
  layers, gameLayers, layerScope, layerParent = {}, {}, nil, nil
  layerSequence, reorderQueued = 0, false
  return true
end

-- motion
function Runtime.motion(scope, reducedMotion)
  local owners, active = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), {}
  local motion = {}
  local paused = false
  local function release(tween)
    local entry = active[tween]
    if not entry then
      return
    end
    active[tween] = nil
    scope.remove(entry.connection)
    local properties = owners[entry.object]
    if properties then
      for key in pairs(entry.goals) do
        if properties[key] == tween then
          properties[key] = nil
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function motion.cancel(tween)
    if not tween then
      return
    end
    release(tween)
    tween:Cancel()
  end
  function motion.cancelAll(preserve)
    local pending = {}
    for tween in pairs(active) do
      if not preserve or not preserve(active[tween].object) then
        pending[#pending + 1] = tween
      end
    end
    for _, tween in ipairs(pending) do
      motion.cancel(tween)
    end
  end
  function motion.pause()
    paused = true
    motion.cancelAll()
  end
  function motion.resume() paused = false end
  function motion.play(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
    if paused or not scope.alive or not object or not object.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    local profile = Theme.MOTION[type(preset) == "string" and preset or CONFIG.DEFAULT_MOTION]
    assert(profile, "Unknown motion preset: " .. tostring(preset))
    local duration = reducedMotion and 0 or (type(preset) == "number" and preset or profile.duration)
    local properties = owners[object] or {}
    owners[object] = properties
    for key in pairs(goals) do
      motion.cancel(properties[key])
    end
    if duration <= 0 then
      for key, value in pairs(goals) do
        object[key] = value
      end
      if onComplete then
        onComplete()
      end
      return nil
    end
    local tween = TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(duration, profile.style, profile.direction), goals)
    local entry = { object = object, goals = goals }
    active[tween] = entry
    for key in pairs(goals) do
      properties[key] = tween
    end
    entry.connection = scope.connect(tween.Completed, function(state)
      release(tween)
      if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and onComplete then
        onComplete()
      end
    end)
    tween:Play()
    return tween
  end
  function motion.fade(root, preset, alpha, onComplete)
    root:SetAttribute("ExodusFadeAlpha", alpha)
    local objects = root:GetDescendants()
    table.insert(objects, 1, root)
    local rootTween
    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
      local fields = {}
      if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "BackgroundTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "TextTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "ImageTransparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "Transparency"
      end
      if object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
        fields[#fields + 1] = "ScrollBarImageTransparency"
      end
      local saved = faded[object] or {}
      faded[object] = saved
      local goals = {}
      local opacity, ancestor = 1, object
      while ancestor do
        opacity *= 1 - (ancestor:GetAttribute("ExodusFadeAlpha") or 0)
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
      end
      for _, field in ipairs(fields) do
        if saved[field] == nil then
          saved[field] = object[field]
        end
        goals[field] = saved[field] + (1 - saved[field]) * (1 - opacity)
      end
      if next(goals) then
        local tween = motion.play(object, preset, goals, object == root and onComplete or nil)
        if object == root then
          rootTween = tween
        end
      end
    end
    return rootTween
  end
  function motion.group(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
    if paused or not scope.alive or not object or not object.Parent then
      return nil
    end
    if goals.GroupTransparency ~= nil then
      for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("UIStroke") then
          local base = child:GetAttribute("ExodusBaseTransparency")
          if base == nil then
            base = child.Transparency
            child:SetAttribute("ExodusBaseTransparency", base)
          end
          child.Transparency = base + (1 - base) * object.GroupTransparency
          motion.play(child, preset, { Transparency = base + (1 - base) * goals.GroupTransparency })
        end
      end
    end
    return motion.play(object, preset, goals, onComplete)
  end
  scope.add(motion.cancelAll)
  return motion
end

-- input
function Runtime.isVisible(object)
  while object do
    if object:IsA("GuiObject") and not object.Visible then
      return false
    end
    if object:IsA("LayerCollector") and not object.Enabled then
      return false
    end
    object = object.Parent
  end
  return true
end
function Runtime.bindDrag(scope, target, onChange, canStart)
  local owner
  local function release() owner = nil end
  local function available() return target.Parent ~= nil and Runtime.isVisible(target) and (not canStart or canStart()) end
  local function startsOnTarget(input)
    local point, position, size = input.Position, target.AbsolutePosition, target.AbsoluteSize
    if point.X < position.X or point.Y < position.Y or point.X > position.X + size.X or point.Y > position.Y + size.Y then
      return false
    end
    local gui = target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui") or target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("CoreGui")
    if not gui then
      return true
    end
    local ok, objects = pcall(function() return gui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X, point.Y) end)
    if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or #objects == 0 then
      return true
    end
    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
      if object == target or object:IsDescendantOf(target) then
        return true
      end
      if object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Active and not target:IsDescendantOf(object) then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
    if owner or not available() then
      return
    end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      return
    end
    if not startsOnTarget(input) then
      return
    end
    owner = input
    onChange(input)
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
    if not owner then
      return
    end
    if not available() or owner.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or owner.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
      release()
      return
    end
    local mouse = owner.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    if mouse then
      if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        release()
        return
      end
      onChange(input)
    elseif input == owner then
      onChange(input)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    if input == owner then
      release()
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, release)
  scope.add(release)
  return release
end

-- contract
Runtime.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "scope", "motion", "isVisible", "bindDrag", "mountLayer", "teardown" },
  requires = { Theme = "uitheme", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = { Lifetime = { "scope" } },
  requiresData = { Theme = { "tokens" } },
}

return Runtime

-- @modules uitheme

-- module
local Theme = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {

    header = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 34),

    accent = Color3.fromRGB(99, 102, 241),

    Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 140),
    Color3.fromRGB(110, 95, 150),
    Color3.fromRGB(150, 95, 130),
    Color3.fromRGB(95, 130, 165),
  },
  ICON = nil, -- Image URI; nil uses the title initial.
  BTN_SIZE = 56,
  CLASH_SIZE = 64,
  MINI_W = 112,
  MINI_H = 96,
  PANEL_W = 540,
  PANEL_H = 380,
  TITLE_H = 50,
  PAD = 14,
  GAP = 12,
  CARD_GAP = 8,
  CARD_H = 48,
  RATE_CARD_H = 64,
  DRAG_THRESHOLD_SQ = 100,
  TITLE_SPACING = 7,
  TITLE_TEXT_SIZE = 16,
  AUTHOR_TEXT_SIZE = 14,
  AUTHOR_TRANSPARENCY = 0.22,
}

CONFIG.COLORS.cardHover = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 50)
CONFIG.RADIUS = { panel = 16, card = 12, control = 8, pill = 999 }
CONFIG.FONT = { body = Enum.Font.Gotham, label = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold, strong = Enum.Font.GothamBold }

    style = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
    direction = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
  },
  feedback = {
    duration = 0.16,
    style = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
    direction = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
  },
  control = {
    duration = 0.32,
    style = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
    direction = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
  },
  page = {
    duration = 0.42,
    style = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
    direction = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
  },
  panel = {
    duration = 0.52,
    style = Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,
    direction = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
  },
}
CONFIG.SELECTOR_COLORS = {
  CPS = CONFIG.COLORS.accent,
  CPF = CONFIG.COLORS.accentPink,
  MS = Color3.fromRGB(234, 179, 8),
  Auto = CONFIG.COLORS.autoMode,
  Toggle = CONFIG.COLORS.accent,
  Hold = CONFIG.COLORS.hold,
}
CONFIG.DROPDOWN = { gap = 5, margin = 6, rowHeight = 32, rowGap = 3, padding = 4, selectionDelay = 0.18 }
CONFIG.PAGE_OFFSET = 70
CONFIG.SCROLLBAR = 3
CONFIG.LAYERS = { panel = 30, outline = 1000 }
CONFIG.CHILD_VERTICAL_PADDING = 6
CONFIG.CONTROL_BLEED = 2
CONFIG.DISPLAY_ORDER = 2147483647
CONFIG.SCREEN_LAYERS = { window = 1, information = 2, notifications = 3, popup = 4 }

-- public-api
Theme.tokens = CONFIG

-- setup
function Theme.setup() return true end

-- contract
Theme.__contract = { provides = { "setup" }, data = { "tokens" }, requires = {} }

return Theme
