-- [[ uikit ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules uikit

-- module
local UIKit = {}
local Theme
local Runtime
local Icons
local Display
local ControlComponents
local Inputs
local Selection
local Dropdown
local Appearance
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- configuration

-- setup
function UIKit.setup(deps)
  Theme, Runtime, Icons, Appearance = deps.Theme.tokens, deps.Runtime, deps.Icons, deps.Appearance
  Display, ControlComponents, Inputs, Selection, Dropdown = deps.Display, deps.ControlComponents, deps.Inputs, deps.Selection, deps.Dropdown
  return true
end

-- helpers
local function finite(value)
  local number = tonumber(value)
  return number and number == number and number > -math.huge and number < math.huge and number or nil
end
local function choiceValue(choice) return type(choice) == "table" and choice.value or choice end
local function choiceLabel(choice) return tostring(type(choice) == "table" and (choice.label or choice.value) or choice) end
local function keyName(value)
  if value == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
    return "—"
  end
  local names = {
    MouseButton1 = "M1",
    MouseButton2 = "M2",
    MouseButton3 = "M3",
    LeftControl = "LCtrl",
    RightControl = "RCtrl",
    LeftShift = "LShift",
    RightShift = "RShift",
  }

  local name = typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value.Name or tostring(value or "—")
  return names[name] or name
end

-- library
function UIKit.create(options)
  options = options or {}
  local scope = Runtime.scope()
  local desktop = UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled or not UIS.TouchEnabled
  if options.read and options.read("ForcePCUI") == true then
    desktop = true
  end
  local motion = Runtime.motion(scope, options.reducedMotion)
  local C, FONT, TEXT = Theme.COLORS, Theme.FONT, Theme.TEXT
  local bindings, components, drags, observers = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local feedback = {}
  local controlOwners = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local popup, capture, capturedInput = {}, nil, nil
  local kit = { icon = Icons.create, Theme = Theme, Components = components, scope = scope, motion = motion, suspended = false }
  function kit.isDesktop() return desktop end
  local motions = { [motion] = true }
  function kit.createMotion(lifetime)
    local owned = Runtime.motion(lifetime, options.reducedMotion)
    motions[owned] = true
    lifetime.add(function() motions[owned] = nil end)
    return owned
  end
  local function read(key, fallback)
    local value = key and options.read and options.read(key)
    if value == nil then
      return fallback
    end
    return value
  end
  kit.read = read
  function kit.observe(callback)
    local connection = {}
    observers[connection] = callback
    function connection.Disconnect() observers[connection] = nil end
    return connection
  end
  scope.add(function() table.clear(observers) end)
  function kit.instance(class, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
      object.BorderSizePixel = 0
    end
    if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
      object.AutoButtonColor = false
    end
    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      object[key] = value
    end
    object.Parent = parent
    if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
      local ancestor = parent
      while ancestor do
        local owner = controlOwners[ancestor]
        if owner then
          owner.attachFeedback(object)
          break
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
      end
    end
    return object
  end
  local inst = kit.instance
  function kit.interactionColor(background, pressed) return Appearance.interactionColor(background, pressed) end
  function kit.borderColor(background) return Appearance.borderColor(background) end
  function kit.corner(root, radius) return inst("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or Theme.RADIUS.control) }, root) end
  function kit.stroke(root, color, thickness, light)
    local surface = root
    if root:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
      local inset = thickness or 1
      surface = inst("Frame", {
        Name = "Outline",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Active = false,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inset, inset),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2),
        ZIndex = Theme.LAYERS.outline,
      }, root)
      local radius = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
      kit.corner(surface, radius and math.max(0, radius.CornerRadius.Offset - inset) or Theme.RADIUS.control)
    end
    local automatic = color == nil or color == C.border
    local function outlineColor() return Appearance.borderColor(root.BackgroundColor3, light) end
    local line =
      inst("UIStroke", { Color = automatic and outlineColor() or color, Thickness = thickness or 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, surface)
    line.Transparency = 0
    if automatic then
      line.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
      local gradient = inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 20 }, line)
      local animation =
        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(gradient, TweenInfo.new(8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Rotation = 40 })
      animation:Play()
      local function updateOutline() gradient.Color = Appearance.borderGradient(root.BackgroundColor3, root:GetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover") or 0) end
      updateOutline()
      local connection = root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(updateOutline)
      local hover = root:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ExodusBorderHover"):Connect(updateOutline)
      local cleanup
      cleanup = root.Destroying:Connect(function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        hover:Disconnect()
        animation:Cancel()
        cleanup:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    return line
  end
  local function text(parent, value, properties)
    local props = {
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      Text = tostring(value or ""),
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.body,
      Font = FONT.label,
      TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
      TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
      ZIndex = 8,
    }

    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      props[key] = value
    end
    return inst("TextLabel", props, parent)
  end
  function kit.isCapturing(input) return capture ~= nil or (input ~= nil and capturedInput == input) end
  function kit.cancelCapture()
    local pending = capture
    capture = nil
    if pending then
      pending.restore()
      if options.onCapture then
        options.onCapture(false)
      end
    end
  end
  function kit.dismiss()
    for _, reset in pairs(feedback) do
      reset()
    end
    for cancel in pairs(drags) do
      cancel()
    end
    if popup.close then
      popup.close()
    end
    kit.cancelCapture()
  end
  function kit.suspend()
    kit.suspended = true
    kit.dismiss()
    for owned in pairs(motions) do
      owned.pause()
    end
  end
  function kit.resume()
    kit.suspended = false
    for owned in pairs(motions) do
      owned.resume()
    end
    kit.refresh()
  end
  function kit.destroy()
    kit.dismiss()
    scope.destroy()
  end
  scope.add(kit.dismiss)
  local function bind(handle, key, refresh)
    if not key then
      return
    end
    local listeners = bindings[key] or {}
    bindings[key] = listeners
    listeners[refresh] = handle
    handle.scope.add(function()
      listeners[refresh] = nil
      if not next(listeners) then
        bindings[key] = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  function kit.refresh(changes)
    for key, listeners in pairs(bindings) do
      if not changes or changes[key] ~= nil then
        for refresh, handle in pairs(listeners) do
          if handle.scope.alive then
            refresh(read(key))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    for _, observer in pairs(observers) do
      observer(changes)
    end
  end
  if options.observe then
    scope.add(options.observe(kit.refresh))
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input)
    if not capture then
      return
    end
    local binding
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType.Name:match("^Gamepad") then
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        capturedInput = input
        kit.cancelCapture()
        return
      end
      if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
        binding = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
      elseif input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
        binding = input.KeyCode
      end
    elseif
      input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
      or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
    then
      binding = input.UserInputType
    end
    if binding then
      capturedInput = input
      local pending = capture
      kit.cancelCapture()
      pending.pick(binding)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, kit.cancelCapture)
  function kit.feedback(lifetime, target, paint, enabled)
    local hovered, held = false, nil
    local function refresh()
      local allowed = not kit.suspended and (not enabled or enabled())
      paint(allowed and (hovered or held ~= nil), allowed and held ~= nil)
    end
    local function reset()
      hovered, held = false, nil
      refresh()
    end
    local function release(input)
      if held == input then
        if held.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          hovered = false
        end
        held = nil
        refresh()
      end
    end
    feedback[release] = reset
    lifetime.add(function() feedback[release] = nil end)
    lifetime.connect(target.MouseEnter, function()
      hovered = true
      refresh()
    end)
    lifetime.connect(target.MouseLeave, function()
      hovered = false
      refresh()
    end)
    lifetime.connect(target.InputBegan, function(input)
      if held or kit.suspended or (enabled and not enabled()) then
        return
      end
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          hovered = false
        end
        held = input
        refresh()
      end
    end)
    return refresh, reset
  end
  scope.connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    for release in pairs(feedback) do
      release(input)
    end
  end)
  scope.connect(UIS.WindowFocusReleased, function()
    for _, reset in pairs(feedback) do
      reset()
    end
  end)
  local function control(parent, definition, height, class)
    definition = definition or {}
    assert(not definition.desktopOnly or desktop, "Desktop-only UI is unavailable in mobile mode")
    assert(not definition.mobileOnly or not desktop, "Mobile-only UI is unavailable in desktop mode")
    local root = inst(class or "Frame", {
      Name = definition.name or definition.key or definition.kind or "Control",
      Size = definition.size or UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
      ZIndex = 6,
    }, parent)
    kit.corner(root, Theme.RADIUS.card)
    local border = kit.stroke(root)
    local childScope = Runtime.scope()
    local childMotion = kit.createMotion(childScope)
    local handle = { Root = root, Border = border, scope = childScope, motion = childMotion, enabled = true }
    scope.add(handle, function() handle.destroy() end)
    childScope.add(function() scope.forget(handle) end)
    childScope.connect(root.Destroying, childScope.destroy)
    local activeTargets = {}
    function handle.attachFeedback(target)
      kit.feedback(childScope, target, function(active, pressed)
        if definition.kind == "label" or definition.kind == "divider" then
          return
        end
        activeTargets[target] = active and (pressed and 2 or 1) or nil
        local strength = 0
        for _, value in pairs(activeTargets) do
          strength = math.max(strength, value)
        end
        root:SetAttribute("ExodusBorderHover", strength)
      end, function() return handle.enabled end)
    end
    controlOwners[root] = handle
    handle.attachFeedback(root)
    childScope.add(function() controlOwners[root] = nil end)
    function handle.setEnabled(enabled)
      handle.enabled = enabled == true
      root.Active = handle.enabled
      if not handle.enabled and capture and capture.owner == handle then
        kit.cancelCapture()
      end
      for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
          descendant.Active = handle.enabled
          descendant.Selectable = handle.enabled
        end
        if descendant:IsA("TextBox") then
          descendant.TextEditable = handle.enabled
        end
      end
    end
    function handle.setVisible(visible) root.Visible = visible == true end
    function handle.destroy()
      childScope.destroy()
      root:Destroy()
    end
    if definition.enabled == false then
      handle.setEnabled(false)
    end
    return handle
  end
  local function title(handle, definition, rightSpace, height)
    local root = handle.Root
    local hasDescription = definition.description and definition.description ~= ""
    text(root, definition.title or definition.text, {
      Name = "Title",
      Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, hasDescription and 5 or 0),
      Size = UDim2.new(1, -(28 + (rightSpace or 0)), 0, hasDescription and 18 or height),
    })
    if hasDescription then
      text(root, definition.description, {
        Name = "Description",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, definition.expandedDescription and 42 or 26),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(28 + (definition.expandedDescription and 0 or (rightSpace or 0))), 0, height - (definition.expandedDescription and 48 or 30)),
        TextColor3 = C.subtext,
        TextSize = TEXT.caption,
        Font = FONT.body,
        TextWrapped = true,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
      })
    end
  end
  local function button(parent, label, properties)
    local props = {
      Text = tostring(label),
      TextColor3 = C.text,
      TextSize = TEXT.control,
      Font = FONT.strong,
      BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg,
      ZIndex = 10,
      Selectable = true,
    }

    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
      props[key] = value
    end
    local root = inst("TextButton", props, parent)
    kit.corner(root)
    if props.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then
      kit.stroke(root)
    end
    return root
  end
  local function hitbox(handle, callback, height)
    local root = button(handle.Root, "", {
      Name = "CardHitbox",
      Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, height and 0 or 1, height or 0),
      BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      ZIndex = 10,
    })
    local scale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, handle.Root)
    handle.scope.connect(root.Activated, function()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return
      end
      handle.motion.play(scale, "press", { Scale = 0.97 }, function() handle.motion.play(scale, "feedback", { Scale = 1 }) end)
      callback()
    end)
    return root
  end
  local function commit(handle, definition, value)
    if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
      return false
    end
    if definition.key and options.write and options.write(definition.key, value) == false then
      if options.notify then
        options.notify("Unable to update " .. tostring(definition.title or definition.key), true)
      end
      return false
    end
    if definition.key and options.read and options.read(definition.key) ~= value then
      return false
    end
    local result
    if definition.onChange then
      result = definition.onChange(value)
    end
    if result == false and not definition.key then
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  local function shortcut(handle, key, xOffset, topAligned)
    if not key or not desktop then
      return
    end
    local cap = button(handle.Root, keyName(read(key)), {
      Name = "Shortcut_" .. key,
      Position = topAligned and UDim2.new(1, xOffset or -126, 0, 10) or UDim2.new(1, xOffset or -126, 0.5, -13),
      Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 26),
      BackgroundColor3 = C.btnDark,
      TextSize = 11,
      ZIndex = 12,
    })
    local function paint(value) cap.Text = keyName(value) end
    bind(handle, key, paint)
    handle.scope.connect(cap.Activated, function()
      if not handle.enabled or kit.suspended then
        return
      end
      kit.cancelCapture()
      cap.Text = "..."
      capture = {
        restore = function()
          if cap.Parent then
            paint(read(key))
          end
        end,
        owner = handle,
        pick = function(value)
          if options.validateShortcut then
            local ok, reason = options.validateShortcut(key, value)
            if not ok then
              if options.notify then
                options.notify(reason or "Shortcut already assigned", true, { category = "system" })
              end
              return
            end
          end
          if not options.write or options.write(key, value) ~= false then
            paint(value)
          end
        end,
      }

      if options.onCapture then
        options.onCapture(true)
      end
    end)
    handle.scope.add(function()
      if capture and capture.owner == handle then
        kit.cancelCapture()
      end
    end)
  end
  local context = {
    drags = drags,
    kit = kit,
    Theme = Theme,
    Runtime = Runtime,
    UIS = UIS,
    RunService = RunService,
    options = options,
    components = components,
    C = C,
    FONT = FONT,
    TEXT = TEXT,
    inst = inst,
    text = text,
    control = control,
    title = title,
    button = button,
    hitbox = hitbox,
    commit = commit,
    shortcut = shortcut,
    bind = bind,
    read = read,
    finite = finite,
    choiceValue = choiceValue,
    choiceLabel = choiceLabel,
    keyName = keyName,
    popup = popup,
  }

  Display.install(context)
  ControlComponents.install(context)
  Inputs.install(context)
  Selection.install(context)
  Dropdown.install(context)
  components.tabs = components.segmented
  components.click = components.button
  components.scroll = components.slider
  components.off_on = components.toggle
  components.keybind_selector = function(parent, definition)
    assert(desktop, "Keybind controls are unavailable in mobile mode; enable PC UI in settings")
    return components.button(parent, definition)
  end
  return kit
end

-- contract
UIKit.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
  requires = {
    Theme = "uitheme",
    Appearance = "uiappearance",
    Runtime = "uiruntime",
    Icons = "uiicons",
    Display = "uidisplay",
    ControlComponents = "uicontrols",
    Inputs = "uiinputs",
    Selection = "uiselection",
    Dropdown = "uidropdown",
  },
  requiresData = { Theme = { "tokens" } },
  requiresMethods = {
    Appearance = { "borderColor", "interactionColor", "borderGradient" },
    Runtime = { "scope", "motion", "isVisible", "bindDrag", "mountLayer" },
    Icons = { "create" },
    Display = { "install" },
    ControlComponents = { "install" },
    Inputs = { "install" },
    Selection = { "install" },
    Dropdown = { "install" },
  },
}

return UIKit
sources.universal/anti_lag/antilag.luau:
-- [[ antilag ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules renderadapter, antilag

-- code
local __part_renderadapter = (function()
  local Adapter = {}
  local hub
  function Adapter.setup(deps)
    hub = deps.Hub
    return true
  end
  function Adapter.isAvailable() return hub.isNativeVisualAvailable() end
  function Adapter.create(...) return hub.createVisualAdapter(...) end
  function Adapter.apply(...) return hub.applyVisualPolicy(...) end
  Adapter.__contract = {
    access = { default = "render.write" },
    provides = { "setup", "create", "apply", "isAvailable" },
    requires = { Hub = "hubapi" },
    requiresMethods = { Hub = { "createVisualAdapter", "applyVisualPolicy", "isNativeVisualAvailable" } },
  }
  return Adapter
end)()
local __part_antilag = (function()
  local AntiLag = {}
  local Utils
  local properties
  local adapter
  local spatial
  local CONFIG = {
    schema = {
      AntiLagEnabled = "boolean",
      AntiLagFloorCull = "boolean",
      AntiLagRenderDistance = "rate",
      AntiLagRemoveSwordSounds = "boolean",
      AntiLagRemoveEffects = "boolean",
    },
    defaults = {
      AntiLagEnabled = false,
      AntiLagFloorCull = true,
      AntiLagRenderDistance = 300,
      AntiLagRemoveSwordSounds = true,
      AntiLagRemoveEffects = true,
    },
  }

  local PROFILE = {
    StartEnabled = false,
    ShowMenu = false,
    CullEnabled = true,
    CullView = false,
    CullVertical = false,
    CullAbove = 200,
    CullBelow = 100,
    CullVerticalMargin = 20,
    CullFloorEnabled = true,
    GameSwordSounds = false,
    CullDistance = 300,
    CullKeepNear = 16,
    CullViewPadding = 12,
    CullViewDegrees = 8,
    CullHideDelay = 0.15,
    CullInterval = 0.1,
    CullBudgetMs = 0.8,
    GameGenerators = true,
    GameNoVFX = true,
    GameKeepIndicators = true,
    GameCosmeticAudio = true,
    GameKeepCombatAudio = true,
    GameMuteMusic = true,
    GameMuteAmbience = true,
    GameReducedUI = true,
    GameReducedHeadLook = true,
    Particles = true,
    TrailsAndBeams = true,
    LegacyEffects = true,
    PostEffects = true,
    Lights = true,
    Shadows = true,
    FlatLighting = true,
    FlatSky = true,
    Atmosphere = true,
    Clouds = true,
    NoFog = false,
    Water = true,
    TransparentWater = true,
    TerrainDecoration = true,
    FlatMaterials = false,
    HideTaggedDecorations = false,
    LowestGraphics = false,
    MaintainEffects = true,
    RestoreLatest = false,
    ShowFPS = false,
    FlatSkyTexture = "",
    BudgetMs = 1.5,
    MaxItemsPerFrame = 160,
    ReapplyInterval = 0.25,
  }

  local function applyScenePolicy(object, target, watch, masks)
    if masks[object] then
      if object:IsA("BasePart") then
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
        target.Transparency = 1
      elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
        target.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
      elseif object:IsA("ForceField") or object:IsA("Explosion") or object:IsA("PVAdornment") then
        target.Visible = false
      else
        target.Enabled = false
      end
      watch = not object:IsA("BasePart")
    end
    return target, watch
  end
  local session, observer, shutdown
  local working, revision = false, 0
  local function setting(key)
    local value = Utils and Utils.getConfigValue(key)
    if value == nil then
      return CONFIG.defaults[key]
    end
    return value
  end
  local function requestedProfile()
    local profile = table.clone(PROFILE)
    local distance = tonumber(setting("AntiLagRenderDistance"))
    if not distance or distance ~= distance or math.abs(distance) == math.huge then
      distance = CONFIG.defaults.AntiLagRenderDistance
    end
    profile.CullDistance = math.clamp(distance, 300, 1200)
    local removeEffects = setting("AntiLagRemoveEffects") == true
    profile.GameSwordSounds = not setting("AntiLagRemoveSwordSounds")
    profile.CullFloorEnabled = setting("AntiLagFloorCull") == true
    profile.Particles, profile.TrailsAndBeams, profile.LegacyEffects = removeEffects, removeEffects, removeEffects
    profile.GameNoVFX, profile.GameReducedUI = removeEffects, removeEffects
    return profile
  end
  local function startSession()
    local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    assert(player, "LocalPlayer indisponível")
    local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local lighting, runService = game:GetService("Lighting"), game:GetService("RunService")
    local replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local owner = {
      masks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
      closed = false,
      profile = requestedProfile(),
      runService = runService,
      replicated = replicated,
      compatible = adapter.isAvailable(),
    }

    session = owner
    local gameSettings
    pcall(function() gameSettings = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings") end)
    local visualRoots = { workspace }
    local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
      visualRoots[#visualRoots + 1] = playerGui
    end
    local optimizerRoots = table.clone(visualRoots)
    optimizerRoots[#optimizerRoots + 1], optimizerRoots[#optimizerRoots + 2] = lighting, game:GetService("SoundService")
    owner.engine = properties.create({
      Workspace = workspace,
      Lighting = lighting,
      RunService = runService,
      CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService"),
      GameSettings = gameSettings,
      Roots = optimizerRoots,
      ExtraPolicy = function(object, target, watch, options)
        target, watch = applyScenePolicy(object, target, watch, owner.masks)
        if owner.compatible then
          target, watch = adapter.apply(object, target, watch, options)
        end
        return target, watch
      end,
    }, owner.profile)
    local function getOption(key) return owner.engine:GetOption(key) end
    if owner.compatible then
      local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
      owner.adapter = adapter.create({ Workspace = workspace, Player = player, PlayerScripts = scripts, ReplicatedStorage = replicated }, getOption)
    end
    local function viewedCharacter() return player.Character end
    owner.spatial = spatial.create({
      Workspace = workspace,
      Roots = visualRoots,
      Player = player,
      RunService = runService,
      GetFocusY = function()
        local character = viewedCharacter()
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return root and root.Position.Y or nil
      end,
      GetFloorY = function()
        if not getOption("CullFloorEnabled") then
          return nil
        end
        local character = viewedCharacter()
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
          local footY = root.Position.Y - humanoid.HipHeight - root.Size.Y * 0.5
          owner.floorY = owner.floorY and math.min(owner.floorY, footY) or footY
        end
        return owner.floorY and owner.floorY - 2 or nil
      end,
      GetFocusPosition = function()
        local character = viewedCharacter()
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return root and root.Position or nil
      end,
      OnHidden = function(object, hidden)
        owner.masks[object] = if hidden then true else nil
        owner.engine:RefreshInstance(object, true)
        if hidden and (object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail")) then
          pcall(function() object:Clear() end)
        end
      end,
    }, getOption, PROFILE)
    owner.engine:SetEnabled(true)
    if owner.adapter then
      owner.adapter:SetEnabled(true)
    end
    owner.spatial:SetEnabled(true)
  end
  local function stopSession()
    local owner = session
    if not owner then
      return
    end
    owner.closed = true
    if owner.spatial then
      owner.spatial:Destroy()
    end
    if owner.adapter then
      owner.adapter:Destroy()
    end
    if owner.engine then
      owner.engine:Destroy()
      while owner.engine:GetStatus().Alive do
        owner.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
      end
    end
    if session == owner then
      session = nil
    end
  end
  local function updateSession()
    local profile, owner = requestedProfile(), session
    local spatialChanged = profile.CullDistance ~= owner.profile.CullDistance or profile.CullFloorEnabled ~= owner.profile.CullFloorEnabled
    for key, value in pairs(profile) do
      if owner.profile[key] ~= value then
        owner.engine:SetOption(key, value)
      end
    end
    owner.profile = profile
    if owner.adapter then
      owner.adapter:Refresh()
    end
    if spatialChanged then
      owner.spatial:Refresh()
    end
  end
  local function reconcile()
    revision += 1
    if working then
      return
    end
    working = true
    task.defer(function()
      local seen
      repeat
        seen = revision
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
          if Utils and Utils.isActive() and setting("AntiLagEnabled") then
            if session then
              updateSession()
            else
              startSession()
            end
          else
            stopSession()
          end
        end)
        if not ok then
          local reporting = Utils
          local cleaned, cleanupError = pcall(stopSession)
          if reporting then
            reporting.recordError("AntiLag", tostring(err))
          end
          if not cleaned then
            warn("[Exodus AntiLag] Falha ao restaurar: " .. tostring(cleanupError))
          end
        end
      until seen == revision
      working = false
    end)
  end
  function AntiLag.setEnabled(enabled)
    if not Utils then
      return false, "recurso indisponível"
    end
    return Utils.setConfig({ AntiLagEnabled = enabled == true })
  end
  function AntiLag.getStatus()
    local owner = session
    return {
      enabled = owner ~= nil and not owner.closed,
      busy = working,
      engine = owner and owner.engine and owner.engine:GetStatus() or nil,
      spatial = owner and owner.spatial and owner.spatial:GetStatus() or nil,
      generators = owner and owner.adapter and owner.adapter:GetStatus() or nil,
    }
  end
  function AntiLag.teardown()
    local previous = Utils
    Utils = nil
    revision += 1
    if observer then
      observer:Disconnect()
      observer = nil
    end
    if shutdown then
      shutdown.Connected = false
      if previous then
        previous.untrackGlobal(shutdown)
      end
      shutdown = nil
    end
    while working do
      game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    stopSession()
    return true
  end
  function AntiLag.setup(deps)
    if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
      return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
    end
    AntiLag.teardown()
    Utils = deps.Utils
    properties, adapter, spatial = deps.Properties, deps.Adapter, deps.Spatial
    observer = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
      for key in pairs(changes) do
        if CONFIG.schema[key] then
          if session or setting("AntiLagEnabled") then
            reconcile()
          end
          return
        end
      end
    end)
    shutdown = { Connected = true }
    function shutdown:Disconnect()
      if not self.Connected then
        return
      end
      self.Connected = false
      AntiLag.teardown()
    end
    Utils.trackGlobal(shutdown)
    if setting("AntiLagEnabled") then
      reconcile()
    end
    return true
  end
  AntiLag.__config = CONFIG
  AntiLag.__contract = {
    requires = {
      Properties = "renderproperties",
      Adapter = "renderadapter",
      Spatial = "renderspatial",
      Utils = "utils",
    },
    requiresMethods = {
      Properties = { "create" },
      Adapter = { "create", "apply", "isAvailable" },
      Spatial = { "create" },
      Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "observeConfig", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    },
    provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "getStatus" },
  }
  return AntiLag
end)()

return { __bundle = { renderadapter = __part_renderadapter, antilag = __part_antilag } }

-- [[ reversible property optimization ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules renderproperties

-- code
local Properties = {}
function Properties.setup() return true end
local function createOptimizer(services, initialConfig)
  local Workspace = services.Workspace
  local Lighting = services.Lighting
  local roots = services.Roots or { Workspace, Lighting }
  local CollectionService = services.CollectionService
  local Heartbeat = services.RunService.Heartbeat
  local options = table.clone(initialConfig)
  local controller = {}
  local enabled, alive, destroying = false, true, false
  local journal, records = {}, {}
  local connections = {}
  local pending, queued, head, tail = {}, {}, 1, 0
  local scan = {}
  local dirty = {}
  local delayed = false
  local workerRunning = false
  local generation = 0
  local unsupported = {}
  local unsupportedCount, restoreFailures, runtimeFailures = 0, 0, 0
  local changedProperties = 0
  local scheduleWorker, enqueue, process, restartScan
  local oneSequence = NumberSequence.new(1)
  local zeroLifetime = NumberRange.new(0)
  local white, black = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
  local skyProperties = { "SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp" }
  local function read(object, property)
    return pcall(function() return object[property] end)
  end
  local function write(object, property, value)
    return pcall(function() object[property] = value end)
  end
  local function reportUnavailable(key)
    if not unsupported[key] then
      unsupported[key] = true
      unsupportedCount += 1
      if key ~= "Terrain.Decoration" then
        warn("[AntiLag] Ajuste indisponivel neste cliente: " .. key)
      end
    end
  end
  local function unavailable(object, property) reportUnavailable(object.ClassName .. "." .. property) end
  local function inScope(object)
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
      if object == root or object:IsDescendantOf(root) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function desiredFor(object)
    local target = {}
    local watch = true
    if object == services.GameSettings then
      if options.LowestGraphics then
        target.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
      end
      return target, false
    elseif object == Lighting then
      if options.Shadows then
        target.GlobalShadows = false
      end
      if options.FlatLighting then
        target.Ambient, target.OutdoorAmbient = white, white
        target.Brightness, target.ExposureCompensation = 0, 0
        target.EnvironmentDiffuseScale, target.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0, 0
        target.ColorShift_Top, target.ColorShift_Bottom = black, black
        local ok, soft = pcall(function() return Enum.LightingStyle.Soft end)
        if ok then
          target.LightingStyle = soft
        end
        target.PrioritizeLightingQuality = false
      end
      if options.NoFog then
        target.FogStart, target.FogEnd = 0, 1000000
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Terrain") then
      if options.Water then
        target.WaterWaveSize, target.WaterWaveSpeed, target.WaterReflectance = 0, 0, 0
        target.WaterTransparency = if options.TransparentWater then 1 else 0
      end
      if options.TerrainDecoration then
        target.Decoration = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
      if options.Particles then
        target.Enabled = false
        target.Lifetime = zeroLifetime
        target.Transparency = oneSequence
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") then
      if options.TrailsAndBeams then
        target.Enabled, target.Transparency = false, oneSequence
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Smoke") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.Opacity, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 0, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Fire") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Sparkles") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled, target.LocalTransparencyModifier = false, 1
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Highlight") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("ForceField") or object:IsA("Explosion") then
      if options.LegacyEffects then
        target.Visible = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("PostEffect") then
      if options.PostEffects then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Light") then
      if options.Lights then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
      if options.Shadows then
        target.Shadows = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Atmosphere") then
      if options.Atmosphere then
        target.Density, target.Haze, target.Glare = 0, 0, 0
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Clouds") then
      if options.Clouds then
        target.Enabled = false
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Sky") then
      if options.FlatSky then
        target.CelestialBodiesShown, target.StarCount = false, 0
        for _, property in ipairs(skyProperties) do
          target[property] = options.FlatSkyTexture
        end
      end
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
      watch = false
      if options.Shadows then
        target.CastShadow = false
      end
      if options.FlatMaterials then
        target.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        target.MaterialVariant, target.Reflectance = "", 0
      end
      if options.HideTaggedDecorations and CollectionService:HasTag(object, "AntiLagDecoration") then
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
      end
    end
    return target, watch and options.MaintainEffects
  end
  local function removeEntry(entry)
    if entry.connection then
      entry.connection:Disconnect()
      entry.connection = nil
    end
    journal[entry.object] = nil
    local index = entry.index
    local last = records[#records]
    records[index] = last
    if last then
      last.index = index
    end
    records[#records] = nil
  end
  local function restoreProperty(object, property, saved)
    local ok, current = read(object, property)
    if options.RestoreLatest and ok and current ~= saved.applied then
      saved.original = current
    end
    if ok and current == saved.original then
      return
    end
    if not write(object, property, saved.original) then
      restoreFailures += 1
    end
  end
  local function restoreEntry(entry)
    removeEntry(entry)
    for property, saved in pairs(entry.properties) do
      restoreProperty(entry.object, property, saved)
      changedProperties -= 1
    end
  end
  local function delayDirty()
    if delayed then
      return
    end
    delayed = true
    task.delay(options.ReapplyInterval, function()
      delayed = false
      local batch = dirty
      dirty = {}
      if not alive or not enabled then
        return
      end
      for object in pairs(batch) do
        enqueue(object)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function updateWatcher(entry, watch)
    if not watch then
      if entry.connection then
        entry.connection:Disconnect()
        entry.connection = nil
      end
      return
    end
    if entry.connection then
      return
    end
    entry.connection = entry.object.Changed:Connect(function(property)
      if not enabled or not alive or journal[entry.object] ~= entry then
        return
      end
      local saved = entry.properties[property]
      if not saved then
        return
      end
      local ok, current = read(entry.object, property)
      if not ok or current == saved.applied then
        return
      end
      if options.RestoreLatest then
        saved.original = current
      end
      dirty[entry.object] = true
      delayDirty()
    end)
  end
  process = function(object)
    local special = object == services.GameSettings
    if not enabled or (not special and not inScope(object)) then
      if journal[object] then
        restoreEntry(journal[object])
      end
      return
    end
    local target, watch = desiredFor(object)
    if services.ExtraPolicy then
      target, watch = services.ExtraPolicy(object, target, watch, options)
    end
    local entry = journal[object]
    if entry then
      for property, saved in pairs(entry.properties) do
        if target[property] == nil then
          entry.properties[property] = nil
          restoreProperty(object, property, saved)
          changedProperties -= 1
        end
      end
    end
    for property, value in pairs(target) do
      if unsupported[object.ClassName .. "." .. property] then
        continue
      end
      local ok, current = read(object, property)
      if not ok then
        unavailable(object, property)
        continue
      end
      local saved = entry and entry.properties[property]
      if not saved and current == value and not watch then
        continue
      end
      if not entry then
        entry = { object = object, properties = {}, index = #records + 1 }
        journal[object], records[entry.index] = entry, entry
      end
      if not saved then
        saved = { original = current, applied = current }
        entry.properties[property] = saved
        changedProperties += 1
      elseif options.RestoreLatest and current ~= saved.applied then
        saved.original = current
      end
      if current ~= value then
        local previous = saved.applied
        saved.applied = value
        if not write(object, property, value) then
          saved.applied = previous
          unavailable(object, property)
          if saved.original == current then
            entry.properties[property] = nil
            changedProperties -= 1
          end
        end
      else
        saved.applied = value
      end
    end
    if entry then
      if next(entry.properties) == nil then
        removeEntry(entry)
      else
        updateWatcher(entry, watch)
      end
    end
  end
  local function popPending()
    if head > tail then
      return nil
    end
    local object = pending[head]
    pending[head] = nil
    head += 1
    queued[object] = nil
    if head > tail then
      pending, head, tail = {}, 1, 0
    end
    return object
  end
  local function nextScan()
    while #scan > 0 do
      local frame = scan[#scan]
      local object = frame.items[frame.index]
      if not object then
        scan[#scan] = nil
        continue
      end
      frame.index += 1
      local ok, children = pcall(function() return object:GetChildren() end)
      if ok and #children > 0 then
        scan[#scan + 1] = { items = children, index = 1 }
      end
      return object
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function workAvailable() return if enabled then head <= tail or #scan > 0 else #records > 0 end
  local function finishDestroy()
    alive = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
    connections, dirty, pending, queued, scan = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
  end
  scheduleWorker = function()
    if workerRunning or not alive then
      return
    end
    workerRunning = true
    task.defer(function()
      while alive and workAvailable() do
        local bootstrap = #scan > 0 or not enabled
        local deadline = os.clock() + (bootstrap and 6 or options.BudgetMs) / 1000
        local count = 0
        local limit = bootstrap and 4096 or options.MaxItemsPerFrame
        repeat
          if not enabled then
            local entry = records[#records]
            if entry then
              restoreEntry(entry)
            end
          else
            local object
            if count % 2 == 0 then
              object = popPending() or nextScan()
            else
              object = nextScan() or popPending()
            end
            if object then
              local ok, message = pcall(process, object)
              if not ok then
                runtimeFailures += 1
                if runtimeFailures <= 3 then
                  warn("[AntiLag] " .. tostring(message))
                end
              end
            end
          end
          count += 1
        until count >= limit or os.clock() >= deadline or not workAvailable()
        if workAvailable() then
          Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
      end
      workerRunning = false
      if destroying and not enabled and #records == 0 then
        finishDestroy()
      end
    end)
  end
  enqueue = function(object)
    if not alive or not enabled or queued[object] then
      return
    end
    tail += 1
    pending[tail], queued[object] = object, true
    scheduleWorker()
  end
  restartScan = function()
    generation += 1
    scan = { { items = table.clone(roots), index = 1 } }
    if services.GameSettings then
      enqueue(services.GameSettings)
    end
    if options.LowestGraphics and not services.GameSettings then
      reportUnavailable("UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel")
    end
    if enabled then
      process(Lighting)
      if services.GameSettings then
        process(services.GameSettings)
      end
    end
    scheduleWorker()
  end
  for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(enqueue)
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object)
      if journal[object] then
        enqueue(object)
      end
    end)
  end
  for _, signal in ipairs({
    CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("AntiLagDecoration"),
    CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("AntiLagDecoration"),
  }) do
    connections[#connections + 1] = signal:Connect(enqueue)
  end
  connections[#connections + 1] = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
    if enabled and object:IsA("Humanoid") and object.Parent then
      scan[#scan + 1] = { items = { object.Parent }, index = 1 }
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end)
  function controller:RefreshInstance(object, immediate)
    if not enabled or not alive then
      return
    end
    if immediate then
      local ok, message = pcall(process, object)
      if not ok then
        runtimeFailures += 1
        if runtimeFailures <= 3 then
          warn("[AntiLag] " .. tostring(message))
        end
      end
    else
      enqueue(object)
    end
  end
  function controller:RefreshSubtree(object)
    if enabled and alive and object then
      scan[#scan + 1] = { items = { object }, index = 1 }
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  function controller:SetEnabled(value)
    if not alive or destroying or enabled == value then
      return
    end
    enabled = value
    generation += 1
    if enabled then
      restartScan()
    else
      pending, queued, scan, dirty, head, tail = {}, {}, {}, {}, 1, 0
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  function controller:SetOption(key, value)
    if not alive or destroying or options[key] == nil then
      return false
    end
    if typeof(value) ~= typeof(options[key]) then
      return false
    end
    if type(value) == "number" and (value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge) then
      return false
    end
    if key == "BudgetMs" then
      value = math.clamp(value, 0.25, 4)
    end
    if key == "MaxItemsPerFrame" then
      value = math.floor(math.clamp(value, 8, 1000))
    end
    if key == "ReapplyInterval" then
      value = math.clamp(value, 0.1, 2)
    end
    local bounds = {
      CullDistance = { 300, 1200 },
      CullKeepNear = { 8, 128 },
      CullViewPadding = { 0, 100 },
      CullViewDegrees = { 2, 30 },
      CullHideDelay = { 0.05, 2 },
      CullInterval = { 0.06, 0.35 },
      CullBudgetMs = { 0.2, 1.5 },
      CullAbove = { 80, 600 },
      CullBelow = { 50, 400 },
      CullVerticalMargin = { 5, 30 },
    }

    if bounds[key] then
      value = math.clamp(value, bounds[key][1], bounds[key][2])
    end
    if options[key] == value then
      return true
    end
    options[key] = value
    local noScan = key == "ShowFPS"
      or key == "ShowMenu"
      or key == "StartEnabled"
      or key == "BudgetMs"
      or key == "MaxItemsPerFrame"
      or key == "ReapplyInterval"
      or key == "RestoreLatest"
      or string.sub(key, 1, 4) == "Cull"
      or key == "HideLobbyInMatch"
    if enabled and not noScan then
      restartScan()
    end
    return true
  end
  function controller:GetOption(key) return options[key] end
  function controller:GetStatus()
    return {
      Enabled = enabled,
      Alive = alive,
      Destroying = destroying,
      Busy = workerRunning or workAvailable(),
      Instances = #records,
      Properties = changedProperties,
      Unsupported = unsupportedCount,
      UnsupportedProperties = table.clone(unsupported),
      RestoreFailures = restoreFailures,
      RuntimeFailures = runtimeFailures,
      Generation = generation,
    }
  end
  function controller:Destroy()
    if not alive or destroying then
      return
    end
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    destroying = true
    if #records == 0 then
      finishDestroy()
    else
      scheduleWorker()
    end
  end
  for _, key in ipairs({ "BudgetMs", "MaxItemsPerFrame", "ReapplyInterval" }) do
    controller:SetOption(key, options[key])
  end
  controller:SetEnabled(options.StartEnabled)
  return controller
end
Properties.create = createOptimizer
Properties.__contract = {
  access = { default = "render.write" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
}

return Properties

-- [[ spatial visual selection ]]
--!optimize 2
--!native
-- @modules renderspatial

-- code
local Spatial = {}
function Spatial.setup() return true end
local function verticalDecision(minY, maxY, cameraY, previous, options)
  if options.CullFloorY and maxY < options.CullFloorY then
    return "floor"
  end
  if not options.CullVertical then
    return nil
  end
  local margin = options.CullVerticalMargin or 20
  local above = (options.CullAbove or 200) - (if previous == "above" then margin else 0)
  local below = (options.CullBelow or 100) - (if previous == "below" then margin else 0)
  local anchorY = options.CullAnchorY or cameraY
  if minY > math.max(cameraY, anchorY) + above then
    return "above"
  end
  if maxY < math.min(cameraY, anchorY) - below then
    return "below"
  end
  return nil
end
local function boundsHalf(frame, size)
  local right, up, look = frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, frame.LookVector
  return Vector3.new(
    (math.abs(right.X) * size.X + math.abs(up.X) * size.Y + math.abs(look.X) * size.Z) * 0.5,
    (math.abs(right.Y) * size.X + math.abs(up.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5,
    (math.abs(right.Z) * size.X + math.abs(up.Z) * size.Y + math.abs(look.Z) * size.Z) * 0.5
  )
end
local function cameraPlanes(view)
  local normals = {
    view.look,
    view.look * view.options.ViewTanX + view.right,
    view.look * view.options.ViewTanX - view.right,
    view.look * view.options.ViewTanY + view.up,
    view.look * view.options.ViewTanY - view.up,
  }

  local planes = {}
  for _, normal in ipairs(normals) do
    planes[#planes + 1] = { normal = normal, padding = view.options.CullViewPadding * normal.Magnitude }
  end
  return planes
end
local function inCameraView(delta, half, view)
  for _, plane in ipairs(view.planes) do
    local normal = plane.normal
    local support = math.abs(normal.X) * half.X + math.abs(normal.Y) * half.Y + math.abs(normal.Z) * half.Z
    if normal:Dot(delta) + support + plane.padding < 0 then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function renderDecision(position, half, previous, outsideSince, now, view, turnHold)
  local delta = position - view.position
  local options = view.options
  local origin = view.focus or view.position
  local rangeDelta = position - origin
  local dx, dy, dz = math.max(0, math.abs(rangeDelta.X) - half.X), math.max(0, math.abs(rangeDelta.Y) - half.Y), math.max(0, math.abs(rangeDelta.Z) - half.Z)
  local surfaceDistance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
  if surfaceDistance > options.CullDistance then
    return "distance", nil
  end
  local vertical = verticalDecision(position.Y - half.Y, position.Y + half.Y, view.position.Y, previous, options)
  if vertical then
    return vertical, nil
  end
  if turnHold or inCameraView(delta, half, view) then
    return nil, nil
  end
  if not options.CullView or surfaceDistance <= options.CullKeepNear then
    return nil, nil
  end
  outsideSince = outsideSince or now
  if now - outsideSince >= options.CullHideDelay then
    return "view", outsideSince
  end
  return nil, outsideSince
end
local function createSpatialController(services, getOption, PROFILE)
  local Workspace = services.Workspace
  local controller = {}
  local roots = services.Roots or { Workspace }
  local function inScope(object)
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
      if object == root or object:IsDescendantOf(root) then
        return true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local active, alive = false, true
  local records, chunks, chunkList = {}, {}, {}
  local stack, pending, queued = {}, {}, {}
  local head, tail, chunkIndex = 1, 0, 1
  local driver
  local connections = {}
  local hiddenCount, trackedCount = 0, 0
  local elapsed, holdUntil, lastLook = 1, 0, nil
  local cameraSnapshot
  local function option(key, fallback)
    local value = getOption(key)
    return if value == nil then fallback else value
  end
  local function setHidden(entry, hidden)
    if entry.hidden == hidden then
      return
    end
    entry.hidden = hidden
    hiddenCount += if hidden then 1 else -1
    services.OnHidden(entry.object, hidden)
  end
  local function forget(object)
    local entry = records[object]
    if not entry then
      return
    end
    setHidden(entry, false)
    records[object] = nil
    trackedCount -= 1
    local chunk = entry.chunk
    local last = chunk.parts[#chunk.parts]
    chunk.parts[entry.index] = last
    if last then
      last.index = entry.index
    end
    chunk.parts[#chunk.parts] = nil
    if #chunk.parts == 0 then
      chunks[chunk.key] = nil
      local lastChunk = chunkList[#chunkList]
      chunkList[chunk.index] = lastChunk
      if lastChunk then
        lastChunk.index = chunk.index
      end
      chunkList[#chunkList] = nil
    end
  end
  local modelBounds = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local function visualBounds(object)
    if object:IsA("BasePart") and not object:IsA("Terrain") then
      return object.Position, boundsHalf(object.CFrame, object.Size)
    end
    if object:IsA("Explosion") then
      return object.Position, Vector3.zero
    end
    if object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") then
      local first, second = object.Attachment0, object.Attachment1
      if first and second then
        local a, b = first.WorldPosition, second.WorldPosition
        return (a + b) * 0.5, Vector3.new(math.abs(a.X - b.X), math.abs(a.Y - b.Y), math.abs(a.Z - b.Z)) * 0.5
      end
    end
    local subject = object
    if object:IsA("Highlight") or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") or object:IsA("PVAdornment") then
      subject = object.Adornee or object.Parent
    end
    while subject and subject ~= Workspace do
      if subject:IsA("Attachment") then
        return subject.WorldPosition, Vector3.zero
      end
      if subject:IsA("BasePart") then
        return subject.Position, boundsHalf(subject.CFrame, subject.Size)
      end
      if subject:IsA("Model") then
        local cached = modelBounds[subject]
        if not cached then
          local frame, size = subject:GetBoundingBox()
          cached = { frame.Position, boundsHalf(frame, size) }
          modelBounds[subject] = cached
        end
        return cached[1], cached[2]
      end
      subject = subject.Parent
    end
  end
  local function eligible(object)
    return (object:IsA("BasePart") and not object:IsA("Terrain"))
      or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
      or object:IsA("Beam")
      or object:IsA("Trail")
      or object:IsA("Smoke")
      or object:IsA("Fire")
      or object:IsA("Sparkles")
      or object:IsA("Light")
      or object:IsA("Highlight")
      or object:IsA("ForceField")
      or object:IsA("Explosion")
      or object:IsA("BillboardGui")
      or object:IsA("SurfaceGui")
      or object:IsA("PVAdornment")
      or object:IsA("Humanoid")
      or object:IsA("Decal")
      or object:IsA("Texture")
  end
  local function register(object)
    if records[object] then
      return
    end
    if not eligible(object) then
      return
    end
    local position = visualBounds(object) or Vector3.zero
    local size = 64
    local x, y, z = math.floor(position.X / size), math.floor(position.Y / size), math.floor(position.Z / size)
    local key = x .. ":" .. y .. ":" .. z
    local chunk = chunks[key]
    if not chunk then
      chunk = {
        key = key,
        index = #chunkList + 1,
        parts = {},
      }

      chunks[key], chunkList[chunk.index] = chunk, chunk
    end
    local entry = { object = object, position = position, chunk = chunk, index = #chunk.parts + 1, hidden = false }
    chunk.parts[entry.index], records[object] = entry, entry
    trackedCount += 1
    if cameraSnapshot then
      local actualPosition, half = visualBounds(object)
      if actualPosition then
        entry.reason, entry.outsideSince = renderDecision(actualPosition, half, nil, nil, os.clock(), cameraSnapshot, false)
      end
      setHidden(entry, entry.reason ~= nil)
    end
  end
  local function enqueue(object)
    if not active or not option("CullEnabled", true) or queued[object] then
      return
    end
    tail += 1
    pending[tail], queued[object] = object, true
  end
  local function nextNode()
    if head <= tail then
      local object = pending[head]
      pending[head], queued[object] = nil, nil
      head += 1
      if head > tail then
        pending, head, tail = {}, 1, 0
      end
      return object, false
    end
    while #stack > 0 do
      local frame = stack[#stack]
      local object = frame.items[frame.index]
      if not object then
        stack[#stack] = nil
        continue
      end
      frame.index += 1
      return object, true
    end
    return nil, false
  end
  local function currentOptions(camera)
    local aspect = camera.ViewportSize.X / math.max(camera.ViewportSize.Y, 1)
    local margin = math.rad(option("CullViewDegrees", PROFILE.CullViewDegrees))
    local vertical = math.rad(camera.FieldOfView * 0.5)
    local horizontal = math.atan(math.tan(vertical) * aspect)
    return {
      CullDistance = option("CullDistance", PROFILE.CullDistance),
      CullKeepNear = option("CullKeepNear", PROFILE.CullKeepNear),
      CullView = option("CullView", true),
      CullViewPadding = option("CullViewPadding", PROFILE.CullViewPadding),
      CullHideDelay = option("CullHideDelay", PROFILE.CullHideDelay),
      ViewTanX = math.tan(math.min(math.rad(89), horizontal + margin)),
      ViewTanY = math.tan(math.min(math.rad(89), vertical + margin)),
      CullVertical = option("CullVertical", false),
      CullAbove = option("CullAbove", PROFILE.CullAbove),
      CullBelow = option("CullBelow", PROFILE.CullBelow),
      CullVerticalMargin = option("CullVerticalMargin", PROFILE.CullVerticalMargin),
    }
  end
  function controller:Tick(now, camera)
    table.clear(modelBounds)
    if not active or not alive or not option("CullEnabled", true) then
      return
    end
    local indexing = #stack > 0 or head <= tail
    local budget = indexing and 0.004 or option("CullBudgetMs", 0.8) / 1000
    local deadline = os.clock() + budget
    local count = 0
    if not camera then
      return
    end
    local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
    if lastLook and look:Dot(lastLook) < 0.75 then
      holdUntil = now + 0.15
    end
    lastLook = look
    cameraSnapshot = {
      position = camera.CFrame.Position,
      focus = services.GetFocusPosition and services.GetFocusPosition(),
      look = look,
      right = camera.CFrame.RightVector,
      up = camera.CFrame.UpVector,
      options = currentOptions(camera),
    }

    cameraSnapshot.planes = cameraPlanes(cameraSnapshot)
    if services.GetFocusY then
      cameraSnapshot.options.CullAnchorY = services.GetFocusY()
    end
    if services.GetFloorY then
      cameraSnapshot.options.CullFloorY = services.GetFloorY()
    end
    if not active or not alive then
      return
    end
    local scanDeadline = os.clock() + budget * 0.65
    while count < (indexing and 4096 or 160) and os.clock() < scanDeadline do
      local object, descend = nextNode()
      if not object then
        break
      end
      if inScope(object) then
        if descend then
          local children = object:GetChildren()
          if #children > 0 then
            stack[#stack + 1] = { items = children, index = 1 }
          end
        end
        register(object)
      end
      count += 1
    end
    -- Revisit visible and hidden entries; moving cameras and objects can cross either boundary.
    local visited = 0
    while #chunkList > 0 and visited < #chunkList and os.clock() < deadline do
      if chunkIndex > #chunkList then
        chunkIndex = 1
      end
      local chunk = chunkList[chunkIndex]
      chunkIndex += 1
      visited += 1
      chunk.cursor = chunk.cursor or 1
      local countInChunk = 0
      while #chunk.parts > 0 and countInChunk < #chunk.parts and os.clock() < deadline do
        if chunk.cursor > #chunk.parts then
          chunk.cursor = 1
        end
        local entry = chunk.parts[chunk.cursor]
        chunk.cursor += 1
        countInChunk += 1
        if not entry.object.Parent or not inScope(entry.object) then
          forget(entry.object)
        else
          local position, half = visualBounds(entry.object)
          if position then
            entry.reason, entry.outsideSince = renderDecision(position, half, entry.reason, entry.outsideSince, now, cameraSnapshot, now < holdUntil)
            setHidden(entry, entry.reason ~= nil)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function clearSpatial()
    for _, entry in pairs(records) do
      setHidden(entry, false)
    end
    records, chunks, chunkList, stack, pending, queued = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    head, tail, chunkIndex, trackedCount = 1, 0, 1, 0
    lastLook, elapsed = nil, 1
  end
  local function refreshDriver()
    if driver then
      driver:Disconnect()
      driver = nil
    end
    if not active or not option("CullEnabled", true) then
      return
    end
    driver = services.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
      elapsed += dt
      if (#stack > 0 or head <= tail) or elapsed >= option("CullInterval", 0.1) then
        elapsed = 0
        controller:Tick(os.clock(), Workspace.CurrentCamera)
      end
    end)
  end
  function controller:SetEnabled(value)
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    active = value
    clearSpatial()
    if active and option("CullEnabled", true) then
      stack = { { items = table.clone(roots), index = 1 } }
    end
    refreshDriver()
    if active then
      self:Tick(os.clock(), Workspace.CurrentCamera)
    end
  end
  function controller:Refresh()
    if not active then
      return
    end
    self:Tick(os.clock(), Workspace.CurrentCamera)
  end
  function controller:GetStatus() return { Tracked = trackedCount, Hidden = hiddenCount, Chunks = #chunkList, Indexing = #stack > 0 or head <= tail } end
  function controller:Destroy()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    alive = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
  end
  for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) enqueue(object) end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(object) forget(object) end)
  end
  return controller
end
Spatial.create = createSpatialController
Spatial.__contract = {
  access = { default = "render.write" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "create" },
}

return Spatial

-- [[ auto jump ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules autojump

-- module
local AutoJump = {}
local utils
local jumpConnection
local jumpCharacter
local jumpHumanoid
local configObserver
local epoch = 0

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  AIR_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.Air,
  JUMPING_STATE = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
}

-- jump-control
local function stopJump()
  epoch += 1
  local connection = jumpConnection
  jumpConnection, jumpCharacter, jumpHumanoid = nil, nil, nil
  if not connection then
    return
  end
  if utils then
    utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
  end
  connection:Disconnect()
end

-- jump-loop
local function jumpStep(player)
  local character = player.Character
  if character ~= jumpCharacter then
    jumpCharacter, jumpHumanoid = character, nil
  end
  if not character or not character.Parent then
    return
  end
  local humanoid = jumpHumanoid
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Parent ~= character then
    humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    jumpHumanoid = humanoid
  end
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.FloorMaterial == CONFIG.AIR_MATERIAL then
    return
  end
  if humanoid:GetState() ~= CONFIG.JUMPING_STATE then
    humanoid:ChangeState(CONFIG.JUMPING_STATE)
  end
end

-- synchronization
function AutoJump.sync()
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoJump") ~= true then
    stopJump()
    return true
  end
  if jumpConnection and jumpConnection.Connected ~= false then
    return true
  end
  stopJump()
  local player, runService = utils.getLocalPlayer(), utils.getRunService()
  if not player or not runService or not runService.Heartbeat then
    return false, "Jogador ou Heartbeat indisponível"
  end
  local token = epoch
  jumpConnection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if token ~= epoch then
      return
    end
    if not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoJump") ~= true then
      stopJump()
      return
    end
    jumpStep(player)
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(jumpConnection)
  return true
end

-- setup
function AutoJump.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Utils ausente"
  end
  AutoJump.teardown()
  utils = deps.Utils
  configObserver = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.AutoJump ~= nil then
      AutoJump.sync()
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(configObserver)
  return AutoJump.sync()
end
function AutoJump.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(configObserver)
    end
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopJump()
  utils = nil
end

-- contract
AutoJump.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getLocalPlayer", "getRunService", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "isActive", "observeConfig" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "sync", "teardown" },
}

return AutoJump

-- [[ camera ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules camera, invisicam, infinitezoom

-- code
local __part_camera = (function()
  local Camera = {}
  local utils
  local cameraEpoch = 0
  local cameraInput
  local cameraOriginal
  local cameraWrapped
  local configConnection
  local sensitivity = 1.5
  local CONFIG = {
    DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY = 1.5,
    MODULE_SEARCH_RETRY = 0.5,
  }

  local function normalizeSensitivity(value)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value or value < 0 or value == math.huge then
      return CONFIG.DEFAULT_SENSITIVITY
    end
    return value
  end
  local function stopCamera()
    cameraEpoch += 1
    if cameraInput and cameraInput.getRotation == cameraWrapped then
      cameraInput.getRotation = cameraOriginal
    end
    if configConnection then
      if utils then
        utils.untrackGlobal(configConnection)
      end
      configConnection:Disconnect()
      configConnection = nil
    end
    cameraInput, cameraOriginal, cameraWrapped = nil, nil, nil
  end
  local function startCamera()
    stopCamera()
    local token = cameraEpoch
    task.spawn(function()
      while token == cameraEpoch and utils and utils.isActive() do
        local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
        local scripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        local camera = module and module:FindFirstChild("CameraModule")
        local input = camera and camera:FindFirstChild("CameraInput")
        if input and input:IsA("ModuleScript") then
          local loaded, api = pcall(require, input)
          if token ~= cameraEpoch or not utils then
            return
          end
          if loaded and type(api) == "table" and type(api.getRotation) == "function" then
            cameraInput, cameraOriginal = api, api.getRotation
            local original, boundUtils = cameraOriginal, utils
            local wrapped
            wrapped = function(...)
              local rotation = original(...)
              if token ~= cameraEpoch or utils ~= boundUtils or not boundUtils.isActive() then
                if api.getRotation == wrapped then
                  api.getRotation = original
                end
                return rotation
              end
              return rotation * sensitivity
            end
            cameraWrapped = wrapped
            cameraInput.getRotation = cameraWrapped
            return
          end
        end
        task.wait(CONFIG.MODULE_SEARCH_RETRY)
      end
    end)
  end
  function Camera.setup(deps)
    if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
      return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
    end
    Camera.teardown()
    utils = deps.Utils
    sensitivity = normalizeSensitivity(utils.getConfigValue("CameraSensitivity"))
    startCamera()
    configConnection = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
      if changes.CameraSensitivity ~= nil then
        sensitivity = normalizeSensitivity(changes.CameraSensitivity)
      end
    end)
    utils.trackGlobal(configConnection)
    return true
  end
  function Camera.teardown()
    stopCamera()
    utils = nil
  end
  Camera.__contract = {
    requires = { Utils = "utils" },
    requiresMethods = {
      Utils = {
        "getLocalPlayer",
        "getConfigValue",
        "isActive",
        "observeConfig",
        "trackGlobal",
        "untrackGlobal",
      },
    },
    provides = { "setup", "teardown" },
  }
  return Camera
end)()
local __part_infinitezoom = (function()
  local InfiniteZoom = {}
  local utils
  local configObserver
  local zoomConnection
  local player
  local savedMaximum
  local enabled = false
  local writing = false
  local CONFIG = {
    schema = { UniversalInfiniteZoom = "boolean" },
    defaults = { UniversalInfiniteZoom = false },
    MAX_DISTANCE = 1000000,
  }

  local function stop()
    enabled = false
    if zoomConnection then
      zoomConnection:Disconnect()
      zoomConnection = nil
    end
    if player and savedMaximum ~= nil then
      local ok, reason = pcall(function() player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = savedMaximum end)
      if not ok then
        return false, tostring(reason)
      end
    end
    player, savedMaximum = nil, nil
    return true
  end
  local function start()
    local target = utils.getLocalPlayer()
    if not target then
      return false, "LocalPlayer indisponível"
    end
    local ok, original = pcall(function() return target.CameraMaxZoomDistance end)
    if not ok then
      return false, "limite da câmera indisponível"
    end
    player, savedMaximum, enabled = target, original, true
    local function apply()
      if not enabled or writing then
        return
      end
      writing = true
      local applied, reason = pcall(function() player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = CONFIG.MAX_DISTANCE end)
      writing = false
      if not applied then
        return false, tostring(reason)
      end
      return true
    end
    local success, reason = apply()
    if not success then
      stop()
      return false, reason
    end
    local connected, connection = pcall(function() return target:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMaxZoomDistance"):Connect(apply) end)
    if not connected then
      stop()
      return false, tostring(connection)
    end
    zoomConnection = connection
    return true
  end
  local function applyEnabled(value)
    if value == enabled then
      return true
    end
    if value then
      return start()
    end
    return stop()
  end
  function InfiniteZoom.setEnabled(value)
    if not utils then
      return false, "recurso indisponível"
    end
    value = value == true
    local ok, reason = applyEnabled(value)
    if not ok then
      return false, reason
    end
    if not utils.setConfig({ UniversalInfiniteZoom = value }) then
      applyEnabled(not value)
      return false, "configuração rejeitada"
    end
    return true
  end
  function InfiniteZoom.teardown()
    if configObserver then
      configObserver:Disconnect()
      configObserver = nil
    end
    local ok, reason = stop()
    utils = nil
    return ok, reason
  end
  function InfiniteZoom.setup(deps)
    if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
      return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
    end
    InfiniteZoom.teardown()
    utils = deps.Utils
    configObserver = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
      if changes.UniversalInfiniteZoom ~= nil then
        local ok, reason = applyEnabled(changes.UniversalInfiniteZoom == true)
        if not ok then
          utils.recordError("InfiniteZoom", reason)
          utils.setConfig({ UniversalInfiniteZoom = false })
        end
      end
    end)
    if utils.getConfigValue("UniversalInfiniteZoom") == true then
      return InfiniteZoom.setEnabled(true)
    end
    return true
  end
  InfiniteZoom.__config = CONFIG
  InfiniteZoom.__contract = {
    requires = { Utils = "utils" },
    requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" } },
    provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
  }
  return InfiniteZoom
end)()
local __part_invisicam = (function()
  local Invisicam = {}
  local Utils
  local configObserver
  local applied = false
  local CONFIG = {
    schema = { UniversalInvisicam = "boolean" },
    defaults = { UniversalInvisicam = false },
  }

  local function applyMode(enabled)
    local player = Utils and Utils.getLocalPlayer()
    if not player then
      return false, "LocalPlayer unavailable"
    end
    local mode = enabled and Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam or Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Zoom
    local propertyOk, propertyError = pcall(function() player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = mode end)
    local cameraOk, cameraError = pcall(function()
      local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
      local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
      if not module then
        return false
      end
      local api = require(module)
      local cameras = type(api) == "table" and type(api.GetCameras) == "function" and api:GetCameras()
      if not cameras or type(cameras.ActivateOcclusionModule) ~= "function" then
        return false
      end
      cameras:ActivateOcclusionModule(mode)
      return true
    end)
    if propertyOk or (cameraOk and cameraError == true) then
      applied = enabled == true
      return true
    end
    return false, tostring(propertyError or cameraError)
  end
  function Invisicam.setEnabled(enabled)
    if not Utils then
      return false, "feature unavailable"
    end
    local value = enabled == true
    local ok, reason = applyMode(value)
    if not ok then
      return false, reason
    end
    return Utils.setConfig({ UniversalInvisicam = value })
  end
  function Invisicam.teardown()
    if configObserver then
      configObserver:Disconnect()
      configObserver = nil
    end
    local ok, reason = true, nil
    if Utils and applied then
      ok, reason = applyMode(false)
    end
    Utils = nil
    return ok, reason
  end
  function Invisicam.setup(deps)
    if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
      return false, "missing dependency: Utils"
    end
    Invisicam.teardown()
    Utils = deps.Utils
    configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
      if changes.UniversalInvisicam ~= nil then
        local ok, reason = applyMode(changes.UniversalInvisicam == true)
        if not ok then
          Utils.recordError("Invisicam", reason)
        end
      end
    end)
    if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalInvisicam") == true then
      return applyMode(true)
    end
    return true
  end
  Invisicam.__config = CONFIG
  Invisicam.__contract = {
    requires = { Utils = "utils" },
    requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" } },
    provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
  }
  return Invisicam
end)()
