sources.universal/dumper.luau:
-- [[ dumper ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules dumper

-- module
local Dumper = {}
local activeToken
local activeCallbacks
local status = {
  running = false,
  startedAt = 0,
  folder = nil,
  total = 0,
  processed = 0,
  saved = 0,
  failed = 0,
  bytecode = 0,
}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  PREFIX = "SrcDump",
  PROGRESS_EVERY = 25,
  MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS = 11,
  RETRY_BATCH = 8,
  RETRY_DELAY = 1,
  RETRY_MAX_DELAY = 3,
  RETRY_TIME_BUDGET = 120,
  API_TIMEOUT = 10,
  INSTANCE_BATCH = 5000,
  SCRIPT_BATCH = 100,
  SAVE_BYTECODE = true,
  SAVE_DISASSEMBLY = true,
  INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES = true,
}

local SCRIPT_CLASSES = {
  Script = true,
  LocalScript = true,
  ModuleScript = true,
}

local REMOTE_CLASSES = {
  RemoteEvent = true,
  RemoteFunction = true,
  UnreliableRemoteEvent = true,
  BindableEvent = true,
  BindableFunction = true,
}

local SYSTEM_NAMES = {
  CoreGui = true,
  CorePackages = true,
  RobloxGui = true,
  RobloxReplicatedStorage = true,
  CoreScripts = true,
  RobloxDefault = true,
  RobloxPlayerScript = true,
}

-- helpers
local function emit(callbacks, name, ...)
  local callback = callbacks and callbacks[name]
  if type(callback) == "function" then
    pcall(callback, ...)
  end
end
local function log(message)
  if type(print) == "function" then
    pcall(print, "[SrcDump] " .. tostring(message))
  end
end
local function line(value) return tostring(value):gsub("[\r\n]", " ") end
local function safeProperty(object, key, fallback)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object[key] end)
  if ok and value ~= nil then
    return value
  end
  return fallback
end
local function objectName(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "Name", "Unnamed")) end
local function objectClass(object) return tostring(safeProperty(object, "ClassName", "Unknown")) end
local function objectPath(object)
  local ok, value = pcall(function() return object:GetFullName() end)
  return ok and value or objectName(object)
end
local function isInstance(object) return typeof(object) == "Instance" end
local function safeFilename(value)
  local result = tostring(value):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):sub(1, 80)
  if result == "" or result == "." or result == ".." then
    return "unnamed"
  end
  return result
end
local function getEnvironment()
  if type(getfenv) == "function" then
    local ok, environment = pcall(getfenv)
    if ok and type(environment) == "table" then
      return environment
    end
  end
  if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    local ok, environment = pcall(getgenv)
    if ok and type(environment) == "table" then
      return environment
    end
  end
  return type(_G) == "table" and _G or {}
end
local function lookup(name)
  local environment = getEnvironment()
  local value = environment[name]
  if type(value) == "function" then
    return value
  end
  if type(_G) == "table" and type(_G[name]) == "function" then
    return _G[name]
  end
  return nil
end
local function ensureFolder(path)
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if ok and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return false, "makefolder is unavailable"
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(makefolder, path)
  if ok then
    return true
  end
  if type(isfolder) == "function" then
    local checked, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
    if checked and exists then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false, tostring(err)
end
local function saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
    return false, "writefile is unavailable"
  end
  local directory = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
  if directory and not createdFolders[directory] then
    local current = ""
    for part in directory:gmatch("[^/]+") do
      current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part
      if not createdFolders[current] then
        local ok, err = ensureFolder(current)
        if not ok then
          return false, "cannot create " .. current .. ": " .. tostring(err)
        end
        createdFolders[current] = true
      end
    end
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(writefile, path, content)
  if not ok then
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  return true
end
local function allowed(object, allowDetached)
  if not isInstance(object) then
    return false
  end
  local current = object
  for _ = 1, 200 do
    if current == game then
      return true
    end
    if SYSTEM_NAMES[objectName(current)] then
      return false
    end
    local parent = safeProperty(current, "Parent")
    if not isInstance(parent) then
      return allowDetached == true
    end
    current = parent
  end
  return false
end
local function serialize(value)
  if type(value) == "string" then
    return string.format("%q", value)
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(tostring, value)
  return ok and line(result) or "<unavailable>"
end
local function attributes(object)
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return object:GetAttributes() end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "{}"
  end
  local result = {}
  for key, value in pairs(values) do
    result[#result + 1] = line(key) .. "=" .. serialize(value)
  end
  table.sort(result)
  return "{" .. table.concat(result, ", ") .. "}"
end
local function tags(object, collection)
  if not collection then
    return "[]"
  end
  local ok, values = pcall(function() return collection:GetTags(object) end)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    return "[]"
  end
  table.sort(values)
  return "[" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. "]"
end
local function errorText(value)
  local text = type(value) == "string" and value or ("returned " .. type(value))
  return line(text)
end
local SOURCE_ERRORS = {
  "failed to get script bytecode",
  "failed to get bytecode",
  "failed to decompile",
  "failed to extract",
  "decompilation failed",
  "decompiler error",
  "decompiler timed out",
  "script has no bytecode",
  "no bytecode available",
  "empty bytecode",
  "server scripts are impossible",
  "invalid argument",
  "server error",
  "decompilation error",
}

local function sourceError(value)
  local lower = tostring(value):lower():gsub("^%s*%-%-%[%[", ""):gsub("^%s*%-%-+%s*", ""):gsub("^%s+", "")
  for _, phrase in ipairs(SOURCE_ERRORS) do
    if lower:sub(1, #phrase) == phrase then
      return line(value)
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function timedCall(token, fn, argument, retryDeadline)
  if token.cancelled then
    return false, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local deadline = math.min(os.clock() + CONFIG.API_TIMEOUT, retryDeadline or math.huge)
  if os.clock() >= deadline then
    return false, "retry time budget exhausted"
  end
  local finished, success, result = false, false, nil
  local worker = task.defer(function()
    local ok, value = pcall(fn, argument)
    success, result, finished = ok, value, true
  end)
  while not finished and not token.cancelled and os.clock() < deadline do
    task.wait()
  end
  if finished then
    return success, result
  end
  if worker and type(task.cancel) == "function" then
    pcall(task.cancel, worker)
  end
  return false, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or "API timed out"
end
local function getGameName(token)
  local ok, product = timedCall(token, function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId) end)
  if ok and type(product) == "table" and type(product.Name) == "string" and product.Name:match("%S") then
    return product.Name
  end
  local name = safeProperty(game, "Name")
  if type(name) == "string" and name:match("%S") and name ~= "Game" and name ~= "game" then
    return name
  end
  return "Place_" .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
end
local function nextFolder(gameName)
  local base = CONFIG.PREFIX .. "_" .. safeFilename(gameName)
  if type(isfolder) ~= "function" then
    return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
  end
  local index = 1
  while true do
    local candidate = base .. "_" .. index
    local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, candidate)
    if not ok then
      return base .. "_" .. tostring(os.time())
    end
    if not exists then
      return candidate
    end
    index += 1
  end
end
local function addDiscovery(api, add, errors, token)
  local ok, values = pcall(api)
  if not ok or type(values) ~= "table" then
    errors[#errors + 1] = "discovery failed: " .. errorText(values)
    return
  end
  local processed = 0
  for _, object in pairs(values) do
    if token.cancelled then
      return
    end
    processed += 1
    if processed % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
      task.wait()
    end
    add(object, "executor", CONFIG.INCLUDE_NIL_INSTANCES)
  end
end

-- dump
local function run(token, callbacks)
  if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
    return nil, "writefile and makefolder are required"
  end
  local gameName = getGameName(token)
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local createdFolders = {}
  local base = nextFolder(gameName)
  local status = token.status
  local retryDeadline
  local function callAPI(fn, argument) return timedCall(token, fn, argument, retryDeadline) end
  local function save(path, content)
    if token.cancelled then
      return false, "Dump canceled"
    end
    return saveFile(path, content, createdFolders)
  end
  status.folder = base
  for _, path in ipairs({ base, base .. "/scripts", base .. "/remotes" }) do
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(path)
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[path] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/bytecode")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create bytecode folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/bytecode"] = true
  end
  if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY then
    local ok, err = ensureFolder(base .. "/disassembly")
    if not ok then
      return nil, "cannot create disassembly folder: " .. tostring(err)
    end
    createdFolders[base .. "/disassembly"] = true
  end
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Finding scripts...")
  local catalog, candidates, seen, discoveryErrors = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function add(object, origin, detached)
    if seen[object] or not isInstance(object) then
      return
    end
    seen[object] = true
    local class = objectClass(object)
    local item = { instance = object, origin = origin, detached = detached }
    catalog[#catalog + 1] = item
    if SCRIPT_CLASSES[class] and allowed(object, detached) then
      item.path = objectPath(object)
      candidates[#candidates + 1] = item
    end
  end
  add(game, "game", false)
  local ok, descendants = pcall(function() return game:GetDescendants() end)
  if ok then
    for index, object in ipairs(descendants) do
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil, "Dump canceled"
      end
      add(object, "game:GetDescendants", false)
      if index % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
        task.wait()
      end
    end
  else
    discoveryErrors[#discoveryErrors + 1] = "game:GetDescendants: " .. errorText(descendants)
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscripts", "getnilinstances", "getloadedmodules", "getinstances" }) do
    local api = lookup(name)
    if api then
      addDiscovery(api, add, discoveryErrors, token)
    end
  end
  status.total = #candidates
  emit(callbacks, "onProgress", 0, #candidates)
  local decompiler, disassembler = lookup("decompile"), lookup("disassemble")
  local closureReaders, readers = {}, {}
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptclosure", "getscriptfunction" }) do
    local fn = lookup(name)
    if fn then
      closureReaders[#closureReaders + 1] = { name = name, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "getscriptbytecode", "dumpstring" }) do
    local fn = lookup(name)
    if fn then
      readers[#readers + 1] = { name = name, fn = fn }
    end
  end
  local manifest, errors = {}, discoveryErrors
  local saved, failed, bytecodes, cacheHits = 0, 0, 0, 0
  local sourceCache, unresolved = {}, {}
  local folderByInstance, usedFolderNames = { [game] = "" }, { [""] = { _nilinstances = true } }
  local function folderFor(object)
    local chain, current = {}, safeProperty(object, "Parent")
    while isInstance(current) and current ~= game and folderByInstance[current] == nil and #chain < 200 do
      chain[#chain + 1] = current
      current = safeProperty(current, "Parent")
    end
    local folder = isInstance(current) and folderByInstance[current] or nil
    if folder == nil then
      folder = "_NilInstances"
    end
    for i = #chain, 1, -1 do
      local node = chain[i]
      local used = usedFolderNames[folder]
      if not used then
        used = {}
        usedFolderNames[folder] = used
      end
      local name = safeFilename(objectName(node))
      local candidate, suffix = name, 1
      while used[candidate:lower()] do
        suffix += 1
        candidate = name .. "__" .. suffix
      end
      used[candidate:lower()] = true
      folder = folder == "" and candidate or folder .. "/" .. candidate
      folderByInstance[node] = folder
    end
    return folder
  end
  local function concurrent(items, process, batchSize)
    batchSize = batchSize or CONFIG.SCRIPT_BATCH
    for first = 1, #items, batchSize do
      if token.cancelled then
        return false, "Dump canceled"
      end
      local pending, failure = 0, nil
      for index = first, math.min(#items, first + batchSize - 1) do
        local itemIndex, item = index, items[index]
        pending += 1
        task.defer(function()
          local ok, err = xpcall(function() process(itemIndex, item) end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
          if not ok then
            failure = failure or err
          end
          pending -= 1
        end)
      end
      repeat
        task.wait()
      until pending == 0
      if failure then
        return false, failure
      end
    end
    return not token.cancelled, token.cancelled and "Dump canceled" or nil
  end
  local processed = 0
  local function extract(index, item)
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object, attempts = item.instance, {}
    local source, method, bytecode, closure
    local function attempt(label, fn, argument, validateSource)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      local success, value = callAPI(fn, argument)
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil
      end
      if not success then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": error: " .. errorText(value)
        return nil
      end
      if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 then
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty or invalid return (" .. type(value) .. ")"
        return nil
      end
      if validateSource then
        if not value:match("%S") then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": empty source"
          return nil
        end
        local problem = sourceError(value)
        if problem then
          attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": " .. problem
          return nil
        end
      end
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = label .. ": returned " .. #value .. " bytes"
      return value
    end
    do
      if token.cancelled then
        return nil, "Dump canceled"
      end
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "source attempt 1/" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS
      local sourceOk, directSource = pcall(function() return object.Source end)
      if sourceOk and type(directSource) == "string" and directSource:match("%S") and not sourceError(directSource) then
        source, method = directSource, "Source"
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: available"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "Source: " .. (sourceOk and "empty or unavailable" or errorText(directSource))
      end
      if not bytecode and #readers > 0 then
        for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
          bytecode = attempt(reader.name .. "(instance)", reader.fn, object, false)
          if bytecode then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and sourceCache[bytecode] then
        source, method = sourceCache[bytecode], "cached bytecode"
        cacheHits += 1
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(instance)", decompiler, object, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(instance)"
        end
      end
      if not source and bytecode and decompiler then
        source = attempt("decompile(bytecode)", decompiler, bytecode, true)
        if source then
          method = "decompile(bytecode)"
        end
      end
      if not source and decompiler then
        for _, reader in ipairs(closureReaders) do
          local success, value = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if success and type(value) == "function" then
            closure = value
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": function obtained"
            source = attempt("decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")", decompiler, closure, true)
            if source then
              method = "decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")"
              break
            end
          else
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = reader.name .. ": " .. (success and ("returned " .. type(value)) or errorText(value))
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if source and bytecode and not sourceCache[bytecode] then
      sourceCache[bytecode] = source
    end
    if not decompiler then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "decompile: unavailable"
    end
    if #readers == 0 then
      attempts[#attempts + 1] = "bytecode readers unavailable"
    end
    local folder = folderFor(object)
    local filename = ("%s__%s_%04d"):format(safeFilename(objectName(object)), objectClass(object), index)
    local stem = folder ~= "" and folder .. "/" .. filename or filename
    local bytecodeSaved = false
    if bytecode and CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
      local byteOk, byteError = save(base .. "/bytecode/" .. stem .. ".bin", bytecode)
      if byteOk then
        bytecodes += 1
        bytecodeSaved = true
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save bytecode: " .. tostring(byteError)
      end
    end
    local context = line(safeProperty(object, "RunContext", "unavailable"))
    local header = table.concat({
      "-- SrcDump",
      "-- index: " .. index,
      "-- class: " .. objectClass(object),
      "-- path: " .. line(item.path),
      "-- discovered_by: " .. item.origin,
      "-- run_context: " .. context,
      "-- method: " .. tostring(method or "none"),
      "",
    }, "\n")
    local entry = {
      item = item,
      stem = stem,
      index = index,
      bytecode = bytecode,
      closure = closure,
      attempts = attempts,
      context = context,
      source = source,
      method = method,
      bytecodeSaved = bytecodeSaved,
    }

    if source then
      local savedOk, saveError = save(base .. "/scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua", header .. source .. "\n")
      if savedOk then
        saved += 1
        manifest[index] = "[OK] " .. line(item.path) .. " | " .. method .. " | scripts/" .. stem .. ".lua"
      else
        attempts[#attempts + 1] = "save source: " .. tostring(saveError)
        unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
        failed += 1
        manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      end
    else
      unresolved[#unresolved + 1] = entry
      manifest[index] = "[PENDING] " .. line(item.path)
      failed += 1
    end
    processed += 1
    status.processed, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = processed, saved, failed, bytecodes
    if processed == 1 or processed % CONFIG.PROGRESS_EVERY == 0 then
      emit(callbacks, "onProgress", processed, #candidates, item.path)
    end
  end
  local extracted, extractError = concurrent(candidates, extract)
  if not extracted then
    return nil, extractError
  end
  local collection
  pcall(function() collection = game:GetService("CollectionService") end)
  emit(callbacks, "onStatus", "Saving game data...")
  local tree = { "SrcDump - instances", "", "" }
  local remotes = { "SrcDump - remotes and bindables", "" }
  local remoteCount, instanceCount = 0, 0
  for index, item in ipairs(catalog) do
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local object = item.instance
    if allowed(object, item.detached) then
      local class = objectClass(object)
      local detail = ("[%s] %s | discovered=%s | attributes=%s | tags=%s"):format(
        class,
        line(item.path or objectPath(object)),
        item.origin,
        attributes(object),
        tags(object, collection)
      )
      instanceCount += 1
      tree[#tree + 1] = detail
      if REMOTE_CLASSES[class] then
        remoteCount += 1
        remotes[#remotes + 1] = detail
      end
    end
    if index % CONFIG.INSTANCE_BATCH == 0 then
      task.wait()
    end
  end
  tree[2] = "total=" .. instanceCount
  remotes[2] = "total=" .. remoteCount
  local treeOk, treeError = save(base .. "/tree.txt", table.concat(tree, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not treeOk then
    return nil, "cannot save tree.txt: " .. tostring(treeError)
  end
  local remoteOk, remoteError = save(base .. "/remotes/remotes.txt", table.concat(remotes, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not remoteOk then
    return nil, "cannot save remotes.txt: " .. tostring(remoteError)
  end
  local info = {
    "SrcDump - game information",
    "place_id=" .. tostring(game.PlaceId),
    "game_id=" .. tostring(game.GameId),
    "job_id=" .. tostring(game.JobId),
    "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
    "creator_id=" .. tostring(game.CreatorId),
    "creator_type=" .. tostring(game.CreatorType),
    "place_version=" .. tostring(game.PlaceVersion),
    "instances=" .. instanceCount,
    "scripts=" .. #candidates,
    "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
  }

  info[#info + 1] = "product_name=" .. line(gameName)
  local infoOk, infoError = save(base .. "/game_info.txt", table.concat(info, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not infoOk then
    return nil, "cannot save game_info.txt: " .. tostring(infoError)
  end
  local function retrySource(_, entry, round)
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    local recovered = entry.source or (entry.bytecode and sourceCache[entry.bytecode])
    local recoveredMethod = entry.method or (recovered and "cached bytecode (later match)" or nil)
    if recovered and not entry.source then
      cacheHits += 1
    end
    entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "source/save attempt " .. round .. "/" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS
    if not recovered and not token.cancelled and os.clock() < retryDeadline then
      local object = entry.item.instance
      local sourceOk, source = pcall(function() return object.Source end)
      if sourceOk and type(source) == "string" and source:match("%S") and not sourceError(source) then
        recovered, recoveredMethod = source, "Source (retry)"
      end
      if not recovered then
        for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
          local ok, value = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 then
            entry.bytecode = value
            if CONFIG.SAVE_BYTECODE then
              local byteOk, byteError = save(base .. "/bytecode/" .. entry.stem .. ".bin", value)
              if byteOk then
                if not entry.bytecodeSaved then
                  bytecodes += 1
                  entry.bytecodeSaved = true
                end
              else
                entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "save bytecode: " .. tostring(byteError)
              end
            end
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if not recovered and entry.bytecode and sourceCache[entry.bytecode] then
        recovered, recoveredMethod = sourceCache[entry.bytecode], "cached bytecode (retry)"
        cacheHits += 1
      end
      local function tryDecompile(argument, label)
        if recovered or not decompiler or token.cancelled then
          return
        end
        local ok, value = callAPI(decompiler, argument)
        if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and value:match("%S") and not sourceError(value) then
          recovered, recoveredMethod = value, label .. " (retry)"
        else
          entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = label .. ": " .. (ok and errorText(value) or "error: " .. errorText(value))
        end
      end
      tryDecompile(object, "decompile(instance)")
      if entry.bytecode then
        tryDecompile(entry.bytecode, "decompile(bytecode)")
      end
      if not recovered then
        for _, reader in ipairs(closureReaders) do
          local ok, closure = callAPI(reader.fn, object)
          if ok and type(closure) == "function" then
            tryDecompile(closure, "decompile(" .. reader.name .. ")")
          end
          if recovered or token.cancelled then
            break
          end
        end
      end
      if recovered and entry.bytecode then
        sourceCache[entry.bytecode] = recovered
      end
    end
    if token.cancelled then
      return nil, "Dump canceled"
    end
    if recovered then
      entry.source, entry.method = recovered, recoveredMethod
      local header = table.concat({
        "-- SrcDump",
        "-- index: " .. entry.index,
        "-- class: " .. objectClass(entry.item.instance),
        "-- path: " .. line(entry.item.path),
        "-- discovered_by: " .. entry.item.origin,
        "-- run_context: " .. entry.context,
        "-- method: " .. recoveredMethod,
        "",
      }, "\n")
      local ok, err = save(base .. "/scripts/" .. entry.stem .. ".lua", header .. recovered .. "\n")
      if ok then
        saved += 1
        failed -= 1
        entry.saved = true
        manifest[entry.index] = "[OK] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | " .. recoveredMethod .. " | scripts/" .. entry.stem .. ".lua"
      else
        entry.attempts[#entry.attempts + 1] = "save source: " .. tostring(err)
      end
    end
    status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = saved, failed, bytecodes
  end
  local initialFailed, retryRounds = #unresolved, 0
  status.initialFailed, status.recovered, status.retryRound = initialFailed, 0, 0
  retryDeadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.RETRY_TIME_BUDGET
  for round = 2, CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS do
    if #unresolved == 0 or token.cancelled or os.clock() >= retryDeadline then
      break
    end
    local delayUntil = math.min(retryDeadline, os.clock() + math.min(CONFIG.RETRY_MAX_DELAY, CONFIG.RETRY_DELAY * (round - 1)))
    while not token.cancelled and os.clock() < delayUntil do
      task.wait(math.min(0.1, delayUntil - os.clock()))
    end
    if token.cancelled or os.clock() >= retryDeadline then
      break
    end
    retryRounds = round - 1
    status.retryRound = retryRounds
    emit(callbacks, "onStatus", ("Retry %d/%d: %d scripts remaining..."):format(retryRounds, CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS - 1, #unresolved))
    local retried, retryError = concurrent(unresolved, function(index, entry) retrySource(index, entry, round) end, CONFIG.RETRY_BATCH)
    if not retried then
      return nil, retryError
    end
    local remaining = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(unresolved) do
      if not entry.saved then
        remaining[#remaining + 1] = entry
      end
    end
    unresolved = remaining
    status.recovered = initialFailed - #unresolved
  end
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  local function finalizeFailure(_, entry)
    if entry.source then
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | write failed"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[WRITE_ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. "\n  " .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
    else
      if CONFIG.SAVE_DISASSEMBLY and disassembler then
        local function disassemble(argument)
          local ok, value = callAPI(disassembler, argument)
          if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and not sourceError(value) then
            return value
          end
          return nil
        end
        local assembly = disassemble(entry.item.instance)
        if not assembly and entry.bytecode then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.bytecode)
        end
        if not assembly and entry.closure then
          assembly = disassemble(entry.closure)
        end
        if assembly then
          save(base .. "/disassembly/" .. entry.stem .. ".txt", assembly .. "\n")
        end
      end
      local category = entry.bytecode and "bytecode available; source unavailable" or "bytecode unavailable to client"
      errors[#errors + 1] = "[SOURCE_ERROR] "
        .. line(entry.item.path)
        .. " | "
        .. objectClass(entry.item.instance)
        .. " | "
        .. category
        .. "\n  "
        .. table.concat(entry.attempts, "\n  ")
      manifest[entry.index] = "[ERROR] " .. line(entry.item.path) .. " | " .. category
    end
    status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = saved, failed, bytecodes
  end
  local retried, retryError = concurrent(unresolved, finalizeFailure, CONFIG.RETRY_BATCH)
  if not retried then
    return nil, retryError
  end
  if token.cancelled then
    return nil, "Dump canceled"
  end
  status.saved, status.failed = saved, failed
  local manifestOk, manifestError = save(base .. "/manifest.txt", table.concat(manifest, "\n") .. "\n")
  if not manifestOk then
    return nil, "cannot save manifest.txt: " .. tostring(manifestError)
  end
  local errorsOk, errorsError = save(base .. "/errors.txt", #errors > 0 and table.concat(errors, "\n\n") .. "\n" or "No errors.\n")
  if not errorsOk then
    return nil, "cannot save errors.txt: " .. tostring(errorsError)
  end
  local summaryOk, summaryError = save(
    base .. "/summary.txt",
    table.concat({
      "SrcDump",
      "folder=" .. base,
      "game_name=" .. line(gameName),
      "total_found=" .. #candidates,
      "decompiled_and_saved=" .. saved,
      "failed=" .. failed,
      "initial_failed=" .. initialFailed,
      "recovered_on_retry=" .. (initialFailed - failed),
      "retry_rounds=" .. retryRounds,
      "max_source_attempts=" .. CONFIG.MAX_SOURCE_ATTEMPTS,
      "retry_budget_exhausted=" .. tostring(failed > 0 and os.clock() >= retryDeadline),
      "bytecode_saved=" .. bytecodes,
      "source_cache_hits=" .. cacheHits,
      "instances=" .. instanceCount,
      "remotes=" .. remoteCount,
      "note=Only content accessible to the client environment can be captured.",
      "",
    }, "\n")
  )
  if not summaryOk then
    return nil, "cannot save summary.txt: " .. tostring(summaryError)
  end
  log(("Finished: %d saved, %d failed (%d recovered on retry). Folder: %s"):format(saved, failed, initialFailed - failed, base))
  return {
    folder = base,
    total = #candidates,
    saved = saved,
    failed = failed,
    bytecode = bytecodes,
    initialFailed = initialFailed,
    recovered = initialFailed - failed,
    retryRounds = retryRounds,
  }
end

-- lifecycle
function Dumper.setup()
  Dumper.stop()
  return true
end
function Dumper.start(callbacks)
  if activeToken then
    return false, "A dump is already running"
  end
  if type(callbacks) ~= "table" then
    callbacks = {}
  end
  local token = { cancelled = false }
  activeToken, activeCallbacks = token, callbacks
  status = {
    running = true,
    startedAt = os.clock(),
    folder = nil,
    total = 0,
    processed = 0,
    saved = 0,
    failed = 0,
    bytecode = 0,
  }

  token.status = status
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok, result, reason = xpcall(
      function() return run(token, callbacks) end,
      function(errorValue) return debug and type(debug.traceback) == "function" and debug.traceback(tostring(errorValue), 2) or tostring(errorValue) end
    )
    if activeToken ~= token then
      return
    end
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    status.running = false
    if token.cancelled then
      emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
      return
    end
    if not ok or not result then
      local message = not ok and result or reason or "Dump failed"
      emit(callbacks, "onError", message)
      return
    end
    status.folder = result.folder
    status.total, status.saved, status.failed, status.bytecode = result.total, result.saved, result.failed, result.bytecode
    emit(callbacks, "onComplete", table.clone(result))
  end)
  return true
end
function Dumper.stop()
  status.running = false
  if activeToken then
    local callbacks = activeCallbacks
    activeToken.cancelled = true
    activeToken, activeCallbacks = nil, nil
    emit(callbacks, "onCanceled")
    log("Dump canceled.")
  end
  return true
end
function Dumper.isRunning() return activeToken ~= nil end
function Dumper.getStatus() return table.clone(status) end
function Dumper.teardown() return Dumper.stop() end

-- contract
Dumper.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = {},
  provides = { "setup", "start", "stop", "isRunning", "getStatus", "teardown" },
}

return Dumper

-- [[ fly ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules fly

local Fly = {}

local Utils
local configObserver

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    UniversalFly = "boolean",
    UniversalFlySpeed = "rate",
  },
  defaults = {
    UniversalFly = false,
    UniversalFlySpeed = 1,
  },
}

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local states = { Fly = false }
local epoch = 0
local flyCharacter
local flyHumanoid
local flyRoot
local flyVelocity
local flyGyro
local flyPlatformStand
local flyAutoRotate
local playerControls
local playerControlsModule
local pressedKeys = {}
local controls = { Forward = 0, Backward = 0, Left = 0, Right = 0, Up = 0, Down = 0 }
local bindings = {
  [Enum.KeyCode.W] = { "Forward", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.S] = { "Backward", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.A] = { "Left", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.D] = { "Right", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.E] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Q] = { "Down", -1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.Space] = { "Up", 1 },
  [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = { "Down", -1 },
}

local connections = {}
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local function disconnectPrefix(prefix)
  for name in pairs(connections) do
    if name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
      disconnect(name)
    end
  end
end
local function destroy(object)
  if object then
    pcall(object.Destroy, object)
  end
end
local function clearControls()
  table.clear(pressedKeys)
  for key in pairs(controls) do
    controls[key] = 0
  end
end
local function detachFly()
  if flyRoot and flyRoot.Parent then
    pcall(function() flyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
  end
  destroy(flyVelocity)
  destroy(flyGyro)
  if flyHumanoid and flyHumanoid.Parent then
    pcall(function()
      if flyPlatformStand ~= nil then
        flyHumanoid.PlatformStand = flyPlatformStand
      end
      if flyAutoRotate ~= nil then
        flyHumanoid.AutoRotate = flyAutoRotate
      end
    end)
  end
  flyCharacter, flyHumanoid, flyRoot, flyVelocity, flyGyro = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  flyPlatformStand, flyAutoRotate = nil, nil
end
local function flyCharacterReady()
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
    detachFly()
    return nil
  end
  if flyCharacter ~= character or flyHumanoid ~= humanoid or flyRoot ~= root then
    detachFly()
    flyCharacter, flyHumanoid, flyRoot = character, humanoid, root
    flyPlatformStand, flyAutoRotate = humanoid.PlatformStand, humanoid.AutoRotate
  end
  if not flyVelocity or not flyVelocity.Parent then
    flyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyVelocity.Name = "ExodusFlyVelocity"
    flyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyVelocity.P = 9e4
    flyVelocity.Parent = root
  end
  if not flyGyro or not flyGyro.Parent then
    flyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    flyGyro.Name = "ExodusFlyGyro"
    flyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyGyro.P = 9e4
    flyGyro.D = 1000
    flyGyro.Parent = root
  end
  return humanoid
end
local function getPlayerControls()
  if playerControls and playerControlsModule and playerControlsModule.Parent then
    return playerControls
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local scripts = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
  local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
  if not module then
    return nil
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
  if owner ~= epoch or not Utils or not states.Fly then
    return nil
  end
  if ok and type(value) == "table" and type(value.GetControls) == "function" then
    local ready, result = pcall(value.GetControls, value)
    if owner == epoch and Utils and states.Fly and ready and result and type(result.GetMoveVector) == "function" then
      playerControls, playerControlsModule = result, module
    end
  end
  return playerControls
end
local function updateFly()
  if not Utils or not states.Fly then
    return
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local humanoid = flyCharacterReady()
  local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not humanoid or not camera then
    return
  end
  local direction
  if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
    clearControls()
  end
  if UIS.TouchEnabled and UIS:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
    local controller = getPlayerControls()
    if controller then
      local movement = controller:GetMoveVector()
      direction = camera.CFrame.RightVector * movement.X - camera.CFrame.LookVector * movement.Z
    else
      direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
    end
  else
    direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (controls.Forward + controls.Backward)
      + camera.CFrame.RightVector * (controls.Left + controls.Right)
      + Vector3.new(0, controls.Up + controls.Down, 0)
  end
  if owner ~= epoch or not states.Fly or not Utils or humanoid ~= flyHumanoid or not flyRoot or not flyRoot.Parent then
    return
  end
  if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
    direction = direction.Unit
  end
  local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalFlySpeed")) or 1, 0.1, 10)
  local velocity = direction * speed * 50
  flyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
  flyRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
  flyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
  humanoid.PlatformStand = true
  humanoid.AutoRotate = false
end
local function startFly()
  connect("FlyBegan", UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
    if processed then
      return
    end
    local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
    if binding then
      pressedKeys[input.KeyCode] = true
      controls[binding[1]] = binding[2]
    end
  end)
  connect("FlyEnded", UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    local binding = bindings[input.KeyCode]
    if binding then
      pressedKeys[input.KeyCode] = nil
      controls[binding[1]] = 0
      for key in pairs(pressedKeys) do
        local held = bindings[key]
        if held and held[1] == binding[1] then
          controls[held[1]] = held[2]
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  connect("FlyFocus", UIS.WindowFocusReleased, clearControls)
  local frameSignal = RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Stepped or RunService.Heartbeat
  if not frameSignal then
    return false
  end
  connect("FlyFrame", frameSignal, updateFly)
  updateFly()
  return true
end
local function stopFly()
  epoch += 1
  disconnectPrefix("Fly")
  clearControls()
  detachFly()
  playerControls, playerControlsModule = nil, nil
  return true
end
function Fly.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  local value = enabled == true
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalFly = value }) then
    return false, "configuração rejeitada"
  end
  if states.Fly == value then
    return true
  end
  states.Fly = value
  local ok, result, detail = pcall(value and startFly or stopFly)
  if not ok or result == false then
    pcall(stopFly)
    states.Fly = false
    Utils.setConfig({ UniversalFly = false })
    return false, tostring(ok and (detail or "falha ao alterar recurso") or result)
  end
  return true
end
function Fly.setValue(value)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  value = tonumber(value)
  if not value or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
    return false, "velocidade inválida"
  end
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalFlySpeed = math.clamp(value, 0.1, 10) }) then
    return false
  end
  if states.Fly then
    updateFly()
  end
  return true
end
function Fly.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopFly()
  states.Fly = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function Fly.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  Fly.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  connections = connectionPool.connections
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.UniversalFly ~= nil then
      Fly.setEnabled(changes.UniversalFly == true)
    end
  end)
  if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalFly") == true then
    return Fly.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
end
Fly.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Fly.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Lifetime = { "connections" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}

return Fly

-- [[ gravity ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules gravity

local Gravity = {}

local Utils
local configObserver

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    UniversalGravityEnabled = "boolean",
    UniversalGravity = "rate",
  },
  defaults = {
    UniversalGravityEnabled = false,
    UniversalGravity = 196.2,
  },
}

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local gravityValue
local enabledState = false
local connection
local gravityRoot
local attachment
local force
local function clearGravity()
  if force then
    force:Destroy()
    force = nil
  end
  if attachment then
    attachment:Destroy()
    attachment = nil
  end
  gravityRoot = nil
end
local function updateGravity()
  if not Utils or not enabledState then
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root.Parent then
    clearGravity()
    return
  end
  if gravityRoot ~= root or not force or not force.Parent or not attachment or not attachment.Parent then
    clearGravity()
    gravityRoot = root
    attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Name = "ExodusGravityAttachment"
    attachment.Parent = root
    force = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    force.Name = "ExodusGravityForce"
    force.Attachment0 = attachment
    force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
    force.Parent = root
  end
  local mass = root.AssemblyMass
  local compensation = (not root.Anchored and mass == mass and mass < math.huge) and mass * (Workspace.Gravity - gravityValue) or 0
  local desired = Vector3.new(0, compensation, 0)
  if force.Force ~= desired then
    force.Force = desired
  end
end
local function startGravity()
  local signal = RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Stepped or RunService.Heartbeat
  if not signal then
    return false
  end
  connection = signal:Connect(updateGravity)
  Utils.trackGlobal(connection)
  updateGravity()
  return true
end
local function stopGravity()
  if connection then
    Utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
    connection:Disconnect()
    connection = nil
  end
  clearGravity()
  return true
end
function Gravity.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  local value = enabled == true
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalGravityEnabled = value }) then
    return false, "configuração rejeitada"
  end
  if enabledState == value then
    if value then
      updateGravity()
    end
    return true
  end
  enabledState = value
  local ok, result, detail = pcall(value and startGravity or stopGravity)
  if not ok or result == false then
    pcall(stopGravity)
    enabledState = false
    Utils.setConfig({ UniversalGravityEnabled = false })
    return false, tostring(ok and (detail or "falha ao alterar recurso") or result)
  end
  return true
end
function Gravity.setValue(value)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "controle inválido"
  end
  local number = tonumber(value)
  if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
    return false, "valor inválido"
  end
  number = math.clamp(number, 0, 400)
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalGravity = number }) then
    return false
  end
  gravityValue = number
  if not enabledState then
    return Gravity.setEnabled(true)
  end
  updateGravity()
  return true
end
function Gravity.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopGravity()
  enabledState = false
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function Gravity.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  Gravity.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.UniversalGravity ~= nil then
      local value = tonumber(changes.UniversalGravity)
      if value and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge then
        gravityValue = math.clamp(value, 0, 400)
      end
      if enabledState then
        updateGravity()
      end
    end
    if changes.UniversalGravityEnabled ~= nil then
      Gravity.setEnabled(changes.UniversalGravityEnabled == true)
    end
  end)
  gravityValue = tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalGravity")) or Workspace.Gravity
  if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalGravityEnabled") == true then
    return Gravity.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
end
Gravity.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Gravity.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}

return Gravity

-- [[ infinitejump ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules infinitejump

local InfiniteJump = {}

local Utils
local hub
local configObserver

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = { UniversalInfiniteJump = "boolean" },
  defaults = { UniversalInfiniteJump = false },
}

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local states = { InfiniteJump = false }
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local jumpButton
local lastJump = 0
local function jumpInAir()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or not root or humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - lastJump < 0.08 then
    return
  end
  local power = humanoid.UseJumpPower and humanoid.JumpPower or math.sqrt(math.max(0, 2 * Workspace.Gravity * humanoid.JumpHeight))
  if power ~= power or power <= 0 or power == math.huge or root.Anchored then
    return
  end
  lastJump = now
  local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, power, velocity.Z)
  humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end
local function attachJumpButton()
  if not Utils or not states.InfiniteJump then
    return
  end
  local button = hub.getJumpButton()
  if button == jumpButton then
    return
  end
  disconnect("GameJump")
  jumpButton = button
  if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") then
    connect("GameJump", button.MouseButton1Down, jumpInAir)
  end
end
local function startInfiniteJump()
  lastJump = 0
  connect("InfiniteJump", UIS.JumpRequest, jumpInAir)
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if gui then
    local queued = false
    connect("JumpGuiAdded", gui.DescendantAdded, function()
      if queued then
        return
      end
      queued = true
      task.defer(function()
        queued = false
        attachJumpButton()
      end)
    end)
    connect("JumpGuiRemoving", gui.DescendantRemoving, function(object)
      if object == jumpButton then
        disconnect("GameJump")
        jumpButton = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  attachJumpButton()
  return true
end
local function stopInfiniteJump()
  disconnect("InfiniteJump")
  disconnect("GameJump")
  disconnect("JumpGuiAdded")
  disconnect("JumpGuiRemoving")
  jumpButton = nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  local value = enabled == true
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalInfiniteJump = value }) then
    return false, "configuração rejeitada"
  end
  if states.InfiniteJump == value then
    return true
  end
  states.InfiniteJump = value
  local ok, result, detail = pcall(value and startInfiniteJump or stopInfiniteJump)
  if not ok or result == false then
    pcall(stopInfiniteJump)
    states.InfiniteJump = false
    Utils.setConfig({ UniversalInfiniteJump = false })
    return false, tostring(ok and (detail or "falha ao alterar recurso") or result)
  end
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopInfiniteJump()
  states.InfiniteJump = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function InfiniteJump.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  InfiniteJump.teardown()
  Utils, hub = deps.Utils, deps.Hub
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.UniversalInfiniteJump ~= nil then
      InfiniteJump.setEnabled(changes.UniversalInfiniteJump == true)
    end
  end)
  if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalInfiniteJump") == true then
    return InfiniteJump.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
end
InfiniteJump.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
InfiniteJump.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime", Hub = "hubapi" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Hub = { "getJumpButton" },
    Lifetime = { "connections" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}

return InfiniteJump

-- [[ noclip ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules noclip

local Noclip = {}

local Utils
local configObserver

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = { UniversalNoclip = "boolean" },
  defaults = { UniversalNoclip = false },
}

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local savedCollision = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local noclipCharacter
local characterParts = {}
local partIndexes = {}
local enabledState = false
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local function restoreCollision()
  disconnect("NoclipAdded")
  disconnect("NoclipRemoving")
  table.clear(characterParts)
  table.clear(partIndexes)
  for part, value in pairs(savedCollision) do
    if part.Parent then
      pcall(function() part.CanCollide = value end)
    end
    savedCollision[part] = nil
  end
  noclipCharacter = nil
end
local function applyNoclip()
  if not Utils or not enabledState then
    return
  end
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  if character ~= noclipCharacter then
    restoreCollision()
    noclipCharacter = character
    if character then
      local function addPart(part)
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") or partIndexes[part] then
          return
        end
        characterParts[#characterParts + 1] = part
        partIndexes[part] = #characterParts
      end
      local function removePart(part)
        local index = partIndexes[part]
        if not index then
          return
        end
        local last = characterParts[#characterParts]
        characterParts[index] = last
        characterParts[#characterParts] = nil
        partIndexes[part] = nil
        if last and last ~= part then
          partIndexes[last] = index
        end
        local original = savedCollision[part]
        savedCollision[part] = nil
        if original ~= nil then
          pcall(function() part.CanCollide = original end)
        end
      end
      connect("NoclipAdded", character.DescendantAdded, addPart)
      connect("NoclipRemoving", character.DescendantRemoving, removePart)
      for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        addPart(part)
      end
    end
  end
  if not character or not character.Parent then
    return
  end
  for _, part in ipairs(characterParts) do
    if savedCollision[part] == nil then
      savedCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
    end
    if part.CanCollide then
      part.CanCollide = false
    end
  end
end
local function startNoclip()
  connect("Noclip", RunService.Stepped, applyNoclip)
  applyNoclip()
  return true
end
local function stopNoclip()
  disconnect("Noclip")
  restoreCollision()
  return true
end
function Noclip.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  local value = enabled == true
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalNoclip = value }) then
    return false, "configuração rejeitada"
  end
  if enabledState == value then
    return true
  end
  enabledState = value
  local ok, result, detail = pcall(value and startNoclip or stopNoclip)
  if not ok or result == false then
    pcall(stopNoclip)
    enabledState = false
    Utils.setConfig({ UniversalNoclip = false })
    return false, tostring(ok and (detail or "falha ao alterar recurso") or result)
  end
  return true
end
function Noclip.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopNoclip()
  enabledState = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function Noclip.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  Noclip.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.UniversalNoclip ~= nil then
      Noclip.setEnabled(changes.UniversalNoclip == true)
    end
  end)
  if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalNoclip") == true then
    return Noclip.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
end
Noclip.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Noclip.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Lifetime = { "connections" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled" },
}

return Noclip

-- [[ server navigation ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules servers

local Servers = {}

local utils
local failureConnection
local generation = 0
local busy = false
local busyUntil = 0
local reporter = nil
local pendingServerId

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MAX_PING_MS = 100,
  MAX_PAGES = 3,
  PAGE_SIZE = 100,
  PAGE_DELAY = 0.5,
  TELEPORT_TIMEOUT = 15,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v > -math.huge and v < math.huge end
local function begin(callback)
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return nil, "Hub inativo"
  end
  if busy and os.clock() < busyUntil then
    return nil, "Já existe uma busca ou um teleporte em andamento"
  end
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, busyUntil, reporter, pendingServerId = true, os.clock() + 60, callback, nil
  return generation
end
local function report(message)
  if type(reporter) == "function" then
    local ok, reason = pcall(reporter, message)
    if not ok and utils then
      utils.recordError("Servers.callback", reason)
    end
  end
end
local function teleport(serverId, token)
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not player then
    busy = false
    return false, "Jogador indisponível"
  end
  busyUntil, pendingServerId = os.clock() + CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, serverId
  local ok, err = pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, serverId, player) end)
  if token ~= generation or not utils then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not ok then
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  task.delay(CONFIG.TELEPORT_TIMEOUT, function()
    if token ~= generation or not busy or not utils then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("O teleporte não foi concluído; você pode tentar novamente")
  end)
  return true
end

-- actions
function Servers.rejoin(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  if type(game.JobId) ~= "string" or game.JobId == "" then
    busy = false
    return false, "Servidor atual indisponível"
  end
  report("Reconectando ao servidor atual...")
  return teleport(game.JobId, token)
end
function Servers.hop(callback)
  local token, err = begin(callback)
  if not token then
    return false, err
  end
  local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
  local best, cursor
  local seenCursors = {}
  report("Buscando servidores com ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms...")
  for page = 1, CONFIG.MAX_PAGES do
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    local url = ("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%s/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=%d&excludeFullGames=true"):format(
      tostring(game.PlaceId),
      CONFIG.PAGE_SIZE
    )
    if cursor then
      url = url .. "&cursor=" .. http:UrlEncode(cursor)
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url)) end)
    if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
      return false, "Operação cancelada"
    end
    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.data) ~= "table" then
      busy = false
      return false, "Falha ao consultar servidores: " .. tostring(result)
    end
    for _, server in ipairs(result.data) do
      if
        type(server) == "table"
        and type(server.id) == "string"
        and server.id ~= ""
        and server.id ~= game.JobId
        and finite(server.playing)
        and finite(server.maxPlayers)
        and server.playing >= 0
        and server.maxPlayers > 0
        and server.playing < server.maxPlayers
        and finite(server.ping)
        and server.ping > 0
        and server.ping <= CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS
      then
        if not best or server.ping < best.ping or (server.ping == best.ping and server.playing < best.playing) then
          best = server
        end
      end
    end
    cursor = result.nextPageCursor
    if type(cursor) ~= "string" or cursor == "" or seenCursors[cursor] then
      break
    end
    seenCursors[cursor] = true
    if page < CONFIG.MAX_PAGES then
      task.wait(CONFIG.PAGE_DELAY)
    end
  end
  if token ~= generation or not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Operação cancelada"
  end
  if not best then
    busy = false
    return false, "Nenhum outro servidor com vaga e ping informado de até " .. CONFIG.MAX_PING_MS .. " ms foi encontrado"
  end
  report(("Entrando no servidor com menor ping informado: %.0f ms..."):format(best.ping))
  return teleport(best.id, token)
end

-- lifecycle
function Servers.teardown()
  generation = generation + 1
  busy, reporter, pendingServerId = false, nil, nil
  if failureConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(failureConnection)
    end
    failureConnection:Disconnect()
    failureConnection = nil
  end
  utils = nil
  return true
end
function Servers.setup(deps)
  Servers.teardown()
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "Utils ausente"
  end
  utils = deps.Utils
  failureConnection = game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, _, message, placeId, options)
    if not utils or player ~= utils.getLocalPlayer() or placeId ~= game.PlaceId or not busy or not pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    if options and options.ServerInstanceId ~= "" and options.ServerInstanceId ~= pendingServerId then
      return
    end
    busy, pendingServerId = false, nil
    report("Teleporte falhou: " .. tostring(message))
    utils.recordError("Servers", message)
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(failureConnection)
  return true
end

-- contract
Servers.__contract = {
  access = { default = "tooling.execute" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "isActive", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "rejoin", "hop" },
}

return Servers

-- [[ speed ]]
--!optimize 2
-- @modules speed

local Speed = {}

local Utils
local configObserver

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  schema = {
    UniversalSpeedEnabled = "boolean",
    UniversalSpeed = "rate",
  },
  defaults = {
    UniversalSpeedEnabled = false,
    UniversalSpeed = 40,
  },
}

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local states = { Speed = false }
local speedValue
local connectionPool
local function disconnect(name)
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.disconnect(name)
  end
end
local function connect(name, signal, callback) return connectionPool.connect(name, signal, callback) end
local speedHumanoid, speedRestore, speedApplied
local applyingSpeed = false
local function writeSpeed(humanoid, value)
  if humanoid.WalkSpeed == value then
    return
  end
  applyingSpeed = true
  humanoid.WalkSpeed = value
  applyingSpeed = false
end
local function currentHumanoid()
  local player = Utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function applySpeed()
  if not Utils or not states.Speed then
    return true
  end
  local humanoid = currentHumanoid()
  if humanoid ~= speedHumanoid then
    disconnect("SpeedChanged")
    if speedHumanoid and speedHumanoid.Parent and speedApplied ~= nil and speedHumanoid.WalkSpeed == speedApplied and speedRestore ~= nil then
      writeSpeed(speedHumanoid, speedRestore)
    end
    speedHumanoid, speedApplied = humanoid, nil
    speedRestore = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or nil
    if humanoid then
      connect("SpeedChanged", humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"), function()
        if not applyingSpeed and states.Speed and speedHumanoid == humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= speedApplied then
          speedRestore, speedApplied = humanoid.WalkSpeed, nil
          if humanoid.WalkSpeed < speedValue then
            speedApplied = speedValue
            writeSpeed(humanoid, speedValue)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  local configured = tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalSpeed"))
  if configured and configured == configured and configured > -math.huge and configured < math.huge then
    speedValue = math.clamp(configured, 0, 200)
  end
  if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
    if speedApplied ~= nil and humanoid.WalkSpeed == speedApplied then
      local desired = math.max(speedRestore or 0, speedValue)
      if desired ~= speedApplied then
        speedApplied = desired
        writeSpeed(humanoid, desired)
      end
    elseif humanoid.WalkSpeed < speedValue then
      speedRestore, speedApplied = humanoid.WalkSpeed, speedValue
      writeSpeed(humanoid, speedValue)
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function startSpeed()
  local frameSignal = RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Stepped or RunService.Heartbeat
  if not frameSignal then
    return false
  end
  connect("SpeedFrame", frameSignal, applySpeed)
  return applySpeed()
end
local function stopSpeed()
  disconnect("SpeedStep")
  disconnect("SpeedFrame")
  disconnect("SpeedRender")
  disconnect("SpeedChanged")
  if speedHumanoid and speedHumanoid.Parent and speedApplied ~= nil and speedHumanoid.WalkSpeed == speedApplied and speedRestore ~= nil then
    writeSpeed(speedHumanoid, speedRestore)
  end
  speedHumanoid, speedRestore, speedApplied = nil, nil, nil
  return true
end
function Speed.setEnabled(enabled)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "recurso indisponível"
  end
  local value = enabled == true
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalSpeedEnabled = value }) then
    return false, "configuração rejeitada"
  end
  if states.Speed == value then
    if value then
      applySpeed()
    end
    return true
  end
  states.Speed = value
  local ok, result, detail = pcall(value and startSpeed or stopSpeed)
  if not ok or result == false then
    pcall(stopSpeed)
    states.Speed = false
    Utils.setConfig({ UniversalSpeedEnabled = false })
    return false, tostring(ok and (detail or "falha ao alterar recurso") or result)
  end
  return true
end
function Speed.setValue(value)
  if not Utils then
    return false, "controle inválido"
  end
  local number = tonumber(value)
  if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
    return false, "valor inválido"
  end
  number = math.clamp(number, 0, 200)
  if not Utils.setConfig({ UniversalSpeed = number, UniversalSpeedEnabled = true }) then
    return false
  end
  speedValue = number
  if not states.Speed then
    return Speed.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return applySpeed()
end
function Speed.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  stopSpeed()
  states.Speed = false
  if connectionPool then
    connectionPool.destroy()
    connectionPool = nil
  end
  Utils = nil
  return true
end
function Speed.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência ausente: Utils"
  end
  Speed.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  connectionPool = deps.Lifetime.connections(Utils)
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.UniversalSpeedEnabled ~= nil then
      Speed.setEnabled(changes.UniversalSpeedEnabled == true)
    end
  end)
  speedValue = tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalSpeed")) or CONFIG.defaults.UniversalSpeed
  if Utils.getConfigValue("UniversalSpeedEnabled") == true then
    return Speed.setEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
end
Speed.__config = CONFIG

-- contract
Speed.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Lifetime = { "connections" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "setConfig", "observeConfig", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "setEnabled", "setValue" },
}

return Speed

-- [[ autopearl ]]
--!optimize 2
local Pearl = {}
local native, ballistics, tuning, units, target
local shot, track, retryAt = nil, nil, 0
local speed, gravity, drag, transportDelay = 30, 12, 0.99, 0.08
local HORIZONTAL = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
function Pearl.setup(deps)
  native, ballistics, tuning, units, target = deps.Native, deps.Ballistics, deps.Options.tuning, deps.Units, deps.Target
  return true
end
local function restore(snap)
  if not shot or not snap or snap.character ~= shot.character or snap.tool and snap.tool ~= shot.tool then
    return
  end
  local tool = shot.previous
  if not tool or not tool.Parent then
    tool = native.findSword(snap)
  end
  if tool then
    native.equip(snap, tool)
  end
end
function Pearl.reset()
  restore(native.snapshot())
  shot, track, retryAt = nil, nil, 0
end
local function finish(snap, delay)
  restore(snap)
  shot, retryAt = nil, snap.now + delay
end
function Pearl.busy() return shot ~= nil and shot.phase ~= "flight" end
function Pearl.pending() return shot ~= nil end
function Pearl.observeProjectile(action, _id, kind, _position, velocity, acceleration, resistance, sentAt)
  if action ~= "Projectile" or kind ~= "Pearl" or typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" then
    return
  end
  local observedSpeed = units.toBlocks(velocity.Magnitude)
  if observedSpeed > 0 and observedSpeed < 312.5 then
    speed = observedSpeed
  end
  if type(acceleration) == "number" and acceleration > 0 and units.toBlocks(acceleration) < 312.5 then
    gravity = units.toBlocks(acceleration)
  end
  if type(resistance) == "number" and resistance > 0 and resistance <= 1 then
    drag = resistance
  end
  if type(sentAt) == "number" then
    local lag = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - sentAt
    if lag >= 0 and lag <= 0.5 then
      transportDelay = transportDelay * 0.5 + math.min(0.25, lag) * 0.5
    end
  end
end
local function observe(snap, chosen)
  local position = units.toBlocks(chosen.root.Position)
  local velocity = units.toBlocks(chosen.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * HORIZONTAL
  if velocity.Magnitude > 14 then
    velocity = velocity.Unit * 14
  end
  if not track or track.character ~= chosen.character then
    track = { character = chosen.character, position = position, velocity = velocity, at = snap.now }
    return velocity
  end
  local elapsed = snap.now - track.at
  if elapsed >= 0.04 then
    if elapsed <= 0.5 then
      local measured = (position - track.position) * HORIZONTAL / elapsed
      if measured.Magnitude <= 14 then
        velocity = (velocity + measured) * 0.5
      end
    end
    track.position, track.at = position, snap.now
  end
  track.velocity = track.velocity:Lerp(velocity, 0.7)
  return track.velocity
end
local function rayParams(snap)
  local ignored = { snap.camera }
  for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = player.Character
    end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "LocalItemVisuals", "PredictedBlocks", "ArenaPvPBots" }) do
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
    if folder then
      ignored[#ignored + 1] = folder
    end
  end
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, ignored
  return params
end
local function plan(snap, chosen, motion)
  local params = rayParams(snap)
  local origin, position = units.toBlocks(snap.eye), units.toBlocks(chosen.root.Position)
  local playerPosition = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position)
  local rear = native.shieldBlocks(snap, chosen) and native.shieldRear(chosen.character, chosen.root)
  local forward = motion.Magnitude >= 0.5 and motion.Unit or (position - playerPosition) * HORIZONTAL
  if forward.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return nil
  end
  forward = forward.Unit
  local approach = rear or forward
  local ahead = rear and 1.4 or math.clamp(0.75 + motion.Magnitude * 0.12, 0.75, 1.6)
  local side = Vector3.new(-approach.Z, 0, approach.X)
  local delay = transportDelay + 0.05
  local sword = native.findSword(snap)
  local reach = native.stats(sword or snap.tool).reachBlocks or 3
  for _, lateral in ipairs({ 0, 0.6, -0.6 }) do
    local flight = math.clamp((position - origin).Magnitude / speed, 0.1, tuning.pearlMaxFlight)
    for _ = 1, 8 do
      -- Lead by travel AND replication time, then stand ahead instead of at the old feet position.
      local future = position + motion * (flight + delay)
      local destination = future + approach * ahead + side * lateral
      if (destination - playerPosition).Magnitude > tuning.pearlRangeBlocks + reach then
        break
      end
      local floor = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(destination + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), units.offset(0, -20, 0), params)
      if not floor then
        break
      end
      local landing = units.toBlocks(floor.Position)
      local direction, duration = ballistics.solve(origin, landing, speed, gravity, params, tuning.pearlMaxFlight, drag)
      if not direction then
        break
      end
      local actualFuture = position + motion * (duration + delay)
      local gap = (landing - actualFuture) * HORIZONTAL
      local inFront = gap:Dot(approach) >= (rear and 0.5 or 0.4)
      local inReach = (landing + Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0) - actualFuture).Magnitude <= reach
      if math.abs(duration - flight) * math.max(1, motion.Magnitude) <= 0.15 and inFront and inReach then
        return direction, duration, landing
      end
      flight = duration
    end
  end
  -- No throw is better than a fallback that repeatedly lands behind a runner.
  return nil
end
function Pearl.step(snap, chosen)
  if shot and shot.character ~= snap.character then
    finish(snap, 0.25)
  end
  local motion = chosen and observe(snap, chosen)
  if shot then
    if shot.phase == "equip" then
      if
        snap.now >= shot.deadline
        or not chosen
        or chosen.character ~= shot.target
        or chosen.sessionId ~= shot.sessionId
        or not target.isCurrent(snap, chosen)
        or units.distance(chosen.root.Position, snap.root.Position) > tuning.pearlRangeBlocks
      then
        finish(snap, 0.3)
        return false
      end
      if snap.tool ~= shot.tool or native.blocked(snap) then
        return false
      end
      local direction, duration, landing = plan(snap, chosen, motion)
      if not direction then
        finish(snap, 0.4)
        return false
      end
      shot.count, shot.landing = tonumber(shot.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, landing
      shot.phase, shot.sentAt, shot.duration = "confirm", snap.now, duration
      shot.deadline, shot.arrival = snap.now + 1.2, snap.now + duration + transportDelay + 0.6
      if not native.usePearl(snap, shot.tool, direction) then
        finish(snap, 0.4)
        return false
      end
      target.follow(snap, chosen)
      return true
    end
    if shot.phase == "confirm" then
      local consumed = not shot.tool.Parent or (tonumber(shot.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or shot.count) < shot.count
      if not consumed and native.pearlReady() then
        if snap.now >= shot.deadline then
          finish(snap, math.max(0.5, native.pearlCooldown()))
        end
        return false
      end
      restore(snap)
      shot.phase = "flight"
    end
    -- An already sent pearl remains tracked even if focus changes. Never queue another during its flight.
    local teleported = snap.character:GetAttribute("PearlTeleportAt") ~= shot.teleportAt
    local arrived = snap.now - shot.sentAt >= shot.duration * 0.75
      and (units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position) - shot.landing - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)).Magnitude < 0.75
    if teleported or arrived or snap.now >= shot.arrival then
      finish(snap, 0.3)
    end
    return false
  end
  if
    not chosen
    or not target.isCurrent(snap, chosen)
    or snap.now < retryAt
    or native.blocked(snap)
    or not native.pearlReady()
    or units.distance(chosen.root.Position, snap.root.Position) > tuning.pearlRangeBlocks
    or native.aerialMace(snap, chosen)
  then
    return false
  end
  if native.canHit(snap, chosen) and not native.shieldBlocks(snap, chosen) then
    return false
  end
  retryAt = snap.now + 0.4
  local tool = native.findPearl(snap)
  if not tool then
    return false
  end
  if not plan(snap, chosen, motion) then
    return false
  end
  shot = {
    character = snap.character,
    target = chosen.character,
    sessionId = chosen.sessionId,
    previous = snap.tool,
    tool = tool,
    phase = "equip",
    deadline = snap.now + 0.9,
    teleportAt = snap.character:GetAttribute("PearlTeleportAt"),
  }
  if not native.equip(snap, tool) then
    finish(snap, 0.4)
    return false
  end
  return true
end
Pearl.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "busy", "pending", "step", "observeProjectile" },
  requires = { Native = "mcpnative", Options = "mcpoptions", Ballistics = "mcpballistics", Units = "mcpunits", Target = "mcptarget" },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
  requiresMethods = {
    Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" },
    Native = {
      "snapshot",
      "findSword",
      "equip",
      "findPearl",
      "usePearl",
      "pearlReady",
      "pearlCooldown",
      "blocked",
      "canHit",
      "aerialMace",
      "stats",
      "shieldRear",
      "shieldBlocks",
    },
    Ballistics = { "solve" },
    Target = { "follow", "isCurrent" },
  },
}
return Pearl
