-- [[ mcpaim ]]
--!optimize 2
local Aim = {}
local native, utils, tuning, units, input, gui, world, scope, nativeAssist
local humanoids, assisted, lockModel, lockSpeed = {}, nil, nil, 0
-- Native touch profile is 30 degrees / Pull 9 / 72 degrees per second.
local PROFILE = { Cone = math.rad(35), Pull = 7, MaxSpeed = math.rad(60), LockBias = math.rad(3) }
function Aim.reset()
  assisted, lockModel, lockSpeed = nil, nil, 0
end
function Aim.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  humanoids, nativeAssist = {}, nil
  Aim.reset()
end
function Aim.setup(deps)
  Aim.teardown()
  native, utils, tuning, units = deps.Native, deps.Utils, deps.Options.tuning, deps.Units
  input, gui, world = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("GuiService"), utils.getWorkspace()
  scope = deps.Lifetime.scope()
  local function add(instance)
    if instance:IsA("Humanoid") then
      humanoids[instance] = true
    end
  end
  scope.connect(world.DescendantAdded, add)
  scope.connect(world.DescendantRemoving, function(instance) humanoids[instance] = nil end)
  for _, instance in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
    add(instance)
  end
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("MobileAimAssist")
  local ok, library = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  if ok and type(library) == "table" and type(library.Step) == "function" then
    nativeAssist = library
  end
  return true
end
local function directionTo(snap, model, humanoid, root, lock)
  if
    not model
    or not model.Parent
    or model == snap.character
    or not model:IsA("Model")
    or model:IsDescendantOf(snap.camera)
    or model:GetAttribute("Invisible") == true
    or not humanoid
    or humanoid.Health <= 0
    or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    or not root
    or not root:IsA("BasePart")
    or not root.Parent
  then
    return nil
  end
  local distance = units.distance(root.Position, snap.root.Position)
  if distance > (lock and tuning.focusRangeBlocks or tuning.assistRangeBlocks) then
    return nil
  end
  local point = native.aimPoint(model, root)
  local delta = point - snap.camera.CFrame.Position
  if units.toBlocks(delta).Magnitude < 1 / 320 then
    return nil
  end
  if not native.visible(snap, point, model, snap.camera.CFrame.Position) then
    return nil
  end
  if lock and not native.visible(snap, point, model) then
    return nil
  end
  return delta.Unit, distance
end
local function assistTarget(snap, look)
  local best, direction, score, bestDistance
  -- Native-style angular selection, across all living humanoids: no player/selected-target whitelist.
  for human in pairs(humanoids) do
    local model = human.Parent
    local root = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local aim, distance = directionTo(snap, model, human, root, false)
    if not aim then
      continue
    end
    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(aim), -1, 1))
    if angle > PROFILE.Cone then
      continue
    end
    local rank = angle - (model == assisted and PROFILE.LockBias or 0)
    if score == nil or rank < score then
      best, direction, score, bestDistance = model, aim, rank, distance
    end
  end
  assisted = best
  return direction, bestDistance
end
local function assistStep(look, target, dt, distance)
  local falloff = 1 - 0.65 * math.clamp((distance - tuning.focusRangeBlocks) / (tuning.assistRangeBlocks - tuning.focusRangeBlocks), 0, 1)
  local profile = { Pull = PROFILE.Pull * falloff, MaxSpeed = PROFILE.MaxSpeed * falloff }
  if nativeAssist then
    local ok, direction = pcall(nativeAssist.Step, look, target, dt, profile)
    if ok and typeof(direction) == "Vector3" and direction.Magnitude > 0.001 then
      return direction.Unit
    end
    nativeAssist = nil
  end
  -- Same stateless native Step formula when the shared module is unavailable.
  local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(target), -1, 1))
  if angle < math.rad(0.35) then
    return look
  end
  local elapsed = math.clamp(dt or 1 / 60, 0, 1 / 15)
  local turn = math.min(angle * (1 - math.exp(-profile.Pull * elapsed)), profile.MaxSpeed * elapsed)
  local axis = look:Cross(target)
  if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 then
    return look
  end
  return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, turn):VectorToWorldSpace(look)
end
local function apply(camera, direction, maxTurn)
  local look, eye = camera.CFrame.LookVector, camera.CFrame.Position
  local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(direction), -1, 1))
  if angle < 1e-6 then
    return
  end
  angle = math.min(angle, maxTurn or angle)
  local axis = look:Cross(direction)
  if axis.Magnitude < 1e-6 then
    axis = camera.CFrame.UpVector
  end
  camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(eye) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, angle) * camera.CFrame.Rotation
end
function Aim.step(snap, focus, dt)
  local lock, assist = utils.getConfigValue("MCAimLock"), utils.getConfigValue("MCAimAssist")
  if not (lock or assist) or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or gui.MenuIsOpen or native.blocked(snap) then
    Aim.reset()
    return
  end
  -- Fixed tuning with eased, acceleration-limited turns; never snap to a new focus.
  if lock and focus then
    local direction = directionTo(snap, focus.character, focus.humanoid, focus.root, true)
    if direction then
      if lockModel ~= focus.character then
        lockModel, lockSpeed = focus.character, 0
      end
      local elapsed = math.clamp(dt or 1 / 60, 0, 1 / 15)
      local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(direction), -1, 1))
      lockSpeed = math.min(math.rad(150), lockSpeed + math.rad(600) * elapsed)
      local turn = math.min(angle * (1 - math.exp(-10 * elapsed)), lockSpeed * elapsed)
      apply(snap.camera, direction, turn)
      assisted = focus.character
      return
    end
  end
  lockModel, lockSpeed = nil, 0
  if not assist then
    Aim.reset()
    return
  end
  local look = snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
  local direction, distance = assistTarget(snap, look)
  if direction then
    apply(snap.camera, assistStep(look, direction, dt, distance))
  end
end
Aim.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "teardown", "step" },
  requires = { Native = "mcpnative", Utils = "utils", Options = "mcpoptions", Units = "mcpunits", Lifetime = "lifetime" },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
  requiresMethods = {
    Units = { "distance", "toBlocks" },
    Native = { "blocked", "visible", "aimPoint" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getWorkspace" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
  },
}
return Aim

-- [[ mcpmelee ]]
--!optimize 2
local Melee = {}
local native, target, utils, tuning, units
local owner, cycle, selected, pending
local queuedManual, equipAt, apex, warnedManual = false, 0, 0.25, false
function Melee.setup(deps)
  native, target, utils, tuning, units = deps.Native, deps.Target, deps.Utils, deps.Options.tuning, deps.Units
  return true
end
function Melee.reset()
  native.finishCritical()
  owner, cycle, selected, pending = nil, nil, nil, nil
  queuedManual, equipAt, apex = false, 0, 0.25
end
local function grounded(snap)
  local value = snap.character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded")
  if type(value) == "boolean" then
    return value
  end
  return snap.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end
local function bind(snap)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Melee.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
end
local function startJump(snap)
  if native.crystalJumpRisk(snap) then
    cycle, queuedManual = nil, false
    return false
  end
  native.prepareCritical()
  cycle = { at = snap.now, phase = "takeoff", vertical = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) }
  queuedManual = false
  native.requestJump(snap)
  return true
end
function Melee.manual(snap)
  bind(snap)
  if not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") or native.blocked(snap) then
    return false
  end
  if not native.attackGateReady() and not warnedManual then
    warnedManual = true
    utils.recordError("mcpvp.critical.manual", "O executor não permite adiar o ataque nativo; o pulo manual sozinho não garante um crítico.")
  end
  queuedManual = true
  if grounded(snap) and native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool) - snap.now <= apex + 0.04 then
    return startJump(snap)
  end
  return true
end
function Melee.intercept(snap, direction)
  if not utils.isActive() or not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") or native.blocked(snap) then
    return true
  end
  bind(snap)
  local kind = native.stats(snap.tool).type
  if snap.tool and not kind then
    return true
  end
  local intended = target.manual(snap, direction)
  if grounded(snap) and native.crystalJumpRisk(snap) then
    pending = nil
    return true
  end
  if native.criticalReady(snap) and snap.now >= native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool) then
    native.prepareCritical(true)
    pending, queuedManual = nil, false
    cycle = cycle or { at = snap.now, vertical = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) }
    cycle.phase = "land"
    return true
  end
  local aim = typeof(direction) == "Vector3" and direction.Magnitude > 0.001 and direction.Unit or nil
  pending = { character = snap.character, tool = snap.tool, direction = aim, chosen = intended, expires = snap.now + 2.5 }
  Melee.manual(snap)
  return false
end
function Melee.postSimulation(snap)
  if not pending then
    return
  end
  if
    not snap
    or not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit")
    or snap.character ~= pending.character
    or snap.tool ~= pending.tool
    or snap.now >= pending.expires
    or pending.chosen and not target.isCurrent(snap, pending.chosen)
  then
    pending, queuedManual, cycle = nil, false, nil
    native.finishCritical()
    return
  end
  if native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  local readyAt = native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool)
  local crystalException = grounded(snap) and native.crystalJumpRisk(snap)
  if snap.now < readyAt or not (crystalException or native.criticalReady(snap)) then
    return
  end
  if not crystalException then
    native.prepareCritical(true)
  end
  -- A deferred click must not acquire whoever happens to enter the camera later.
  local direction = pending.direction or native.aimDirection(snap)
  local underRay = target.pick(snap, direction)
  if (underRay and underRay.character) ~= (pending.chosen and pending.chosen.character) then
    pending, queuedManual = nil, false
    if cycle then
      cycle.phase = "land"
    end
    return
  end
  local intended = pending.chosen
  if native.replayAttack(snap, direction) then
    if intended then
      target.noteAttack(snap, intended)
    end
    pending, queuedManual = nil, false
    if cycle then
      cycle.phase = "land"
    end
  end
end
function Melee.preSimulation(snap)
  if not snap or not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") or native.blocked(snap) then
    cycle, queuedManual, pending = nil, false, nil
    native.finishCritical()
    return
  end
  bind(snap)
  local ground = grounded(snap)
  if cycle then
    local vertical = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
    if cycle.phase == "takeoff" then
      if ground then
        -- Keep the request alive until the native movement actually leaves the ground.
        if native.crystalJumpRisk(snap) then
          cycle, queuedManual = nil, false
          return
        end
        native.requestJump(snap)
      else
        cycle.phase = "air"
      end
    elseif ground then
      cycle = nil
      native.finishCritical()
    end
    if cycle then
      if cycle.phase == "air" and cycle.vertical > 0 and vertical <= 0 then
        local measured = snap.now - cycle.at
        if measured >= 0.1 and measured <= 0.8 then
          apex = math.clamp((apex + measured) * 0.5, 0.1, 0.8)
        end
      end
      cycle.vertical = vertical
      if not ground then
        native.prepareCritical()
      end
    end
  end
  if not cycle and queuedManual and ground and native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool) - snap.now <= apex + 0.04 then
    startJump(snap)
  end
end
local function criticalReady(snap, readyAt)
  if not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") then
    cycle, queuedManual = nil, false
    return snap.now >= readyAt
  end
  if grounded(snap) then
    if native.crystalJumpRisk(snap) then
      cycle, queuedManual = nil, false
      return snap.now >= readyAt
    end
    if not cycle and readyAt - snap.now <= apex + 0.04 then
      startJump(snap)
    end
    return false
  end
  -- Each automatic strike gets its own jump cycle; do not chain grounded fallbacks.
  if cycle and cycle.phase == "land" then
    return false
  end
  if not cycle then
    cycle = { at = snap.now, phase = "air", vertical = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) }
  end
  if snap.now < readyAt or not native.criticalReady(snap) then
    return false
  end
  native.prepareCritical(true)
  return true
end
function Melee.step(snap, chosen)
  bind(snap)
  if
    not utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoSword")
    or not chosen
    or not target.isCurrent(snap, chosen)
    or native.blocked(snap)
    or units.distance(chosen.root.Position, snap.root.Position) > tuning.focusRangeBlocks
  then
    return false
  end
  local tool = native.findSword(snap)
  local stats = native.stats(tool)
  if pending then
    return false
  end
  if not tool or stats.type ~= "sword" or type(stats.speed) ~= "number" or stats.speed <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  if snap.tool ~= tool then
    if not native.attackDirection(snap, chosen, tool) then
      return false
    end
    if selected ~= tool or snap.now - equipAt >= 0.75 then
      if native.equip(snap, tool) then
        selected, equipAt = tool, snap.now
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local readyAt = native.readyAt(snap, tool)
  local lead = utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") and apex + 0.04 or 0
  if not cycle and readyAt - snap.now > lead then
    return false
  end
  local direction = native.attackDirection(snap, chosen, tool)
  if not direction or not criticalReady(snap, readyAt) then
    return false
  end
  if not target.isCurrent(snap, chosen) or not native.attack(snap, chosen, direction) then
    return false
  end
  target.noteAttack(snap, chosen)
  if utils.getConfigValue("MCAutoCrit") and cycle then
    cycle.phase = "land"
  end
  return true
end
Melee.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "step", "manual", "preSimulation", "intercept", "postSimulation" },
  requires = { Native = "mcpnative", Target = "mcptarget", Utils = "utils", Options = "mcpoptions", Units = "mcpunits" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Units = { "distance", "toBlocks" },
    Native = {
      "blocked",
      "findSword",
      "stats",
      "equip",
      "prepareCritical",
      "requestJump",
      "crystalJumpRisk",
      "attack",
      "readyAt",
      "attackDirection",
      "finishCritical",
      "criticalReady",
      "attackGateReady",
      "replayAttack",
      "aimDirection",
    },
    Target = { "noteAttack", "manual", "isCurrent", "pick" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "isActive", "recordError" },
  },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
}
return Melee

-- [[ mcpsupplies ]]
--!optimize 2
local Supplies = {}
local inventory, native, utils, target, units
local owner, class, job, immediate, rejected
local remembered, nextRun = {}, 0
local strengthEpoch, strengthUsed, quietUntil = nil, false, 0
local function alive(tool) return typeof(tool) == "Instance" and tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Parent ~= nil and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 end
local function enabled(key) return utils.getConfigValue(key) == true end
local function identity(tool) return tostring(tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")) .. "|" .. tostring(tool:GetAttribute("BlockKey")) .. "|" .. tool.Name end
local function find(values, kind, first, last)
  for slot = first, last do
    local tool = values[slot]
    if alive(tool) and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == kind then
      return tool, slot
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function destination(values, snap, urgent)
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(values[slot]) and not remembered[slot] then
      return slot
    end
  end
  for slot = 1, 9 do
    if not alive(values[slot]) then
      return slot
    end
  end
  for slot = 9, 1, -1 do
    local tool = values[slot]
    if
      urgent and tool ~= snap.tool and native.stats(tool).type == nil and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") ~= "Pearl"
      or not urgent and tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == "SpeedPotion"
    then
      return slot
    end
  end
  if urgent then
    return values[9] ~= snap.tool and 9 or 8
  end
  return nil
end
local function restore(snap)
  if job and job.kind == "strength" and snap.character == job.character and (snap.tool == job.tool or not snap.tool) and alive(job.previous) then
    native.equip(snap, job.previous)
  end
end
function Supplies.setup(deps)
  inventory, native, utils, target, units = deps.Inventory, deps.Native, deps.Utils, deps.Target, deps.Units
  return true
end
function Supplies.reset()
  local snap = native.snapshot()
  if snap then
    restore(snap)
  end
  inventory.cancel()
  job = nil
end
function Supplies.busy() return job ~= nil or immediate ~= nil and os.clock() - immediate.at < 1 end
function Supplies.observe(snap)
  local equipped = snap.character:GetAttribute("EquippedClass")
  local epoch = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt") or 0
  if owner ~= snap.character or class ~= equipped then
    Supplies.reset()
    owner, class, remembered, immediate, rejected = snap.character, equipped, {}, nil, nil
    strengthEpoch, strengthUsed, quietUntil =
      epoch, snap.character:GetAttribute("ExodusStrengthAttemptPop") == epoch and snap.character:GetAttribute("ExodusStrengthAttemptAt") ~= nil, snap.now + 4
  elseif epoch ~= strengthEpoch then
    strengthEpoch, strengthUsed, quietUntil = epoch, false, snap.now + 4
  end
  local values = inventory.slots()
  if values and not job and not inventory.busy() then
    for slot = 1, 9 do
      if alive(values[slot]) then
        remembered[slot] = identity(values[slot])
      end
    end
  end
end
local function protect(snap, values)
  if immediate then
    if immediate.character ~= snap.character then
      immediate, rejected = nil, nil
    elseif inventory.confirm(immediate, snap) then
      immediate = nil
    elseif immediate.done and not immediate.accepted then
      rejected, immediate = immediate.tool, nil
    else
      return
    end
  end
  if not enabled("MCAutoTotem") or snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" then
    return
  end
  local tool = find(values, "Totem", 1, 9)
  if tool and rejected ~= tool then
    immediate = inventory.offhand("totem", snap, tool, true)
  end
end
local function request(snap, kind, tool, from, to)
  if not inventory.begin(kind, snap) then
    return false
  end
  job =
    { kind = kind, character = snap.character, tool = tool, from = from, to = to, stage = from and "move" or "offhand", at = snap.now, previous = snap.tool }
  return true
end
local configKeys = { totem = "MCAutoTotem", refill = "MCAutoRefill", strength = "MCAutoStrength" }
function Supplies.step(snap, allowStart)
  local values = inventory.slots()
  if not values then
    return
  end
  protect(snap, values)
  if job then
    if not enabled(configKeys[job.kind]) or snap.now - job.at > 6 or job.character ~= snap.character then
      Supplies.reset()
      nextRun = snap.now + 0.5
      return
    end
    if job.stage == "move" or job.stage == "offhand" then
      if not inventory.ready(job.kind, snap, job.kind == "totem") then
        return
      end
      if not job.pending then
        if job.stage == "move" then
          job.pending = inventory.move(job.kind, snap, job.tool, job.from, job.to, job.kind == "totem" and "totem" or job.kind == "strength")
        elseif snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" then
          job.stage = "close"
        else
          job.pending = inventory.offhand(job.kind, snap, job.tool)
        end
        return
      end
      if not inventory.confirm(job.pending, snap) then
        return
      end
      job.pending = nil
      job.stage = job.kind == "totem" and snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") ~= "totem" and "offhand" or "close"
    end
    if job.stage == "close" then
      if not inventory.finish(job.kind, snap) then
        return
      end
      if job.kind ~= "strength" then
        job = nil
        nextRun = snap.now + 0.15
        return
      end
      job.stage = "equip"
    end
    if job.stage == "equip" then
      if not target.quiet(snap, 4) or snap.now < quietUntil then
        Supplies.reset()
        return
      end
      if not alive(job.tool) then
        Supplies.reset()
        return
      end
      if snap.tool ~= job.tool then
        native.equip(snap, job.tool)
        return
      end
      if native.blocked(snap) or math.abs(units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)) > 25 / 16 then
        return
      end
      job.count, job.stage = tonumber(job.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1, "confirm"
      strengthUsed = true
      snap.character:SetAttribute("ExodusStrengthAttemptAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
      snap.character:SetAttribute("ExodusStrengthAttemptPop", strengthEpoch)
      if not native.useItem(snap, job.tool, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) then
        Supplies.reset()
      end
      return
    end
    if job.stage == "confirm" then
      local consumed = not alive(job.tool) or (tonumber(job.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or job.count) < job.count
      if consumed or (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_strength")) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
        Supplies.reset()
      end
    end
    return
  end
  if not allowStart or immediate and snap.now - immediate.at < 1 or snap.now < nextRun or inventory.busy() then
    return
  end
  nextRun = snap.now + 0.2
  local missing = snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") ~= "totem"
  if not immediate and enabled("MCAutoTotem") and (missing or target.quiet(snap, 0.8) and not find(values, "Totem", 1, 9)) then
    local tool, from = find(values, "Totem", missing and 1 or 10, 36)
    if tool then
      local reserve = from > 9
      local to = reserve and destination(values, snap, true)
      if request(snap, "totem", tool, reserve and from or nil, to) then
        return
      end
    end
  end
  if native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  if enabled("MCAutoRefill") then
    for to = 1, 9 do
      if not remembered[to] or alive(values[to]) then
        continue
      end
      for from = 10, 36 do
        local tool = values[from]
        if alive(tool) and identity(tool) == remembered[to] and request(snap, "refill", tool, from, to) then
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if
    not enabled("MCAutoStrength")
    or strengthUsed
    or snap.now < quietUntil
    or not target.quiet(snap, 4)
    or (tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("Effect_strength")) or 0) > workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  then
    return
  end
  local tool, from = find(values, "StrengthPotion", 1, 36)
  if not tool then
    return
  end
  if from <= 9 then
    job = { kind = "strength", character = snap.character, tool = tool, stage = "equip", at = snap.now, previous = snap.tool }
  else
    local to = destination(values, snap, false)
    if to then
      request(snap, "strength", tool, from, to)
    end
  end
end
Supplies.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "busy", "observe", "step" },
  requires = { Inventory = "mcpinventory", Native = "mcpnative", Utils = "utils", Target = "mcptarget", Units = "mcpunits" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Units = { "toBlocks" },
    Inventory = { "slots", "begin", "ready", "move", "offhand", "confirm", "finish", "cancel", "busy" },
    Native = { "snapshot", "equip", "blocked", "stats", "useItem" },
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
    Target = { "quiet" },
  },
}
return Supplies

-- [[ mcpballistics ]]
--!native
--!optimize 2
local Ballistics = {}
local units
local STEP = 0.05
function Ballistics.setup(deps)
  units = deps.Units
  return true
end
-- Exact sums for move -> drag -> gravity, including the fractional final tick.
local function coefficients(time, drag)
  local n = math.floor(time / STEP)
  local fraction = time - n * STEP
  if math.abs(1 - drag) < 1e-7 then
    return n * STEP + fraction, STEP * STEP * n * (n - 1) / 2 + fraction * STEP * n
  end
  local power = drag ^ n
  local sum = (1 - power) / (1 - drag)
  return STEP * sum + fraction * power, STEP / (1 - drag) * (STEP * (n - sum) + fraction * (1 - power))
end
local function safeFloor(hit, destination, params)
  if hit.Normal.Y < 0.65 or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or (units.toBlocks(hit.Position) - destination).Magnitude > 15 / 32 then
    return false
  end
  local block = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
  if block == "lava" or block == "water" then
    return false
  end
  local feet = units.toBlocks(hit.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 3 / 64, 0)
  for _, offset in ipairs({ Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(13 / 64, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-13 / 64, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 13 / 64), Vector3.new(0, 0, -13 / 64) }) do
    if workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(feet + offset), units.offset(0, 2, 0), params) then
      return false
    end
    local floor = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(feet + offset), units.offset(0, -0.25, 0), params)
    if not floor or floor.Normal.Y < 0.65 or floor.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
      return false
    end
    local key = floor.Instance:GetAttribute("BlockKey")
    if key == "lava" or key == "water" then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
local function clear(origin, velocity, gravity, drag, duration, destination, params)
  local position = origin
  for _ = 1, math.ceil((duration + STEP) / STEP) do
    local offset = velocity * STEP
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(units.toWorld(position), units.toWorld(offset), params)
    if hit then
      return safeFloor(hit, destination, params)
    end
    position += offset
    velocity = velocity * drag - Vector3.new(0, gravity * STEP, 0)
  end
  return false
end
-- Positions are blocks; speed is blocks/s and gravity is blocks/s^2.
function Ballistics.solve(origin, destination, speed, gravity, params, maxFlight, drag)
  drag, maxFlight = drag or 0.99, maxFlight or 6
  if speed <= 0 or gravity <= 0 or drag <= 0 or drag > 1 or maxFlight <= STEP then
    return nil
  end
  local delta = destination - origin
  local function required(time)
    local travel, drop = coefficients(time, drag)
    local velocity = (delta + Vector3.new(0, gravity * drop, 0)) / travel
    return velocity:Dot(velocity) - speed * speed, velocity
  end
  local low, lowError = 0.001, required(0.001)
  for tick = 1, math.ceil(maxFlight / STEP) do
    local high = math.min(tick * STEP, maxFlight)
    local highError = required(high)
    if lowError * highError <= 0 then
      local left, right, error = low, high, lowError
      for _ = 1, 20 do
        local mid = (left + right) * 0.5
        local value = required(mid)
        if error * value <= 0 then
          right = mid
        else
          left, error = mid, value
        end
      end
      local duration = (left + right) * 0.5
      local _, velocity = required(duration)
      local direction = velocity.Unit
      if clear(origin, direction * speed, gravity, drag, duration, destination, params) then
        return direction, duration
      end
    end
    low, lowError = high, highError
  end
  return nil
end
Ballistics.__contract =
  { provides = { "setup", "solve" }, requires = { Units = "mcpunits" }, requiresMethods = { Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset" } } }
return Ballistics

-- [[ mcpbridge ]]
--!optimize 2
local Bridge = {}
local utils, scripts, nextScan = nil, nil, 0
local found = {}
local wanted = {
  VoxelCombatClient = { performAttack = "attack" },
  ItemClient = { use = "use" },
  VoxelPackHUD = { selectSlot = "select", refreshTools = "refresh", setOpen = "open" },
}
function Bridge.setup(deps)
  utils = deps.Utils
  return true
end
function Bridge.get(key)
  local current = utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
  if scripts ~= current then
    scripts, found, nextScan = current, {}, 0
  end
  local entry = found[key]
  if entry and entry.source.Parent == scripts then
    return entry.fn
  end
  if os.clock() < nextScan then
    return nil
  end
  nextScan = os.clock() + 5
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  if not scripts or type(env.getgc) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  local ok, objects = pcall(env.getgc, false)
  if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then
    return nil
  end
  for _, fn in pairs(objects) do
    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
      continue
    end
    local got, scope = pcall(getfenv, fn)
    local source = got and scope and scope.script
    if typeof(source) ~= "Instance" or source.Parent ~= scripts then
      continue
    end
    local names = wanted[source.Name]
    if not names then
      continue
    end
    local named, name = pcall(debug.info, fn, "n")
    if named and names[name] then
      local key = names[name]
      local existing = found[key]
      -- Keep live call sites stable: executor hooks can expose an unhooked clone to getgc.
      if not existing or existing.source.Parent ~= scripts then
        found[key] = { fn = fn, source = source }
      end
    end
  end
  entry = found[key]
  return entry and entry.fn
end
function Bridge.upvalues(fn)
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  local getter = env.getupvalues or (env.debug and env.debug.getupvalues)
  if not fn or type(getter) ~= "function" then
    return nil
  end
  local ok, values = pcall(getter, fn)
  return ok and type(values) == "table" and values or nil
end
function Bridge.teardown()
  found, scripts, nextScan = {}, nil, 0
end
Bridge.__contract =
  { provides = { "setup", "get", "upvalues", "teardown" }, requires = { Utils = "utils" }, requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer" } } }
return Bridge

-- [[ mcpinventory ]]
--!optimize 2
local Inventory = {}
local utils, bridge
local refresh, slots, hud, panel, session, offhand
local transitionAt = 0
local DELAY = 0.4
local function owned(tool)
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  return typeof(tool) == "Instance"
    and tool:IsA("Tool")
    and tool.Parent ~= nil
    and (tool.Parent == player.Character or tool.Parent == player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
end
local function available(tool) return owned(tool) and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1) > 0 end
function Inventory.setup(deps)
  utils, bridge = deps.Utils, deps.Bridge
  return true
end
function Inventory.visible()
  local gui = utils.getLocalPlayer():FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  local current = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("VoxelPackHUD")
  if current ~= hud or not panel or not panel:IsDescendantOf(current) then
    hud, panel = current, current and current:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true)
  end
  if not panel or not panel:IsA("GuiObject") then
    return false
  end
  local ancestor = panel
  while ancestor and ancestor ~= gui do
    if ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") and not ancestor.Visible or ancestor:IsA("ScreenGui") and not ancestor.Enabled then
      return false
    end
    ancestor = ancestor.Parent
  end
  return ancestor == gui
end
function Inventory.slots()
  local fn = bridge.get("refresh")
  if fn ~= refresh then
    refresh, slots = fn, nil
  end
  if slots then
    return slots
  end
  local values = bridge.upvalues(refresh)
  if not values then
    return nil
  end
  local found
  for _, value in pairs(values) do
    if type(value) ~= "table" or getmetatable(value) ~= nil then
      continue
    end
    local valid, count = true, 0
    for index, tool in pairs(value) do
      if type(index) ~= "number" or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > 36 or typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
        valid = false
        break
      end
      count += 1
    end
    if valid and count > 0 then
      if found then
        return nil
      end
      found = value
    end

end
function Inventory.begin(actor, snap)
  if session then
    return session.actor == actor and not session.cancelled
  end
  if not bridge.get("open") or not Inventory.slots() then
    return false
  end

  if
    not visible
    and (
      snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen")
      or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple")
      or snap.character:GetAttribute("DrinkingPotion")
      or snap.character:GetAttribute("BowDrawStarted")
      or snap.player:GetAttribute("OffhandUsing")
    )

    return false
  end
  session = { actor = actor, character = snap.character, owned = not visible, at = snap.now, actionAt = snap.now }
  return true
end
function Inventory.ready(actor, snap, urgent)
  local current = session
  if not current or current.actor ~= actor or current.character ~= snap.character or current.cancelled or current.closing then
    return false
  end
  if not current.opened then
    if snap.now < transitionAt then
      return false
    end
    current.opened = true
    if current.owned then
      transitionAt = snap.now + DELAY
      local fn = bridge.get("open")
      if not fn or not pcall(fn, true) then
        current.cancelled = true
        return false
      end
    end
  end
  if not Inventory.visible() or snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") ~= true then
    current.visibleAt = nil
    return false
  end
  current.visibleAt = current.visibleAt or snap.now
  return urgent or snap.now - current.visibleAt >= DELAY
end
local function ticket(actor, snap, kind)
  if not Inventory.ready(actor, snap, actor == "totem") then
    return nil
  end
  if session.pending and not Inventory.confirm(session.pending, snap) then
    return nil
  end
  local operation = { kind = kind, character = snap.character, at = snap.now, urgent = actor == "totem" }
  session.pending, session.actionAt = operation, snap.now
  return operation
end
function Inventory.move(actor, snap, tool, from, destination, swap)
  local values = Inventory.slots()
  if
    not values
    or type(from) ~= "number"
    or type(destination) ~= "number"
    or from < 10
    or from > 36
    or destination < 1
    or destination > 9
    or values[from] ~= tool
    or not available(tool)
  then
    return nil
  end
  local previous = values[destination]
  if available(previous) and not (swap == "totem" or swap == true and previous:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == "SpeedPotion") then
    return nil
  end
  local operation = ticket(actor, snap, "move")
  if not operation then
    return nil
  end
  operation.tool, operation.from, operation.destination = tool, from, destination
  values[from], values[destination] = swap and previous or nil, tool
  operation.done = pcall(refresh)
  if not operation.done then
    values[from], values[destination] = tool, previous
    session.cancelled = true
  end
  return operation
end
function Inventory.offhand(actor, snap, tool, immediate)
  if offhand and not offhand.confirmed then
    if not offhand.done or offhand.accepted and offhand.character == snap.character then
      return nil
    end
    offhand = nil
  end
  local values = Inventory.slots()
  if not values or not available(tool) or tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") ~= "Totem" then
    return nil
  end
  local from
  for slot = 1, 36 do
    if values[slot] == tool then
      from = slot
      break
    end
  end
  if not from or immediate and from > 9 and not Inventory.visible() then
    return nil
  end
  local remoteFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local remote = remoteFolder and remoteFolder:FindFirstChild("InventoryAction")
  if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
    return nil
  end
  local previous = session and session.pending
  local operation = immediate and { kind = "offhand", character = snap.character, at = snap.now, urgent = true } or ticket(actor, snap, "offhand")
  if not operation then
    return nil
  end
  operation.tool, operation.from, operation.count = tool, from, tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 1
  operation.popAt = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt")
  if previous and previous.kind == "move" and previous.tool == tool then
    previous.usedBy = operation
  end
  offhand = operation
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok, result = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, "EquipOffhand", tool)
    operation.done, operation.accepted = true, ok and result ~= nil and result ~= false
    if not operation.accepted or utils.getLocalPlayer().Character ~= operation.character then
      return
    end
    if values[from] == tool and not tool.Parent then
      values[from] = nil
    end
    if typeof(result) == "Instance" and not values[from] then
      for index, other in pairs(values) do
        if other == result then
          values[index] = nil
        end
      end
      values[from] = result
    end
    if refresh then
      pcall(refresh)
    end
  end)
  return operation
end
function Inventory.confirm(operation, snap)
  if not operation or operation.character ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  if operation.confirmed then
    return true
  end
  local valid
  if operation.kind == "move" then
    local values = Inventory.slots()
    valid = operation.done
      and values
      and values[operation.destination] == operation.tool
      and values[operation.from] ~= operation.tool
      and available(operation.tool)
    if not valid and operation.usedBy then
      valid = Inventory.confirm(operation.usedBy, snap)
    end
  else
    local consumed = not owned(operation.tool) or (tonumber(operation.tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or operation.count) < operation.count
    local popped = snap.character:GetAttribute("TotemPoppedAt")
    valid = operation.done
      and operation.accepted
      and consumed
      and (snap.character:GetAttribute("OffhandItem") == "totem" or popped ~= nil and popped ~= operation.popAt)
  end
  if not valid then
    operation.stableAt = nil
    return false
  end
  operation.stableAt = operation.stableAt or snap.now
  operation.confirmed = operation.urgent or snap.now - operation.stableAt >= DELAY
  return operation.confirmed
end
function Inventory.finish(actor, snap)
  if not session then
    return true
  end
  local current = session
  if current.actor ~= actor or current.cancelled then
    return false
  end
  if current.pending and not Inventory.confirm(current.pending, snap) then
    return false
  end
  if snap.now < math.max(transitionAt, current.actionAt + DELAY) then
    return false
  end
  if current.owned and Inventory.visible() then
    if not current.closing then
      current.closing, transitionAt = true, snap.now + DELAY
      local fn = bridge.get("open")
      if not fn or not pcall(fn, false) then
        current.cancelled = true
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  if current.owned and snap.player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") then
    return false
  end
  session = nil
  return true
end
function Inventory.cancel(actor)
  if session and (not actor or actor == session.actor) then
    session.cancelled = true
  end
end
function Inventory.step()
  local current = session
  if not current then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - current.at > 5 and not current.cancelled then
    current.cancelled = true
    utils.recordError("mcpvp.inventory", "Operação sem confirmação; sessão cancelada sem repetir a ação pendente.")
  end
  if not current.cancelled or now < math.max(transitionAt, current.actionAt + DELAY) then
    return
  end
  if current.owned and Inventory.visible() then
    local fn = bridge.get("open")
    if fn then
      pcall(fn, false)
    end
    transitionAt = now + DELAY
  end
  session = nil
end
function Inventory.busy() return session ~= nil end
function Inventory.teardown()
  Inventory.cancel()
  local current = session
  Inventory.step()
  if current and session == current then
    task.delay(math.max(0, math.max(transitionAt, current.actionAt + DELAY) - os.clock()), function()
      if session == current then
        Inventory.step()
      end
    end)
  end
end
Inventory.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "visible", "slots", "begin", "ready", "move", "offhand", "confirm", "finish", "cancel", "step", "busy", "teardown" },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Bridge = "mcpbridge" },
  requiresMethods = { Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" }, Bridge = { "get", "upvalues" } },
}
return Inventory

-- [[ mcpnative ]]
--!optimize 2
local Native = {}
local player, world, storage, weapons, geometry, config, controller, utils, units
local shields
local bridge, charge, dispatching, criticalAt = nil, nil, false, 0
local gate, hookedAttack, originalAttack, hooker
local sprintOwner, resumeSprint
local observedCharacter, observedTool
local equippedAt, attackAt, attemptAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
local function load(name)
  local source = storage:FindFirstChild(name)
  if not source then
    return nil
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(require, source)
  return ok and type(result) == "table" and result or nil
end
local function owned(tool)
  return typeof(tool) == "Instance"
    and tool:IsA("Tool")
    and tool.Parent ~= nil
    and (tool.Parent == player.Character or tool.Parent == player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
end
function Native.setup(deps)
  utils, bridge, units = deps.Utils, deps.Bridge, deps.Units
  player, world = utils.getLocalPlayer(), utils.getWorkspace()
  storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
  weapons, geometry, config, controller = load("VoxelWeapons"), load("VoxelMeleeGeometry"), load("GameConfig"), load("ControllerInput")
  charge, shields = load("HeldItemFov"), load("ShieldRules")
  dispatching, criticalAt = false, 0
  observedCharacter, observedTool = nil, nil
  equippedAt, attackAt, attemptAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
  return true
end
function Native.isDispatching() return dispatching end
function Native.snapshot()
  local char = player.Character
  local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local camera = world.CurrentCamera
  if not root or not human or human.Health <= 0 or not camera or player:GetAttribute("InArena") == false or player:GetAttribute("ArenaProtected") == true then
    return nil
  end
  local now, tool = os.clock(), char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if observedCharacter ~= char then
    observedCharacter, observedTool = char, tool
    equippedAt, attackAt, attemptAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
  elseif observedTool ~= tool then
    observedTool, equippedAt = tool, now
  end
  local sneaking = char:GetAttribute("Sneaking") == true
  local eye = geometry and geometry.Eye(root.Position, sneaking) or root.Position + units.offset(0, sneaking and 0.02 or 0.37, 0)
  return {
    player = player,
    character = char,
    root = root,
    humanoid = human,
    camera = camera,
    eye = eye,
    tool = tool,
    now = now,
  }
end
function Native.stats(tool)
  local stats = weapons and type(weapons.Stats) == "function" and weapons.Stats(tool)
  if not stats then
    return { type = tool and tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType"), speed = 1.6, reachBlocks = 3 }
  end
  return {
    type = stats.type,
    speed = stats.speed,
    damage = stats.damage,
    reachBlocks = tonumber(stats.reachBlocks) or units.toBlocks(stats.reach or units.toWorld(3)),
  }
end
local function find(snap, predicate)
  for _, parent in pairs({ snap.character, player:FindFirstChild("Backpack") }) do
    if not parent then
      continue
    end
    for _, tool in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
      if tool:IsA("Tool") and predicate(tool) then
        return tool
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.findSword(snap)
  if owned(snap.tool) and Native.stats(snap.tool).type == "sword" then
    return snap.tool
  end
  return find(snap, function(tool) return Native.stats(tool).type == "sword" end)
end
function Native.findPearl(snap)
  return find(snap, function(tool) return tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem") == "Pearl" and (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("Count")) or 0) > 0 end)
end
function Native.visible(snap, point, target, origin)
  origin = origin or snap.eye
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  params.RespectCanCollide = true
  params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  local hit = world:Raycast(origin, point - origin, params)
  return not hit or (target ~= nil and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target))
end
function Native.aimDirection(snap)
  local aim = snap.player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection")
  return typeof(aim) == "Vector3" and aim.Magnitude > 0.001 and aim.Unit or snap.camera.CFrame.LookVector
end
function Native.hitDistanceBlocks(snap, target, tool, direction)
  local delta = units.toBlocks(target.root.Position - snap.eye)
  if delta.Magnitude < 1 / 320 then
    return nil
  end
  direction = direction or delta.Unit
  local reachBlocks = Native.stats(tool).reachBlocks
  if type(reachBlocks) ~= "number" or reachBlocks <= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local distanceBlocks
  if geometry and type(geometry.Hit) == "function" then
    local worldDistance = geometry.Hit(snap.eye, direction, target.root.Position, target.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), units.toWorld(reachBlocks))
    if worldDistance == nil then
      return nil
    end
    distanceBlocks = units.toBlocks(worldDistance)
  else
    distanceBlocks = delta.Magnitude
    if distanceBlocks > reachBlocks or direction:Dot(delta.Unit) < 0.995 then
      return nil
    end
  end
  if not Native.visible(snap, snap.eye + direction * units.toWorld(distanceBlocks), target.character) then
    return nil
  end
  return distanceBlocks
end
function Native.canHit(snap, target, tool, direction) return Native.hitDistanceBlocks(snap, target, tool or snap.tool, direction) ~= nil end
function Native.blocked(snap)
  return (controller and type(controller.IsBlocked) == "function" and controller.IsBlocked())
    or player:GetAttribute("MenuOpen") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("EatingApple") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("DrinkingPotion") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("BowDrawStarted")
    or player:GetAttribute("OffhandUsing") == true
end
local function invoke(action, direction)
  local previous = player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection")
  local previousCF = player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame")
  local snap = Native.snapshot()
  if not snap or dispatching or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return false
  end
  direction = direction.Unit
  local aimCF = CFrame.lookAt(snap.eye, snap.eye + direction)
  dispatching = true
  player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", direction)
  player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", aimCF)
  local ok, result = pcall(function()
    local fn = bridge.get(action == "Attack" and "attack" or "use")
    if fn then
      return fn(direction) ~= false
    end
    if controller and type(controller.BeginTouch) == "function" and type(controller.EndTouch) == "function" then
      if not controller.BeginTouch(action) then
        return false
      end
      controller.EndTouch(action)
      return true
    end
    return false
  end)
  if player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection") == direction then
    player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection", previous)
  end
  if player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame") == aimCF then
    player:SetAttribute("FrontCameraAimCFrame", previousCF)
  end
  dispatching = false
  if not ok then
    utils.recordError("mcpvp.native." .. action, tostring(result))
  end
  return ok and result == true
end
local function releaseAttackGate()
  if hookedAttack and originalAttack and hooker then
    local ok, reason = pcall(hooker, hookedAttack, originalAttack)
    if not ok then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.critical.restore", tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  hookedAttack, originalAttack, hooker = nil, nil, nil
end
function Native.setAttackGate(callback)
  gate = callback
  if not callback then
    releaseAttackGate()
    return false
  end
  local fn = bridge.get("attack")
  if fn and fn == hookedAttack then
    return true
  end
  local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
  if not fn or type(env.hookfunction) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  releaseAttackGate()
  local original
  local ok, result = pcall(env.hookfunction, fn, function(direction)
    if dispatching or not gate then
      return original(direction)
    end
    local snap = Native.snapshot()
    if not snap then
      return original(direction)
    end
    local success, allow = pcall(gate, snap, direction)
    if not success then
      utils.recordError("mcpvp.critical.gate", tostring(allow))
      return
    end
    if allow then
      return original(direction)
    end
    return nil
  end)
  if not ok or type(result) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  original = result
  hookedAttack, originalAttack, hooker = fn, original, env.hookfunction
  return true
end
function Native.attackGateReady() return hookedAttack ~= nil and gate ~= nil end
function Native.readyAt(snap, tool)
  local speed = Native.stats(tool).speed
  if type(speed) ~= "number" or speed <= 0 then
    return math.huge
  end
  -- VoxelWeapons.Strength reaches full damage at (elapsed + 0.025) * speed == 1.
  local period = math.max(1 / 15, 1 / speed - 0.025)
  local swing = tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalAttackSwing")) or -math.huge
  local ready = math.max(attackAt + period, attemptAt + 1 / 15, equippedAt + period, swing + period)
  -- The native HUD tracks charge after manual attacks and equipment changes too.
  if tool == snap.tool and charge and type(charge.Charge) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(charge.Charge)
    if ok and type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= 1 then
      return math.max(ready, snap.now + math.max(0, (1 - value) / speed - 0.025))
    end
  end
  return math.max(ready, swing + period)
end
local function intercepted(snap, chosen, direction, distance)
  if not geometry or type(geometry.Hit) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  local function closer(character)
    if not character or character == snap.character or character == chosen.character then
      return false
    end
    local human = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not human or human.Health <= 0 then
      return false
    end
    local hit = geometry.Hit(snap.eye, direction, root.Position, character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), units.toWorld(distance))
    return hit ~= nil and units.toBlocks(hit) <= distance
  end
  for _, other in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
    if closer(other.Character) then
      return true
    end
  end
  local bots = world:FindFirstChild("ArenaPvPBots")
  if bots then
    for _, character in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
      if closer(character) then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  local crystals = world:FindFirstChild("EndCrystals")
  if crystals and type(geometry.Box) == "function" then
    for _, crystal in ipairs(crystals:GetChildren()) do
      local feet = crystal:GetAttribute("CrystalFeet")
      if typeof(feet) ~= "Vector3" then
        continue
      end
      -- performAttack prioritizes crystalPick before the selected melee target.
      local hit = geometry.Box(snap.eye, direction, feet - units.offset(1, 0, 1), feet + units.offset(1, 2, 1), units.toWorld(distance))
      if hit and units.toBlocks(hit) < distance then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
function Native.incomingHit(snap, opponent)
  local tool = opponent.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  local reach = Native.stats(tool).reachBlocks
  if type(reach) ~= "number" or reach <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  local sneaking = opponent.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") == true
  local eye = geometry and geometry.Eye(opponent.root.Position, sneaking) or opponent.root.Position + units.offset(0, sneaking and 0.02 or 0.37, 0)
  local aim = opponent.player:GetAttribute("FrontCameraAimDirection")
  local direction = typeof(aim) == "Vector3" and aim.Magnitude > 0.001 and aim.Unit or opponent.root.CFrame.LookVector
  local distance
  if geometry and type(geometry.Hit) == "function" then
    distance = geometry.Hit(eye, direction, snap.root.Position, snap.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking"), units.toWorld(reach))
    if distance == nil then
      return false
    end
  else
    local delta = snap.root.Position - eye
    if units.toBlocks(delta).Magnitude > reach or delta.Magnitude < 0.001 or direction:Dot(delta.Unit) < 0.995 then
      return false
    end
    distance = delta.Magnitude
  end
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.IgnoreWater = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, true
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { opponent.character, snap.camera }
  local hit = world:Raycast(eye, direction * distance, params)
  return not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(snap.character)
end
function Native.shieldRear(character, root)
  local now = world:GetServerTimeNow()
  local blocking
  if shields and type(shields.IsBlocking) == "function" then
    blocking = shields.IsBlocking(character, now)
  else
    local raised = tonumber(character:GetAttribute("ShieldRaisedAt"))
    blocking = raised ~= nil and now - raised >= 0.25 and (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("ShieldDisabledUntil")) or 0) <= now
  end
  if not blocking then
    return nil
  end
  local facing = root.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  return facing.Magnitude > 0.001 and -facing.Unit or nil
end
function Native.shieldBlocks(snap, chosen)
  if shields and type(shields.Blocks) == "function" then
    return shields.Blocks(chosen.character, snap.eye, world:GetServerTimeNow())
  end
  local rear = Native.shieldRear(chosen.character, chosen.root)
  if not rear then
    return false
  end
  local towardUs = (snap.eye - chosen.root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  return towardUs.Magnitude > 0.001 and towardUs.Unit:Dot(rear) < 0
end
function Native.aimPoint(character, root)
  local rear = Native.shieldRear(character, root)
  local height = character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") == true and 3 / 64 or 5 / 32
  return root.Position + units.offset(0, height, 0) + (rear and rear * units.toWorld(0.25) or Vector3.zero)
end
function Native.attackDirection(snap, chosen, tool)
  if not chosen.character.Parent or not chosen.root.Parent or chosen.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local function valid(direction)
    local distance = Native.hitDistanceBlocks(snap, chosen, tool, direction)
    return distance and not intercepted(snap, chosen, direction, distance)
  end
  local rear = Native.shieldRear(chosen.character, chosen.root)
  if rear then
    local delta = Native.aimPoint(chosen.character, chosen.root) - snap.eye
    if units.toBlocks(delta).Magnitude > 1 / 3200 and valid(delta.Unit) then
      return delta.Unit
    end
  end
  local aim = Native.aimDirection(snap)
  if valid(aim) then
    return aim
  end
  local root = chosen.root.Position
  local crouch = chosen.character:GetAttribute("Sneaking") == true and 0.3 or 0
  local relative = units.toBlocks(snap.eye - root)
  -- Use current body/head boxes from VoxelMeleeGeometry, with points inside their margins.
  local nearest = Vector3.new(math.clamp(relative.X, -3 / 8, 3 / 8), math.clamp(relative.Y, -21 / 16, 3 / 16 - crouch), math.clamp(relative.Z, -3 / 8, 3 / 8))
  local head =
    Vector3.new(math.clamp(relative.X, -3 / 8, 3 / 8), math.clamp(relative.Y, 1 / 4 - crouch, 25 / 32 - crouch), math.clamp(relative.Z, -3 / 8, 3 / 8))
  for _, offset in ipairs({ nearest, head, Vector3.new(0, 3 / 32 - crouch, 0), Vector3.new(0, 15 / 32 - crouch, 0) }) do
    local delta = units.toBlocks(root - snap.eye) + offset
    if delta.Magnitude > 1 / 3200 and valid(delta.Unit) then
      return delta.Unit
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function Native.attack(snap, target, direction)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or not snap.tool or Native.stats(snap.tool).type ~= "sword" or snap.now + 1e-6 < Native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool) then
    return false
  end
  direction = direction or Native.attackDirection(snap, target, snap.tool)
  if not direction then
    return false
  end
  attemptAt = snap.now
  local sent = invoke("Attack", direction)
  if sent then
    attackAt = os.clock()
  end
  return sent
end
function Native.replayAttack(snap, direction)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or snap.now + 1e-6 < Native.readyAt(snap, snap.tool) then
    return false
  end
  attemptAt = snap.now
  local sent = invoke("Attack", direction or Native.aimDirection(snap))
  if sent then
    attackAt = os.clock()
  end
  return sent
end
function Native.pearlCooldown() return config and config.Items and config.Items.Pearl and config.Items.Pearl.cooldown or 1 end
function Native.pearlReady() return (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_Pearl")) or 0) <= world:GetServerTimeNow() end
function Native.usePearl(snap, tool, direction)
  if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
    return false
  end
  if Native.blocked(snap) or not owned(tool) or tool.Parent ~= snap.character or not Native.pearlReady() then
    return false
  end
  return invoke("Use", direction)
end
function Native.equip(snap, tool)
  if not owned(tool) then
    return false
  end
  if tool.Parent == snap.character then
    return true
  end
  local select = bridge.get("select")
  if select then
    local values = bridge.upvalues(select)
    if values then
      for _, value in pairs(values) do
        if type(value) ~= "table" then
          continue
        end
        for slot = 1, 9 do
          if rawget(value, slot) == tool then
            local ok, result = pcall(select, slot)
            return ok and result ~= false
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  -- Same equip operation as selectSlot; no repeated selection when already held.
  snap.humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
  return true
end
function Native.crystalJumpRisk(snap)
  local folder = world:FindFirstChild("EndCrystals")
  local crystals = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("EndCrystal")
  if folder then
    for _, crystal in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
      crystals[#crystals + 1] = crystal
    end
  end
  if #crystals == 0 then
    return false
  end
  local seen, params = {}, RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
  local ignored = { snap.character, snap.camera }
  for _, crystal in ipairs(crystals) do
    ignored[#ignored + 1] = crystal
  end
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
  local motion = units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
  -- Native movement in blocks: 8.4 blocks/s jump, 0.05 s ticks, then (vy - 1.6) * 0.98.
  local trajectory, height, vertical = {}, 0, 8.4
  for tick = 1, 20 do
    height += vertical * 0.05
    if height < 0 then
      break
    end
    trajectory[#trajectory + 1] = units.toBlocks(snap.root.Position) - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0) + motion * (tick * 0.05) + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
    vertical = (vertical - 1.6) * 0.98
  end
  for _, crystal in ipairs(crystals) do
    if seen[crystal] or not crystal.Parent then
      continue
    end
    seen[crystal] = true
    local origin = crystal:GetAttribute("CrystalFeet")
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
      continue
    end
    origin = units.toBlocks(origin)
    for _, feet in ipairs(trajectory) do
      -- Narrow client estimate: feet at/above the crystal in its immediate one-block space,
      -- with full body exposure. The server's exact damage formula is not replicated.
      if feet.Y < origin.Y or (feet - origin).Magnitude > 1 then
        continue
      end
      local exposed = true
      for _, heightOffset in ipairs({ 3 / 64, 1, 31 / 16 }) do
        for _, side in ipairs({
          Vector3.zero,
          Vector3.new(-9 / 32, 0, -9 / 32),
          Vector3.new(-9 / 32, 0, 9 / 32),
          Vector3.new(9 / 32, 0, -9 / 32),
          Vector3.new(9 / 32, 0, 9 / 32),
        }) do
          local from = origin + Vector3.new(0, 1 / 64, 0)
          local destination = feet + side + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
          if world:Raycast(units.toWorld(from), units.toWorld(destination - from), params) then
            exposed = false
            break
          end
        end
        if not exposed then
          break
        end
      end
      if exposed then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
function Native.requestJump(snap)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or snap.humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  snap.humanoid.Jump = true
  -- The game's VoxelAirMovement listens to the native Jumping state as well as Jump.
  snap.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
  return true
end
function Native.prepareCritical(force)
  local character = player.Character
  if not character then
    return
  end
  if sprintOwner ~= character then
    sprintOwner, resumeSprint = character, false
  end
  if character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true or character:GetAttribute("SprintRequested") == true then
    resumeSprint = true
  end
  if not force and os.clock() < criticalAt then
    return
  end
  criticalAt = os.clock() + 0.1
  local combat = storage:FindFirstChild("VoxelCombat")
  local sprint = combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Sprint")
  if sprint and sprint:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    sprint:FireServer(false)
  end
end
function Native.finishCritical()
  local character, shouldResume = sprintOwner, resumeSprint
  sprintOwner, resumeSprint = nil, false
  if not character or character ~= player.Character or not shouldResume or player:GetAttribute("SprintToggleEnabled") ~= true then
    return
  end
  local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return
  end
  local snap = Native.snapshot()
  if not snap or Native.blocked(snap) then
    return
  end
  local forward
  if controller and type(controller.ForwardHeld) == "function" then
    forward = controller.ForwardHeld()
  else
    forward = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
  end
  if not forward then
    return
  end
  local combat = storage:FindFirstChild("VoxelCombat")
  local sprint = combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Sprint")
  if sprint and sprint:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    sprint:FireServer(true)
  end
end
function Native.criticalReady(snap)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or snap.humanoid.Sit or snap.humanoid.PlatformStand then
    return false
  end
  local ground = snap.character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded")
  if ground == true or ground == nil and snap.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
    return false
  end
  local fall = units.toBlocks(tonumber(snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalFallDistance")) or 0)
  -- performAttack sends LocalFallDistance as the native fall metadata. Velocity alone is insufficient.
  if fall <= 0 or units.toBlocks(snap.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) >= -1 / 32 then
    return false
  end
  if snap.character:GetAttribute("Sprinting") == true or snap.character:GetAttribute("SprintRequested") == true then
    return false
  end
  if
    snap.character:GetAttribute("LocalInWater") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("InLava") == true
    or snap.player:GetAttribute("LocalGliding") == true
    or snap.character:GetAttribute("Gliding") == true
  then
    return false
  end
  local state = snap.humanoid:GetState()
  return state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
end
function Native.teardown()
  gate = nil
  releaseAttackGate()
  Native.finishCritical()
end
function Native.useItem(snap, tool, direction)
  if Native.blocked(snap) or not owned(tool) or tool.Parent ~= snap.character then
    return false
  end
  local class = tool:GetAttribute("ClassItem")
  if type(class) ~= "string" then
    return false
  end
  if (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("ItemCooldown_" .. class)) or 0) > world:GetServerTimeNow() then
    return false
  end
  return invoke("Use", direction)
end
local recentMaces = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function Native.aerialMace(snap, target)
  if not target or not target.character.Parent or not target.root.Parent then
    return false
  end
  local tool = target.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  local stats = Native.stats(tool)
  local now = os.clock()
  if stats.type == "mace" then
    recentMaces[target.character] = now + 1
  end
  if (recentMaces[target.character] or 0) < now then
    return false
  end
  local grounded = target.character:GetAttribute("VoxelGrounded")
  if grounded == true then
    return false
  end
  if grounded == nil and target.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
    return false
  end
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  params.RespectCanCollide = true
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { snap.character, target.character, snap.camera }
  -- A normal jump rises about 1.25 blocks; aerial mace detection needs more clearance.
  local support = world:Raycast(target.root.Position, units.offset(0, -3.75, 0), params)
  local above = units.toBlocks(target.root.Position.Y - snap.root.Position.Y)
  local fall = units.toBlocks(tonumber(target.character:GetAttribute("LocalFallDistance")) or 0)
  return not support or above > 2.5 or fall > 2.5
end
Native.__contract = {
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "snapshot",
    "stats",
    "visible",
    "canHit",
    "aimDirection",
    "hitDistanceBlocks",
    "incomingHit",
    "attack",
    "readyAt",
    "attackDirection",
    "shieldRear",
    "shieldBlocks",
    "aimPoint",
    "findSword",
    "findPearl",
    "pearlCooldown",
    "pearlReady",
    "usePearl",
    "equip",
    "blocked",
    "isDispatching",
    "prepareCritical",
    "finishCritical",
    "criticalReady",
    "setAttackGate",
    "attackGateReady",
    "replayAttack",
    "teardown",
    "requestJump",
    "crystalJumpRisk",
    "useItem",
    "aerialMace",
  },
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Bridge = "mcpbridge", Units = "mcpunits" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Units = { "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset" },
    Bridge = { "get", "upvalues" },
    Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "getWorkspace", "recordError" },
  },
}
return Native

-- [[ mcptarget ]]
--!optimize 2
local Target = {}
local native, tuning, players, units
local owner, health, session, attempt
local serial = 0
local swings = {}
local SWITCH_WINDOW = 0.35
local clickAt, hurtAt, hitAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
function Target.setup(deps)
  native, tuning, players, units = deps.Native, deps.Options.tuning, game:GetService("Players"), deps.Units
  return true
end
local function finish()
  session, attempt, swings = nil, nil, {}
  serial += 1
end
function Target.reset()
  finish()
  owner, health = nil, nil
  clickAt, hurtAt, hitAt = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
end
local function candidate(player, snap, rangeBlocks)
  if
    not player
    or player == snap.player
    or player.Parent ~= players
    or player:GetAttribute("ArenaProtected") == true
    or player:GetAttribute("InArena") == false
  then
    return nil
  end
  local char = player.Character
  local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not root or not root.Parent or not human or human.Health <= 0 or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
    return nil
  end
  local distance = units.distance(root.Position, snap.root.Position)
  if distance > rangeBlocks then
    return nil
  end
  return { player = player, character = char, root = root, humanoid = human, distanceBlocks = distance }
end
local function active(snap)
  if not session then
    return nil
  end
  if owner ~= snap.character or snap.now - session.at > tuning.pursuitSeconds then
    finish()
    return nil
  end
  local chosen = candidate(session.player, snap, tuning.pearlRangeBlocks)
  if not chosen or chosen.character ~= session.character then
    finish()
    return nil
  end
  chosen.sessionId = session.id
  return chosen
end
local function select(snap, chosen)
  finish()
  session = { id = serial, player = chosen.player, character = chosen.character, at = snap.now, startedAt = snap.now, switchedAt = snap.now }
  chosen.sessionId = session.id
end
function Target.noteSwing(source)
  if not session or typeof(source) ~= "Instance" then
    return
  end
  if source:IsA("Player") then
    source = source.Character
  end
  if not source or not source:IsA("Model") or source == owner or not players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(source) then
    return
  end
  swings[source] = { at = os.clock(), sessionId = session.id }
end
local function considerSwitch(snap, current)
  if not session or not session.damageAt or snap.now - session.damageAt > SWITCH_WINDOW or snap.now - session.switchedAt < SWITCH_WINDOW then
    return
  end
  local chosen, distance
  local currentClose = native.canHit(snap, current)
  for character, swing in pairs(swings) do
    if swing.sessionId ~= session.id or not character.Parent or snap.now - swing.at > SWITCH_WINDOW then
      swings[character] = nil
      continue
    end
    if character == session.character or swing.at < session.startedAt or math.abs(swing.at - session.damageAt) > SWITCH_WINDOW then
      continue
    end
    local other = candidate(players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character), snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
    if not other or other.character ~= character or not native.canHit(snap, other) or not native.incomingHit(snap, other) then
      continue
    end
    if currentClose and other.distanceBlocks + 0.25 >= current.distanceBlocks then
      continue
    end
    if not distance or other.distanceBlocks < distance then
      chosen, distance = other, other.distanceBlocks
    end
  end
  if chosen then
    select(snap, chosen)
  end
end
function Target.observe(snap)
  if owner ~= snap.character then
    Target.reset()
    owner = snap.character
  end
  -- Validate/end the old fight BEFORE considering any incoming swing.
  local current = active(snap)
  if health and snap.humanoid.Health < health then
    hurtAt = snap.now
    if session then
      session.damageAt = snap.now
    end
  end
  health = snap.humanoid.Health
  for character, swing in pairs(swings) do
    if not session or swing.sessionId ~= session.id or not character.Parent or snap.now - swing.at > SWITCH_WINDOW then
      swings[character] = nil
    end
  end
  if current then
    considerSwitch(snap, current)
  end
  if attempt and snap.now - attempt.at > 0.7 then
    attempt = nil
  end
end
function Target.isCurrent(snap, chosen)
  local current = active(snap)
  return current ~= nil and chosen ~= nil and chosen.sessionId == current.sessionId and chosen.character == current.character
end
function Target.follow(snap, chosen)
  -- Automatic actions may extend this fight, but cannot start or replace one.
  if not Target.isCurrent(snap, chosen) then
    return false
  end
  session.at = snap.now
  return true
end
function Target.noteAttack(snap, chosen)
  if not Target.follow(snap, chosen) then
    return false
  end
  attempt = { at = snap.now, sessionId = session.id }
  return true
end
function Target.confirmHit(now)
  if attempt and session and attempt.sessionId == session.id and now - attempt.at <= 0.7 then
    hitAt, session.at = now, now
  end
  attempt = nil
end
function Target.pick(snap, direction)
  direction = direction or native.aimDirection(snap)
  local best, distance
  for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    local chosen = candidate(player, snap, tuning.focusRangeBlocks)
    local hit = chosen and native.hitDistanceBlocks(snap, chosen, snap.tool, direction)
    if hit and (not distance or hit < distance) then
      best, distance = chosen, hit
    end
  end
  return best
end
function Target.manual(snap, direction)
  Target.observe(snap)
  if native.blocked(snap) then
    return nil
  end
  clickAt = snap.now
  local chosen = Target.pick(snap, direction)
  if not chosen then
    return nil
  end
  if not session or session.character ~= chosen.character then
    select(snap, chosen)
  end
  chosen.sessionId = session.id
  Target.noteAttack(snap, chosen)
  return chosen
end
function Target.get(snap)
  local chosen = active(snap)
  if not chosen or chosen.distanceBlocks > tuning.focusRangeBlocks then
    return nil
  end
  if not native.visible(snap, chosen.root.Position, chosen.character) then
    return nil
  end
  return chosen
end
function Target.getPearl(snap) return active(snap) end
function Target.quiet(snap, duration) return snap.now - math.max(clickAt, hurtAt, hitAt) >= (duration or 4) end
Target.__contract = {
  provides = { "setup", "reset", "observe", "noteSwing", "manual", "pick", "get", "noteAttack", "confirmHit", "follow", "getPearl", "isCurrent", "quiet" },
  requires = { Native = "mcpnative", Options = "mcpoptions", Units = "mcpunits" },
  requiresMethods = { Units = { "distance" }, Native = { "blocked", "aimDirection", "hitDistanceBlocks", "visible", "canHit", "incomingHit" } },
  requiresData = { Options = { "tuning" } },
}
return Target

-- [[ mcpunits ]]
--!optimize 2
local Units = {}
local scale = 3.2
function Units.setup()
  local source = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("VoxelWeapons")
  local ok, weapons = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  local block = ok and type(weapons) == "table" and weapons.Block
  scale = type(block) == "number" and block == block and block > 0 and block < math.huge and block or 3.2
  return true
end
-- Numbers and Vector3s retain fractional blocks; no grid rounding belongs here.
function Units.toBlocks(worldValue) return worldValue / scale end
function Units.toWorld(blockValue) return blockValue * scale end
function Units.offset(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x, y, z) * scale end
function Units.distance(worldA, worldB) return (worldA - worldB).Magnitude / scale end
Units.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "toBlocks", "toWorld", "offset", "distance" }, requires = {} }
return Units
