-- [[ gameruntime ]]
--!optimize 2
local Runtime = {}
local modules, scope, owner
function Runtime.setup() return true end
function Runtime.reset()
  if not modules then
    return
  end
  modules.autopearl.reset()
  modules.mcpmelee.reset()
  modules.mcpsupplies.reset()
  modules.mcptarget.reset()
  modules.mcpaim.reset()
end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if modules then
    modules.mcpnative.setAttackGate(nil)
  end
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  Runtime.reset()
  modules, owner = nil, nil
end
function Runtime.bind(loaded)
  Runtime.teardown()
  modules, scope = loaded, loaded.lifetime.scope()
  local native, target, supplies = loaded.mcpnative, loaded.mcptarget, loaded.mcpsupplies
  local function intercept(snap, direction)
    if owner ~= snap.character then
      Runtime.reset()
      owner = snap.character
    end
    return loaded.mcpmelee.intercept(snap, direction)
  end
  native.setAttackGate(intercept)
  local input, storage, run = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("RunService")
  local source = storage:FindFirstChild("ControllerInput")
  local ok, controller = pcall(function() return source and require(source) end)
  if not ok or type(controller) ~= "table" then
    controller = nil
  end
  local function enabled(key) return loaded.utils.getConfigValue(key) == true end
  local function combatEnabled()
    return enabled("MCAutoSword") or enabled("MCAutoCrit") or enabled("MCAutoPearl") or enabled("MCAimLock") or enabled("MCAimAssist")
  end
  local pearlRecoverAt = 0
  local function guarded(name, fn, ...)
    local success, reason = pcall(fn, ...)
    if not success then
      if name == "aim" then
        loaded.mcpaim.reset()
      elseif name == "critical" then
        loaded.mcpmelee.reset()
      elseif name == "pearl" then
        loaded.autopearl.reset()
        pearlRecoverAt = os.clock() + 0.5
      else
        Runtime.reset()
      end
      loaded.utils.recordError("mcpvp." .. name, tostring(reason))
    end
  end
  scope.connect(controller and controller.InputBegan or input.InputBegan, function(event, processed)
    guarded("input", function()
      if native.isDispatching() or processed or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not loaded.utils.isActive() or not combatEnabled() then
        return
      end
      local matches = controller and type(controller.Matches) == "function" and controller.Matches(event, "Attack")
      if not matches and (controller or event.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        return
      end
      local snap = native.snapshot()
      if snap then
        if owner ~= snap.character then
          Runtime.reset()
          owner = snap.character
        end
        if not native.attackGateReady() then
          loaded.mcpmelee.manual(snap)
        end
        target.manual(snap)
      end
    end)
  end)
  local bound, scanAt = {}, 0
  local function bindRemote(folderName, name, callback)
    local folder = storage:FindFirstChild(folderName)
    local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
    local previous = bound[name]
    if previous and previous.remote ~= remote then
      previous.connection:Disconnect()
      bound[name] = nil
    end
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or bound[name] then
      return
    end
    bound[name] = { remote = remote, connection = scope.connect(remote.OnClientEvent, function(...) guarded(name, callback, ...) end) }
  end
  local function heartbeat()
    loaded.mcpinventory.step()
    if not loaded.utils.isActive() then
      if owner then
        Runtime.reset()
        owner = nil
      end
      return
    end
    local snap = native.snapshot()
    if not snap then
      if owner then
        Runtime.reset()
        owner = nil
      end
      return
    end
    if owner ~= snap.character then
      Runtime.reset()
      owner = snap.character
    end
    if snap.now >= scanAt then
      scanAt = snap.now + 1
      native.setAttackGate(intercept)
      bindRemote("VoxelCombat", "Swing", target.noteSwing)
      bindRemote("VoxelCombat", "Feedback", function(kind, blocked)
        if kind == "HitConfirm" and not blocked then
          target.confirmHit(os.clock())
        end
      end)
      bindRemote("Remotes", "ItemAction", loaded.autopearl.observeProjectile)
    end
    target.observe(snap)
    supplies.observe(snap)
    supplies.step(snap, not loaded.autopearl.busy())
    if supplies.busy() then
      loaded.mcpmelee.reset()
      return
    end
    if not combatEnabled() then
      loaded.autopearl.reset()
      loaded.mcpmelee.reset()
      target.reset()
      return
    end
    snap = native.snapshot()
    if not snap then
      return
    end
    local chosen = target.get(snap)
    if enabled("MCAutoPearl") then
      if snap.now >= pearlRecoverAt then
        guarded("pearl", loaded.autopearl.step, snap, target.getPearl(snap))
      end
    else
      loaded.autopearl.reset()
    end
    if loaded.autopearl.busy() then
      loaded.mcpmelee.reset()
      return
    end
    loaded.mcpmelee.step(snap, chosen)
  end
  scope.connect(run.PreSimulation, function()
    guarded("critical", function() loaded.mcpmelee.preSimulation(loaded.utils.isActive() and native.snapshot() or nil) end)
  end)
  scope.connect(run.PostSimulation, function()
    guarded("critical", function() loaded.mcpmelee.postSimulation(loaded.utils.isActive() and native.snapshot() or nil) end)
  end)
  scope.connect(run.Heartbeat, function() guarded("heartbeat", heartbeat) end)
  local renderScope = scope
  local renderName = "ExodusMCPAim_" .. tostring(renderScope)
  renderScope.add(function() run:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end)
  run:BindToRenderStep(renderName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)

      if snap then
        local nearest = target.get(snap)
        loaded.mcpaim.step(snap, nearest, dt)
      end
    end)
  end)
  return { mode = "mcpvp" }
end
function Runtime.createAPI(loaded)
  return {
    getUIConfig = function() return loaded.gameui.definition end,
    resetState = Runtime.reset,
    updateBlockers = { loaded.autopearl.pending, loaded.mcpsupplies.busy, loaded.mcpinventory.busy },
    migrateConfig = loaded.mcpoptions.migrateConfig,

end
Runtime.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "reset", "teardown", "bind", "createAPI" }, requires = {} }

-- [[ autodark ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local AutoDark = {}
local utils
local remote
local gameInfo
local world
local connection
local configObserver
local epoch = 0

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  ENABLED_KEY = "AutoDark",
}

-- connections
local function disconnect()
  epoch += 1
  if not connection then
    return
  end
  if utils then
    utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
  end
  connection:Disconnect()
  connection = nil
end

-- synchronization
function AutoDark.sync()
  if not utils or not remote or not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue(CONFIG.ENABLED_KEY) ~= true then
    disconnect()
    return true
  end
  if connection and connection.Connected ~= false then
    return true
  end
  disconnect()
  local runService = utils.getRunService()
  if not runService or not runService.Heartbeat then
    return false, "Heartbeat indisponível"
  end
  local owner = epoch
  local lastErrorAt = -math.huge
  connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if owner ~= epoch then
      return
    end
    if not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue(CONFIG.ENABLED_KEY) ~= true then
      disconnect()
      return
    end
    if not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() then
      return
    end
    local camera = world.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
      return
    end
    local ok, reason = pcall(remote.fireDark, gameInfo.getDarkSealEventId(), camera.CFrame)
    if owner ~= epoch then
      return
    end
    if not ok and os.clock() - lastErrorAt >= 1 then
      lastErrorAt = os.clock()
      warn("[AutoDark] " .. tostring(reason))
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(connection)
  return true
end

-- setup
function AutoDark.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.Remote) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes: Utils, GameInfo ou Remote"
  end
  AutoDark.teardown()
  utils, remote, gameInfo = deps.Utils, deps.Remote, deps.GameInfo
  configObserver = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.AutoDark ~= nil then
      AutoDark.sync()
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(configObserver)
  world = utils.getWorkspace()
  return AutoDark.sync()
end
function AutoDark.teardown()
  if configObserver then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(configObserver)
    end
    configObserver:Disconnect()
    configObserver = nil
  end
  disconnect()
  utils, remote, gameInfo, world = nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- contract
AutoDark.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", Remote = "remote", GameInfo = "gameinfo" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue", "getWorkspace", "getRunService", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "isActive", "observeConfig" },
    Remote = { "fireDark" },
    GameInfo = { "getDarkSealEventId", "areAbilitiesEnabled" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "sync", "teardown" },
}

return AutoDark

-- [[ auto dash ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local AutoDash = {}
local deflectGeometry
local utils
local gameInfo
local dash
local movement
local localPlayer
local runService
local root
local heartbeat
local lastTickAt = -math.huge
local inFlight, handledSignals = nil, {}
local exchangePartner = nil
local exchangeTarget = nil
local exchangeChanges = 0
local exchangeAt = nil

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MAX_EXCHANGE_AGE = 1,
  MAX_EVENT_AGE = 0.2,
  MIN_UP_SPEED = 68,
  MAX_HORIZONTAL_RATIO = 0.65,
  TICK_INTERVAL = 1 / 120,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function validVector(value) return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z) end

-- event-filtering
local function clearExchange()
  exchangePartner, exchangeTarget, exchangeChanges, exchangeAt = nil, nil, 0, nil
end
local function clashPartner(packetTarget)
  local time = utils.now()
  local physics = deflectGeometry.getDefensePhysics()
  local context = gameInfo.getClashContext(true)
  local snapshot = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time)
  if
    not physics
    or physics.inClash ~= true
    or not context
    or not gameInfo.isSnapshotValid(snapshot)
    or snapshot.targetUncertain
    or snapshot.teleported
    or snapshot.locked
    or (snapshot.syncAt ~= nil and (not finite(snapshot.syncAt) or time < snapshot.syncAt or time - snapshot.syncAt > 0.5))
  then
    clearExchange()
    return nil
  end
  local partner, target = context.partnerId, packetTarget or snapshot.targetId
  if not finite(partner) or partner <= 0 or partner == localPlayer.UserId or (target ~= localPlayer.UserId and target ~= partner) then
    clearExchange()
    return nil
  end
  if exchangePartner ~= partner or (exchangeAt and (time < exchangeAt or time - exchangeAt > CONFIG.MAX_EXCHANGE_AGE)) then
    clearExchange()
    exchangePartner = partner
  end
  if exchangeTarget ~= target then
    if exchangeTarget ~= nil then
      exchangeChanges = exchangeChanges + 1
    end
    exchangeTarget, exchangeAt = target, time
  end
  if exchangeChanges < 2 then
    return nil
  end
  return partner
end
local function relevantOpponent(event) return clashPartner() == event.userId end

-- event-handling
local function onDash(event)
  local localRoot = root
  if
    not localRoot
    or not localRoot.Parent
    or inFlight
    or not utils.isActive()
    or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true
    or not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled()
  then
    return
  end
  if
    type(event) ~= "table"
    or event.confirmed ~= true
    or not finite(event.signalAt)
    or not finite(event.detectedAt)
    or not validVector(event.position)
    or not validVector(event.velocity)
  then
    return
  end
  local time = utils.now()
  if not finite(event.userId) or event.userId <= 0 then
    return
  end
  if
    time < event.detectedAt
    or time - event.detectedAt > CONFIG.MAX_EVENT_AGE
    or event.userId == localPlayer.UserId
    or handledSignals[event.userId] == event.signalAt
  then
    return
  end
  local player = event.player
  if not player or player.UserId ~= event.userId then
    return
  end
  if event.signalActive ~= true or not gameInfo.isPlayerDashing(player) then
    return
  end
  local character = player.Character
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local localHumanoid = localRoot.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not localHumanoid or localHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return
  end
  local velocity = event.velocity
  local horizontalSpeed = math.sqrt(velocity.X * velocity.X + velocity.Z * velocity.Z)
  if velocity.Y < CONFIG.MIN_UP_SPEED or horizontalSpeed > velocity.Y * CONFIG.MAX_HORIZONTAL_RATIO then
    return
  end
  if not relevantOpponent(event, localRoot) then
    return
  end
  local token = {}
  inFlight = token
  local ok, result = pcall(movement.upDash)
  if inFlight == token then
    inFlight = nil
    if ok and result == true and root == localRoot then
      handledSignals[event.userId] = event.signalAt
    end
  end
  if not ok then
    warn("[AutoDash] " .. tostring(result))
  end
end

-- setup
function AutoDash.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.DeflectGeometry) ~= "table" then
    return false, "DeflectGeometry ausente"
  end
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or not deps.Utils or not deps.GameInfo or not deps.Dash or not deps.Movement then
    return false, "dependências ausentes"
  end
  AutoDash.teardown()
  deflectGeometry = deps.DeflectGeometry
  utils, gameInfo, dash, movement = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.Dash, deps.Movement
  localPlayer, runService = utils.getLocalPlayer(), utils.getRunService()
  if not localPlayer or not runService then
    return false, "serviços indisponíveis"
  end
  dash.setHandler(onDash)
  return true
end

-- character-binding
function AutoDash.bindCharacter(character)
  AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  local newRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not newRoot or not newRoot:IsA("BasePart") or not newRoot.Parent then
    return false, "HumanoidRootPart indisponível"
  end
  root, lastTickAt = newRoot, -math.huge
  heartbeat = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not root or not root.Parent then
      return
    end
    local time = utils.now()
    if time >= lastTickAt and time - lastTickAt < CONFIG.TICK_INTERVAL then
      return
    end
    lastTickAt = time
    if not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true or not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() then
      clearExchange()
      return
    end
    local partner = clashPartner()
    if partner then
      dash.tick(time, true, partner)
    end
  end)
  utils.trackCharacter(heartbeat)
  return true
end
function AutoDash.onBallSync(data)
  if not root or not utils or not utils.isActive() or utils.getConfigValue("AutoClashUpDash") ~= true then
    clearExchange()
    return
  end
  if type(data) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  if data.Teleported then
    clearExchange()
    return
  end
  clashPartner(data.TargetPlayerID)
end
function AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  root, inFlight, lastTickAt = nil, nil, -math.huge
  table.clear(handledSignals)
  clearExchange()
  if heartbeat then
    utils.untrackCharacter(heartbeat)
    heartbeat:Disconnect()
    heartbeat = nil
  end
end
function AutoDash.teardown()
  AutoDash.detachCharacter()
  if dash then
    dash.setHandler(nil)
  end
  utils, gameInfo, dash, movement, localPlayer, runService = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- contract
AutoDash.__contract = {
  requires = {
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    Dash = "dash",
    Movement = "movement",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    DeflectGeometry = { "getDefensePhysics" },
    Utils = {
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "getRunService",
      "getConfigValue",
      "isActive",
      "now",
      "trackCharacter",
      "untrackCharacter",
    },
    GameInfo = {
      "areAbilitiesEnabled",
      "getClashContext",
      "getSnapshotAt",
      "isSnapshotValid",
      "isPlayerDashing",
    },
    Dash = { "setHandler", "tick" },
    Movement = { "upDash" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "bindCharacter", "detachCharacter", "teardown", "onBallSync" },
  bindCharacter = true,
}

return AutoDash

-- [[ autofierce ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local AutoFierce = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local geometry
local cooldown
local remote
local autoParry
local autoSpam
local generation = 0
local pending = false
local lastEpisode, errorAt = 0, -math.huge
local function enabled() return utils and utils.isActive() and utils.getConfigValue("AutoFierce") == true and gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() end
local function fierceReady()
  local ability = gameInfo.getFierceDeflectAbility()
  if
    type(ability) ~= "table"
    or type(ability.ActivateAndBlock) ~= "function"
    or type(ability.Cooldown) ~= "number"
    or ability.Cooldown ~= ability.Cooldown
    or math.abs(ability.Cooldown) == math.huge
    or ability.Cooldown > 0
  then
    return false
  end
  if type(ability.IsOwnerAlive) == "function" and not ability:IsOwnerAlive() then
    return false
  end
  return type(ability.IsAvailable) ~= "function" or ability:IsAvailable(false)
end
local function eligible()
  if not enabled() or not fierceReady() then
    return nil
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  local value = gameInfo.getDefenseSnapshot(now)
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local character = player and player.Character
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if
    not value
    or value.mode == "training"
    or not player
    or value.targetId ~= player.UserId
    or not root
    or not root.Parent
    or not humanoid
    or humanoid.Health <= 0
  then
    return nil
  end
  local t = geometry.getParryTiming(value, root.Position, {
    factor = 0.3,
    ping = gameInfo.getAveragePing(),
    frameLead = 1 / 60,
    rootVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
  })
  if not t or not t.ready or (not t.approaching and t.timeToKill ~= 0) then
    return nil
  end
  local recovery = cooldown.getDeflectRecoveryState(t.timeToKill, 1 / 60)
  if not recovery or not recovery.needsFierce then
    return nil
  end
  local observedCooldown = recovery.cooldown
  if not observedCooldown or observedCooldown.source ~= "local" or observedCooldown.blocking ~= true or observedCooldown.miss ~= true then
    return nil
  end
  local episode = observedCooldown.episode
  if type(episode) ~= "number" or episode <= lastEpisode then
    return nil
  end
  local pressAt, accepted = observedCooldown.pressAt, gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt()
  if type(pressAt) ~= "number" or type(accepted) ~= "number" or math.abs(accepted - pressAt) > 0.01 then
    return nil
  end
  return value, episode, pressAt, observedCooldown.confirmationVersion
end
local function update()
  if pending then
    return
  end
  local value, episode, pressAt, confirmation = eligible()
  if not value then
    return
  end
  local owner, token = generation, nil
  local boundParry = autoParry
  pending = true
  local ok, sent = pcall(remote.fireFierce, function()
    if owner ~= generation then
      return false
    end
    local current, currentEpisode, currentPress, currentConfirmation = eligible()
    if not current or current.ball ~= value.ball or currentEpisode ~= episode or currentPress ~= pressAt or currentConfirmation ~= confirmation then
      return false
    end
    if not token then
      token = boundParry.beginFierce()
      autoSpam.stopSpam("fierce_rescue")
    end
    return true
  end)
  if owner ~= generation then
    return
  end
  pending = false
  if ok and sent == true then
    lastEpisode = episode
  else
    boundParry.cancelFierce(token)
  end
  if not ok and os.clock() - errorAt >= 1 then
    errorAt = os.clock()
    utils.recordError("AutoFierce", tostring(sent))
  end
end
local function safeUpdate()
  local ok, detail = pcall(update)
  if not ok and utils and os.clock() - errorAt >= 1 then
    errorAt = os.clock()
    utils.recordError("AutoFierce", tostring(detail))
  end
end
function AutoFierce.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes"
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({ "Utils", "GameInfo", "DeflectGeometry", "Cooldown", "Remote", "AutoParry", "AutoSpam" }) do
    if type(deps[name]) ~= "table" then
      return false, "dependência ausente: " .. name
    end
  end
  AutoFierce.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, geometry, cooldown, remote, autoParry, autoSpam =
    deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.DeflectGeometry, deps.Cooldown, deps.Remote, deps.AutoParry, deps.AutoSpam
  return true
end
function AutoFierce.onBallSync()
  safeUpdate()
  return true
end
function AutoFierce.teardown()
  generation += 1
  pending, lastEpisode, errorAt = false, 0, -math.huge
  utils, gameInfo, geometry, cooldown, remote, autoParry, autoSpam = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end
AutoFierce.__contract = {
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
    Cooldown = "cooldown",
    Remote = "remote",
    AutoParry = "autoparry",
    AutoSpam = "autospam",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "isActive", "getConfigValue", "getLocalPlayer", "recordError" },
    GameInfo = { "getDefenseSnapshot", "getAveragePing", "areAbilitiesEnabled", "getFierceDeflectAbility", "getLastAcceptedDeflectAt" },
    DeflectGeometry = { "getParryTiming" },
    Cooldown = { "getDeflectRecoveryState", "observeDeflect" },
    Remote = { "fireFierce" },
    AutoParry = { "beginFierce", "cancelFierce" },
    AutoSpam = { "stopSpam" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "onBallSync" },
}

return AutoFierce

-- [[ auto parry: ordered target episodes and native clash cadence ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local AutoParry = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local geometry
local cooldown
local remote
local targeting
local state = { generation = 0, cycle = 0, bound = false, connections = {}, phase = "detached", reason = "initial" }
local evaluating = false
local sending = false
local errorAt = -math.huge
local POLICY =
  { SLOW_WINDOW = 0.5, FAST_WINDOW = 0.3, DEFAULT_FACTOR = 0.45, MAX_FACTOR = 0.85, NATIVE_INTERVAL = 0.008, TRAINING_INTERVAL = 0.03, MAX_SAMPLE_AGE = 0.25 }
local calls, firstCall, lastCall = {}, 1, 0
local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and math.abs(v) < math.huge end
local function vector(v) return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z) end
local function clock() return os.clock() end
local function phase(reason)
  state.phase, state.reason = state.bound and "waiting" or "detached", reason
end
local function track(c)
  state.connections[#state.connections + 1] = c
  utils.trackCharacter(c)
end
local function resetFlight(reason)
  state.cycle += 1
  state.fired, state.shot, state.target, state.known = false, nil, -1, false
  state.timing, state.lastOwnPress, state.returnInterval, state.returnAt = nil, nil, nil, nil
  state.factor, state.factorAt, state.wasSpamActive, state.lastOwnAt = nil, nil, false, nil
  state.episodeAt, state.consumedParry, state.trackerEpoch = clock(), -math.huge, nil
  if state.tracker then
    state.tracker.reset()
  end
  phase(reason)
end
local function live()
  return state.bound
    and state.character.Parent ~= nil
    and state.root.Parent ~= nil
    and state.humanoid.Health > 0
    and utils.isActive()
    and utils.getConfigValue("AutoParry") ~= false
end
local function rate(now, record)
  while firstCall <= lastCall and calls[firstCall] <= now - 1 + 0.000001 do
    calls[firstCall] = nil
    firstCall += 1
  end
  if firstCall > lastCall then
    firstCall, lastCall = 1, 0
  elseif firstCall > 128 then
    local count = lastCall - firstCall + 1
    table.move(calls, firstCall, lastCall, 1)
    for index = count + 1, lastCall do
      calls[index] = nil
    end
    firstCall, lastCall = 1, count
  end
  if record then
    lastCall += 1
    calls[lastCall] = now
  end
  state.cps = lastCall - firstCall + 1
  if record then
    state.maxCps = math.max(state.maxCps or 0, state.cps)
  end
  return state.cps
end
local function observe(value, now)
  local mode = value.mode == "training" and "training" or "match"
  if state.ball ~= value.ball or state.mode ~= mode or (mode == "training" and state.round ~= value.trainingRound) then
    resetFlight("new_ball")
    state.ball, state.mode, state.round = value.ball, mode, value.trainingRound
  end
  local report = value.targetSignals
  if mode == "training" and not report then
    report = {
      serverNow = utils.getWorkspace():GetServerTimeNow(),
      serverTime = value.serverTime,
      receivedAt = value.syncAt,
      signals = { { name = "sync.TargetPlayerID", available = value.targetId >= 0, targeted = value.targeted } },
    }

  end
  state.tracker.observe(report, now, state.visualFrame or 0, gameInfo.getAveragePing())
  local yes, epoch = state.tracker.resolve(now)
  if yes and epoch ~= state.trackerEpoch then
    state.trackerEpoch, state.fired, state.shot = epoch, false, nil
    state.cycle += 1
    if state.lastOwnAt then
      local interval = now - state.lastOwnAt
      state.returnInterval = interval > 0 and interval <= 1.5 and interval or nil
    end
    state.lastOwnAt, state.returnAt, state.episodeAt = now, now, now
  end
  state.known, state.target = yes, yes and state.player.UserId or value.targetId
  return yes
end
local function adaptiveFactor(tti, closing, speed, base, now, ping)
  local pressure = 0
  local interval = state.returnInterval
  local age = state.returnAt and now - state.returnAt
  if finite(interval) and interval > 0 and age and age >= 0 and age <= math.min(1.5, math.max(0.1, interval) * 2) then
    pressure = 1 - math.clamp((interval - 0.1) / 0.8, 0, 1)
  end
  local budget = ping + 1 / 60
  if finite(tti) then
    pressure = math.max(pressure, math.clamp((budget - tti) / math.max(budget, 0.001), 0, 1))
  end
  pressure = math.max(pressure, math.clamp(closing / math.max(speed, 1) - 1, 0, 1))
  local desired = base + (POLICY.MAX_FACTOR - base) * pressure
  if finite(state.factor) and state.factor > desired then
    desired += (state.factor - desired) * math.exp(-math.max(0, now - (state.factorAt or now)) / 0.25)
  end
  return math.clamp(desired, base, POLICY.MAX_FACTOR)
end
local function timing(value, now, explicitFactor, own)
  if not value or not state.root then
    return nil
  end
  own = own or state.root.Position
  local speed = value.syncSpeed or value.speed
  if not vector(own) or not vector(value.position) or not finite(speed) or speed < 16 or speed > 1000 then
    return nil
  end
  local ping, raw, count = gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  state.ping, state.pingRaw, state.pingSamples = ping, raw, count
  if not finite(ping) or ping < 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local training = value.mode == "training"
  local radius = training and 8.5 or state.player:GetAttribute("DeflectRange")
  radius = finite(radius) and math.clamp(radius, 8.5, 16) or 8.5
  local delta = value.position - own
  local distance = delta.Magnitude
  local ownVelocity = vector(state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) and state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
  local closing = speed
  if vector(value.velocity) then
    closing = distance > 0.001 and -(value.velocity - ownVelocity):Dot(delta) / distance or speed
  end
  if not finite(closing) then
    return nil
  end
  local entry = closing > 0 and math.max(0, distance - radius) / closing or (distance <= radius and 0 or math.huge)
  local configured = tonumber(utils.getConfigValue("AutoParryWindowFactor"))
  local base = finite(explicitFactor) and explicitFactor or (finite(configured) and configured or POLICY.DEFAULT_FACTOR)
  base = math.clamp(base, 0, POLICY.MAX_FACTOR)
  local factor = explicitFactor ~= nil and base or adaptiveFactor(entry, closing, speed, base, now, ping)
  local window
  if training then
    window = gameInfo.getTrainingWindow(speed)
  else
    local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
    if not finite(low) or not finite(high) or high <= low then
      return nil
    end
    window = POLICY.SLOW_WINDOW + (POLICY.FAST_WINDOW - POLICY.SLOW_WINDOW) * math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
    if state.clash then
      local native = geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, false)
      if finite(native) and native > 0 then
        window = math.min(window, native)
      end
    end
  end
  if not finite(window) or window <= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local lead = window * factor + ping
  local threshold = radius + math.max(0, closing) * lead
  return {
    speed = speed,
    distance = distance,
    closingSpeed = closing,
    noWindowParryRadius = radius,
    fullRadius = threshold,
    triggerDistance = threshold,
    windowFactor = factor,
    deflectWindow = window,
    effectiveWindow = lead,
    timeToRange = entry,
    timeToTrigger = math.max(0, entry - lead),
    ready = distance <= radius or (closing > 0 and distance <= threshold),
    approaching = closing > 0,
    timeToKill = closing > 0 and math.max(0, distance - 4) / closing or math.huge,
  }
end
local function cooldownState(mode) return mode == "training" and cooldown.getTrainingCooldownState() or cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState() end
local function ready(cd, mode, clash)
  if not cd then
    return false
  end
  if mode == "training" then
    return cd.blocking == false
  end
  return (cd.source == "local" or cd.source == "server") and (cd.blocking == false or (clash and cd.source == "local" and cd.miss ~= true))
end
local function usable(value)
  return gameInfo.isSnapshotValid(value)
    and not value.locked
    and value.ballCanMove ~= false
    and not value.frozen
    and (value.mode == "training" or gameInfo.getGameContext().inMatch)
end
local function recover(value, cd, now)
  local shot = state.shot
  if not state.fired or not shot then
    return
  end
  local training = state.mode == "training"
  local confirmed = training and value.trainingParryAt or cd.lastParriedAt
  if training and ready(cd, state.mode, false) and not finite(confirmed) then
    state.fired, state.shot = false, nil
    return
  end
  if cd.miss == true and cd.blocking == false and finite(cd.pressAt) and cd.pressAt >= shot.at - 0.001 then
    state.fired, state.shot = false, nil
    return
  end
  if not finite(confirmed) or confirmed <= state.consumedParry or (training and confirmed == shot.trainingConfirmation) then
    return
  end
  if (not training and confirmed < shot.at) or (training and confirmed < shot.serverTime) then
    return
  end
  if (training and value.targetId ~= state.player.UserId) or (not training and value.exchangeTargetId ~= state.player.UserId) then
    return
  end
  local version = value.syncVersion or value.syncSequence
  if not finite(version) or not finite(shot.version) or version == shot.version then
    return
  end
  local floor = training and confirmed - gameInfo.getAveragePing()
    or utils.getWorkspace():GetServerTimeNow() - math.max(0, now - confirmed) - gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  if not finite(value.serverTime) or value.serverTime <= shot.serverTime or value.serverTime < math.max(shot.serverTime, floor) then
    return
  end
  local predicted = gameInfo.getParrySnapshot(now, true, true, state.tracker.floor)
  if not predicted or predicted.ball ~= state.ball or not vector(predicted.velocity) then
    return
  end
  local delta = predicted.position - state.root.Position
  local incoming = delta:Dot(predicted.velocity - state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) < 0
  if not incoming and delta:Dot(delta) <= 8.5 * 8.5 and vector(value.syncDirection) and vector(value.realPosition) then
    incoming = (value.realPosition - state.root.Position):Dot(value.syncDirection) < 0
  end
  if not incoming then
    return
  end
  state.consumedParry = confirmed
  state.tracker.rearm(math.max(shot.serverTime, floor))
  state.fired, state.shot = false, nil
  observe(value, now)
  state.confirmedReturns = (state.confirmedReturns or 0) + 1
  phase("confirmed_return")
end
local function manualStamp(now)
  local stamp = gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt()
  return finite(stamp) and stamp > state.episodeAt and stamp <= now and stamp ~= state.lastOwnPress and stamp or nil
end
local function dispatch(value, now)
  local repeatClash = state.mode ~= "training" and state.clash
  if sending or (state.fired and not repeatClash) then
    return false
  end
  local interval = state.mode == "training" and POLICY.TRAINING_INTERVAL or POLICY.NATIVE_INTERVAL
  local accepted = state.mode ~= "training" and gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt()
  if now - (state.lastAttemptAt or -math.huge) < interval or (finite(accepted) and now - accepted < interval) then
    return false
  end
  local limit = utils.getWorkspace():GetAttribute("CPS_LIMIT")
  if state.mode == "training" and rate(now) >= (finite(limit) and limit or 16) then
    return false
  end
  local generation, cycle, ball, mode = state.generation, state.cycle, state.ball, state.mode
  local function guard()
    if generation ~= state.generation or cycle ~= state.cycle or not live() then
      return false
    end
    if mode ~= "training" and utils.isSpamActive() then
      return false
    end
    local current = gameInfo.getParrySnapshot(clock(), true, false, state.tracker.floor)
    if not usable(current) or current.ball ~= ball or (current.mode == "training" and "training" or "match") ~= mode then
      return false
    end
    local cd = cooldownState(mode)
    if not ready(cd, mode, mode ~= "training" and gameInfo.isNativeClash()) then
      return false
    end
    if mode ~= "training" and manualStamp(clock()) then
      return false
    end
    local t = timing(current, clock())
    return t ~= nil and t.ready
  end
  sending, state.lastAttemptAt = true, now
  local ok, sent, detail = pcall(remote.fireCheckedParry, guard)
  sending = false
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return false
  end
  if not ok then
    if now - errorAt >= 1 then
      errorAt = now
      utils.recordError("AutoParry", tostring(sent))
    end
    phase("dispatch_error")
    return false
  end
  if sent ~= true then
    if generation == state.generation and cycle == state.cycle then
      phase(detail or "dispatch_declined")
    end
    return false
  end
  state.acceptedCalls = (state.acceptedCalls or 0) + 1
  if repeatClash then
    state.clashCalls = (state.clashCalls or 0) + 1
  end
  rate(now, true)
  if generation ~= state.generation or cycle ~= state.cycle then
    return true
  end
  local nativeStamp = gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt()
  state.fired, state.lastFireAt, state.lastOwnPress = true, now, nativeStamp
  state.shot = {
    at = now,
    serverTime = finite(value.serverTime) and value.serverTime or -math.huge,
    version = value.syncVersion or value.syncSequence,
    trainingConfirmation = value.trainingParryAt,
  }
  state.lastClickAt = now
  if mode == "training" then
    cooldown.recordTrainingDeflectAttempt(now)
  else
    cooldown.recordDeflectAttempt(nativeStamp or now)
  end
  phase("awaiting_return")
  return true
end
local function tick()
  if not live() then
    phase("inactive")
    return false
  end
  local now = clock()
  local value = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(now)
  if not usable(value) then
    phase("snapshot_unavailable")
    return false
  end
  local targeted = observe(value, now)
  state.clash = state.mode ~= "training" and gameInfo.isNativeClash()
  if state.mode ~= "training" and utils.isSpamActive() then
    state.wasSpamActive = true
    phase("spam_active")
    return false
  end
  if state.wasSpamActive then
    state.lastOwnPress, state.wasSpamActive = gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt(), false
  end
  local cd = cooldownState(state.mode)
  if not cd then
    phase("cooldown_unknown")
    return false
  end
  recover(value, cd, now)
  targeted = state.known and state.target == state.player.UserId
  if not targeted then
    phase("not_target")
    return false
  end
  if state.fired and not state.clash then
    phase("awaiting_return")
    return false
  end
  local manual = state.mode ~= "training" and manualStamp(now)
  if manual then
    state.fired, state.lastFireAt, state.lastOwnPress = true, manual, manual
    state.shot = {
      at = manual,
      serverTime = value.serverTime or -math.huge,
      version = value.syncVersion or value.syncSequence,
      trainingConfirmation = value.trainingParryAt,
    }
    cooldown.recordDeflectAttempt(manual)
    if not state.clash then
      phase("manual_deflect")
      return false
    end
  end
  if not ready(cd, state.mode, state.clash) then
    phase("deflect_cooldown")
    return false
  end
  value = gameInfo.getParrySnapshot(now, true, false, state.tracker.floor)
  if not usable(value) then
    phase("snapshot_changed")
    return false
  end
  local t = timing(value, now)
  if not t then
    phase("timing_unavailable")
    return false
  end
  state.timing, state.factor, state.factorAt, state.timingAt = t, t.windowFactor, now, now
  if not t.ready then
    phase("outside_window")
    return false
  end
  return dispatch(value, now)
end
local function evaluate()
  if evaluating or sending then
    return false
  end
  evaluating = true
  local ok, result = pcall(tick)
  evaluating = false
  if not ok then
    local now = clock()
    if utils and now - errorAt >= 1 then
      errorAt = now
      utils.recordError("AutoParry", tostring(result))
    end
    phase("evaluation_error")
    return false
  end
  return result == true
end
function AutoParry.step(dt)
  if finite(dt) and dt > 0 then
    state.frameTime = math.clamp(dt, 1 / 240, 0.12)
    state.visualFrame = (state.visualFrame or 0) + 1
  end
  return evaluate()
end
function AutoParry.isDeadlineDue()
  local t = state.timing
  return live()
    and state.reason == "outside_window"
    and not utils.isSpamActive()
    and t ~= nil
    and finite(t.timeToTrigger)
    and clock() >= (state.timingAt or clock()) + t.timeToTrigger
end
function AutoParry.setup(deps)
  AutoParry.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, geometry, cooldown, remote, targeting = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.DeflectGeometry, deps.Cooldown, deps.Remote, deps.Targeting
  state.tracker = targeting.createParryTracker()
  state.acceptedCalls, state.clashCalls, state.confirmedReturns = 0, 0, 0
  return true
end
function AutoParry.bindCharacter(character)
  AutoParry.detachCharacter()
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not root or not humanoid or not character.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    return false, "personagem incompleto"
  end
  state.character, state.root, state.humanoid, state.player, state.bound = character, root, humanoid, utils.getLocalPlayer(), true
  state.ball, state.mode, state.round, state.visualFrame = nil, nil, nil, 0
  state.frameTime, state.lastAttemptAt, state.lastSyncAt, state.syncInterval = 1 / 60, -math.huge, nil, nil
  resetFlight("character_bound")
  local generation = state.generation
  track(character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    if not parent and generation == state.generation then
      AutoParry.detachCharacter()
    end
  end))
  track(humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
    if generation == state.generation then
      AutoParry.detachCharacter()
    end
  end))
  return true
end
function AutoParry.detachCharacter()
  state.generation += 1
  state.bound = false
  for _, c in ipairs(state.connections) do
    if utils then
      utils.untrackCharacter(c)
    end
    c:Disconnect()
  end
  table.clear(state.connections)
  state.character, state.root, state.humanoid, state.player, state.ball = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  resetFlight("detached")
end
function AutoParry.resetState() AutoParry.detachCharacter() end
function AutoParry.teardown()
  AutoParry.detachCharacter()
  state.tracker = nil
  utils, gameInfo, geometry, cooldown, remote, targeting = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  table.clear(calls)
  firstCall, lastCall, state.cps, state.maxCps = 1, 0, 0, 0
end
function AutoParry.onBallSync(data)
  if not state.bound or type(data) ~= "table" then
    return true
  end
  if data.Source ~= "target" and data.Source ~= "clash" then
    local now = clock()
    if data.Teleported then
      resetFlight("teleport")
    end
    if state.lastSyncAt and now > state.lastSyncAt then
      state.syncInterval = now - state.lastSyncAt
    end
    state.lastSyncAt = now
  end
  if live() then
    local value = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(clock())
    if usable(value) then
      observe(value, clock())
    end
  end
  evaluate()
  return true
end
function AutoParry.fire() return evaluate() end
function AutoParry.tryRedirectReturn() return evaluate() end
function AutoParry.beginFierce()
  if not state.bound then
    return nil
  end
  return { generation = state.generation, cycle = state.cycle, startedAt = clock() }
end
function AutoParry.cancelFierce(token) return token ~= nil and token.generation == state.generation end
local function internalTiming(value, time, root, factor)
  if not value then
    return state.timing
  end
  return timing(value, finite(time) and time or clock(), factor, root)
end
function AutoParry.getTargetStatus()
  return {
    armed = not state.fired,
    firedForTarget = state.fired == true,
    lastTargeted = state.target == (state.player and state.player.UserId),
    targeted = state.known == true and state.target == (state.player and state.player.UserId),
    targetId = state.target,
    targetKnown = state.known == true,
    approaching = state.timing and state.timing.approaching or false,
    cooldown = cooldown and cooldownState(state.mode),
  }
end
function AutoParry.getPressureDetector()
  return {
    enabled = utils ~= nil and live() or false,
    ball = state.ball,
    targetId = state.target,
    cycle = state.cycle,
    firedForTarget = state.fired == true,
    attemptAt = state.lastFireAt,
    frameTime = state.frameTime or 1 / 60,
    syncInterval = state.syncInterval,
    ping = state.ping or 0,
    retryAt = 0,
  }
end
function AutoParry.getDefenseState(value)
  local result = AutoParry.getPressureDetector()
  result.armed, result.fired, result.reason, result.lastRequestAt = not state.fired, state.fired == true, state.reason, state.lastFireAt
  local cd = cooldown and cooldownState(state.mode)
  result.blocking, result.lastParriedAt = cd and cd.blocking == true, cd and cd.lastParriedAt
  return result
end
function AutoParry.getPressure() return { latestReturnTime = state.returnInterval, samples = state.lastClickAt and 1 or 0, cps = state.cps or 0 } end
function AutoParry.getStatus()
  rate(clock())
  local t = internalTiming()
  return {
    available = t ~= nil,
    schema = utils and utils.apiVersion(),
    api = {
      name = "AutoParry",
      version = 16,
      endpoints = { "getStatus", "getTargetStatus" },
    },
    lifecycle = {
      phase = state.phase,
      reason = state.reason,
      bound = state.bound,
      alive = state.bound and state.humanoid.Health > 0,
      generation = state.generation,
    },
    target = AutoParry.getTargetStatus(),
    mode = state.mode,
    ping = {
      oneWay = state.ping or 0,
      raw = state.pingRaw,
      samples = state.pingSamples or 0,
    },
    cps = state.cps or 0,
    maxObservedCps = state.maxCps or 0,
    nativeClash = state.clash == true,
    acceptedClientCalls = state.acceptedCalls or 0,
    nativeClashCalls = state.clashCalls or 0,
    confirmedReturns = state.confirmedReturns or 0,
    pressure = AutoParry.getPressure(),
    cycle = {
      fired = state.fired == true,
      armed = not state.fired,
      lastFireAt = state.lastFireAt,
    },
    training = {
      active = state.mode == "training",
    },
    timestamp = clock(),
  }
end
AutoParry.__contract = {
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
    Cooldown = "cooldown",
    Remote = "remote",
    Targeting = "targeting",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Targeting = { "createParryTracker" },
    Utils = {
      "getWorkspace",
      "getLocalPlayer",
      "getRunService",
      "getConfigValue",
      "isActive",
      "isSpamActive",
      "trackCharacter",
      "untrackCharacter",
      "recordError",
      "apiVersion",
    },
    GameInfo = {
      "getSnapshotAt",
      "getParrySnapshot",
      "isSnapshotValid",
      "getGameContext",
      "getTrainingWindow",
      "isNativeClash",
      "getLastAcceptedDeflectAt",
      "isSnapshotAfterDeflect",
      "getAveragePing",
      "getBallSpeedLimits",
      "getRootPosition",
      "getLastDeflectPressAt",
      "observeTraining",
    },
    DeflectGeometry = { "getParryTiming", "getDefensePhysics", "getDeflectWindow" },
    Cooldown = { "getDeflectCooldownState", "getTrainingCooldownState", "recordDeflectAttempt", "recordTrainingDeflectAttempt", "observeDeflect" },
    Remote = { "fireCheckedParry" },
  },
  provides = {
    "step",
    "isDeadlineDue",
    "setup",
    "teardown",
    "bindCharacter",
    "detachCharacter",
    "resetState",
    "onBallSync",
    "fire",
    "tryRedirectReturn",
    "beginFierce",
    "cancelFierce",
    "getTargetStatus",
    "getPressureDetector",
    "getDefenseState",
    "getPressure",
    "getStatus",
  },
  bindCharacter = true,
  version = 16,
}

return AutoParry

-- [[ auto spam ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local AutoSpam = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local clashStatsModule
local cooldownInfo
local deflectGeometry
local players
local runService
local localPlayer
local current
local generation = 0
local matchDeathSerial = 0
local lastActivationReason
local lastActivationAt
local lastStopReason
local lastStopAt
local evaluate

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  ACTIVATION = {
    RETURN = 0.6,
    WINDOW_FACTOR = 0.9,
    REACTIVATION_COOLDOWN = 0.15,
    CLOSE_TARGET_DISTANCE = 5,
  },
  TIMING = {
    SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE = 0.5,
    PACKET_CACHE_AGE = 0.2,
  },
}

-- helpers
local function finite(x) return type(x) == "number" and x == x and x > -math.huge and x < math.huge end
local function vector(x) return typeof(x) == "Vector3" and finite(x.X) and finite(x.Y) and finite(x.Z) end
local function userId(x) return finite(x) and x > 0 and x % 1 == 0 and x or nil end
local function now() return utils.now() end
local function snapshotSpeed(s)
  local speed = s and (s.syncSpeed ~= nil and s.syncSpeed or s.speed)
  return finite(speed) and speed >= 0 and speed <= 1000 and speed or nil
end
local function networkLatency()
  local ping = gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  return finite(ping) and math.clamp(ping * 0.5, 0, 0.25) or 0
end
local function frameLead(state) return math.clamp(state.frameInterval or 1 / 60, 1 / 240, 0.05) end
local function playerIsAlive(id)
  local _, _, humanoid = gameInfo.getPlayerParts(id)
  return humanoid ~= nil and finite(humanoid.Health) and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function playerPosition(id)
  local position = id and gameInfo.getPlayerMotion(id)
  return vector(position) and position or nil
end
local function nearPartner(state, id, limit)
  if not userId(id) or id == localPlayer.UserId or not playerIsAlive(id) then
    return nil
  end
  local player = players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
  local lives = player:GetAttribute("Lives")
  if player:GetAttribute("Playing") == false or (finite(lives) and lives <= 0) then
    return nil
  end
  local position = playerPosition(id)
  return position and (position - state.root.Position).Magnitude <= limit and id or nil
end
local function listen(state, signal, callback, pool)
  local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
  state.connections[connection] = true
  if pool then
    pool[connection] = true
  end
  utils.trackCharacter(connection)
  return connection
end
local function disconnectPool(state, pool)
  for connection in pairs(pool) do
    utils.untrackCharacter(connection)
    connection:Disconnect()
    state.connections[connection] = nil
  end
  table.clear(pool)
end
local function clearEvidence(state)
  state.target, state.outbound, state.returnEvidence, state.receipt, state.exchange = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  state.confirmedReturns, state.exchangeHistory, state.lastPairExchangeAt = nil, nil, nil
  state.packetSnapshot, state.packetAt, state.receivedSequence = nil, nil, nil
  state.leg = (state.leg or 0) + 1
end
local function deactivate(state, reason, time)
  if not state.active then
    return false
  end
  time = time or now()
  state.active, state.phase, state.reason, state.lastGate = false, "idle", reason, reason
  if reason == "opponent_left_or_died" then
    clashStatsModule.freeze(state.partner, state)
  end
  state.partner, state.deathSerial = nil, nil
  state.cooldownSince, state.cooldownInitialRemaining = nil, nil
  state.reactivateAt = time + CONFIG.ACTIVATION.REACTIVATION_COOLDOWN
  lastStopReason, lastStopAt = reason, time
  utils.setAutoSpamActive(false)
  utils.recordTransition("AutoSpam", "active", "idle", reason)
  return true
end
local function sequenceOrder(state, incoming)
  if incoming == nil then
    return "none"
  end
  if not finite(incoming) or incoming < 0 or incoming >= 65536 or incoming % 1 ~= 0 then
    return "invalid"
  end
  if state.sequence == nil then
    return "new"
  end
  local delta = (incoming - state.sequence) % 65536
  return delta == 0 and "same" or (delta < 32768 and "new" or "old")
end
local function targetOf(s)
  if not s then
    return nil
  end
  if s.exchangeTargetId ~= nil then
    return userId(s.exchangeTargetId)
  end
  return userId(s.targetId)
end
local function lifecycleGate(state, s)
  if not s or not s.ball or not s.ball.Parent then
    return "snapshot_invalid"
  end
  if s.ball ~= state.ball or s.teleported or s.resetting or s.ballValid == false or s.valid == false then
    return "ball_reset"
  end
  if s.mode == "training" then
    return "training"
  end
  if gameInfo.getBallFrozen() == true then
    return "ball_paused"
  end
  if s.locked or s.ballCanMove == false then
    return "ball_reset"
  end
end
local function selectSnapshot(state, s, time)
  local cached = state.packetSnapshot
  if not s or not cached or s.ball ~= cached.ball or time < state.packetAt or time - state.packetAt > CONFIG.TIMING.PACKET_CACHE_AGE then
    return s
  end
  if s.teleported or s.resetting or s.locked or s.frozen or s.ballValid == false or s.valid == false or s.ballCanMove == false or s.mode == "training" then
    return s
  end
  local order = sequenceOrder(state, s.syncSequence)
  if order == "old" then
    return cached
  end
  if
    order == "same"
    and s.targetSignals
    and s.targetSignals.known

local function geometry(state, s, factor)

  local memo = state.evaluation
  if memo and memo[key] then
    return memo[key], speed
  end
  local g = deflectGeometry.getDeflectGeometry(speed, "game", key, false, networkLatency())
  if not g or not finite(g.effectiveWindow) or not finite(g.noWindowParryRadius) then
    return nil
  end
  local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
  local result = deflectGeometry.withSpeedWindowBonus(g, speed, low, high, key)
  if memo then
    memo[key] = result

  return result, speed
end
local function opponentDistanceLimit(state, s, partner)

    return memo.distanceLimit

  local speed = snapshotSpeed(s)
  if not speed then
    return 0
  end
  local factor = utils.getConfigValue("AutoParryWindowFactor")
  factor = finite(factor) and math.clamp(factor, 0, 1) or 0.3

    memo.distanceLimit = result

  return result
end
local function insideSpamWindow(state, s, time, factor)

    return false

  local g = geometry(state, s, windowFactor)
  if not g or not finite(g.fullRadius) or g.fullRadius < 0 then

  local delta = s.position - state.root.Position

local function observeTarget(state, s, time, event)

    at = time,

    ball = s.ball,

    distanceAtSwitch = distance,

      and outbound.ball == s.ball
      and time >= outbound.at
      and time - outbound.at <= CONFIG.ACTIVATION.RETURN + networkLatency()

      state.confirmedReturns = { partner = previous, at = time, count = h and h.partner == previous and h.count + 1 or 1 }
      state.returnEvidence = { partner = previous, at = time, ball = s.ball, leg = state.leg, interval = time - outbound.at }
      state.lastPairExchangeAt = time

    state.outbound = nil

    state.outbound, state.returnEvidence, state.confirmedReturns = nil, nil, nil

  state.exchangeHistory = h

local function distantTargetGate(state, s)
  if not state.active or not s then
    return nil
  end

  if not target and not s.targetUncertain then
    target = userId(s.targetId)
  end
  if not target or target == localPlayer.UserId or target == state.partner then
    return nil
  end
  local targetPosition = playerPosition(target)
  if not vector(targetPosition) then
    return nil
  end
  local g = geometry(state, s, 1)
  if not g or not finite(g.fullRadius) or g.fullRadius <= 0 then
    return nil
  end
  if (targetPosition - state.root.Position).Magnitude > g.fullRadius then
    return "distant_target"
  end

end
local function autoHardStop(state, s)
  if not utils.isActive() then
    return "hub_inactive"
  end
  if utils.getConfigValue("AutoSpam") ~= true then
    return "disabled"
  end
  if utils.getWorkspace():GetAttribute("MatchStatus") ~= 6 then
    return "match_ended"
  end
  if gameInfo.getBallFrozen() == true then
    return "ball_paused"
  end
  if not state.character.Parent or not state.root.Parent or not playerIsAlive(localPlayer.UserId) then
    return "player_died"
  end
  if state.deathSerial and state.deathSerial ~= matchDeathSerial then
    return "match_player_died"
  end
  if state.partner and not playerIsAlive(state.partner) then
    return "opponent_left_or_died"
  end
  return distantTargetGate(state, s)
end
local function activate(state, candidate, s, time)
  state.active, state.phase, state.reason, state.partner = true, "clashing", candidate.reason, candidate.partner
  state.activatedAt, state.deathSerial, state.lastGate = time, matchDeathSerial, candidate.reason
  state.cooldownSince, state.cooldownInitialRemaining, state.cooldownEpisode = nil, nil, nil
  lastActivationReason, lastActivationAt = candidate.reason, time
  clashStatsModule.begin(candidate.partner, time)
  utils.recordTransition("AutoSpam", "idle", "active", candidate.reason)
  utils.setAutoSpamActive(true)
end
local function autoStop(state, s, time)
  local reason = autoHardStop(state, s)
  if reason then
    return reason
  end
  local speed = snapshotSpeed(s) or 0
  local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
  local progress = finite(low) and finite(high) and high > low and math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1) or 0
  local other = playerPosition(state.partner)
  local near = other and (other - state.root.Position).Magnitude <= 10 + 6 * progress
  local limit = 0.225 - 0.125 * progress + networkLatency() + (near and 0.12 or 0)
  local cd = cooldownInfo.getDeflectCooldownState()
  state.cooldown = cd
  if cd and cd.source == "local" and cd.blocking == true and cd.miss == true then
    return "miss_confirmed"
  end
  local localBlocked = cd and ((cd.source == "local" and finite(cd.localRemaining) and cd.localRemaining > 0) or (cd.source == nil and cd.blocking == true))
  if not localBlocked then
    state.cooldownSince, state.cooldownInitialRemaining = nil, nil
    state.cooldownLimit = limit
  else
    local began = finite(cd.blockingSince) and cd.blockingSince <= time and cd.blockingSince or time
    state.cooldownSince = math.min(state.cooldownSince or began, began)
    if not state.cooldownInitialRemaining and finite(cd.localRemaining) and cd.localRemaining > 0 then
      state.cooldownInitialRemaining = cd.localRemaining
    end
    if finite(state.cooldownInitialRemaining) then
      limit = math.min(limit, math.max(0.08, state.cooldownInitialRemaining * 0.8))

end
local function deactivationGate(state, s, time) return autoStop(state, s, time) end
local function observeStats(state, s, time, packet)

    return
  end
  local stats = clashStatsModule.get()
  if stats and stats.frozen and not state.active then

  end

end
local function fastReturnActivation(state, s, time)

  local evidence = state.returnEvidence
  if evidence then
    if evidence.ball ~= s.ball or evidence.leg ~= state.leg or time < evidence.at or time - evidence.at > CONFIG.ACTIVATION.RETURN + networkLatency() then
      state.returnEvidence = nil
      state.gates.fastReturn = "return_expired"
    elseif targetOf(s) ~= localPlayer.UserId then
      state.gates.fastReturn = "return_not_self"
    elseif not nearPartner(state, evidence.partner, opponentDistanceLimit(state, s, evidence.partner)) then
      state.gates.fastReturn = "partner_unavailable"
    elseif not insideSpamWindow(state, s, time, 0.6) then
      state.gates.fastReturn = "return_outside_window"
    else
      local g = geometry(state, s, 1)
      local budget = g and g.effectiveWindow + networkLatency() + frameLead(state) or 0
      if evidence.interval <= budget then
        state.gates.fastReturn = "ready"
        return { partner = evidence.partner, reason = "fast_return" }
      end
      state.gates.fastReturn = "return_has_reaction_time"
    end

    state.gates.fastReturn = "no_return_evidence"
  end

end
local function closeTargetActivation(state, s, time)
  local receipt = state.receipt
  if not s or not receipt or receipt.ball ~= s.ball or receipt.leg ~= state.leg or receipt.target ~= localPlayer.UserId then
    state.gates.closeTarget = "no_target_switch"
    return nil
  end
  if not receipt.closeAtSwitch then
    state.gates.closeTarget = "switch_outside_5_studs"
    return nil
  end
  if targetOf(s) ~= localPlayer.UserId then
    state.gates.closeTarget = "target_changed"
    return nil
  end
  state.gates.closeTarget = "ready"
  return { partner = receipt.from, reason = "close_target" }
end
local function chooseActivation(state, s, time)
  local closeTarget = closeTargetActivation(state, s, time)
  local fastReturn = fastReturnActivation(state, s, time)
  return closeTarget or fastReturn
end
local function evaluateCore(state, s, time, packet)
  if current ~= state then

  table.clear(state.gates)
  if s and s.ball ~= state.ball then
    state.ball, state.sequence, state.packetSnapshot, state.packetAt = s.ball, nil, nil, nil
    clearEvidence(state)
  end
  local order = sequenceOrder(state, s and s.syncSequence)
  if order == "old" or order == "invalid" then
    return
  end
  if order == "new" then
    state.sequence = s.syncSequence
  end
  if packet and s then
    state.packetSnapshot, state.packetAt = table.clone(s), time
  end
  if s then
    observeTarget(state, s, time, packet)
  end
  if state.active then
    local stop = deactivationGate(state, s, time)
    if stop then
      deactivate(state, stop, time)
      return
    end
    local gate = lifecycleGate(state, s)
    if gate then
      state.lastGate, state.gates.common = gate, gate
      return
    end
    state.lastGate, state.gates.common = "active", nil
    observeStats(state, s, time, packet)
    return
  end
  local candidate = chooseActivation(state, s, time)
  if candidate then
    if time >= (state.reactivateAt or 0) then
      activate(state, candidate, s, time)
    else
      state.lastGate = "reactivation_cooldown"
    end
  else
    state.lastGate = state.gates.closeTarget == "ready" and state.gates.closeTarget or state.gates.fastReturn
  end
  observeStats(state, s, time, packet)
end
evaluate = function(state, s, time, packet)
  local previous = state.evaluation
  local memo = not previous and state.scratch or {}
  if not memo then
    memo = {}
    state.scratch = memo
  end
  table.clear(memo)
  state.evaluation = memo
  local ok, message = pcall(evaluateCore, state, s, time, packet)
  state.evaluation = previous
  if not ok then
    error(message, 0)
  end
end
local function watchPlayer(state, player)
  if state.sensors[player.UserId] then
    return
  end
  local sensor = { player = player, characterConnections = {}, playerConnections = {}, lives = player:GetAttribute("Lives") }
  state.sensors[player.UserId] = sensor
  local world = utils.getWorkspace()
  local function death()
    if current ~= state or world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") ~= 6 or sensor.reported or not sensor.participated then
      return
    end
    sensor.reported = true
    matchDeathSerial += 1
    deactivate(state, "match_player_died", now())
  end
  local function updateLives()
    local lives = player:GetAttribute("Lives")
    if world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == 6 and finite(lives) and lives > 0 and player:GetAttribute("Playing") ~= false then
      sensor.participated = true
    end
    if finite(sensor.lives) and sensor.lives > 0 and finite(lives) and lives <= 0 then
      death()
    end
    sensor.lives = lives
  end
  local function watchCharacter(character)
    disconnectPool(state, sensor.characterConnections)
    sensor.character, sensor.humanoid, sensor.reported = character, nil, false
    local function watchHumanoid(humanoid)
      if current ~= state or player.Character ~= character or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or sensor.humanoid == humanoid then
        return
      end
      sensor.humanoid = humanoid
      listen(state, humanoid.Died, death, sensor.characterConnections)
    end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
      watchHumanoid(humanoid)
    end
    listen(state, character.ChildAdded, watchHumanoid, sensor.characterConnections)
    updateLives()
  end
  listen(state, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Lives"), updateLives, sensor.playerConnections)
  listen(state, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Playing"), updateLives, sensor.playerConnections)
  listen(state, player.CharacterAdded, watchCharacter, sensor.playerConnections)
  if player.Character then
    watchCharacter(player.Character)
  else
    updateLives()
  end
end
local function detach(reason)
  local state = current
  if not state then
    return
  end
  local stats = clashStatsModule.get()
  if stats and not stats.frozen then
    clashStatsModule.finish(reason, now())
  end
  deactivate(state, reason, now())
  current = nil
  generation += 1
  disconnectPool(state, state.connections)
end
function AutoSpam.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or not deps.Utils or not deps.GameInfo or not deps.ClashStats or not deps.Cooldown or not deps.DeflectGeometry then
    return false, "dependências ausentes"
  end
  if current then
    detach("setup")
  end
  utils, gameInfo, clashStatsModule, cooldownInfo, deflectGeometry = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.ClashStats, deps.Cooldown, deps.DeflectGeometry
  players, runService, localPlayer = utils.getPlayers(), utils.getRunService(), utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not players or not runService or not localPlayer then
    return false, "serviços indisponíveis"
  end
  return true
end
function AutoSpam.bindCharacter(character)
  detach("rebind")
  local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
    return false, "HumanoidRootPart indisponível"
  end
  local state = {
    character = character,
    root = root,
    connections = {},
    sensors = {},
    active = false,
    phase = "idle",
    reason = "waiting",
    lastGate = "waiting",
    gates = {},
    leg = 0,
  }

  current = state
  local initial = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(now())
  state.ball = initial and initial.ball
  for _, player in ipairs(gameInfo.getPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(state, player)
  end
  listen(state, players.PlayerAdded, function(player)
    if current == state then
      watchPlayer(state, player)
    end
  end)
  listen(state, players.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
    local sensor = state.sensors[player.UserId]
    if sensor then
      disconnectPool(state, sensor.characterConnections)
      disconnectPool(state, sensor.playerConnections)
      state.sensors[player.UserId] = nil
    end
    if state.partner == player.UserId then
      deactivate(state, "opponent_left_or_died", now())
    end
    if state.previousOpponent == player.UserId then
      clearEvidence(state)
    end
  end)
  local world = utils.getWorkspace()
  listen(state, world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MatchStatus"), function()
    clearEvidence(state)
    for _, sensor in pairs(state.sensors) do
      local lives = sensor.player:GetAttribute("Lives")
      sensor.lives, sensor.reported = lives, false
      sensor.participated = world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == 6 and finite(lives) and lives > 0 and sensor.player:GetAttribute("Playing") ~= false
    end
    if world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") ~= 6 then
      deactivate(state, "match_ended", now())
    end
  end)
  local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if humanoid then
    listen(state, humanoid.Died, function()
      if current == state then
        clashStatsModule.freeze(localPlayer.UserId, state)
        deactivate(state, "player_died", now())
      end
    end)
  end
  listen(state, character.AncestryChanged, function(_, parent)
    if not parent and current == state then
      detach("character_removed")
    end
  end)
  AutoSpam.step()
  return true
end
function AutoSpam.step(dt)
  local state = current
  if not state then
    return
  end
  if finite(dt) and dt > 0 then
    state.frameInterval = dt
  end
  local time = now()
  evaluate(state, selectSnapshot(state, gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time), time), time, false)
end
function AutoSpam.detachCharacter() detach("detach") end
function AutoSpam.teardown()
  detach("teardown")

  players, runService, localPlayer = nil, nil, nil
end
function AutoSpam.onBallSync(data)
  local state = current
  if not state or type(data) ~= "table" then
    return
  end
  local time = now()
  local s = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time)
  if not s then
    return
  end
  local received = data.Source == "packet" or data.Source == "replicator"
  if received then
    local incoming = data.Sequence or data.TeleportSequence
    local order = sequenceOrder(state.ball == s.ball and state or {}, incoming)
    if order == "old" or order == "invalid" or (order == "same" and state.receivedSequence == incoming and data.Teleported ~= true) then
      return
    end
    state.receivedSequence = incoming
    s = table.clone(s)
    s.syncSequence, s.syncAt = incoming, time
    if data.TargetPlayerID ~= nil then
      if not userId(data.TargetPlayerID) then
        state.target, state.outbound, state.returnEvidence, state.exchange = nil, nil, nil, nil
        state.leg = state.leg + 1
      end
      s.exchangeTargetId, s.targetId, s.targetUncertain = data.TargetPlayerID, data.TargetPlayerID, not userId(data.TargetPlayerID)
      s.targeted = data.TargetPlayerID == localPlayer.UserId
    end
    if data.Speed ~= nil then
      s.syncSpeed = data.Speed
    end
    if data.RealPosition ~= nil then
      s.realPosition = data.RealPosition
    end
    if vector(data.ForcedDirection) then
      s.syncDirection = data.ForcedDirection
    end
    s.teleported = data.Teleported == true
    if type(data.Locked) == "boolean" then
      s.locked = data.Locked
    end
    if data.ServerTime ~= nil then
      s.serverTime = data.ServerTime
    end
  end
  if data.Source == "target" and data.TargetPlayerID ~= nil and not userId(data.TargetPlayerID) then
    state.target, state.outbound, state.returnEvidence, state.exchange = nil, nil, nil, nil
    state.leg = state.leg + 1
  end
  local targetEvent = data.Source == "target" and userId(data.TargetPlayerID) or nil
  if targetEvent then
    s = table.clone(s)
    s.syncSequence = state.sequence or s.syncSequence
    s.targetId, s.exchangeTargetId = targetEvent, targetEvent
    s.targeted, s.targetUncertain = targetEvent == localPlayer.UserId, false
  end
  evaluate(state, s, time, received or targetEvent ~= nil)
end
function AutoSpam.onDefenseOpportunity(snapshot)

end
function AutoSpam.isActive() return current ~= nil and current.active end
function AutoSpam.canSendManual()

    and utils.isActive()
    and utils.isManualSpamActive()
    and state.root.Parent ~= nil
    and state.character.Parent ~= nil
    and playerIsAlive(localPlayer.UserId)

function AutoSpam.canSend()
  local state = current
  if not state or not state.active then
    return false
  end
  local time = now()
  local s = selectSnapshot(state, gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time), time)
  local stop = deactivationGate(state, s, time)
  if stop then
    deactivate(state, stop, time)
    state.lastSendBlockReason, state.lastSendBlockAt = stop, time
    return false
  end
  local gate = lifecycleGate(state, s)
  if gate then
    state.lastSendBlockReason, state.lastSendBlockAt = gate, time
    return false
  end
  local closeSend = state.reason == "close_target" and s and targetOf(s) == localPlayer.UserId
  if not closeSend and not insideSpamWindow(state, s, time) then
    state.lastSendBlockReason, state.lastSendBlockAt = "outside_spam_window", time

  end

function AutoSpam.stopSpam(reason)

-- contract
AutoSpam.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { canSend = "combat.runtime", canSendManual = "combat.runtime", stopSpam = "combat.runtime" } },
  requires = {
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    ClashStats = "clashstats",
    Cooldown = "cooldown",
  },
