sources.hubs/phantom-ball/combat/dynamic_parry.l:
-- [[ dynamic parry ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Dynamic = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local cooldownInfo
local remote
local connections, uiConnections = {}, {}
local binding
local session
local held
local protectedUntil
local editing = false
local lastStopReason
local active = false
local pulseUntil = 0
local epoch = 0
local function enabled() return utils and utils.isActive() and utils.getConfigValue("DynamicParry") == true end
local function connect(list, signal, callback)
  local c = signal:Connect(callback)
  list[#list + 1] = c
  return c
end
local function disconnect(list)
  for _, c in ipairs(list) do
    c:Disconnect()
  end
  table.clear(list)
end
local function stop()
  active, session = false, nil
  if utils then
    utils.setDynamicSpamActive(false)
  end
end
local function finite(x) return type(x) == "number" and x == x and x > -math.huge and x < math.huge end
local function cooldownExpired(time)
  local cd = cooldownInfo.getDeflectCooldownState()
  if not cd or cd.source == "unknown" or cd.blocking ~= true or cd.predictedReset == true then
    session.cooldownSince, session.cooldownEpisode = nil, nil
    return false
  end
  if finite(cd.lastParriedAt) and cd.lastParriedAt ~= session.cooldownParriedAt then
    session.cooldownParriedAt, session.cooldownSince = cd.lastParriedAt, time
  end
  if not session.cooldownSince or (cd.episode ~= nil and session.cooldownEpisode ~= cd.episode) then
    session.cooldownSince = finite(cd.blockingSince) and cd.blockingSince <= time and cd.blockingSince or time
    session.cooldownEpisode = cd.episode
  end
  local s = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt(time)
  local speed = s and (s.syncSpeed ~= nil and s.syncSpeed or s.speed)
  speed = finite(speed) and math.clamp(speed, 0, 1000) or 0
  local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
  local progress = finite(low) and finite(high) and high > low and math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1) or 0
  local near = false
  for _, player in ipairs(utils.getPlayers():GetPlayers()) do
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local position = player.UserId ~= utils.getLocalPlayer().UserId and gameInfo.getPlayerMotion(player.UserId)
    local lives = player:GetAttribute("Lives")
    if
      position
      and humanoid
      and humanoid.Health > 0
      and player:GetAttribute("Playing") ~= false
      and (not finite(lives) or lives > 0)
      and (position - session.root.Position).Magnitude <= 10 + 6 * progress
    then
      near = true
      break
    end
  end
  local ping = gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  local latency = finite(ping) and math.clamp(ping * 0.5, 0, 0.25) or 0
  local limit = 0.225 - 0.125 * progress + latency + (near and 0.12 or 0)
  return time - session.cooldownSince >= limit
end
local function matches(input)
  local key = utils.getConfigValue("DynamicParryKey")
  return key ~= nil and key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and (input.KeyCode == key or input.UserInputType == key)
end
local function press(input)
  if not enabled() or editing or held then
    return
  end
  if active then
    stop()
    return
  end
  held, pulseUntil = input, os.clock() + 0.12
  local owner = epoch
  remote.fireNativeParry(function() return enabled() and epoch == owner end)
  task.delay(0.18, function()
    if epoch ~= owner or not held or not enabled() then
      return
    end
    local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    session = root and { character = character, root = root }
    if not session then
      return
    end
    local ping = gameInfo.getAveragePing()
    protectedUntil = os.clock() + 0.3 + math.max(0, tonumber(ping) or 0)
    active = true
    utils.setDynamicSpamActive(true)
  end)
end
local function release(input)
  if not held or (input ~= held and not matches(input)) then
    return
  end
  held = nil
  epoch += 1
  if utils.getConfigValue("DynamicParryMode") == "Hold" then
    stop()
  end
end
local function restore()
  disconnect(uiConnections)
  if not binding then
    return
  end
  local old = binding
  binding = nil
  if old.animations then
    pcall(old.animations.Unbind, old.animations, old.button)
  end
  for key, value in pairs(old.references) do
    if old.interface[key] == old.replacements[key] then
      old.interface[key] = value
    end
  end
  if old.ability.OnKeyDown == old.hook then
    old.ability.OnKeyDown = old.keyDown
  end
  if old.original.Parent then
    old.original.Visible = old.visible
  end
  if old.clone then
    old.clone:Destroy()
  end
end
local function attach(ability)
  local interface = ability and ability.Interface
  local original = interface and interface.MobileUIAbilityFrame
  local sourceButton = interface and interface.MobileUIAbilityButton
  local sourceImage = interface and interface.MobileUIAbilityImage
  if
    not original
    or not original.Parent
    or not sourceButton
    or not sourceImage
    or not sourceButton:IsA("ImageButton")
    or not sourceButton:IsDescendantOf(original)
    or not sourceImage:IsDescendantOf(original)
    or type(ability.OnKeyDown) ~= "function"
  then
    return
  end
  if binding and binding.ability == ability and binding.original == original and binding.clone.Parent then
    return
  end
  restore()
  local clone = original:Clone()
  clone.Name = "ExodusDynamicParry"
  for _, item in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
    if item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
      item:Destroy()
    end
  end
  local function counterpart(item)
    if item == original then
      return clone
    end
    local path = {}
    local node = item
    while node and node ~= original do
      table.insert(path, 1, node.Name)
      node = node.Parent
    end
    if node ~= original then
      return nil
    end
    local target = clone
    for _, name in ipairs(path) do
      target = target and target:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    return target
  end
  local references, replacements = {}, {}
  for key, value in pairs(interface) do
    if typeof(value) == "Instance" and (value == original or value:IsDescendantOf(original)) then
      local target = counterpart(value)
      if target then
        references[key], replacements[key], interface[key] = value, target, target
      end
    end
  end
  local button, image = interface.MobileUIAbilityButton, interface.MobileUIAbilityImage
  image.Image = ""
  image.Visible = false
  for _, item in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
    if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then
      item.Text = ""
    end
  end
  local animations = gameInfo.getNativeButtonAnimations()
  local oldKey = ability.OnKeyDown
  local function hook(self, input, processed)
    local service = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local desktop = service.KeyboardEnabled or service.MouseEnabled or not service.TouchEnabled or utils.getConfigValue("ForcePCUI") == true
    if enabled() and desktop and matches(input) then
      return
    end
    return oldKey(self, input, processed)
  end
  local visible = original.Visible
  binding = {
    ability = ability,
    interface = interface,
    original = original,
    clone = clone,
    visible = visible,
    references = references,
    replacements = replacements,
    keyDown = oldKey,
    hook = hook,
    button = button,
    image = image,
    animations = animations,
  }

  ability.OnKeyDown = hook
  local state = button:FindFirstChild("Label")
  if not state or not state:IsA("TextLabel") then
    state = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    state.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    state.Parent = button
  end
  state.Name = "DynamicState"
  state.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  state.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  state.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
  state.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.5)
  state.TextScaled = true
  state.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  state.Text = "OFF"
  state.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 5
  state.Visible = true
  binding.state = state
  clone.Parent = original.Parent
  original.Visible = false
  if animations then
    animations:Bind(button)
  end
  for _, property in ipairs({ "Size", "Position", "AnchorPoint", "Rotation", "LayoutOrder" }) do
    connect(uiConnections, original:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
      if clone.Parent then
        clone[property] = original[property]
      end
    end)
  end
  for _, property in ipairs({ "Size", "Position", "AnchorPoint", "Rotation" }) do
    local source = references.MobileUIAbilityButton
    connect(uiConnections, source:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
      if not clone.Parent then
        return
      end
      if animations then
        animations:Unbind(button)
      end
      button[property] = source[property]
      if animations then
        animations:Bind(button)
      end
    end)
  end
  connect(uiConnections, button.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
      press(input)
    end
  end)
end
function Dynamic.canSend()
  if not active then
    return false
  end
  if not enabled() or not utils.isDynamicSpamActive() then
    stop()
    return false
  end
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
    stop()
    return false
  end
  if not session or player.Character ~= session.character or not session.root.Parent or not session.character.Parent then
    stop()
    return false
  end
  if utils.getConfigValue("DynamicParryDeactivation") ~= false then
    local time = os.clock()
    local expired = cooldownExpired(time)
    if expired and time >= (protectedUntil or 0) then
      lastStopReason = "cooldown"
      stop()
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end
function Dynamic.setup(deps)
  Dynamic.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, cooldownInfo, remote = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.Cooldown, deps.Remote
  local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  connect(connections, input.InputBegan, function(event, processed)
    local desktop = input.KeyboardEnabled or input.MouseEnabled or not input.TouchEnabled or utils.getConfigValue("ForcePCUI") == true
    if desktop and not processed and not input:GetFocusedTextBox() and matches(event) then
      press(event)
    end
  end)
  local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
  local function updateEditing()
    local value = player:GetAttribute("MobileLayoutEditing") == true
    if value and not editing then
      held = nil
      epoch += 1
      stop()
      restore()
      local ability = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
      local frame = ability and ability.Interface and ability.Interface.MobileUIAbilityFrame
      if frame and frame.Parent then
        frame.Visible = true
      end
    end
    editing = value
  end
  connect(connections, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MobileLayoutEditing"), updateEditing)
  updateEditing()
  connect(connections, input.InputEnded, release)
  connect(connections, input.WindowFocusReleased, function()
    held = nil
    epoch += 1
    stop()
  end)
  connections[#connections + 1] = utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes.DynamicParry ~= nil or changes.DynamicParryKey ~= nil or changes.DynamicParryMode ~= nil then
      held = nil
      epoch += 1
      stop()
      restore()
    end
  end)
  connect(connections, utils.getRunService().Heartbeat, function()
    if not enabled() then
      held = nil
      epoch += 1
      stop()
      restore()
      return
    end
    if editing then
      return
    end
    local ability = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
    if not ability then
      stop()
      restore()
      return
    end
    if binding and binding.ability == ability then
      if not binding.original.Parent or not binding.clone.Parent then
        held = nil
        epoch += 1
        stop()
        restore()
      end
    else
      held = nil
      epoch += 1
      stop()
      attach(ability)
    end
    if not binding then
      attach(ability)
    end
    if active then
      Dynamic.canSend()
    end
    if binding then
      if binding.original.Visible then
        binding.original.Visible = false
      end
      local mobile = input.TouchEnabled and not input.KeyboardEnabled and not input.GamepadEnabled and utils.getConfigValue("ForcePCUI") ~= true
      if binding.clone.Visible ~= mobile then
        binding.clone.Visible = mobile
      end
      local on = active or held ~= nil or os.clock() < pulseUntil
      local label = on and "ON" or "OFF"
      if binding.state.Text ~= label then
        binding.state.Text = label
      end
      local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
      if binding.state.TextColor3 ~= white then
        binding.state.TextColor3 = white
      end
      if binding.image.Image ~= "" then
        binding.image.Image = ""
      end
      if binding.image.Visible then
        binding.image.Visible = false
      end
      local body = on and Color3.fromRGB(24, 157, 73) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 34, 46)
      if binding.button.ImageColor3 ~= body then
        binding.button.ImageColor3 = binding.button.ImageColor3:Lerp(body, 0.65)
      end
      if binding.button.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
        binding.button.BackgroundColor3 = binding.button.BackgroundColor3:Lerp(body, 0.65)
      end
    end
  end)
  if enabled() and not editing then
    attach(gameInfo.getDeflectAbility())
  end
  return true
end
function Dynamic.teardown()
  epoch += 1
  held = nil
  stop()
  restore()
  disconnect(connections)
  utils, gameInfo, cooldownInfo, remote = nil, nil, nil, nil
end
function Dynamic.getStatus()
  return { active = active, held = held ~= nil, protectedUntil = protectedUntil, attached = binding ~= nil, lastStopReason = lastStopReason }
end
Dynamic.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { canSend = "combat.runtime" } },
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    Cooldown = "cooldown",
    Remote = "remote",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "setDynamicSpamActive", "isDynamicSpamActive", "getConfigValue", "isActive", "getLocalPlayer", "getPlayers", "getRunService", "observeConfig" },
    GameInfo = { "getDeflectAbility", "getAveragePing", "getNativeButtonAnimations", "getSnapshotAt", "getBallSpeedLimits", "getPlayerMotion" },
    Cooldown = { "getDeflectCooldownState" },
    Remote = { "fireNativeParry" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "canSend", "getStatus" },
}

return Dynamic
sources.hubs/phantom-ball/combat/spam.luau:
-- [[ spam ]]
--!optimize 2

local Spam = {}

local Utils
local Remote
local GameInfo
local AutoSpam
local DynamicParry
local spamObserver
local configObserver
local generation = 0
local running = false
local currentMode
local currentRate
local status = {
  phase = "stopped",
  lastRequestAt = 0,
  lastError = nil,
  lastErrorAt = -math.huge,
}

local samples = {}
local head = 1
local tail = 0
local attempts = 0
local accepted = 0

-- statistics
local function clearSamples()
  table.clear(samples)
  head, tail = 1, 0
  attempts, accepted = 0, 0
end
local function expireSamples(now)
  while head <= tail and now - samples[head].at >= 1 do
    local sample = samples[head]
    sample.live = false
    attempts -= sample.attempts
    accepted -= sample.accepted
    samples[head] = nil
    head += 1
  end
  if head > tail then
    clearSamples()
  elseif head > 128 then
    local count = tail - head + 1
    table.move(samples, head, tail, 1)
    for i = count + 1, tail do
      samples[i] = nil
    end
    head, tail = 1, count
  end
end
local function newSample()
  local now = os.clock()
  expireSamples(now)
  local sample = {
    at = now,
    attempts = 0,
    accepted = 0,
    live = true,
  }

  tail += 1
  samples[tail] = sample
  return sample
end

-- configuration
local function getRate()
  local mode = Utils.getConfigValue("SpamRateMode")
  if mode ~= "Auto" and mode ~= "CPF" and mode ~= "CPS" and mode ~= "MS" then
    mode = "CPS"
  end
  if mode == "Auto" then
    return mode, 1
  end
  local rate = tonumber(Utils.getConfigValue(mode)) or 0
  if rate ~= rate or rate <= 0 or rate == math.huge then
    return mode, 0
  end
  if mode == "MS" then
    rate = 1000 / rate
  end
  if rate == math.huge then
    return mode, 0
  end
  return mode, rate
end

-- state
local function transition(phase, reason)
  if status.phase == phase then
    return
  end
  local previous = status.phase
  status.phase = phase
  if Utils and type(Utils.recordTransition) == "function" then
    pcall(Utils.recordTransition, "Spam", previous, phase, reason)
  end
end
local function stop(reason)
  generation += 1
  running, currentMode, currentRate = false, nil, nil
  transition("stopped", reason)
end
local function reportError(utils, err)
  status.lastError = tostring(err)
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - status.lastErrorAt < 1 then
    return
  end
  status.lastErrorAt = now
  local ok, message = pcall(utils.recordError, "Spam", status.lastError)
  if not ok then
    warn("[Spam] " .. tostring(message))
  end
end

-- engine
local function run(token, mode, rate, U, R, G, A, D)
  local heartbeat = U.getRunService().Heartbeat
  local function active() return token == generation and U.isActive() and (U.isManualSpamActive() or U.isAutoSpamActive() or U.isDynamicSpamActive()) end
  local function canSend()
    if not active() then
      return false
    end
    if U.isDynamicSpamActive() then
      return D.canSend()
    end
    if U.isManualSpamActive() then
      return A.canSendManual()
    end
    return A.canSend()
  end
  local prepared = type(R.prepareParry) == "function" and R.prepareParry(canSend) or function() return R.fireParry(1, canSend) end
  local function dispatch()
    if U.isDynamicSpamActive() then
      return R.fireNativeParry(canSend)
    end
    return prepared()
  end
  local function send(count)
    local sample
    for _ = 1, count do
      if not canSend() then
        break
      end
      if not sample then
        sample = newSample()
      end
      sample.attempts += 1
      attempts += 1
      status.lastRequestAt = os.clock()
      local result, detail = dispatch()
      if token ~= generation then
        break
      end
      if result == true then
        if sample.live then
          sample.accepted += 1
          accepted += 1
        end
        status.lastError = nil
      elseif detail == "Deflect recusado" or detail == "Deflect recusado pelo cliente" or detail == "Deflect cancelado" then
        status.lastError = nil
      else
        reportError(U, detail or "Remote.fireParry indisponível")
      end
      if detail == "Deflect cancelado" and not U.isManualSpamActive() then
        break
      end
    end
  end
  local function autoReady()
    local delay = G.getAutoSpamDelay()
    local minimum = G.getMinimumSpamInterval()
    if type(minimum) ~= "number" or minimum ~= minimum or minimum <= 0 or minimum == math.huge then
      minimum = 0.0301
    end
    return (delay == nil or (type(delay) == "number" and delay == delay and delay <= 0)) and os.clock() - status.lastRequestAt >= minimum
  end
  if mode == "CPF" then
    local credit, frameId, frameDuration = 0, 0, 1 / 60
    local lastSent, lastSpacing
    while active() do
      frameId += 1
      local owner, started = frameId, os.clock()
      credit += rate
      local count = math.floor(credit)
      credit -= count
      if count > 0 then
        local spacing = frameDuration / count
        local expires = started + frameDuration
        local function slot(index)
          if owner ~= frameId or not active() then
            return
          end
          local now = os.clock()
          if now >= expires or index >= count then
            return
          end
          local due = started + index * spacing
          if now < due then
            task.delay(due - now, slot, index)
            return
          end
          if (not lastSent or now - lastSent + 1e-9 >= math.max(spacing, lastSpacing or 0)) and canSend() then
            local ok, err = pcall(send, 1)
            if not ok then
              reportError(U, err)
              return
            end
            lastSent, lastSpacing = os.clock(), spacing
          end
          local nextIndex = math.max(index + 1, math.floor((os.clock() - started) / spacing) + 1)
          if nextIndex < count then
            task.delay(math.max(0, started + nextIndex * spacing - os.clock()), slot, nextIndex)
          end
        end
        slot(0)
      end
      local before = os.clock()
      local dt = heartbeat:Wait()
      local elapsed = os.clock() - before
      if type(dt) == "number" and dt == dt and dt > 0 then
        frameDuration = dt
      elseif elapsed > 0 then
        frameDuration = elapsed
      end
    end
    frameId += 1
    return
  end
  local frameDuration = 1 / 60
  local function interval()
    local requested
    if mode == "Auto" then
      requested = G.getMinimumSpamInterval()
      if type(requested) ~= "number" or requested ~= requested or requested <= 0 or requested == math.huge then
        requested = 0.0301
      end
    elseif mode == "CPF" then
      requested = frameDuration / rate
    else
      requested = 1 / rate
    end
    return requested
  end
  local nextAt = math.max(os.clock(), status.lastRequestAt > 0 and status.lastRequestAt + interval() or 0)
  while active() do
    local now = os.clock()
    if now >= nextAt then
      if canSend() and (mode ~= "Auto" or autoReady()) then
        send(1)
        nextAt = os.clock() + interval()
      else
        nextAt = now + interval()
      end
    end
    if not active() then
      break
    end
    if mode == "CPF" then
      local before = os.clock()
      local dt = heartbeat:Wait()
      local elapsed = os.clock() - before
      if type(dt) == "number" and dt == dt and dt > 0 then
        frameDuration = dt
      elseif elapsed > 0 then
        frameDuration = elapsed
      end
    else
      task.wait(math.max(0, nextAt - os.clock()))
    end
  end
end

-- synchronization
local function sync()
  if not Utils or not Remote then
    return
  end
  local mode, rate = getRate()
  local enabled = Utils.isActive() and rate > 0 and (Utils.isManualSpamActive() or Utils.isAutoSpamActive() or Utils.isDynamicSpamActive())
  if not enabled then
    if running then
      stop("spam_disabled")
    end
    return
  end
  if running and currentMode == mode and currentRate == rate then
    return
  end
  if running then
    stop("rate_changed")
  end
  generation += 1
  local token = generation
  local U, R, G, A, D = Utils, Remote, GameInfo, AutoSpam, DynamicParry
  running = true
  currentMode, currentRate = mode, rate
  transition("running", "spam_active")
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok, err = xpcall(function() run(token, mode, rate, U, R, G, A, D) end, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message), 2) end)
    if token ~= generation then
      return
    end
    stop(ok and "spam_disabled" or "spam_error")
    if not ok then
      reportError(U, err)
      local retryToken = generation
      task.delay(0.03, function()
        if retryToken == generation and Utils == U and U.isActive() then
          sync()
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
end

-- lifecycle
function Spam.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências inválidas"
  end
  for name, methods in pairs(Spam.__contract.requiresMethods) do
    local dependency = deps[name]
    if type(dependency) ~= "table" then
      return false, "dependência ausente: " .. name
    end
    for _, method in ipairs(methods) do
      if method ~= "prepareParry" and type(dependency[method]) ~= "function" then
        return false, name .. "." .. method .. " ausente"
      end
    end
  end
  Spam.teardown()
  Utils = deps.Utils
  Remote = deps.Remote
  GameInfo = deps.GameInfo
  AutoSpam = deps.AutoSpam
  DynamicParry = deps.DynamicParry
  spamObserver = Utils.observeSpam(sync)
  configObserver = Utils.observeConfig(function(changes)
    if changes and (changes.SpamRateMode ~= nil or changes.CPS ~= nil or changes.CPF ~= nil or changes.MS ~= nil) then
      sync()
    end
  end)
  Utils.trackGlobal(spamObserver)
  Utils.trackGlobal(configObserver)
  sync()
  return true
end
function Spam.resetState()
  stop("reset")
  status.lastError = nil
  status.lastErrorAt = -math.huge
  clearSamples()
  local token = generation
  task.defer(function()
    if token == generation then
      sync()
    end
  end)
end
function Spam.teardown()
  stop("teardown")
  clearSamples()
  status.lastRequestAt = 0
  status.lastError = nil
  status.lastErrorAt = -math.huge
  if Utils then
    if spamObserver then
      Utils.untrackGlobal(spamObserver)
      spamObserver:Disconnect()
    end
    if configObserver then
      Utils.untrackGlobal(configObserver)
      configObserver:Disconnect()
    end
  end
  spamObserver, configObserver = nil, nil
  Utils, Remote, GameInfo, AutoSpam, DynamicParry = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end
function Spam.getStatus()
  expireSamples(os.clock())
  return {
    schema = Utils and Utils.apiVersion() or 1,
    phase = status.phase,
    lastRequestAt = status.lastRequestAt,
    lastError = status.lastError,
    attemptsLastSecond = attempts,
    acceptedLastSecond = accepted,
    cpfFps = 0,
    cpfClicks = 0,
    cpfCompensation = false,
  }
end

-- contract
Spam.__contract = {
  access = { methods = { resetState = "combat.runtime" } },
  requires = {
    Remote = "remote",
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    AutoSpam = "autospam",
    DynamicParry = "dynamicparry",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Remote = {
      "fireParry",
      "prepareParry",
      "fireNativeParry",
    },
    AutoSpam = {
      "canSend",
      "canSendManual",
    },
    DynamicParry = {
      "canSend",
    },
    GameInfo = {
      "getAutoSpamDelay",
      "getMinimumSpamInterval",
    },
    Utils = {
      "apiVersion",
      "getConfigValue",
      "getRunService",
      "isActive",
      "isManualSpamActive",
      "isAutoSpamActive",
      "isDynamicSpamActive",
      "observeSpam",
      "observeConfig",
      "trackGlobal",
      "untrackGlobal",
      "recordError",
      "recordTransition",
    },
  },
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "resetState",
    "teardown",
    "getStatus",
  },
}

return Spam

-- [[ combat loop ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local CombatLoop = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local profiler
local autoSpam
local autoParry
local autoDash
local fierce
local cooldown
local scope
local running = false
local errorAt = {}
local function invoke(name, callback, ...)
  if not utils or not profiler then
    return
  end
  local metrics, reporting = profiler, utils
  local started = metrics.begin(name)
  local ok, message = pcall(callback, ...)
  metrics.finish(name, started)
  if not ok then
    local now = os.clock()
    if not errorAt[name] or now - errorAt[name] >= 1 then
      errorAt[name] = now
      reporting.recordError(name, message)
    end
  end
end
local function dispatch(data, dt)
  if not utils or not utils.isActive() then
    return
  end
  local info, spam, parry, rescue, cd, dash = gameInfo, autoSpam, autoParry, fierce, cooldown, autoDash
  info.beginEvaluation()
  invoke("combat.cooldown", cd.step)
  local automatic = utils.getConfigValue("AutoSpam") == true or spam.isActive()
  if data then
    if automatic then
      invoke("combat.autospam", spam.onBallSync, data)
    end
    invoke("combat.autoparry", parry.onBallSync, data)
    invoke("combat.autodash", dash.onBallSync, data)
  else
    if automatic then
      invoke("combat.autospam", spam.step, dt)
    end
    invoke("combat.autoparry", parry.step, dt)
  end
  invoke("combat.fierce", rescue.onBallSync)
  info.endEvaluation()
end
local function evaluate(data, dt)
  if running then
    return
  end
  running = true
  local info, reporting = gameInfo, utils
  local ok, reason = pcall(dispatch, data, dt)
  running = false
  if not ok then
    if info then
      pcall(info.endEvaluation)
    end
    if reporting then
      reporting.recordError("CombatLoop", reason)
    end
  end
end
function CombatLoop.pulse(dt) evaluate(nil, dt) end
function CombatLoop.onBallSync(data) evaluate(data) end
function CombatLoop.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  running = false
  table.clear(errorAt)
  utils, gameInfo, profiler, autoSpam, autoParry, fierce, cooldown, autoDash = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end
function CombatLoop.setup(deps)
  CombatLoop.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, profiler = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.Profiler
  autoSpam, autoParry, fierce, cooldown, autoDash = deps.AutoSpam, deps.AutoParry, deps.AutoFierce, deps.Cooldown, deps.AutoDash
  scope = deps.Lifetime.scope()
  local service = utils.getRunService()
  scope.connect(service.PostSimulation or service.Heartbeat, CombatLoop.pulse)
  if service.PreSimulation then
    scope.connect(service.PreSimulation, function(dt)
      if autoParry.isDeadlineDue() then
        CombatLoop.pulse()
      end
    end)
  end
  scope.add(gameInfo.observeTraining(CombatLoop.pulse))
  scope.add(cooldown.observeDeflect(CombatLoop.pulse))
  scope.add(utils.observeConfig(function() CombatLoop.pulse() end))
  return true
end
CombatLoop.__contract = {
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    Profiler = "profiler",
    Lifetime = "lifetime",
    AutoSpam = "autospam",
    AutoParry = "autoparry",
    AutoDash = "autodash",
    AutoFierce = "autofierce",
    Cooldown = "cooldown",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "isActive", "getRunService", "recordError", "observeConfig", "getConfigValue" },
    GameInfo = { "beginEvaluation", "endEvaluation", "observeTraining" },
    Profiler = { "begin", "finish" },
    Lifetime = { "scope" },
    AutoSpam = { "step", "onBallSync", "isActive" },
    AutoParry = { "step", "isDeadlineDue", "onBallSync" },
    AutoDash = { "onBallSync" },
    AutoFierce = { "onBallSync" },
    Cooldown = { "step", "observeDeflect" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "pulse", "onBallSync" },
  onBallSync = true,
}

return CombatLoop

-- [[ ballsync ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local BallSync = {}
function BallSync.setup() return true end
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function validBallSpeed(value) return finite(value) and value >= 0 and value <= 1000 end
local function finiteVector(value) return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z) end
function BallSync.create(deps)
  local Sync = {}
  local getReplicator, invalidateSnapshotCache = deps.getReplicator, deps.invalidateSnapshotCache
  local CONFIG = { PACKET_AGE = deps.packetAge }
  local lastSync, packet, packetAt, syncReceivedAt = nil, nil, 0, 0
  local receivedSequence
  local version, lastServerTime = 0, nil
  local nativeEntry
  local function syncData(provider)
    if provider == nil then
      provider = getReplicator()
    end
    if packet and os.clock() - packetAt > CONFIG.PACKET_AGE then
      packet = nil
    end
    if packet then
      local sequence = provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.lastSeq
      if type(sequence) ~= "number" or (packet.Sequence ~= sequence and (packet.Sequence - sequence) % 65536 < 32768) then
        return packet
      end
      packet = nil
    end
    local sequence = provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.lastSeq
    if lastSync and receivedSequence and (not finite(sequence) or (receivedSequence ~= sequence and (receivedSequence - sequence) % 65536 < 32768)) then
      return lastSync
    end
    local data = provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.syncData or lastSync
    if type(data) ~= "table" then
      data = provider and provider.syncData
    end
    return type(data) == "table" and data or nil
  end
  local function syncSequence(current, provider)
    if packet and current == packet then
      return packet.Sequence
    end
    local sequence = provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.lastSeq or nil
    if not finite(sequence) then
      return receivedSequence
    end
    if receivedSequence and (receivedSequence - sequence) % 65536 < 32768 then
      return receivedSequence
    end
    return sequence
  end
  function Sync.applyPacket(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
      return false
    end
    if value.Speed ~= nil and not validBallSpeed(value.Speed) then
      return false
    end
    if value.MaxSpeed ~= nil and not validBallSpeed(value.MaxSpeed) then
      return false
    end
    if value.RealPosition ~= nil and not finiteVector(value.RealPosition) then
      return false
    end
    if value.ServerTime ~= nil and (not finite(value.ServerTime) or (lastServerTime and value.ServerTime < lastServerTime)) then
      return false
    end
    local sequence = value.Sequence
    if not finite(sequence) or sequence < 0 or sequence >= 65536 or sequence % 1 ~= 0 then
      return false
    end
    if receivedSequence ~= nil then
      local delta = (sequence - receivedSequence) % 65536
      if delta == 0 or delta >= 32768 then
        return false
      end
    end
    local provider = getReplicator()
    local previous = provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.lastSeq
    if finite(previous) and (sequence - previous) % 65536 >= 32768 then
      return false
    end
    packet, packetAt = table.clone(value), os.clock()
    syncReceivedAt = packetAt
    receivedSequence, lastSync = sequence, packet
    lastServerTime = value.ServerTime or lastServerTime
    version += 1
    invalidateSnapshotCache()
    return true
  end
  local function decodeBallPacketFallback(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "buffer" or buffer.len(value) < 92 then
      return nil
    end
    local flags = buffer.readu8(value, 0)
    local serverTime = buffer.readf64(value, 3)
    local x, y, z = buffer.readf32(value, 11), buffer.readf32(value, 15), buffer.readf32(value, 19)
    local dx, dy, dz = buffer.readf32(value, 23), buffer.readf32(value, 27), buffer.readf32(value, 31)
    local speed, accel, maximum = buffer.readf32(value, 35), buffer.readf32(value, 39), buffer.readf32(value, 43)
    local curve, curveMax = buffer.readf32(value, 47), buffer.readf32(value, 51)
    local target, highlight, possessor = buffer.readf64(value, 55), buffer.readf64(value, 63), buffer.readf64(value, 83)
    if
      not finite(serverTime)
      or not finite(x)
      or not finite(y)
      or not finite(z)
      or not finite(dx)
      or not finite(dy)
      or not finite(dz)
      or not validBallSpeed(speed)
      or not finite(accel)
      or not validBallSpeed(maximum)
      or not finite(curve)
      or curve < 0
      or not finite(curveMax)
      or curveMax < 0
      or not finite(target)
      or not finite(highlight)
      or not finite(possessor)
    then
      return nil
    end
    return {
      seq = buffer.readu16(value, 1),
      serverTime = serverTime,
      position = Vector3.new(x, y, z),
      direction = Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz),
      speed = speed,
      accel = accel,
      maxSpeed = maximum,
      targetId = target,
      highlightId = highlight,
      possessorId = possessor,
      teleported = bit32.btest(flags, 1),
      locked = bit32.btest(flags, 2),
      grace = bit32.btest(flags, 4),
      oldGrace = bit32.btest(flags, 8),
      possessed = bit32.btest(flags, 32),
      forceDirection = bit32.btest(flags, 16),
      curveTime = curve,
      curveTimeMax = curveMax,
      curveAxis = Vector3.new(buffer.readf32(value, 71), buffer.readf32(value, 75), buffer.readf32(value, 79)),
      bouncesLeft = buffer.readu8(value, 91),
      flightTime = buffer.len(value) >= 96 and buffer.readf32(value, 92) or nil,
      noSpeedFeel = bit32.btest(flags, 128),
    }
  end
  function Sync.decodeBallPacket(value)
    local ok, provider = pcall(getReplicator)
    local decoded
    if ok and provider and type(provider.Decode) == "function" then
      local success, result = pcall(provider.Decode, provider, value)
      if success then
        decoded = result
      else
        decoded = decodeBallPacketFallback(value)
      end
    else
      decoded = decodeBallPacketFallback(value)
    end
    if type(decoded) ~= "table" then
      decoded = decodeBallPacketFallback(value)
    end
    if type(decoded) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    if not finiteVector(decoded.position) or not finiteVector(decoded.direction) or not validBallSpeed(decoded.speed) then
      return nil
    end
    if decoded.maxSpeed ~= nil and not validBallSpeed(decoded.maxSpeed) then
      return nil
    end
    return {
      Sequence = decoded.seq,
      ServerTime = decoded.serverTime,
      TeleportSequence = decoded.seq,
      Teleported = decoded.teleported,
      Locked = decoded.locked,
      Grace = decoded.grace,
      OldGrace = decoded.oldGrace,
      TargetPlayerID = decoded.targetId,
      HighlightTargetPlayerID = decoded.highlightId,
      PossessorId = decoded.possessed and decoded.possessorId or 0,
      RealPosition = decoded.position,
      ForcedDirection = decoded.direction,
      Speed = decoded.speed,
      Accel = decoded.accel,
      MaxSpeed = decoded.maxSpeed,
      ForceDirection = decoded.forceDirection,
      CurveTime = decoded.curveTime,
      CurveTimeMax = decoded.curveTimeMax,
      CurveAxis = decoded.curveAxis,
      BouncesLeft = decoded.bouncesLeft,
      FlightTime = decoded.flightTime,
      NoSpeedFeel = decoded.noSpeedFeel,
    }
  end
  function Sync.applySync(value)
    local explicit = value ~= nil
    if type(value) == "table" and type(value.syncData) == "table" then
      value = value.syncData
    end
    local provider = getReplicator()
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
      value = provider and provider.syncData
    end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
      return nil
    end
    if value.Speed ~= nil and not validBallSpeed(value.Speed) then
      return nil
    end
    if value.MaxSpeed ~= nil and not validBallSpeed(value.MaxSpeed) then
      return nil
    end
    if value.RealPosition ~= nil and not finiteVector(value.RealPosition) then
      return nil
    end
    if value.Sequence ~= nil and not finite(value.Sequence) then
      return nil
    end
    if value.ServerTime ~= nil and (not finite(value.ServerTime) or (lastServerTime and value.ServerTime < lastServerTime)) then
      return nil
    end
    local sequence = value.Sequence or (provider and provider.hasState == true and provider.lastSeq)
    if finite(sequence) then
      if sequence < 0 or sequence >= 65536 or sequence % 1 ~= 0 then
        return nil
      end
      if receivedSequence ~= nil then
        local delta = (sequence - receivedSequence) % 65536
        if delta >= 32768 then
          return nil
        end
        if delta == 0 then
          return nil
        end
      end
      receivedSequence = sequence
    elseif not explicit then
      return syncData(provider)
    end
    lastSync, packet, syncReceivedAt = table.clone(value), nil, os.clock()
    if finite(sequence) then
      lastSync.Sequence = sequence
    end
    lastServerTime = value.ServerTime or lastServerTime
    version += 1
    invalidateSnapshotCache()
    return lastSync
  end
  local function detachNative()
    local entry = nativeEntry
    nativeEntry = nil
    if not entry then
      return
    end
    entry.active, entry.handler, entry.serverNow, entry.report = false, nil, nil, nil
    if entry.provider.ApplySnapshot == entry.wrapper then
      entry.provider.ApplySnapshot = entry.original
    end
  end
  function Sync.bindNative(handler)
    local provider = getReplicator()
    if nativeEntry and nativeEntry.provider == provider then
      nativeEntry.handler = handler
      return true
    end
    detachNative()
    if not provider or type(provider.ApplySnapshot) ~= "function" then
      return false
    end
    local entry = { provider = provider, original = provider.ApplySnapshot, active = true, handler = handler, serverNow = deps.serverNow, report = deps.report }
    local function freshNative(sample)
      if type(sample) ~= "table" or not finite(sample.serverTime) then
        return false
      end
      local now = entry.serverNow and entry.serverNow()
      return finite(now) and now - sample.serverTime >= -0.02 and now - sample.serverTime <= 0.25
    end
    local function receive(sample, ...)
      if
        entry.active
        and entry.handler
        and freshNative(sample)
        and finite(sample.serverTime)
        and finiteVector(sample.position)
        and validBallSpeed(sample.speed)
        and (sample.direction == nil or finiteVector(sample.direction))
      then
        local packet = {
          Sequence = sample.seq,
          ServerTime = sample.serverTime,
          RealPosition = sample.position,
          ForcedDirection = sample.direction,
          Speed = sample.speed,
          TargetPlayerID = sample.targetId,
          HighlightTargetPlayerID = sample.highlightId,
          MaxSpeed = sample.maxSpeed,
          Accel = sample.accel,
          Teleported = sample.teleported,
          Locked = sample.locked,
          Grace = sample.grace,
          OldGrace = sample.oldGrace,
          PossessorId = sample.possessed and (sample.possessorId or 1) or 0,
          CurveTime = sample.curveTime,
          CurveTimeMax = sample.curveTimeMax,
          CurveAxis = sample.curveAxis,
          BouncesLeft = sample.bouncesLeft,
          FlightTime = sample.flightTime,
          NoSpeedFeel = sample.noSpeedFeel,
        }

        local ok, detail = pcall(entry.handler, packet)
        if not ok and entry.report then
          entry.report(detail)
        end
      end
      return ...
    end
    entry.wrapper = function(self, sample, ...) return receive(sample, entry.original(self, sample, ...)) end
    provider.ApplySnapshot = entry.wrapper
    nativeEntry = entry
    local history = provider.history
    local latest = type(history) == "table" and history[#history]
    if latest then
      receive(latest)
    end
    return true
  end
  function Sync.destroy() detachNative() end
  function Sync.getVersion() return version end
  Sync.getData = syncData
  Sync.getSequence = syncSequence
  function Sync.getReceivedAt() return syncReceivedAt end
  return Sync
end
BallSync.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }

return BallSync

-- [[ cooldown ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local Cooldown = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local cooldownConnection
local parriedConnection
local nativeParriedConnection
local nativeParriedSignal
local trainingConnection
local trainingRemote
local cooldown
local signalAt
local heldAt
local missingAt
local warningAt
local deflectAttempt
local observedAbility
local blockingSince
local previousBlocking
local cooldownEpisode
local trainingSharedModule
local trainingShared
local trainingLockoutUntil
local trainingAttemptUntil
local cooldownSignal
local parriedSignal
local epoch = 0
local observers = {}

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  COOLDOWN_RETRY = 0.5,
  HELD_COOLDOWN_INTERVAL = 0.05,
  TRAINING_RETRY = 0.5,
  GAME_IDS = {
    DEFLECT = 1,
    COOLDOWN_REMOTE = 5.520474058077904e76,
    PARRIED_REMOTE = 9.611859444202098e76,
    COOLDOWN_EVENT = 5.93848805167512e76,
    COOLDOWN_STOP = 6.60750295352893e76,
  },
}

-- helpers
local nextTrainingAt = 0
local nextParriedAt = 0
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
function Cooldown.observeDeflect(callback)
  assert(type(callback) == "function", "cooldown callback required")
  local entry = { Connected = true }
  function entry:Disconnect()
    self.Connected = false
    observers[self] = nil
  end
  observers[entry] = callback
  return entry
end
local function notify()
  local current = Cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState()
  for entry, callback in pairs(table.clone(observers)) do
    if entry.Connected then
      local ok, detail = pcall(callback, current)
      if not ok and utils then
        utils.recordError("Cooldown.observer", tostring(detail))
      end
    end
  end
end
local function child(parent, name) return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) end
local function disconnect(connection)
  if not connection then
    return
  end
  if utils then
    utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
  end
  connection:Disconnect()
end
local function report(name, message)
  if utils then
    utils.recordError("Cooldown", name .. ": " .. tostring(message))
  end
end
local function generatedRemote(id)
  local storage = utils and utils.getReplicatedStorage()
  local root = child(storage, "Shared") or child(storage, "TS")
  local remotes = child(child(root, "Network"), "GeneratedNetworkRemotes") or child(root, "GeneratedNetworkRemotes")
  local remote = child(remotes, "RE_" .. tostring(id))
  return remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and remote or nil
end
local function confirmParry(native)
  if not cooldown or not utils then
    return
  end
  local now = os.clock()
  if native and cooldown.lastNativeParriedAt and now - cooldown.lastNativeParriedAt < 0.008 then
    return
  end
  if native then
    cooldown.lastNativeParriedAt = now
  end
  cooldown.lastParriedAt = now
  cooldown.confirmationVersion = (cooldown.confirmationVersion or 0) + 1
  cooldown.active, cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.endsAt, cooldown.lastEventAt = false, false, nil, now
  if deflectAttempt then
    deflectAttempt.missed, deflectAttempt.confirmed = false, true
  end
  notify()
end
function Cooldown.getTrainingMissCooldown()
  local storage = utils and utils.getReplicatedStorage()
  local module = child(child(storage, "Training"), "TrainingShared")
  if module ~= trainingSharedModule then
    trainingSharedModule, trainingShared = module, nil
  end
  if module and not trainingShared and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
    local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
    if ok and type(value) == "table" then
      trainingShared = value
    end
  end
  local duration = trainingShared and trainingShared.MissCooldown
  return finite(duration) and duration > 0 and duration or 1.45
end
function Cooldown.recordTrainingDeflectAttempt(time)
  if finite(time) then
    trainingAttemptUntil = time + Cooldown.getTrainingMissCooldown()
  end
end
function Cooldown.getTrainingCooldownState()
  local now = os.clock()
  local endsAt = math.max(trainingAttemptUntil or 0, trainingLockoutUntil or 0)
  return {
    known = trainingAttemptUntil ~= nil or trainingLockoutUntil ~= nil,
    blocking = now < endsAt,
    remaining = math.max(0, endsAt - now),
    endsAt = endsAt > 0 and endsAt or nil,
  }
end
local function bindTraining(now)
  if now < nextTrainingAt then
    return
  end
  nextTrainingAt = now + CONFIG.TRAINING_RETRY
  local storage = utils.getReplicatedStorage()
  local event = child(child(child(storage, "Training"), "Remotes"), "Event")
  if not event or not event:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    event = nil
  end
  if trainingConnection and (trainingConnection.Connected == false or trainingRemote ~= event) then
    disconnect(trainingConnection)
    trainingConnection, trainingRemote = nil, nil
  end
  if trainingConnection then
    return
  end
  if not event then
    return
  end
  trainingRemote = event
  local owner = epoch
  trainingConnection = event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, value)
    if owner ~= epoch or trainingRemote ~= event or not utils then
      return
    end
    local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
    if kind == "BallSpawn" or (kind == "Parry" and player and value == player.UserId) then
      trainingLockoutUntil, trainingAttemptUntil = nil, nil
      notify()
    elseif kind == "Lockout" then
      local duration = finite(value) and value >= 0 and value or Cooldown.getTrainingMissCooldown()
      trainingLockoutUntil = os.clock() + duration
      notify()
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(trainingConnection)
end
function Cooldown.getDeflectServerEvents()
  local first, second = generatedRemote(CONFIG.GAME_IDS.COOLDOWN_REMOTE), generatedRemote(CONFIG.GAME_IDS.PARRIED_REMOTE)
  if not first and not second then
    return nil
  end
  return { cooldown = first and first.OnClientEvent or nil, parried = second and second.OnClientEvent or nil }
end
function Cooldown.decodeDeflectServerEvent(abilityId, eventId, value)
  if abilityId ~= CONFIG.GAME_IDS.DEFLECT then
    return nil
  end
  if eventId == CONFIG.GAME_IDS.COOLDOWN_EVENT and finite(value) then
    return value > 0 and "started" or "reset", math.max(value, 0)
  end
  if eventId == CONFIG.GAME_IDS.COOLDOWN_STOP then
    return "stopped", 0
  end
  return nil
end
function Cooldown.getHeldDeflectServerCooldown()
  local ability = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
  if not ability then
    return nil
  end
  local duration, received = ability.HeldServerCooldown, ability.HeldServerCooldownAt
  if finite(duration) and duration > 0 and finite(received) then
    return duration, received
  end
  return nil
end
function Cooldown.recordDeflectAttempt(pressedAt)
  if not finite(pressedAt) or pressedAt <= 0 then
    return
  end
  local ability = gameInfo and gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
  if ability ~= observedAbility then
    observedAbility, deflectAttempt, blockingSince, previousBlocking = ability, nil, nil, nil
  end
  if deflectAttempt and pressedAt <= deflectAttempt.pressedAt then
    return
  end
  local remaining = ability and ability.Cooldown
  deflectAttempt = {
    pressedAt = pressedAt,
    missed = false,
    initialCooldown = finite(remaining) and remaining > 0 and remaining or nil,
    acceptedAt = gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt(),
  }

end
function Cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState()
  if not cooldown or not utils or not gameInfo then
    return nil
  end
  local time = os.clock()
  if cooldownConnection and cooldownConnection.Connected == false then
    disconnect(cooldownConnection)
    cooldownConnection = nil
    cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.endsAt, cooldown.serverKnown, signalAt = false, nil, false, 0
  end
  if parriedConnection and parriedConnection.Connected == false then
    disconnect(parriedConnection)
    parriedConnection = nil
  end
  if time >= signalAt then
    signalAt = time + CONFIG.COOLDOWN_RETRY
    local signals = Cooldown.getDeflectServerEvents()
    local signal = signals and signals.cooldown
    if cooldownSignal ~= signal then
      disconnect(cooldownConnection)
      cooldownConnection, cooldownSignal = nil, signal
      cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.endsAt, cooldown.serverKnown = false, nil, false
    end
    if signal and not cooldownConnection then
      local owner = epoch
      cooldownConnection = signals.cooldown:Connect(function(abilityId, eventId, value)
        if owner ~= epoch or cooldownSignal ~= signal or not cooldown then
          return
        end
        local kind, duration = Cooldown.decodeDeflectServerEvent(abilityId, eventId, value)
        if not kind then
          return
        end
        cooldown.known, cooldown.serverKnown, cooldown.lastEventAt = true, true, os.clock()
        cooldown.rawActive = kind == "started"
        if kind == "started" then
          cooldown.lastStartedAt = cooldown.lastEventAt
        end
        cooldown.endsAt = cooldown.rawActive and cooldown.lastEventAt + duration or nil
        notify()
      end)
      utils.trackGlobal(cooldownConnection)
      missingAt = nil
    elseif not signal then
      missingAt = missingAt or time
      if time - missingAt >= 3 and time >= warningAt then
        warningAt = time + 10
        report("DeflectCooldown", "evento de cooldown do servidor indisponível")
      end
    end
  end
  if time >= nextParriedAt then
    nextParriedAt = time + CONFIG.COOLDOWN_RETRY
    local native = gameInfo.getParrySignal()
    if nativeParriedSignal ~= native or (nativeParriedConnection and nativeParriedConnection.Connected == false) then
      disconnect(nativeParriedConnection)
      nativeParriedConnection, nativeParriedSignal = nil, native
    end
    if native and not nativeParriedConnection then
      local owner = epoch
      nativeParriedConnection = native:Connect(function(kind, ownerId)
        local player = utils and utils.getLocalPlayer()
        if owner == epoch and nativeParriedSignal == native and kind == "parry" and player and ownerId == player.UserId then
          confirmParry(true)
        end
      end)
      utils.trackGlobal(nativeParriedConnection)
    end
    local signals = Cooldown.getDeflectServerEvents()
    local signal = signals and signals.parried
    if parriedSignal ~= signal then
      disconnect(parriedConnection)
      parriedConnection, parriedSignal = nil, signal
    end
    if signal and not parriedConnection then
      local owner = epoch
      parriedConnection = signals.parried:Connect(function()
        if owner ~= epoch or parriedSignal ~= signal or not cooldown then
          return
        end
        if nativeParriedConnection and nativeParriedConnection.Connected ~= false then
          cooldown.active, cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.endsAt, cooldown.lastEventAt = false, false, nil, os.clock()
          notify()
        else
          confirmParry(false)
        end
      end)
      utils.trackGlobal(parriedConnection)
    end
  end
  if not cooldown.rawActive and time >= heldAt then
    heldAt = time + CONFIG.HELD_COOLDOWN_INTERVAL
    local duration, received = Cooldown.getHeldDeflectServerCooldown()
    if duration and received and received <= time and time < received + duration and received > cooldown.lastEventAt + 0.01 then
      cooldown.known, cooldown.serverKnown, cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.lastEventAt, cooldown.endsAt = true, true, true, received, received + duration
      cooldown.lastStartedAt = received
    end
  end
  if cooldown.rawActive and finite(cooldown.endsAt) and time >= cooldown.endsAt then
    cooldown.rawActive, cooldown.endsAt = false, nil
  end
  local ability = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
  if ability ~= observedAbility then
    observedAbility, deflectAttempt, blockingSince, previousBlocking = ability, nil, nil, nil
  end
  local localKnown = ability ~= nil and finite(ability.Cooldown)
  local localRemaining = localKnown and math.max(0, ability.Cooldown) or nil
  local serverRemaining = cooldown.rawActive and finite(cooldown.endsAt) and math.max(0, cooldown.endsAt - time) or 0
  if localKnown then
    cooldown.known = true
  end
  local serverKnown = cooldown.serverKnown and cooldownConnection ~= nil and cooldownConnection.Connected ~= false
  if localKnown then
    cooldown.remaining, cooldown.source = localRemaining, "local"
  elseif serverKnown then
    cooldown.remaining, cooldown.source = serverRemaining, "server"
  else
    cooldown.remaining, cooldown.source = nil, "unknown"
  end
  cooldown.active = nil
  if cooldown.remaining ~= nil then
    cooldown.active = cooldown.remaining > 0
  end
  cooldown.blocking = cooldown.active
  cooldown.predictedReset = ability and finite(ability.PredictedResetUntil) and time < ability.PredictedResetUntil or false
  local acceptedAt = gameInfo.getLastAcceptedDeflectAt()
  if
    finite(acceptedAt)
    and acceptedAt > 0
    and acceptedAt <= time
    and (not deflectAttempt or acceptedAt > math.max(deflectAttempt.pressedAt, deflectAttempt.nativePressAt or 0) + 0.000001)
  then
    Cooldown.recordDeflectAttempt(acceptedAt)
  end
  local pendingAt = ability and ability.PendingPressAt
  local pendingUntil = ability and ability.PendingPredictUntil
  if finite(pendingAt) and pendingAt > 0 and pendingAt <= time then
    if deflectAttempt and pendingAt >= deflectAttempt.pressedAt and pendingAt - deflectAttempt.pressedAt <= 0.01 then
      deflectAttempt.nativePressAt = pendingAt
    else
      Cooldown.recordDeflectAttempt(pendingAt)
    end
  end
  if deflectAttempt and finite(pendingAt) and finite(pendingUntil) and math.abs(pendingAt - deflectAttempt.pressedAt) <= 0.01 and pendingUntil >= pendingAt then
    deflectAttempt.windowEndsAt = pendingUntil
  end
  if cooldown.blocking then
    if previousBlocking ~= true then
      blockingSince = time
      cooldownEpisode = (cooldownEpisode or 0) + 1
      if deflectAttempt then
        deflectAttempt.initialCooldown = localRemaining
      end
    end
  elseif cooldown.blocking == false then
    if previousBlocking == true then
      cooldown.lastClearedAt = time
    end
    blockingSince = nil
  else
    blockingSince = nil
  end
  previousBlocking = cooldown.blocking
  cooldown.blockingSince, cooldown.episode = blockingSince, cooldownEpisode
  local attempt = deflectAttempt
  local parried = attempt and (attempt.confirmed == true or (finite(cooldown.lastParriedAt) and cooldown.lastParriedAt >= attempt.pressedAt)) or false
  local windowEndsAt = attempt and attempt.windowEndsAt
  local pendingOpen = finite(windowEndsAt) and time < windowEndsAt
  local acceptedAttempt = attempt and finite(attempt.acceptedAt) and math.abs(attempt.acceptedAt - attempt.pressedAt) <= 0.01
  local localBlocked = localKnown and localRemaining > 0
  local episodeAttempt = attempt
    and finite(blockingSince)
    and finite(attempt.pressedAt)
    and attempt.pressedAt <= time
    and attempt.pressedAt >= blockingSince - 0.5
  local threshold = nil
  local missActive = false
  if localBlocked and episodeAttempt and acceptedAttempt and not parried and not pendingOpen and not cooldown.predictedReset then
    local duration = finite(attempt.initialCooldown) and attempt.initialCooldown or localRemaining
    threshold = math.clamp(duration * 0.65, 0.08, 0.22)
    missActive = time - math.max(blockingSince, attempt.pressedAt) >= threshold
    if missActive then
      attempt.missed = true
    end
  end
  if parried and attempt then
    attempt.missed = false
  end
  cooldown.pressAt = attempt and attempt.pressedAt or nil
  cooldown.missDeadline = pendingOpen and windowEndsAt or nil
  cooldown.windowEndsAt, cooldown.windowExpired = windowEndsAt, finite(windowEndsAt) and time >= windowEndsAt
  local ping = missActive and gameInfo.getAveragePing() or 0
  cooldown.missConfirmed = missActive and finite(windowEndsAt) and time >= windowEndsAt + math.max(0, ping or 0) and not cooldown.predictedReset and not parried
  cooldown.pending = pendingOpen
  cooldown.acceptedAt = attempt and attempt.acceptedAt or nil
  cooldown.missThreshold = threshold
  cooldown.miss = not parried and (localBlocked and missActive or (not localBlocked and attempt and attempt.missed == true)) or false
  cooldown.outcome = parried and "parried" or (cooldown.miss and "miss" or "pending")
  if parried then
    cooldown.phase = "reverted"
  elseif localBlocked and missActive then
    cooldown.phase = "miss_cooldown"
  elseif localBlocked then
    cooldown.phase = "cooldown_pending"
  elseif cooldown.miss then
    cooldown.phase = "miss_finished"
  elseif cooldown.blocking == false then
    cooldown.phase = "ready"
  else
    cooldown.phase = "unknown"
  end
  cooldown.localRemaining = localRemaining
  cooldown.serverRemaining = serverRemaining
  return cooldown
end
function Cooldown.getDeflectRecoveryState(timeToImpact, responseLead)
  local current = Cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState()
  if not current then
    return nil
  end
  local known = current.source == "local"
  local blocked = known and current.blocking == true and finite(current.localRemaining) and current.localRemaining > 0
  return {
    cooldown = current,
    ready = known and current.blocking == false,
    recoveryIn = blocked and current.localRemaining or 0,
    needsFierce = blocked
      and current.miss == true
      and current.missConfirmed == true
      and not current.pending
      and not current.predictedReset
      and current.outcome == "miss",
  }
end

-- lifecycle
function Cooldown.step()
  if not utils then
    return
  end
  bindTraining(os.clock())
  Cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState()
end
function Cooldown.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes: Utils ou GameInfo"
  end
  Cooldown.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo
  cooldown = { known = false, active = false, rawActive = false, lastEventAt = -math.huge, lastParriedAt = -math.huge }
  signalAt, heldAt, missingAt, warningAt, nextTrainingAt = 0, 0, nil, 0, 0
  deflectAttempt, observedAbility, blockingSince, previousBlocking, cooldownEpisode = nil, nil, nil, nil, 0
  nextParriedAt = 0
  trainingSharedModule, trainingShared, trainingLockoutUntil, trainingAttemptUntil = nil, nil, nil, nil
  local service = utils.getRunService()
  if not service or not service.Heartbeat then
    return false, "Heartbeat indisponível"
  end
  bindTraining(os.clock())
  Cooldown.getDeflectCooldownState()
  return true
end
function Cooldown.teardown()
  epoch += 1
  for entry in pairs(observers) do
    entry.Connected = false
  end
  table.clear(observers)
  disconnect(nativeParriedConnection)
  nativeParriedConnection, nativeParriedSignal = nil, nil
  disconnect(cooldownConnection)
  disconnect(parriedConnection)
  disconnect(trainingConnection)
  cooldownConnection, parriedConnection, trainingConnection, trainingRemote = nil, nil, nil, nil
  cooldownSignal, parriedSignal = nil, nil
  cooldown, deflectAttempt, observedAbility, blockingSince, previousBlocking, cooldownEpisode = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  trainingSharedModule, trainingShared, trainingLockoutUntil, trainingAttemptUntil = nil, nil, nil, nil
  utils, gameInfo = nil, nil
end

-- contract
Cooldown.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", GameInfo = "gameinfo" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getRunService", "getReplicatedStorage", "getLocalPlayer", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal", "recordError" },
    GameInfo = { "getDeflectAbility", "getLastAcceptedDeflectAt", "getParrySignal", "getAveragePing" },
  },
  provides = {
    "step",
    "setup",
    "teardown",
    "getTrainingMissCooldown",
    "recordTrainingDeflectAttempt",
    "getTrainingCooldownState",
    "getDeflectServerEvents",
    "decodeDeflectServerEvent",
    "getHeldDeflectServerCooldown",
    "recordDeflectAttempt",
    "getDeflectCooldownState",
    "getDeflectRecoveryState",
    "observeDeflect",
  },
}

return Cooldown

-- [[ gameinfo ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local GameInfo = {}
local utils
local resolveTarget
local syncSequence
local registry
local profiler
local presenceTracker
local evaluationDepth = 0
local parryProjectionCache
local players
local world
local ball = nil
local searchAt = 0
local watching = false
local ballVisualConnection
local abilityScript
local abilities
local replicatorScript
local replicator
local gameBallScript
local gameBall
local ballSync
local targeting
local targetCache
local targetCacheAt
local targetAttributeAt = 0
local ballData
local dashAnimation
local minimumSpeed
local maximumSpeed
local speedAt
local syncConnection = nil
local syncRemote = nil
local snapshotConnection = nil
local snapshotRemote = nil
local maintenance = 0
local pingSamples, pingIndex, pingSum, pingSampleAt, pingRaw = {}, 0, 0, nil, nil
local trainingConnection = nil
local trainingRemote = nil
local trainingState = nil
local trainingSequence = 0
local trainingEventConnection
local trainingEventRemote
local trainingZone
local trainingRound = 0
local trainingDespawned = false
local trainingServerTime = nil
local trainingPacketFloor = -math.huge
local trainingObservers = {}
local trainingParryAt
local trainingDataModule
local trainingData
local ballFeelModule
local ballFeel
local trainingSharedModule
local trainingShared
local snapshotBuilder
local dashStateCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MIN_SPEED = 16,
  MAX_SPEED = 600,
  PACKET_AGE = 0.5,
  BALL_SEARCH_INTERVAL = 0.5,
  SYNC_CONNECTED_INTERVAL = 3,
  SYNC_RETRY_INTERVAL = 1,
  SPAM_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.008,
  SPEED_REFRESH = 0.5,
  SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 1 / 240,
  SAMPLE_MAX_GAP = 0.5,
  PING_SAMPLE_INTERVAL = 0.25,
  PING_SAMPLE_COUNT = 8,
  SNAPSHOT_CACHE_INTERVAL = 1 / 240,
  DASH_STATE_CACHE_INTERVAL = 1 / 30,
  GAME_IDS = {
    DEFLECT = 1,
    DASH = 2,
    FIERCE = 19,
    DARK = 20,
    HAUNTER_REMOTE = 9.150098456648103e76,
    DARK_EVENT = 2.4141700243704228e76,
    MANIFEST_REMOTE = 9.318024238496386e76,
    CRATE_CHECK = 4.702176977990345e76,
    CRATE_OWNED = 1.796923298985336e75,
    CRATE_NEW = 1.0038569313364564e77,
  },
}

minimumSpeed, maximumSpeed, speedAt = CONFIG.MIN_SPEED, CONFIG.MAX_SPEED, 0

-- helpers
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function validBallSpeed(value) return finite(value) and value >= 0 and value <= 1000 end
local function finiteVector(value) return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z) end
local function invalidateSnapshotCache()
  if snapshotBuilder then
    snapshotBuilder.invalidate()
  end
  targetCache, targetCacheAt = nil, -math.huge
end
local function child(parent, name) return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) end
local function load(module, name)
  if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
    error("API externa ausente: TS." .. tostring(name), 2)
  end
  local result = require(module)
  if type(result) ~= "table" then
    error("API externa inválida: TS." .. tostring(name) .. " não retornou tabela", 2)
  end
  return result
end
local function storage() return utils and utils.getReplicatedStorage() end
local function ts() return child(storage(), "Shared") or child(storage(), "TS") end
local function sharedLayout() return child(storage(), "Shared") ~= nil end
local function getTrainingSource()
  local module = child(child(storage(), "Training"), "TrainingShared")
  if module ~= trainingSharedModule then
    trainingSharedModule, trainingShared = module, nil
  end
  if module and not trainingShared then
    local ok, result = pcall(load, module, "TrainingShared")
    if ok then
      trainingShared = result
    end
  end
  return trainingShared
end
local function inTrainingArea()
  local player = players and players.LocalPlayer
  if not registry then
    return false
  end
  local _, _, _, root = registry.getParts(player and player.UserId)
  if not root then
    return false
  end
  local lives = player:GetAttribute("Lives")
  local module = child(child(ts(), "Core"), "GameData")
  if module ~= trainingDataModule then
    trainingDataModule, trainingData = module, nil
  end
  if module and not trainingData then
    local ok, result = pcall(load, module, "GameData")
    if ok then
      trainingData = result.GameData
    end
  end
  if trainingData and type(trainingData.GetFallback) == "function" then
    local ok, result = pcall(trainingData.GetFallback, trainingData, player, "Lives", 0)
    if ok then
      lives = result
    end
  end
  if finite(lives) and lives > 0 then
    return false
  end
  local source = getTrainingSource()
  if source and type(source.InZone) == "function" then
    local ok, inside = pcall(source.InZone, root.Position)
    if ok and type(inside) == "boolean" then
      return inside
    end
  end
  local area = trainingZone
  if not area or not area.Parent then
    area = child(child(child(world, "Training"), "Areas"), "Zone")
    trainingZone = area
  end
  if not area or not area:IsA("BasePart") then
    return false
  end
  local localPos, half = area.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position), area.Size / 2
  return math.abs(localPos.X) <= half.X and math.abs(localPos.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= half.Z
end
function GameInfo.isTrainingArea() return inTrainingArea() end
function GameInfo.fireTrainingParry()
  if not inTrainingArea() then
    return false, "fora da arena de treino"
  end
  local endpoint = child(child(child(storage(), "Training"), "Remotes"), "Block")
  local camera = world.CurrentCamera
  if not endpoint or not endpoint:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not camera then
    return false, "bloqueio de treino indisponível"
  end
  endpoint:FireServer(camera.CFrame.Position, camera.CFrame.LookVector)
  return true
end

-- abilities
local function getAbilities()
  if abilities and abilityScript and abilityScript.Parent then
    return abilities
  end
  local root = ts()
  local module = child(child(root, "Abilities"), "ClientAbilities") or child(root, "ClientAbilities")
  if abilityScript ~= module then
    abilityScript, abilities = module, nil
  end
  if not module then
    return nil
  end
  if not abilities then
    local value = load(module, "ClientAbilities")
    if type(value.Abilities) ~= "table" then
      error("API externa ausente: TS.ClientAbilities.Abilities", 2)
    end
    abilities = value.Abilities
  end
  return abilities
end
local function getAbility(index, method)
  local list = getAbilities()
  local ability = list and list[index]
  if ability == nil then
    return nil
  end
  if type(ability) ~= "table" or type(ability[method]) ~= "function" then
    error(("API externa ausente: ClientAbilities[%d].%s"):format(index, method), 2)
  end
  return ability
end
local function getReplicator()
  if replicator and replicatorScript and replicatorScript.Parent then
    return replicator
  end
  local root = ts()
  local folder = child(child(root, "Gameplay"), "BallReplicator") or child(root, "BallReplicator")
  local module = folder and (folder:IsA("ModuleScript") and folder or child(folder, "BallReplicator"))
  if module ~= replicatorScript then
    replicatorScript, replicator = module, nil
  end
  if not replicator and module then
    local ok, value = pcall(load, module, "BallReplicator")
    if ok then
      if type(value.BallReplicator) == "table" then
        replicator = value.BallReplicator
      elseif value.syncData ~= nil then
        replicator = value
      end
    end
  end
  return replicator
end
local function syncData(provider) return ballSync and ballSync.getData(provider) or nil end

-- targeting
function GameInfo.getBallTargetAttribute() return world:GetAttribute("GameBallTarget") end
local function findBall()
  local candidate = world:FindFirstChild("GameBall") or world:FindFirstChild("GameBall", true)
  if candidate and candidate:IsA("BasePart") then
    return candidate
  end
  return nil
end
local function getBall()
  if ball and ball.Parent then
    return ball
  end
  if watching and os.clock() < searchAt then
    return nil
  end
  local previous = ball
  ball, searchAt = findBall(), os.clock() + CONFIG.BALL_SEARCH_INTERVAL
  if previous ~= ball then
    invalidateSnapshotCache()
  end
  return ball
end
local function disconnect(connection)
  if connection then
    if utils and type(utils.untrackGlobal) == "function" then
      utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
    end
    connection:Disconnect()
  end
end

-- synchronization
local function validSyncRemote(instance)
  return typeof(instance) == "Instance" and (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) and instance.Parent ~= nil
end
local function disconnectSync()
  if syncConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(syncConnection)
    end
    syncConnection:Disconnect()
  end
  if snapshotConnection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(snapshotConnection)
    end
    snapshotConnection:Disconnect()
  end
  syncConnection, syncRemote, snapshotConnection, snapshotRemote = nil, nil, nil, nil
end
local function findSyncRemote()
  local replicated = storage()
  if not replicated then
    return nil
  end
  local remotes = replicated:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local candidate = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("BallSyncData")
  if validSyncRemote(candidate) then
    return candidate
  end
  candidate = replicated:FindFirstChild("BallSyncData")
  if validSyncRemote(candidate) then
    return candidate
  end
  candidate = replicated:FindFirstChild("BallSyncData", true)
  if validSyncRemote(candidate) then
    return candidate
  end
  return nil
end
local function notifyTraining()
  local listeners = table.clone(trainingObservers)
  for _, entry in ipairs(listeners) do
    if entry.Connected then
      local ok, err = pcall(entry.callback)
      if not ok then
        utils.recordError("Training.onState", err)
      end
    end
  end
end
function GameInfo.observeTraining(callback)
  assert(type(callback) == "function", "training callback required")
  local entry = { Connected = true, callback = callback }
  function entry:Disconnect()
    if not self.Connected then
      return
    end
    self.Connected = false
    local index = table.find(trainingObservers, self)
    if index then
      table.remove(trainingObservers, index)
    end
  end
  trainingObservers[#trainingObservers + 1] = entry
  return entry
end

local function bindTrainingSync()
  local remotes = child(child(storage(), "Training"), "Remotes")
  local event = child(remotes, "Event")
  if not validSyncRemote(event) then
    event = nil
  end
  if trainingEventRemote ~= event or (trainingEventConnection and not trainingEventConnection.Connected) then
    disconnect(trainingEventConnection)
    trainingEventConnection, trainingEventRemote = nil, event
    resetTrainingBall(false)
  end
  if event and not trainingEventConnection then
    trainingEventConnection = event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, playerId)
      if kind == "BallSpawn" then
        resetTrainingBall(false)
      elseif kind == "BallDespawn" or kind == "Kill" then
        resetTrainingBall(true)
      elseif kind == "Parry" and players.LocalPlayer and playerId == players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
        trainingParryAt = world:GetServerTimeNow()
        invalidateSnapshotCache()
      end
      notifyTraining()
    end)
    utils.trackGlobal(trainingEventConnection)
  end
  local training = child(remotes, "BallState")
  if not validSyncRemote(training) then
    training = nil
  end
  if trainingRemote ~= training or (trainingConnection and not trainingConnection.Connected) then
    disconnect(trainingConnection)
    trainingConnection, trainingRemote, trainingServerTime = nil, nil, nil
    resetTrainingBall(trainingDespawned)
  end
  if training and not trainingConnection then
    trainingRemote = training
    trainingConnection = training.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position, velocity, serverTime, goal, target, speed)
      if not finiteVector(position) or not finiteVector(velocity) or not finite(serverTime) then
        return
      end
      local receivedAt = os.clock()
      local age = world:GetServerTimeNow() - serverTime
      if age < -0.02 or age > 0.6 or serverTime <= trainingPacketFloor or (trainingServerTime and serverTime <= trainingServerTime) then
        return
      end
      if trainingDespawned then
        resetTrainingBall(false)
      end
      if speed == nil then
        speed = velocity.Magnitude
      end
      if not validBallSpeed(speed) then
        return
      end
      trainingServerTime = serverTime
      trainingSequence = (trainingSequence + 1) % 65536
      trainingState = {
        position = position,
        velocity = velocity,
        serverTime = serverTime,
        goal = goal,
        target = target,
        speed = speed,
        receivedAt = receivedAt,
        sequence = trainingSequence,
        round = trainingRound,
      }

      invalidateSnapshotCache()
      notifyTraining()
    end)
    utils.trackGlobal(trainingConnection)
  end
end
function GameInfo.bindBallSync(handler)
  if type(handler) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  bindTrainingSync()
  local nativeReady = ballSync.bindNative(handler)
  local candidate = findSyncRemote()
  if not candidate then
    if syncRemote and not validSyncRemote(syncRemote) then
      disconnectSync()
    end
    return nativeReady or (syncConnection ~= nil and syncConnection.Connected == true)
  end
  local replicated = storage()
  local remotes = replicated and replicated:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local snapshotCandidate = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("BallSnapshot")
  if not validSyncRemote(snapshotCandidate) then
    snapshotCandidate = nil
  end
  if not (syncConnection and syncConnection.Connected and syncRemote == candidate) then
    disconnectSync()
    syncConnection, syncRemote = candidate.OnClientEvent:Connect(handler), candidate
    utils.trackGlobal(syncConnection)
  end
  if snapshotRemote ~= snapshotCandidate or (snapshotConnection and not snapshotConnection.Connected) then
    if snapshotConnection then
      utils.untrackGlobal(snapshotConnection)
      snapshotConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    snapshotConnection, snapshotRemote = nil, nil
  end
  if snapshotCandidate and not snapshotConnection then
    snapshotConnection, snapshotRemote = snapshotCandidate.OnClientEvent:Connect(handler), snapshotCandidate
    utils.trackGlobal(snapshotConnection)
  end
  return true
end

function GameInfo.startMaintenance(options)
  if type(options) ~= "table" or type(options.isActive) ~= "function" then
    return false
  end
  maintenance += 1
  local token = maintenance
  task.spawn(function()
    while token == maintenance do
      if not options.isActive() or token ~= maintenance then
        break
      end
      local linked = type(options.onBallSync) == "function" and GameInfo.bindBallSync(options.onBallSync)
      if token ~= maintenance then
        break
      end
      task.wait(linked and CONFIG.SYNC_CONNECTED_INTERVAL or CONFIG.SYNC_RETRY_INTERVAL)
    end
  end)
  return true
end
function GameInfo.stopMaintenance()
  if presenceTracker then
    presenceTracker.stop()
    presenceTracker = nil

  maintenance += 1
  if ballSync then
    ballSync.destroy()

  disconnectSync()
  disconnect(trainingConnection)
  disconnect(trainingEventConnection)
  trainingConnection, trainingRemote, trainingServerTime = nil, nil, nil
  trainingEventConnection, trainingEventRemote = nil, nil

end

function GameInfo.getAveragePing()
