function GameInfo.getDeflectTargetPrediction(id)
  local source = players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
  local root = source and source.Character and source.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root then
    return nil
  end
  local mode = world:GetAttribute("CurGamemode")
  local teams = mode == 1 or mode == 2
  local candidates = {}
  for _, candidate in ipairs(registry.getPlayers()) do
    local position, character = playerRoot(candidate.UserId)
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local lives = candidate:GetAttribute("Lives")
    if
      candidate ~= source
      and candidate:GetAttribute("IsCloaked") ~= true
      and position
      and humanoid
      and humanoid.Health > 0
      and (not finite(lives) or lives > 0)
      and candidate:GetAttribute("Playing") ~= false
      and (not teams or source:GetAttribute("PlayerTeam") ~= candidate:GetAttribute("PlayerTeam"))
    then
      if candidate:GetAttribute("DarkSealed") == true then
        return candidate.UserId, 1, 1, "dark_seal"
      end
      if candidate:GetAttribute("IsCloaked") ~= true then
        candidates[#candidates + 1] = { player = candidate, root = position }
      end
    end
  end
  local camera = source:GetAttribute("CamCFrame")
  local observed = typeof(camera) == "CFrame"
  if not observed then
    camera = root.CFrame
  end
  if typeof(camera) ~= "CFrame" then
    return nil
  end
  local origin, look = camera.Position, camera.LookVector
  if (origin - root.Position).Magnitude > 64 then
    origin = root.Position
  end
  if not finiteVector(origin) or not finiteVector(look) or look.Magnitude < 0.5 then
    return nil
  end
  if #candidates == 1 then
    return candidates[1].player.UserId, 1, 1, "single_candidate"
  end
  look = look.Unit
  local winner, best, runner = nil, -math.huge, -math.huge
  for _, entry in ipairs(candidates) do
    local candidate, position = entry.player, entry.root
    local delta = position.Position - origin
    if delta.Magnitude > 0.001 then
      local score = look:Dot(delta.Unit)
      if score > best then
        winner, runner, best = candidate.UserId, best, score
      elseif score > runner then
        runner = score
      end
    end
  end
  if winner then
    local separation = best - runner
    if best < (observed and 0.75 or 0.9) or separation < (observed and 0.03 or 0.15) then
      return nil, best, separation, "aim_uncertain"
    end
    return winner, best, separation, observed and "camera" or "root"
  end
  return nil
end

      speed = sync.Speed,

      maxSpeed = sync.MaxSpeed or sync.Speed,
      serverTime = sync.ServerTime,
      targetId = sync.TargetPlayerID,

-- [[ Phantom Ball inventory actions ]]
--!optimize 2
local Actions = {}
function Actions.setup() return true end
function Actions.create(loaded, context)
  local scope, info, Utils = context.scope, loaded.gameinfo, loaded.utils
  local callbacks, states, handles = {}, {}, {}
  local spinActive, spinGeneration = nil, 0
  local CONFIG = { SPIN_INTERVAL = 0.3 }
  local modes = { spinSword = "SwordCrate", spinEmote = "EmoteCrate", spinExplosion = "FinisherCrate" }
  local function paintSpin()
    for action, crate in pairs(modes) do
      if handles[action] then
        handles[action].setValue(spinActive == crate)
      end
    end
  end
  for action, crate in pairs(modes) do
    states[action] = function() return spinActive == crate end
    callbacks[action] = function(enabled)
      spinGeneration += 1
      if enabled then
        spinActive = crate
      elseif spinActive == crate then
        spinActive = nil
      end
      paintSpin()
      if not enabled then
        return true
      end
      local generation = spinGeneration
      task.spawn(function()
        local network = info.createCrateNetwork()
        while scope.alive and generation == spinGeneration and spinActive == crate and Utils.isActive() do
          local sent = info.spinCrate(network, crate, function() return scope.alive and generation == spinGeneration and spinActive == crate end)
          if not sent then
            break
          end
          task.wait(CONFIG.SPIN_INTERVAL)
        end
        if scope.alive and generation == spinGeneration then
          spinActive = nil
          paintSpin()
        end
      end)
      return true
    end
  end

  scope.add(function()
    spinGeneration += 1
  end)
  return {
    callbacks = callbacks,
    states = states,
    attach = function(definition, handle)
      if definition.action then
        handles[definition.action] = handle
      end
    end,
  }
end
Actions.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Actions

-- [[ movement: dash actions ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local Movement = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local remote

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  UP_DIRECTION = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
  MIN_DIRECTION_MAGNITUDE = 0.001,
}

-- dash-actions
local function performDash(direction, upward)
  if not utils or not gameInfo or not remote or not utils.isActive() then
    return false, "Hub inativo"
  end
  if not gameInfo.areAbilitiesEnabled() then
    return false, upward and "Habilidades indisponíveis nesta partida" or "Habilidades indisponíveis"
  end
  if not upward then
    if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
      return false, "Direção indisponível"
    end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude ~= magnitude or magnitude == math.huge or magnitude <= CONFIG.MIN_DIRECTION_MAGNITUDE then
      return false, "Direção indisponível"
    end
  end
  local ability = gameInfo.getDashAbility()
  if not ability then
    return false, upward and "Dash não está equipada ou ainda não carregou" or "Dash indisponível"
  end
  if ability.Dashing then
    return false, upward and "Dash já está em andamento" or "Dash indisponível"
  end
  local moveDir = ability.MoveDir
  local vectorValue = typeof(moveDir) == "Instance" and moveDir:IsA("Vector3Value")
  if not upward and not vectorValue and typeof(moveDir) ~= "Vector3" then
    return false, "Direção do dash indisponível"
  end
  local ok, err = remote.fireDash()
  if not ok then
    return false, tostring(err)
  end
  if not ability.Dashing then
    return false, "Dash indisponível ou em cooldown"
  end
  local targetDirection = upward and CONFIG.UP_DIRECTION or direction.Unit
  if vectorValue then
    moveDir.Value = targetDirection
  else
    ability.MoveDir = targetDirection
  end
  return true
end

-- public-api
function Movement.upDash() return performDash(CONFIG.UP_DIRECTION, true) end
function Movement.dashToward(direction) return performDash(direction, false) end

-- lifecycle
function Movement.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" or type(deps.Remote) ~= "table" then

-- [[ native visual and audio adaptation ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Adapter = {}
function Adapter.setup() return true end
local function createGameAdapter(services, getOption)
  local adapter = {}
  local active, alive = false, true
  local modules = {}
  local patches, attributes = {}, {}
  local connections = {}
  local scheduled = false
  local refresh
  local stats = { DroppedVFX = 0, DroppedAudio = 0, RestoreConflicts = 0, Failures = 0 }
  local Workspace = services.Workspace
  local player = services.Player
  local function enabledOption(key) return active and getOption(key) == true end
  local function deferRefresh()
    if scheduled or not alive then
      return
    end
    scheduled = true
    task.delay(0.25, function()
      scheduled = false
      if alive and active then
        refresh()
      end
    end)
  end
  local function reconcileAttribute(object, key, desired, wanted)
    local byKey = attributes[object]
    local saved = byKey and byKey[key]
    if not wanted then
      if saved then
        byKey[key] = nil
        if saved.connection then
          saved.connection:Disconnect()
        end
        local ok = pcall(function() object:SetAttribute(key, saved.original) end)
        if not ok then
          stats.Failures += 1
        end
        if next(byKey) == nil then
          attributes[object] = nil
        end
      end
      return
    end
    if not saved then
      local ok, original = pcall(function() return object:GetAttribute(key) end)
      if not ok then
        stats.Failures += 1
        return
      end
      if not byKey then
        byKey = {}
        attributes[object] = byKey
      end
      saved = { original = original, applied = desired }
      byKey[key] = saved
      saved.connection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(function()
        if not active or not alive then
          return
        end
        local value = object:GetAttribute(key)
        if value ~= saved.applied then
          if getOption("RestoreLatest") then
            saved.original = value
          end
          deferRefresh()
        end
      end)
    end
    saved.applied = desired
    local ok = pcall(function()
      if object:GetAttribute(key) ~= desired then
        object:SetAttribute(key, desired)
      end
    end)
    if not ok then
      stats.Failures += 1
    end
  end
  local function removePatch(id)
    local patch = patches[id]
    if not patch then
      return
    end
    patches[id] = nil
    if patch.object[patch.key] == patch.wrapper then
      local ok = pcall(function() patch.object[patch.key] = patch.original end)
      if not ok then
        stats.Failures += 1
      end
    else
      stats.RestoreConflicts += 1
    end
  end
  local function ensurePatch(moduleName, key, shouldBlock, category, replacement)
    local id = moduleName .. "." .. key
    local object = modules[moduleName]
    local wanted = active and getOption("GameGenerators") and type(object) == "table"
    if not wanted then
      removePatch(id)
      return
    end
    local existing = patches[id]
    if existing and existing.object == object and object[key] == existing.wrapper then
      return
    end
    if existing then
      removePatch(id)
    end
    local original = object[key]
    if type(original) ~= "function" then
      return
    end
    local wrapper = function(...)
      if alive and active and getOption("GameGenerators") and shouldBlock(...) then
        if category then
          stats[category] += 1
        end
        if replacement then
          return replacement(...)
        end
        return nil
      end
      return original(...)
    end
    local ok = pcall(function() object[key] = wrapper end)
    if ok then
      patches[id] = { object = object, key = key, original = original, wrapper = wrapper }
    else
      stats.Failures += 1
    end
  end
  refresh = function()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    if not active then
      for object, byKey in pairs(attributes) do
        for key in pairs(byKey) do
          reconcileAttribute(object, key, nil, false)
        end
      end
    end
    local noVFX = enabledOption("GameNoVFX")
    local quiet = enabledOption("GameCosmeticAudio")
    local reducedUI = enabledOption("GameReducedUI")
    local flags = {
      PB_PerfEnabled = active,
      PB_PerfNoVFX = noVFX,
      PB_PerfReducedUI = reducedUI,
      PB_PerfMuteMusic = enabledOption("GameMuteMusic"),
      PB_PerfCosmeticAudio = quiet,
      PB_PerfKeepCombatAudio = getOption("GameKeepCombatAudio") == true,
      PB_PerfReducedHeadLook = enabledOption("GameReducedHeadLook"),
      PB_PerfSwordSounds = getOption("GameSwordSounds") ~= false,
    }

    for key, value in pairs(flags) do
      reconcileAttribute(Workspace, key, value, active)
    end
    reconcileAttribute(player, "Setting_WeaponVFX", false, noVFX)
    reconcileAttribute(player, "Setting_ExplosionVFX", false, noVFX)
    reconcileAttribute(player, "Setting_KillSounds", false, quiet or active and getOption("GameSwordSounds") == false)
    reconcileAttribute(player, "Setting_SwordSounds", false, active and getOption("GameSwordSounds") == false)
    for _, method in ipairs({ "Spawn", "SpawnAtCFrame", "SpawnSwordEffect", "Emit", "Toggle" }) do
      ensurePatch("VFX", method, function() return enabledOption("GameNoVFX") end, "DroppedVFX")
    end
    ensurePatch("LowQuality", "CanSpawn", function() return enabledOption("GameNoVFX") end, nil, function() return false end)
    ensurePatch("VFXBudget", "Take", function() return enabledOption("GameNoVFX") end, nil, function() return false end)
    ensurePatch("WindowAnim", "ReducedMotion", function() return enabledOption("GameReducedUI") end, nil, function() return true end)
    ensurePatch("SFX", "SpawnSwordSFX", function(_, _, action)
      if getOption("GameSwordSounds") == false then
        return true
      end
      if not enabledOption("GameCosmeticAudio") then
        return false
      end
      if getOption("GameKeepCombatAudio") and (action == "BallHit" or action == "Block") then
        return false
      end
      return true
    end, "DroppedAudio")
    local emitter = services.PlayerScripts and services.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Emitter2D")
    local emitterModule = emitter and emitter:FindFirstChild("Emitter2D")
    if emitterModule and emitterModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      reconcileAttribute(emitterModule, "Enabled", false, reducedUI)
    end
  end
  function adapter:SetModule(name, value)
    if not alive or type(value) ~= "table" then
      return false
    end
    if modules[name] ~= value then
      local prefix = name .. "."
      for id in pairs(patches) do
        if id:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
          removePatch(id)
        end
      end
    end
    modules[name] = value
    if active then
      refresh()
    end
    return true
  end
  function adapter:SetEnabled(value)
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    active = value
    refresh()
  end
  function adapter:Refresh()
    if active and alive then
      refresh()
    end
  end
  function adapter:GetStatus()
    local patchCount, attributeCount = 0, 0
    for _ in pairs(patches) do
      patchCount += 1
    end
    for _, entries in pairs(attributes) do
      for _ in pairs(entries) do
        attributeCount += 1
      end
    end
    return {
      Active = active,
      Patches = patchCount,
      Attributes = attributeCount,
      DroppedVFX = stats.DroppedVFX,
      DroppedAudio = stats.DroppedAudio,
      RestoreConflicts = stats.RestoreConflicts,
      Failures = stats.Failures,
    }
  end
  function adapter:Destroy()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    alive = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
  end
  local loading = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
  local specs = {
    { "VFX", "Core", "VFX" },
    { "SFX", "Core", "SFX" },
    { "LowQuality", "Core", "LowQuality" },
    { "VFXBudget", "Core" },
    { "WindowAnim", "UI" },
  }
  local function discover()
    if not alive then
      return
    end
    local replicated = services.ReplicatedStorage
    local shared = replicated and replicated:FindFirstChild("Shared")
    if not shared then
      return
    end
    for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
      local branch = shared:FindFirstChild(spec[2])
      local script = branch and branch:FindFirstChild(spec[1])
      if script and script:IsA("ModuleScript") and not loading[script] then
        loading[script] = true
        task.spawn(function()
          local ok, result = pcall(require, script)
          if alive and ok and type(result) == "table" then
            adapter:SetModule(spec[1], spec[3] and result[spec[3]] or result)
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  if services.ReplicatedStorage then
    connections[#connections + 1] = services.ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(discover)
  end
  if services.PlayerScripts then
    connections[#connections + 1] = services.PlayerScripts.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
      if active and object.Name == "Emitter2D" then
        deferRefresh()
      end
    end)
  end
  discover()
  return adapter
end
local function applyGamePolicy(object, target, watch, options)
  if options.GameKeepIndicators then
    local critical = false
    if object:IsA("Highlight") then
      critical = object.Name == "PlayerBallHighlight" or object.Name == "LocalBlockCharacterHighlight"
      local parent = object.Parent
      if parent then
        critical = critical or parent.Name == "GameBall" or parent.Name == "TrainingBall" or parent.Name == "ResilienceHitbox"
      end
    elseif object:IsA("Beam") then
      critical = object.Name == "PossessTether" or object.Name == "DarkForceChain"
    end
    if critical then
      target.Enabled, target.Transparency = nil, nil
      watch = false
    end
  end
  if object:IsA("BasePart") then
    local ancestor = object
    while ancestor do
      if ancestor.Name == "GameBall" or ancestor.Name == "TrainingBall" then
        target.Material, target.MaterialVariant, target.Reflectance = nil, nil, nil
        target.LocalTransparencyModifier = nil
        break
      end
      ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
  elseif object:IsA("SoundGroup") then
    if object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Master" then
      local mute = object.Name == "Music" and options.GameMuteMusic
        or object.Name == "Emotes" and options.GameCosmeticAudio
        or object.Name == "Ambience" and options.GameMuteAmbience
      if mute then
        target.Volume = 0
        watch = options.MaintainEffects
      end
    end
  elseif object:IsA("Sound") then
    local kind = object:GetAttribute("SFXKind")
    local swordMuted = options.GameSwordSounds == false and (kind == "SwordSounds" or kind == "KillSounds")
    if swordMuted or object.Name == "PB_LobbyTheme_Christmas" and options.GameMuteMusic then
      target.Volume = 0
      watch = options.MaintainEffects
    end
  end
  return target, watch
end
Adapter.create = createGameAdapter
Adapter.apply = applyGamePolicy
Adapter.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create", "apply" } }

return Adapter

-- [[ event-maintained player references ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Registry = {}
local lifetime
local scope
local records = {}
local ordered = table.freeze({})
local function publish(player, added)
  local list = {}
  for _, candidate in ipairs(ordered) do
    if candidate ~= player then
      list[#list + 1] = candidate
    end
  end
  if added then
    list[#list + 1] = player
  end
  ordered = table.freeze(list)
end
function Registry.getPlayers() return ordered end
function Registry.getParts(id)
  local record = records[id]
  if not record then
    return nil
  end
  local player, character = record.player, record.character
  if player.Character ~= character or not character or not character.Parent then
    return player
  end
  local root, humanoid = record.root, record.humanoid
  return player, character, humanoid and humanoid.Parent == character and humanoid or nil, root and root.Parent == character and root or nil
end
function Registry.teardown()
  if scope then
    scope.destroy()
    scope = nil
  end
  table.clear(records)
  ordered = table.freeze({})
end
function Registry.setup(deps)
  Registry.teardown()
  lifetime = deps.Lifetime
  scope = lifetime.scope()
  local players = deps.Utils.getPlayers()
  local function remove(player)
    local record = records[player.UserId]
    if not record then
      return
    end
    record.scope.destroy()
    records[player.UserId] = nil
    publish(player, false)
  end
  local function add(player)
    if records[player.UserId] then
      return
    end
    local record = { player = player, scope = scope.child() }
    records[player.UserId] = record
    local function bind(character)
      if record.characterScope then
        record.characterScope.destroy()
      end
      record.character, record.root, record.humanoid = character, nil, nil
      if not character then
        return
      end
      local childScope = record.scope.child()
      record.characterScope = childScope
      local function added(child)
        if child.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
          record.root = child
        end
        if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
          record.humanoid = child
        end
      end
      childScope.connect(character.ChildAdded, added)
      childScope.connect(character.ChildRemoved, function(child)
        if record.root == child then
          record.root = nil
        end
        if record.humanoid == child then
          record.humanoid = nil
        end
      end)
      for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        added(child)
      end
    end
    record.scope.connect(player.CharacterAdded, bind)
    record.scope.connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
      if character == record.character then
        bind(nil)
      end
    end)
    if player.Character then
      bind(player.Character)
    end
    publish(player, true)
  end
  scope.connect(players.PlayerAdded, add)
  scope.connect(players.PlayerRemoving, remove)
  for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    add(player)
  end
  return true
end
Registry.__contract = {
  requires = { Lifetime = "lifetime", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = { Lifetime = { "scope" }, Utils = { "getPlayers" } },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "getPlayers", "getParts" },
}

return Registry

-- [[ match presence tracking ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Presence = {}
function Presence.setup() return true end
function Presence.create(utils, registry)
  local players, world = utils.getPlayers(), utils.getWorkspace()
  local presence, presenceConnections, presenceDeath = {}, {}, nil
  local presenceHumanoid, lobbyRegion, lobbySearchAt
  local function finite(value) return utils.isFiniteNumber(value) end
  local function child(parent, name) return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) end
  local function inLobby(root)
    if not root then
      return true
    end
    local time = os.clock()
    if not lobbyRegion or not lobbyRegion.Parent then
      if not lobbySearchAt or time >= lobbySearchAt then
        lobbySearchAt = time + 0.5
        lobbyRegion = world:FindFirstChild("Lobby Area", true)
      end
    end
    local function inside(region)
      if not region or not region:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
      end
      local point = region.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
      local half = region.Size * 0.5
      return math.abs(point.X) <= half.X and math.abs(point.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(point.Z) <= half.Z
    end
    return inside(lobbyRegion) or inside(child(child(child(world, "Training"), "Areas"), "SafeArea"))
  end
  local function stopPresence()
    if presenceDeath then
      presenceDeath:Disconnect()
      presenceDeath = nil
    end
    for _, connection in ipairs(presenceConnections) do
      if utils and type(utils.untrackGlobal) == "function" then
        utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
      end
      connection:Disconnect()
    end
    presenceConnections, presenceHumanoid, presence = {}, nil, {}
  end
  local function updatePresence()
    if not players or not world then
      return
    end
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local _, character, humanoid, root = registry.getParts(player and player.UserId)
    local round = world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == 6
    local lives = player and player:GetAttribute("Lives")
    local playing = player and player:GetAttribute("Playing")
    if humanoid ~= presenceHumanoid then
      if presenceDeath then
        presenceDeath:Disconnect()
        presenceDeath = nil
      end
      presenceHumanoid = humanoid
      if humanoid and humanoid.Died then
        presenceDeath = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
          if presenceHumanoid == humanoid and player.Character == character and world:GetAttribute("MatchStatus") == 6 then
            presence.eliminated, presence.entered = true, false
          end
        end)
      end
    end
    if presence.round == nil then
      presence.needsTeleport = not round
    end
    if not round then
      if presence.round == true then
        presence.entryProof = false
      end
      presence.eliminated, presence.entered, presence.needsTeleport = false, false, true
    elseif presence.round == true and presence.entered and presence.character and presence.character ~= character then
      presence.eliminated, presence.entered = true, false
    end
    if root and presence.position and (root.Position - presence.position).Magnitude >= 24 then
      presence.entryProof = true
    end
    local alive = humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and root ~= nil and root.Parent ~= nil
    if round and ((humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0) or (finite(presence.lives) and presence.lives > 0 and finite(lives) and lives <= 0)) then
      presence.eliminated = true
    end
    local candidate = round and alive and finite(lives) and lives > 0 and playing ~= false and not inLobby(root)
    if presence.entered and not candidate then
      if not alive or playing == false or not finite(lives) or lives <= 0 then
        presence.eliminated = true
      end
      presence.needsTeleport, presence.entryProof = true, false
    end
    presence.entered = candidate and not presence.eliminated and (not presence.needsTeleport or presence.entryProof == true) or false
    presence.round, presence.character, presence.position, presence.lives = round, character, root and root.Position, lives
  end
  local function startPresence()
    presence, lobbyRegion, lobbySearchAt = {}, nil, nil
    updatePresence()
    local function track(connection)
      presenceConnections[#presenceConnections + 1] = connection
      if type(utils.trackGlobal) == "function" then
        utils.trackGlobal(connection)
      end
    end
    if type(world.GetAttributeChangedSignal) == "function" then
      track(world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MatchStatus"):Connect(updatePresence))
    end
    local runService = type(utils.getRunService) == "function" and utils.getRunService()
    if runService and runService.Heartbeat then
      local elapsed = 0
      track(runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        elapsed += dt
        if elapsed >= 0.1 then
          elapsed = 0
          updatePresence()
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  return { start = startPresence, stop = stopPresence, update = updatePresence, get = function() return presence, presenceHumanoid end }
end
Presence.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }

return Presence

-- [[ remote ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local Remote = {}
local gameInfo
local utils
local epoch = 0
local keybindObject
local inputService
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  PARRY_METHOD = "Deflect",
  DARK_METHOD = "SendEvent",
  FIERCE_METHOD = "ActivateAndBlock",
  DASH_METHOD = "Dash",
}

-- lifecycle
function Remote.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência inválida: GameInfo"
  end
  if type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependência inválida: Utils"
  end
  Remote.teardown()
  gameInfo, utils = deps.GameInfo, deps.Utils
  return true
end

-- dispatch
local function send(ability, method, ...)
  if ability == nil then
    return false, method .. " não equipado ou indisponível"
  end
  local callback = ability[method]
  if type(callback) ~= "function" then
    error("API externa ausente: habilidade." .. method, 2)
  end
  local result = callback(ability, ...)
  if result == false then
    return false, method .. " recusado"
  end
  return true
end
local function allowed(guard)
  if type(guard) ~= "function" then
    return true
  end
  local result = guard()
  return result ~= nil and result ~= false
end
local directSequence = math.random(0, 65535)
local function directRemote()
  local env = type(getrenv) == "function" and getrenv() or nil
  local globals = type(env) == "table" and rawget(env, "_G")
  local remote = type(globals) == "table" and rawget(globals, "did2") or nil
  if typeof(remote) == "Instance" and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") and remote.Parent ~= nil then
    local unreliable = rawget(globals, "did2u")
    if typeof(unreliable) ~= "Instance" or not unreliable:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") or unreliable.Parent ~= remote then
      unreliable = remote:FindFirstChild("u")
    end
    return remote, unreliable
  end
  local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
  local player = Players.LocalPlayer
  remote = remotes and player and (remotes:FindFirstChild("pu_" .. player.UserId) or remotes:FindFirstChild(""))
  if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    return remote, remote:FindFirstChild("u")
  end
end
local function resendDirect(owner, remote, unreliable, guard, packet)
  if epoch == owner and gameInfo and unreliable.Parent == remote and remote.Parent ~= nil and allowed(guard) then
    pcall(unreliable.FireServer, unreliable, packet)
  end
end
local function fireDirect(guard, context)
  local time = os.clock()
  local remote, unreliable
  if context.remote and context.remote.Parent ~= nil and time >= context.checkedAt and time - context.checkedAt < 1 / 240 then
    remote, unreliable = context.remote, context.unreliable
    if unreliable and unreliable.Parent ~= remote then
      unreliable = nil
    end
  else
    remote, unreliable = directRemote()
    context.remote, context.unreliable, context.checkedAt = remote, unreliable, time
  end
  if not remote then
    return false, "Remote de Deflect indisponível"
  end
  local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if not camera then
    return false, "Câmera indisponível"
  end
  local cf = camera.CFrame
  if not context.prefix or context.camera ~= camera or context.frame ~= cf then
    local prefix = buffer.create(25)
    buffer.writeu8(prefix, 0, 1)
    local pos, look = cf.Position, cf.LookVector
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 1, pos.X)
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 5, pos.Y)
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 9, pos.Z)
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 13, look.X)
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 17, look.Y)
    buffer.writef32(prefix, 21, look.Z)
    context.prefix, context.camera, context.frame = prefix, camera, cf
  end
  local packet = buffer.create(35)
  buffer.copy(packet, 0, context.prefix, 0, 25)
  directSequence = (directSequence + 1) % 65536
  buffer.writeu16(packet, 25, directSequence)
  buffer.writef64(packet, 27, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
  if not allowed(guard) then
    return false, "Deflect cancelado"
  end
  remote:FireServer(packet)
  if unreliable and unreliable:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
    pcall(unreliable.FireServer, unreliable, packet)
    task.delay(0.03, resendDirect, epoch, remote, unreliable, guard, packet)
  end
  return true
end
local function configuredInput()
  local ability = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility()
  if ability and type(ability.GetKeybindBySlotID) == "function" then
    local binding = ability:GetKeybindBySlotID()
    if binding then
      for index = 1, 2 do
        local value = index == 1 and binding.Key or binding.AlternateKey
        if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode and value ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
          return value
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if not keybindObject then
    local storage = ReplicatedStorage
    local shared = storage:FindFirstChild("Shared") or storage:FindFirstChild("TS")
    local core = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Core")
    local module = core and core:FindFirstChild("KeybindObject")
    if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
      if ok and type(value) == "table" and type(value.KeybindObject) == "table" then
        keybindObject = value.KeybindObject
      end
    end
  end
  if keybindObject and type(keybindObject.Get) == "function" then
    local binding = keybindObject:Get("Blocking")
    if binding then
      for index = 1, 2 do
        local value = index == 1 and binding.Key or binding.AlternateKey
        if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
          if value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
            return value
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return Enum.KeyCode.F
end
local function releaseInput(vim, input) vim:SendKeyEvent(false, input, false, game) end
local function fireInput(guard)
  local input = configuredInput()
  inputService = inputService or game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
  local vim = inputService
  if not allowed(guard) then
    return false, "Deflect cancelado"
  end
  vim:SendKeyEvent(true, input, false, game)
  task.defer(releaseInput, vim, input)
  return true
end

-- public-api
local function dispatchParry(info, guard, context, native, checked)
  if checked then
    local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    if input and type(input.GetFocusedTextBox) == "function" and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then
      return false, "entrada de texto ativa"
    end
  end
  local method = native and "Deflect" or utils.getConfigValue("ClickMethod")
  if method == "Input" then
    return fireInput(guard)
  end
  if info.isTrainingArea() then
    if not allowed(guard) then
      return false, "Deflect cancelado"
    end
    local sent, detail = info.fireTrainingParry()
    return sent, detail
  end
  if method == "Direct" then
    return fireDirect(guard, context)
  end
  local ability = info.getDeflectAbility()
  if not allowed(guard) then
    return false, "Deflect cancelado"
  end
  if not ability then
    return false, "Deflect não equipado ou indisponível"
  end
  if checked then
    local nativeBefore = ability.LastDeflectCallAt
    local before = info.getDeflectCallStamp(ability)
    local result = ability:Deflect()
    if result == false then
      return false, "Deflect recusado pelo cliente"
    end
    local after = info.getDeflectCallStamp(ability)
    if type(nativeBefore) == "number" or type(ability.LastDeflectCallAt) == "number" then
      if ability.LastDeflectCallAt == nativeBefore then
        return false, "Deflect recusado pelo cliente"
      end
      return true
    end
    if type(before) == "number" or type(after) == "number" then
      if after == before then
        return false, "Deflect recusado pelo cliente"
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  ability:Deflect()
  return true
end
function Remote.prepareParry(callerGuard)
  local owner, info, context = epoch, gameInfo, {}
  local function guard() return owner == epoch and gameInfo == info and allowed(callerGuard) end
  return function()
    if not info or owner ~= epoch or gameInfo ~= info then
      return false, "Remote não inicializado"
    end
    return dispatchParry(info, guard, context)
  end
end
function Remote.fireNativeParry(guard) return dispatchParry(gameInfo, guard, {}, true) end
function Remote.fireParry(_flag, callerGuard) return Remote.prepareParry(callerGuard)() end
function Remote.fireCheckedParry(guard) return dispatchParry(gameInfo, guard, {}, false, true) end
function Remote.fireDark(eventId, cameraFrame) return send(gameInfo and gameInfo.getDarkSealAbility(), CONFIG.DARK_METHOD, eventId, cameraFrame) end
function Remote.fireFierce(guard)
  local owner = epoch
  local ability = gameInfo and gameInfo.getFierceDeflectAbility()
  if owner ~= epoch or not gameInfo or not allowed(guard) then
    return false, "Fierce cancelado"
  end
  return send(ability, CONFIG.FIERCE_METHOD)
end
function Remote.fireDash() return send(gameInfo and gameInfo.getDashAbility(), CONFIG.DASH_METHOD) end
function Remote.teardown()
  epoch += 1
  keybindObject, inputService, gameInfo, utils = nil, nil, nil, nil
  return true
end

-- contract
Remote.__contract = {
  requires = { GameInfo = "gameinfo", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "getConfigValue" },
    GameInfo = {
      "isTrainingArea",
      "fireTrainingParry",
      "getDeflectAbility",
      "getDeflectCallStamp",
      "getDarkSealAbility",
      "getFierceDeflectAbility",
      "getDashAbility",
    },
  },
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "teardown",
    "fireParry",
    "fireCheckedParry",
    "prepareParry",
    "fireNativeParry",
    "fireDark",
    "fireFierce",
    "fireDash",
  },
}

return Remote

-- [[ ball snapshot sampling ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Snapshots = {}
function Snapshots.setup() return true end
function Snapshots.create(deps)
  local builder = { cachedAt = -math.huge }
  local sampledBall, sampledPosition, sampledAt, measuredVelocity, movedAt
  local finite = deps.utils.isFiniteNumber
  local CONFIG = deps.config
  local function child(parent, name) return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) end
  function builder.get(time)
    local utils, world, players = deps.utils, deps.world, deps.players
    local trainingState = deps.getTrainingState()
    time = finite(time) and time or utils.now()
    if
      builder.cached
      and builder.cached.ball
      and builder.cached.ball.Parent
      and time >= builder.cachedAt
      and (deps.inEvaluation() or time - builder.cachedAt < CONFIG.SNAPSHOT_CACHE_INTERVAL)
    then
      return builder.cached
    end
    if deps.inTrainingArea() then
      local sample = trainingState
      local model = child(child(child(world, "Training"), "TrainingClient"), "TrainingBall")
      if not sample or time < sample.receivedAt or time - sample.receivedAt > 0.6 or not model or not model:IsA("BasePart") or not model.Parent then
        return nil
      end
      local age = math.clamp(world:GetServerTimeNow() - sample.serverTime, 0, 0.25)
      local target = finite(sample.goal) and sample.goal > 0 and sample.goal or -1
      local result = {
        schema = 2,
        mode = "training",
        ball = model,
        position = sample.position + sample.velocity * age,
        velocity = sample.velocity,
        speed = sample.velocity.Magnitude,
        syncSpeed = sample.speed,
        targetId = target,
        targeted = players.LocalPlayer ~= nil and target == players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
        targetUncertain = false,
        teleported = false,
        locked = false,
        grace = false,
        syncAt = sample.receivedAt,
        serverTime = sample.serverTime,
        syncSequence = sample.sequence,
        trainingRound = sample.round,
        trainingParryAt = deps.getTrainingParryAt(),
        targetSignals = deps.getTrainingSignals(model, sample.goal, players.LocalPlayer.UserId, sample.serverTime, sample.receivedAt, world:GetServerTimeNow()),
      }

      builder.cached, builder.cachedAt = result, time
      return result
    end
    local currentBall = deps.getBall()
    if not currentBall then
      return nil
    end
    local provider = deps.getReplicator()
    local position, velocity, sync = currentBall.Position, currentBall.AssemblyLinearVelocity, deps.syncData(provider or false)
    local targetReport = deps.resolveTarget(time, provider, sync, currentBall)
    local syncReceivedAt = deps.getReceivedAt()
    local syncFresh = syncReceivedAt > 0 and time >= syncReceivedAt and time - syncReceivedAt <= CONFIG.PACKET_AGE
    if not syncFresh then
      sync = nil
      syncReceivedAt = nil
    end
    local target = targetReport.targetId
    local frozen = deps.getBallFrozen() == true
    if sampledBall ~= currentBall or (sync and sync.Teleported == true) then
      sampledBall, sampledPosition, sampledAt, measuredVelocity, movedAt = currentBall, position, time, Vector3.zero, nil
    elseif sampledPosition and sampledAt and time - sampledAt >= CONFIG.SAMPLE_INTERVAL then
      local elapsed = time - sampledAt
      local displacement = position - sampledPosition
      if displacement.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        local measured, expected = displacement / elapsed, sync and tonumber(sync.Speed)
        if elapsed <= CONFIG.SAMPLE_MAX_GAP and (not expected or expected <= 0 or measured.Magnitude <= expected * 2.5 + 30) then
          measuredVelocity, movedAt = measured, time
        else
          measuredVelocity, movedAt = Vector3.zero, nil
        end
      elseif movedAt and time - movedAt > 0.1 then
        measuredVelocity = Vector3.zero
      end
      sampledPosition, sampledAt = position, time
    end
    if typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" or velocity.Magnitude < 0.1 then
      velocity = measuredVelocity or Vector3.zero
    end
    local result = {
      schema = 2,
      generatedAt = time,
      valid = true,
      ball = currentBall,
      ballValid = true,
      position = position,
      velocity = velocity,
      speed = velocity.Magnitude,
      syncSpeed = sync and sync.Speed or nil,
      realPosition = sync and sync.RealPosition or nil,
      syncDirection = sync and sync.ForcedDirection or nil,
      syncAcceleration = sync and sync.Accel or nil,
      syncMaxSpeed = sync and sync.MaxSpeed or nil,
      targetId = target,
      targeted = players.LocalPlayer ~= nil and target == players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
      targetSource = targetReport.source or "unavailable",
      targetSignals = targetReport,
      exchangeTargetId = sync and sync.TargetPlayerID or -1,
      targetUncertain = not targetReport.known,
      teleported = sync and sync.Teleported == true or false,
      locked = sync and sync.Locked == true or false,
      ballCanMove = not frozen and not (sync and sync.Locked == true),
      frozen = frozen,
      grace = sync and sync.Grace == true or false,
      oldGrace = sync and sync.OldGrace == true or false,
      syncAt = syncReceivedAt,
      serverTime = sync and sync.ServerTime or nil,
      syncSequence = deps.syncSequence(sync, provider),
      syncVersion = deps.getVersion(),
      highlightTargetId = sync and sync.HighlightTargetPlayerID,
    }

    builder.cached, builder.cachedAt = result, time
    return result
  end
  function builder.invalidate()
    builder.cached, builder.cachedAt = nil, -math.huge
  end
  return builder
end
Snapshots.__contract = { requires = {}, provides = { "setup", "create" } }

return Snapshots

-- [[ targeting ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Targeting = {}
function Targeting.setup() return true end
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
function Targeting.create(deps)
  local resolver = {}
  function resolver.resolve(context)
    local me = context.player and context.player.UserId
    local report = { mode = "match", targeted = false, known = false, targetId = -1, conflict = false, positive = {}, signals = {} }
    local function add(name, family, read)
      local signal = { name = name, family = family, available = false, state = "unavailable" }
      report.signals[#report.signals + 1] = signal
      if context.active == false then
        signal.reason = "round_inactive"
        return
      end
      local ok, value, reason = pcall(read)
      if not ok then
        signal.reason = "read_failed"
        return
      end
      signal.reason = reason
      if finite(value) and value % 1 == 0 then
        signal.targetId, signal.targeted = value, value > 0 and value == me
      elseif type(value) == "boolean" then
        signal.targeted = value
        if value then
          signal.targetId = me
        end
      else
        return
      end
      signal.available, signal.state, report.known = true, signal.targeted and "yes" or "no", true
      if signal.targeted then
        report.targeted = true
        report.positive[#report.positive + 1] = name
      end
    end
    report.serverNow, report.receivedAt, report.attributeAt = context.serverNow, context.receivedAt, context.attributeAt
    report.serverTime = context.sync and context.sync.ServerTime
    local sync, provider = context.sync, context.provider
    local function freshSync() return context.syncFresh == true end
    local history = provider and provider.history
    local latest = type(history) == "table" and history[#history]
    local function freshProvider()
      if not provider or provider.hasState ~= true then
        return false
      end
      if finite(context.sequence) and finite(provider.lastSeq) then
        local delta = (context.sequence - provider.lastSeq) % 65536
        if delta > 0 and delta < 32768 then
          return false
        end
      end
      if latest and finite(latest.serverTime) and finite(context.serverNow) then
        local age = context.serverNow - latest.serverTime
        return age >= -0.02 and age <= context.maxAge
      end
      return freshSync()
    end
    report.apProviderSuppressed = freshSync() and sync and (sync.TargetPlayerID == me or sync.HighlightTargetPlayerID == me) or false
    add("replicator.IsLocalTarget", "network", function()
      if freshProvider() and type(provider.IsLocalTarget) == "function" then
        return provider:IsLocalTarget()
      end
    end)
    add("workspace.GameBallTarget", "attribute", function() return context.world:GetAttribute("GameBallTarget") end)
    add("ball.targetColor", "visual", function()
      local ball = context.ball
      if not ball or not ball:IsA("BasePart") or ball.Transparency == 1 or ball.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 then
        return nil
      end
      local color = ball.Color
      local red = Color3.fromRGB(202, 56, 30)
      local function same(a, b) return math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 0.005 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 0.005 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 0.005 end
      local normal = ball:GetAttribute("SkinNormalColor")
      if typeof(normal) == "Color3" and same(normal, red) then
        return nil
      end
      if same(color, red) then
        return true
      end
      if same(color, typeof(normal) == "Color3" and normal or Color3.fromRGB(153, 153, 153)) then
        return false
      end
      return nil
    end)
    add("sync.TargetPlayerID", "network", function() return freshSync() and sync and sync.TargetPlayerID or nil end)
    add("sync.HighlightTargetPlayerID", "network", function() return freshSync() and sync and sync.HighlightTargetPlayerID or nil end)
    add("character.PlayerBallHighlight", "visual", function()
      local character = context.player and context.player.Character
      local mark = character and character:FindFirstChild("PlayerBallHighlight")
      if mark and mark:IsA("Highlight") and mark.Parent == character then
        return mark.Enabled == true
      end
    end)
    local function validId(id) return finite(id) and id > 0 and id % 1 == 0 and id or nil end
    local packet = freshSync() and sync and validId(sync.TargetPlayerID) or nil
    local ok, attribute = pcall(function() return context.world:GetAttribute("GameBallTarget") end)
    attribute = ok and validId(attribute) or nil
    local selected = packet or attribute
    report.conflict = packet ~= nil and attribute ~= nil and packet ~= attribute
    if context.active == false then
      report.targeted, report.known, report.targetId, report.conflict, report.source = false, false, -1, false, "round_inactive"
      return report
    end
    if report.conflict then
      if finite(context.receivedAt) and finite(context.attributeAt) then
        selected = context.attributeAt > context.receivedAt and attribute or packet
      else
        report.targeted, report.known, report.targetId, report.source = false, false, -1, "target_transition"
        return report
      end
    end
    if selected then
      report.targetId, report.targeted, report.known = selected, selected == me, true
      report.source = selected == packet and "sync.target" or "workspace.GameBallTarget"
      return report
    end
    if freshProvider() and not packet and not attribute then
      for _, signal in ipairs(report.signals) do
        if signal.name == "replicator.IsLocalTarget" and signal.targeted then
          report.targeted, report.known, report.targetId, report.source = true, true, me, signal.name
          return report
        end
      end
    end
    local highlighted, multiple
    for _, player in ipairs(context.players and context.players:GetPlayers() or {}) do
      local character = player.Character
      local mark = character and character:FindFirstChild("PlayerBallHighlight")
      if mark and mark.Enabled then
        if highlighted then
          multiple = true
        end
        highlighted = player.UserId
      end
    end
    local redBall = false
    for _, signal in ipairs(report.signals) do
      if signal.name == "ball.targetColor" and signal.targeted then
        redBall = true
      end
    end
    report.targeted = not multiple and highlighted == me and redBall
    report.known = not multiple and highlighted ~= nil and (highlighted ~= me or redBall)
    report.targetId = report.known and highlighted or -1
    report.source = report.known and "visual.highlight_and_ball" or "unavailable"
    return report
  end
  function resolver.training(ball, goal, me, serverTime, receivedAt, serverNow)
    local signals = { { name = "sync.TargetPlayerID", available = finite(goal) and goal >= 0, targeted = goal == me } }
    local function same(a, b) return math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 0.005 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 0.005 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 0.005 end
    local visible = ball and ball.Parent and ball.Transparency < 1 and ball.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1
    if visible then
      local normal, red = ball:GetAttribute("SkinNormalColor"), Color3.fromRGB(202, 56, 30)
      if typeof(normal) ~= "Color3" or not same(normal, red) then
        local own, other = same(ball.Color, red), same(ball.Color, typeof(normal) == "Color3" and normal or Color3.fromRGB(153, 153, 153))
        signals[#signals + 1] = { name = "ball.targetColor", available = own or other, targeted = own }
      end
      if not finite(goal) or goal < 0 then
        local trails = ball:FindFirstChild("Trails")
        local trail = trails and trails:FindFirstChild("BallTrail")
        local target, ordinary = trails and trails:FindFirstChild("BallTrailTarget"), trails and trails:FindFirstChild("BallTrail2")
        local function equal(a, b)
          if typeof(a) ~= "ColorSequence" or typeof(b) ~= "ColorSequence" then
            return false
          end
          local left, right = a.Keypoints, b.Keypoints
          if #left ~= #right then
            return false
          end
          for index, point in ipairs(left) do
            if math.abs(point.Time - right[index].Time) > 0.001 or not same(point.Value, right[index].Value) then
              return false
            end
          end
          return true
        end
        if trail and trail.Enabled and target and ordinary and not equal(target.Color, ordinary.Color) then
          local own, other = equal(trail.Color, target.Color), equal(trail.Color, ordinary.Color)
          signals[#signals + 1] = { name = "character.PlayerBallHighlight", available = own or other, targeted = own }
        end
      end
    end
    return { signals = signals, serverTime = serverTime, receivedAt = receivedAt, serverNow = serverNow, training = true }
  end
  return resolver
end
function Targeting.createParryTracker()
  local tracker = { epoch = 0, floor = -math.huge }
  local sources = {
    ["sync.TargetPlayerID"] = 1,
    ["sync.HighlightTargetPlayerID"] = 2,
    ["replicator.IsLocalTarget"] = 3,
    ["workspace.GameBallTarget"] = 4,
    ["ball.targetColor"] = 5,
    ["character.PlayerBallHighlight"] = 6,
  }

  local slots = {}
  for index = 1, 6 do
    slots[index] = {}
  end
  local serial, cutoff, episode, strong = 0, -math.huge, nil, false
  function tracker.reset()
    serial, cutoff, episode, strong = 0, -math.huge, nil, false
    tracker.floor = -math.huge
    tracker.epoch += 1
    for _, slot in ipairs(slots) do
      table.clear(slot)
    end
  end
  function tracker.rearm(floor)
    serial += 1
    cutoff, episode, strong = serial, nil, false
    tracker.floor = math.max(tracker.floor, floor or -math.huge)
    for index = 1, 3 do
      table.clear(slots[index])
    end
  end
  function tracker.observe(report, now, frame, ping)
    if type(report) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    tracker.training = report.training == true
    for _, signal in ipairs(report.signals or {}) do
      local index = sources[signal.name]
      if index then
        local slot, weak = slots[index], index >= 5
        local available = signal.available and not (index == 3 and report.apProviderSuppressed)
        local value = available and signal.targeted
        local at = index <= 3 and report.receivedAt or now
        local serverTime = index <= 3 and report.serverTime or (report.serverNow and report.serverNow - (ping or 0) - 0.02)
        if
          not available
          or type(value) ~= "boolean"
          or not finite(at)
          or (
            index <= 3
            and (
              not finite(serverTime)
              or serverTime < tracker.floor
              or (finite(report.serverNow) and (report.serverNow - serverTime < -0.02 or report.serverNow - serverTime > (report.training and 0.6 or 0.25)))
            )
          )
        then
          slot.pending, slot.at = nil, -math.huge
        else
          local accepted = true
          if weak then
            if slot.pending ~= value then
              serial += 1
              slot.pending, slot.frame, slot.count, slot.pendingOrder = value, frame, 1, serial
              accepted = false
            else
              if slot.frame ~= frame then
                slot.frame, slot.count = frame, (slot.count or 0) + 1
              end
              accepted = (slot.count or 0) >= 2
            end
          end
          if accepted then
            slot.at = at
            if value ~= slot.value then
              local old, oldEntry = slot.value, slot.entry
              serial += 1
              slot.value, slot.entry = value, weak and value and slot.pendingOrder or serial
              slot.serverTime = serverTime
              if value == false and old == true and episode and oldEntry >= episode and not (weak and strong) then
                cutoff, episode, strong = serial, nil, false
                tracker.floor = math.max(tracker.floor, serverTime or -math.huge)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function tracker.resolve(now)
    local oldest, selected
    for index, slot in ipairs(slots) do
      local lifetime = index == 4 and math.huge or (index >= 5 and 0.1 or (tracker.training and 0.6 or 0.25))
      if slot.value == true and slot.entry >= cutoff and slot.at and now >= slot.at and now - slot.at <= lifetime then
        if index < 5 then
          strong = true
        end
        if not oldest or slot.entry < oldest then
          oldest, selected = slot.entry, index
        end
      end
    end
    if not selected then
      return false, tracker.epoch
    end
    if not episode then
      episode = oldest
      tracker.epoch += 1
      tracker.floor = math.max(tracker.floor, slots[selected].serverTime or -math.huge)
    end
    return true, tracker.epoch
  end
  tracker.reset()
  return tracker
end
Targeting.__contract = {
  access = { default = "internal.read" },
  provides = { "setup", "create", "createParryTracker" },
  requires = {},
}

return Targeting

-- [[ Phantom Ball readouts ]]
--!optimize 2

local Telemetry = {}
function Telemetry.setup() return true end
local StatusView = {}
local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v > -math.huge and v < math.huge end
local function positive(v) return finite(v) and v > 0 end
local function object(v) return type(v) == "table" and v or {} end
local function text(v) return type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" and v ~= "nil" and v ~= "null" end
function StatusView.format(data)
  data = object(data)
  local ap, auto = object(data.ap), object(data.autoSpam)
  local stats = object(auto.clashStats)
  local out = { ap = {}, gates = {}, travel = {}, distance = {} }
  if positive(ap.maxObservedCps) then
    out.ap[1] = string.format("AP max: %.2f CPS", ap.maxObservedCps)
  end
  local predictionGate = object(auto.gates).prediction
  if text(predictionGate) then
    out.gates[#out.gates + 1] = "Prediction: " .. predictionGate
  end
  if text(auto.lastActivationReason) then
    out.gates[#out.gates + 1] = "Last activation: " .. auto.lastActivationReason
  end
  if text(auto.lastStopReason) then
    out.gates[#out.gates + 1] = "Last deactivation: " .. auto.lastStopReason
  end
  local dynamic = object(data.dynamicParry)
  if text(dynamic.lastStopReason) and dynamic.lastStopReason ~= "player_died" and dynamic.lastStopReason ~= "opponent_left_or_died" then
    out.gates[#out.gates + 1] = "Dynamic deactivation: " .. dynamic.lastStopReason
  end
  local start = object(stats.startSample)
  if finite(start.distance) and start.distance >= 0 then
    out.distance[#out.distance + 1] = string.format("Start: %.1f studs", start.distance)
  end
  local sample = object(stats.endSample)
  if finite(sample.distance) and sample.distance >= 0 then
    out.distance[#out.distance + 1] = string.format(stats.frozen == true and "Final distance: %.1f studs" or "Distance: %.1f studs", sample.distance)
  end
  local speed = positive(sample.speed) and sample.speed or stats.speed
  if positive(speed) then
    out.distance[#out.distance + 1] = string.format("Speed: %.0f", speed)
  end
  if positive(stats.currentCps) then
    out.distance[#out.distance + 1] = string.format("Clash: %.2f CPS", stats.currentCps)
  end
  if positive(stats.duration) then
    out.distance[#out.distance + 1] = string.format("Duration: %.2fs", stats.duration)
  end
  local travel = object(data.travel or stats)
  if finite(travel.incomingRecordedAt) or finite(travel.outgoingRecordedAt) then
    local function tti(value) return finite(value) and value >= 0 and string.format("%.0f ms", value * 1000) or "unavailable" end
    out.travel[1] = "Last target TTI: " .. tti(travel.lastIncomingTTI)
    out.travel[2] = "Previous target TTI: " .. tti(travel.previousIncomingTTI)
    if finite(travel.outgoingRecordedAt) then
      out.travel[#out.travel + 1] = "Opponent target TTI: " .. tti(travel.lastOutgoingTTI)
      out.travel[#out.travel + 1] = "Previous opponent TTI: " .. tti(travel.previousOutgoingTTI)
    end
    return out
  end
  if finite(travel.travelElapsed) and travel.travelElapsed >= 0 and text(travel.travelTargetName) then
    out.travel[#out.travel + 1] = string.format("Target (%s): %.0f ms", travel.travelTargetName, travel.travelElapsed * 1000)
  end
  if positive(travel.lastTravelTime) then
    local who = text(travel.lastTravelTargetName) and (" (" .. travel.lastTravelTargetName .. ")") or ""
    out.travel[#out.travel + 1] = string.format("Last target%s: %.0f ms", who, travel.lastTravelTime * 1000)
  end
  if positive(travel.fatalTravelTime) then
    local who = text(travel.deceasedName) and (" (" .. travel.deceasedName .. ")") or ""
    out.travel[#out.travel + 1] = string.format("Last death%s: %.0f ms", who, travel.fatalTravelTime * 1000)
  end
  return out
end

function Telemetry.create(loaded)
  local Utils = loaded.utils
  local lastActivation, lastStop = nil, nil
  local lastPeak, lastDistance = nil, {}
  local lastTravel = {}
  local function finite(v) return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v > -math.huge and v < math.huge end
  local function validText(v) return type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" and v ~= "nil" and v ~= "null" end
  local function read()
    local enabled = {
      ap = Utils.getConfigValue("APMaxCpsVisible") == true,
      gates = Utils.getConfigValue("ClashGateInfoVisible") == true,
      travel = Utils.getConfigValue("ClashTravelTimeVisible") == true,
      distance = Utils.getConfigValue("ClashDistanceVisible") == true,
    }

    local data = {}
    if enabled.ap then
      data.ap = loaded.status.get("autoparry")
    end
    if enabled.gates then
      data.dynamicParry = loaded.status.get("dynamicparry")
    end
    if enabled.gates or enabled.travel or enabled.distance then
      data.autoSpam = loaded.status.get("autospam")
    end
    if type(data.autoSpam) == "table" then
      local status = data.autoSpam
      if
        type(status.lastActivationReason) == "string"
        and status.lastActivationReason ~= ""
        and status.lastActivationReason ~= "nil"
        and status.lastActivationReason ~= "null"
      then
        lastActivation = status.lastActivationReason
      end
      if type(status.lastStopReason) == "string" and status.lastStopReason ~= "" and status.lastStopReason ~= "nil" and status.lastStopReason ~= "null" then
        lastStop = status.lastStopReason
      end
    end
    local status = type(data.autoSpam) == "table" and table.clone(data.autoSpam) or {}
    status.lastActivationReason, status.lastStopReason = lastActivation, lastStop
    data.autoSpam = status
    local peak = type(data.ap) == "table" and data.ap.maxObservedCps
    if finite(peak) and peak > 0 and (not lastPeak or peak > lastPeak) then
      lastPeak = peak
    end
    data.ap = { maxObservedCps = lastPeak }
    local stats = type(status.clashStats) == "table" and status.clashStats or {}
    if stats.partnerId and stats.partnerId ~= lastTravel.partnerId then
      lastTravel.partnerId = stats.partnerId
      lastTravel.outgoingRecordedAt, lastTravel.lastOutgoingTTI, lastTravel.previousOutgoingTTI = nil, nil, nil
    end
    if finite(stats.outgoingRecordedAt) then
      lastTravel.outgoingRecordedAt, lastTravel.lastOutgoingTTI, lastTravel.previousOutgoingTTI =
        stats.outgoingRecordedAt, stats.lastOutgoingTTI, stats.previousOutgoingTTI
    end
    if finite(stats.incomingRecordedAt) then
      lastTravel.incomingRecordedAt, lastTravel.lastIncomingTTI, lastTravel.previousIncomingTTI =
        stats.incomingRecordedAt, stats.lastIncomingTTI, stats.previousIncomingTTI
    end
    if finite(stats.travelElapsed) and stats.travelElapsed >= 0 and validText(stats.travelTargetName) then
      lastTravel.travelElapsed, lastTravel.travelTargetName = stats.travelElapsed, stats.travelTargetName
    end
    if finite(stats.lastTravelTime) and stats.lastTravelTime > 0 then
      lastTravel.lastTravelTime, lastTravel.lastTravelTargetName = stats.lastTravelTime, stats.lastTravelTargetName
    end
    if finite(stats.fatalTravelTime) and stats.fatalTravelTime > 0 then
      lastTravel.fatalTravelTime, lastTravel.deceasedName = stats.fatalTravelTime, stats.deceasedName
    end
    data.travel = lastTravel
    local panels = StatusView.format(data)
    if #panels.distance > 0 then
      lastDistance = panels.distance
    end
    panels.distance = lastDistance
    return panels
  end

  local cachedAt, cached = -math.huge, {}
  local function value(id)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - cachedAt >= 0.05 then
      cached, cachedAt = read(), now
    end
    return table.concat(cached[id] or {}, "\n")
  end
  local result = {}
  for _, spec in ipairs({
    { "distance", "ClashDistanceVisible", Vector2.new(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0) },
    { "travel", "ClashTravelTimeVisible", Vector2.new(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20) },
    { "gates", "ClashGateInfoVisible", Vector2.new(0, 0.5), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0) },
    { "ap", "APMaxCpsVisible", Vector2.new(1, 0.5), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0) },
  }) do
    result[#result + 1] = { id = spec[1], key = spec[2], anchor = spec[3], position = spec[4], read = function() return value(spec[1]) end }
  end
  return result
end
Telemetry.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "create" }, requires = {} }
return Telemetry

-- [[ runtime ]]
--!optimize 2

-- code
local Runtime = {}
local assistScope
function Runtime.setup() return true end
local function contractOf(module) return type(module) == "table" and module.__contract or {} end
function Runtime.bind(loaded, MODULE_ORDER, HttpService, printRawError)
  if assistScope then
    assistScope.destroy()
  end
  assistScope = loaded.lifetime.scope()
  local player, utils = loaded.utils.getLocalPlayer(), loaded.utils
  local characterScope
  local function watch(character)
    if characterScope then
      characterScope.destroy()
    end
    characterScope = assistScope.child()
    local humanoids = {}
    local function bind(humanoid)
      if not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or humanoids[humanoid] then
        return
      end
      humanoids[humanoid] = true
      characterScope.connect(humanoid.Died, function()
        if
          player.Character == character
          and utils.isActive()
          and utils.getConfigValue("ParryOnDeath") == true
          and utils.getConfigValue("AutoParry") ~= true
        then
          utils.setConfig({ AutoParry = true })
        end
      end)
    end
    characterScope.connect(character.ChildAdded, bind)
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
      bind(child)
    end
  end
  assistScope.connect(player.CharacterAdded, watch)
  assistScope.connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function()
    if characterScope then
      characterScope.destroy()
      characterScope = nil
    end
  end)
  if player.Character then
    watch(player.Character)
  end
  local utils = loaded.utils
  local gameInfo = loaded.gameinfo
  local remote = loaded.remote
  if
    type(gameInfo) ~= "table"
    or type(gameInfo.applySync) ~= "function"
    or type(gameInfo.installBallWatcher) ~= "function"
    or type(gameInfo.getSyncData) ~= "function"
    or type(remote) ~= "table"
    or type(gameInfo.bindBallSync) ~= "function"
    or type(gameInfo.startMaintenance) ~= "function"
    or type(gameInfo.stopMaintenance) ~= "function"
  then
    return nil, "contrato de runtime incompleto"
  end
  local ballSyncSubscribers = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(MODULE_ORDER) do
    local module = loaded[name]
    if name ~= "utils" and type(module) == "table" then
      local contract = contractOf(module)
      if contract.onBallSync == true and type(module.onBallSync) ~= "function" then
        return nil, "contrato BallSync incompleto: " .. name
      end
      if contract.onBallSync == true then
        ballSyncSubscribers[#ballSyncSubscribers + 1] = {
          name = name,
          handler = module.onBallSync,
        }
      end
    end
  end
  local syncPriority = { combatloop = 1 }
  table.sort(ballSyncSubscribers, function(a, b)
    local left, right = syncPriority[a.name] or 3, syncPriority[b.name] or 3
    return left == right and a.name < b.name or left < right
  end)
  local syncErrors = {}
  local function dispatchBallSync(decodedData)
    if not utils.isActive() or type(decodedData) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    for _, sub in ipairs(ballSyncSubscribers) do
      local ok, result, detail = pcall(sub.handler, decodedData)
      if not ok or result == false then
        local message = not ok and debug.traceback(tostring(result), 2) or tostring(detail or "handler retornou false")
        local time = os.clock()
        if not syncErrors[sub.name] or time - syncErrors[sub.name] >= 1 then
          syncErrors[sub.name] = time
          local reported, reportError = pcall(utils.recordError, sub.name .. ".onBallSync", message)
          if not reported then
            printRawError(sub.name, reportError)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local pendingAttributeRefresh = false
  local function notifyBallSync(data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" then
      return
    end
    if data.Source == "clash" or (data.Source == "target" and data.TargetPlayerID == nil) then
      if pendingAttributeRefresh then
        return
      end
      pendingAttributeRefresh = true
      task.defer(function()
        pendingAttributeRefresh = false
        if utils.isActive() then
          dispatchBallSync({ Source = "clash" })
        end
      end)
    else
      dispatchBallSync(data)
    end
  end
  local pendingSyncRefresh = false
  local function scheduleSyncRefresh()
    if pendingSyncRefresh then
      return
    end
    pendingSyncRefresh = true
    task.defer(function()
      pendingSyncRefresh = false
      if not utils.isActive() then
        return
      end
      local refreshed = gameInfo.applySync(nil)
      if type(refreshed) == "table" then
        refreshed = table.clone(refreshed)
        refreshed.Source = "replicator"
        notifyBallSync(refreshed)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function onBallSync(...)
    if not utils.isActive() then
      return
    end
    local argCount = select("#", ...)
    local data
    for index = 1, argCount do
      local value = select(index, ...)
      if typeof(value) == "buffer" then
        if type(gameInfo.decodeBallPacket) == "function" then
          local packet = gameInfo.decodeBallPacket(value)
          if type(packet) == "table" and type(packet.Sequence) == "number" then
            packet.Source = "packet"
            if gameInfo.applyPacket(packet) then
              notifyBallSync(packet)
            end
          end
        end
        scheduleSyncRefresh()
        return
      end
      if type(value) == "table" then
        data = value
        break
      end
      if type(value) == "string" then
        local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, value)
        if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
          data = decoded
          break
        end
      end
    end
    local decodedData = gameInfo.applySync(data)
    if type(decodedData) ~= "table" then
      scheduleSyncRefresh()
      return
    end
    decodedData = table.clone(decodedData)
    decodedData.Source = "packet"
    notifyBallSync(decodedData)
  end
  local watcherReady = gameInfo.installBallWatcher(utils.trackGlobal, notifyBallSync)
  if watcherReady ~= true then
    error("GameInfo.installBallWatcher falhou", 2)
  end
  local syncReady = gameInfo.bindBallSync(onBallSync)
  local maintenanceReady = gameInfo.startMaintenance({
    isActive = utils.isActive,
    onBallSync = onBallSync,
  })
  if maintenanceReady ~= true then
    error("GameInfo.startMaintenance falhou", 2)
  end
  local parryReady = gameInfo.getDeflectAbility() ~= nil
  return {
    parryRemote = parryReady,
    parryInitialized = parryReady,
    watcher = watcherReady == true,
    ballSync = syncReady == true,
    maintenance = maintenanceReady == true,
    ballSyncSubscribers = #ballSyncSubscribers,
  }
end
function Runtime.createAPI(loaded)
  local info, utils = loaded.gameinfo, loaded.utils
  return {
    readouts = loaded.telemetry.create(loaded),
    createActions = function(context) return loaded.inventoryactions.create(loaded, context) end,
    getJumpButton = function()
      local player = utils.getLocalPlayer()
      local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
      for _, name in ipairs({ "Interface", "MobileUI", "Buttons", "Jump", "Button" }) do
        gui = gui and gui:FindFirstChild(name)
      end
      return gui
    end,
    getUIConfig = function() return loaded.gameui.definition end,
    getGameContext = info.getGameContext,
    areAbilitiesEnabled = info.areAbilitiesEnabled,
    getAbilityAvailability = info.getAbilityAvailability,
    observeAbilityMode = info.observeAbilityMode,
    hasClashPrediction = loaded.autospam.hasClashPrediction,
    resetState = loaded.spam.resetState,
    createVisualAdapter = loaded.nativevisuals.create,
    applyVisualPolicy = loaded.nativevisuals.apply,
    controls = {
      onAutoDarkChanged = loaded.autodark.sync,
      onAutoJumpChanged = loaded.autojump.sync,
      onUpDash = function()
        local ok, err = loaded.movement.upDash()
        if not ok then
          utils.recordError("UpDash", err or "Dash indisponível")
        end
      end,
      onPanic = function()
        utils.setConfig({ AutoParry = false, AutoSpam = false })
        utils.stopAllSpam()
        loaded.autospam.stopSpam()
      end,
    },
    updateBlockers = {
      function()
        local match = info.getGameContext()
        if not match.inMatch or not match.alive then
          return false
        end
        local physics = loaded.deflectgeometry.getDefensePhysics()
        local clash = info.getClashContext()
        local spam = loaded.autospam.getActivationContext()
        return (physics and physics.inClash == true)
          or (clash and type(clash.age) == "number" and clash.age >= 0 and clash.age <= 0.8)
          or (spam and spam.active == true)
      end,
    },
    miniVisibility = {
      MiniSpamVisible = function()
        if utils.getConfigValue("ManualSpamUIOnDuel") ~= true then
          return false
        end
        local match = info.getGameContext()
        if not match.inMatch or not match.alive or not match.roundActive then
          return false
        end
        local count = 0
        for _, candidate in ipairs(utils.getPlayers():GetPlayers()) do
          local lives, model = candidate:GetAttribute("Lives"), candidate.Character
          local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if type(lives) == "number" and lives > 0 and candidate:GetAttribute("Playing") ~= false and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            count += 1
          end
        end
        return count == 2
      end,
    },
    migrateConfig = function(data)
      local changed = false
      if data.AutoSpam == nil and type(data.AutoClash) == "boolean" then
        data.AutoSpam = data.AutoClash
        changed = true
      end
      if data.AutoParryFactor08Applied ~= true then
        data.AutoParryWindowFactor, data.AutoParryFactor08Applied, changed = 0.25, true, true
      elseif tonumber(data.AutoParryWindowFactor) == 0.8 then
        data.AutoParryWindowFactor, changed = 0.25, true
      end
      if data.AutoParryFactor03Applied ~= true then
        if tonumber(data.AutoParryWindowFactor) == 0.25 then
          data.AutoParryWindowFactor = 0.3
        end
        data.AutoParryFactor03Applied, changed = true, true
      end
      if data.ClickMethod == "Game" then
        data.ClickMethod, changed = "Deflect", true
      end
      for _, key in ipairs({
        "AutoClash",
        "AutoClashActivationMs",
        "AutoClashDeactivationMs",
        "ClashMaxDistance",
        "AutoSpamClashPrediction",
        "AutoSpamPredictionMargin",
        "ClashGrace",
        "ClashMaxAge",
      }) do
        if data[key] ~= nil then
          data[key], changed = nil, true
        end
      end
      return changed
    end,
  }
end
function Runtime.teardown()
  if assistScope then
    assistScope.destroy()
    assistScope = nil
  end
  return true
end
Runtime.__contract = { provides = { "setup", "teardown", "bind", "createAPI" }, requires = {} }

return Runtime
