-- [[ clash stats ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local ClashStats = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local players
local localPlayer
local deflectGeometry
local stats

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  CLASH_RETENTION_SECONDS = 1.5,
  PACKET_FALLBACK_SECONDS = 0.5,
  CPS_SAMPLE_CAP = 35,
  CPS_SMOOTHING_FACTOR = 0.2,
}

-- helpers
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function userId(value)
  if type(value) == "string" then
    value = tonumber(value)
  end
  return finite(value) and value > 0 and value % 1 == 0 and value or nil
end
local function snapshotSpeed(snapshot)
  if not snapshot then
    return nil
  end
  local speed = tonumber(snapshot.syncSpeed)
  return finite(speed) and speed > 0 and speed or snapshot.speed
end

-- lifecycle
function ClashStats.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes"
  end
  if type(deps.DeflectGeometry) ~= "table" then
    return false, "DeflectGeometry ausente"
  end
  ClashStats.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, deflectGeometry = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.DeflectGeometry
  players, localPlayer = utils.getPlayers(), utils.getLocalPlayer()
  if not players or not localPlayer then
    return false, "serviços indisponíveis"
  end
  stats = nil
  return true
end
function ClashStats.teardown()
  stats = nil
  utils, gameInfo, players, localPlayer, deflectGeometry = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- recording
function ClashStats.finish(reason, time)
  if not stats or stats.frozen then
    return
  end
  time = finite(time) and time or stats.lastObserved or stats.startedAt
  stats.frozen, stats.waitingForClash = true, false
  stats.duration = math.max(0, time - stats.startedAt)
  stats.cps = stats.duration > 0 and stats.totalSwitches / stats.duration or 0
  stats.endReason = reason
end
function ClashStats.begin(partner, time)
  if stats and not stats.frozen then
    ClashStats.finish("novo clash", stats.lastObserved)
  end
  local previous = stats
    and {
      ball = stats.incomingBall,
      target = stats.travelObservedTarget,
      last = stats.lastIncomingTTI,
      penultimate = stats.previousIncomingTTI,
      at = stats.incomingRecordedAt,
      outgoing = stats.lastOutgoingTTI,
      outgoingPrevious = stats.previousOutgoingTTI,
      outgoingAt = stats.outgoingRecordedAt,
      partner = stats.partnerId,
    }
  stats = stats or {}
  table.clear(stats)
  if previous then
    stats.incomingBall, stats.travelObservedTarget = previous.ball, previous.target
    stats.lastIncomingTTI, stats.previousIncomingTTI, stats.incomingRecordedAt = previous.last, previous.penultimate, previous.at
    if previous.partner == partner then
      stats.lastOutgoingTTI, stats.previousOutgoingTTI, stats.outgoingRecordedAt = previous.outgoing, previous.outgoingPrevious, previous.outgoingAt
    end
  end
  stats.partnerId, stats.cps, stats.lastObserved = partner, 0, time
  stats.startedAt, stats.startedDate = time, os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  stats.totalSwitches, stats.frozen = 0, false
end

-- observation
function ClashStats.observe(session, snapshot, time, fresh)
  local partner = session.active and session.partner
  if not partner then
    local context = gameInfo.getClashContext()
    partner = context and context.partnerId
  end
  local target = userId(snapshot.exchangeTargetId or snapshot.targetId)
  if
    not partner
    and stats
    and not stats.frozen
    and time - (stats.lastSwitchAt or stats.startedAt) <= CONFIG.CLASH_RETENTION_SECONDS
    and (target == localPlayer.UserId or target == stats.partnerId)
  then
    partner = stats.partnerId
  end
  if not partner then
    if stats and not stats.frozen and time - stats.lastObserved > CONFIG.CLASH_RETENTION_SECONDS then
      ClashStats.finish("clash encerrado", stats.lastObserved)
    end
    if stats and stats.frozen then
      stats.waitingForClash = true
    end
    return
  end
  if stats and stats.frozen then
    if not stats.waitingForClash then
      return
    end
    ClashStats.begin(partner, time)
  elseif not stats or stats.partnerId ~= partner or time - stats.lastObserved > CONFIG.CLASH_RETENTION_SECONDS then
    ClashStats.begin(partner, time)
  end
  local observeTarget = fresh or not stats.lastPacketAt or time - stats.lastPacketAt > CONFIG.PACKET_FALLBACK_SECONDS
  if fresh then
    stats.lastPacketAt = time
  end
  if observeTarget and target then
    local me = localPlayer.UserId
    if fresh then
      if stats.incomingBall ~= snapshot.ball or snapshot.teleported or snapshot.resetting then
        stats.travelObservedTarget = nil
        if stats.incomingBall ~= snapshot.ball then
          stats.lastIncomingTTI, stats.previousIncomingTTI, stats.incomingRecordedAt = nil, nil, nil
          stats.lastOutgoingTTI, stats.previousOutgoingTTI, stats.outgoingRecordedAt = nil, nil, nil
        end
        stats.incomingBall = snapshot.ball
      end
      if
        (target == me or target == partner)
        and stats.travelObservedTarget ~= target
        and not snapshot.teleported
        and not snapshot.resetting
        and not snapshot.locked
      then
        local root = session.root
        if target ~= me then
          local position, velocity = gameInfo.getPlayerMotion(target)
          root = typeof(position) == "Vector3" and { Parent = true, Position = position, AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity } or nil
        end
        local position = typeof(snapshot.realPosition) == "Vector3" and snapshot.realPosition or snapshot.position
        local velocity = snapshot.velocity
        local tti
        if root and root.Parent and typeof(position) == "Vector3" and typeof(velocity) == "Vector3" then
          local delta = root.Position - position
          local distance = delta.Magnitude
          local kill = deflectGeometry.getKillRadius(deflectGeometry.getDefensePhysics())
          local remaining = math.max(0, distance - kill)
          local rootVelocity = typeof(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) == "Vector3" and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
          local closing = distance > 0 and (velocity - rootVelocity):Dot(delta) / distance or 0
          if remaining == 0 then
            tti = 0
          elseif finite(closing) and closing > 0 then
            local acceleration = finite(snapshot.syncAcceleration) and math.max(0, snapshot.syncAcceleration) or 0
            tti = acceleration > 0.0001 and 2 * remaining / (closing + math.sqrt(closing * closing + 2 * acceleration * remaining)) or remaining / closing
          end
        end
        local value = finite(tti) and tti >= 0 and tti or nil
        if target == me then
          stats.previousIncomingTTI, stats.lastIncomingTTI, stats.incomingRecordedAt = stats.lastIncomingTTI, value, time
        else
          stats.previousOutgoingTTI, stats.lastOutgoingTTI, stats.outgoingRecordedAt = stats.lastOutgoingTTI, value, time
        end
      end
      stats.travelObservedTarget = target
    end
    if stats.lastTarget == me and target == partner then
      stats.cycleArmed = true
      stats.lastSwitchAt = time
    elseif stats.lastTarget == partner and target == me then
      if stats.cycleArmed then
        stats.totalSwitches += 1
        if stats.lastCycleAt and time > stats.lastCycleAt then
          stats.cycleInterval = time - stats.lastCycleAt
          local sample = math.min(CONFIG.CPS_SAMPLE_CAP, 1 / stats.cycleInterval)
          stats.currentCps = stats.currentCps and (stats.currentCps + CONFIG.CPS_SMOOTHING_FACTOR * (sample - stats.currentCps)) or sample
        end
        stats.lastCycleAt = time
      end
      stats.cycleArmed = false
      stats.lastSwitchAt = time
    elseif target ~= me and target ~= partner then
      stats.cycleArmed, stats.lastCycleAt, stats.cycleInterval, stats.currentCps = false, nil, nil, nil
    end
    stats.lastTarget = target
  end
  local duration = time - stats.startedAt
  stats.cps = duration > 0 and stats.totalSwitches / duration or 0
  local speed = snapshotSpeed(snapshot)
  if finite(speed) and speed >= 0 then
    stats.speed = speed
  end
  local root = session.root
  if not root or not root.Parent then
    return
  end
  local other = gameInfo.getPlayerMotion(partner)
  local own = root.Position
  local distance = typeof(other) == "Vector3" and (other - own).Magnitude or nil
  if finite(distance) then
    stats.distance = distance
  end
  stats.lastObserved = time
  local sample = stats.endSample or {}
  sample.time, sample.distance, sample.speed, sample.cps = math.max(0, time - stats.startedAt), distance, stats.speed, stats.cps
  sample.own, sample.opponent, sample.ball = own, other, snapshot.position
  if not stats.startSample then
    stats.startSample = table.clone(sample)
  end
  stats.endSample = sample
end
function ClashStats.freeze(playerId, session)
  if not stats or stats.frozen or (playerId ~= localPlayer.UserId and playerId ~= stats.partnerId) then
    return
  end
  local time = utils.now()
  stats.deceasedId = playerId
  local sample = stats.endSample
  if sample and session and session.root and session.root.Parent then
    local other = gameInfo.getPlayerMotion(stats.partnerId)
    sample.own, sample.opponent = session.root.Position, other
    if typeof(other) == "Vector3" then
      sample.distance = (other - sample.own).Magnitude
    end
  end
  ClashStats.finish(playerId == localPlayer.UserId and "jogador morreu" or "oponente morreu", time)
end
function ClashStats.waitForNextClash()
  if stats and stats.frozen then
    stats.waitingForClash = true
  end
end
function ClashStats.get() return stats end
function ClashStats.getStatus()
  if not stats then
    return {}
  end
  local currentCps = stats.currentCps
  if currentCps and not stats.frozen then
    currentCps = math.min(currentCps, 1 / math.max(stats.cycleInterval or 0, stats.lastCycleAt and utils.now() - stats.lastCycleAt or math.huge))
  end
  local duration = stats.duration or (stats.startedAt and math.max(0, utils.now() - stats.startedAt))
  return {
    partnerId = stats.partnerId,
    distance = stats.distance,
    cps = stats.cps,
    currentCps = currentCps,
    startSample = stats.startSample and table.clone(stats.startSample) or nil,
    endSample = stats.endSample and table.clone(stats.endSample) or nil,
    endReason = stats.endReason,
    speed = stats.speed,
    frozen = stats.frozen,
    duration = duration,
    lastIncomingTTI = stats.lastIncomingTTI,
    previousIncomingTTI = stats.previousIncomingTTI,
    incomingRecordedAt = stats.incomingRecordedAt,
    lastOutgoingTTI = stats.lastOutgoingTTI,
    previousOutgoingTTI = stats.previousOutgoingTTI,
    outgoingRecordedAt = stats.outgoingRecordedAt,
    deceasedName = stats.deceasedId and (stats.deceasedId == localPlayer.UserId and "You" or "Opponent") or nil,
    deceasedId = stats.deceasedId,
  }
end

-- contract
ClashStats.__contract = {
  access = {
    default = "combat.runtime",
    methods = { observe = "combat.runtime" },
  },
  requires = {
    Utils = "utils",
    GameInfo = "gameinfo",
    DeflectGeometry = "deflectgeometry",
  },
  requiresMethods = {
    DeflectGeometry = { "getKillRadius", "getDefensePhysics" },
    Utils = { "getLocalPlayer", "getPlayers", "now" },
    GameInfo = { "getClashContext", "getPlayerMotion" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "teardown", "begin", "finish", "observe", "freeze", "get", "getStatus", "waitForNextClash" },
}

return ClashStats

-- [[ dash ]]
--!optimize 2

-- module
local Dash = {}
local utils
local gameInfo
local players
local handler
local records, recordList, connections = {}, {}, {}
local generation = 0

-- configuration
local CONFIG = {
  MIN_SPEED = 70,
  NORMAL_CONFIRM_TIME = 0.06,
  WIND_BLOCK_TIME = 0.85,
  MAX_MEASURED_SPEED = 400,
  MAX_SAMPLE_GAP = 0.15,
  SIGNAL_GRACE = 0.22,
  DETECTION_GAP = 0.06,
  TICK_INTERVAL = 1 / 120,
}

local PROFILES = { normal = { speed = 120, duration = 0.2 } }

-- helpers
local function now() return utils and utils.now() or os.clock() end
local function rootOf(player, record)
  local character = player.Character
  if not character then
    return nil
  end
  local cached = record and record.root
  if cached and cached.Parent == character then
    return cached
  end
  local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
    return nil
  end
  if record then
    record.root = root
  end
  return root
end
local function disconnect(connection)
  if connection then
    if utils then
      utils.untrackGlobal(connection)
    end
    connection:Disconnect()
  end
end
local function estimate(record, time)
  if
    not record.observedAt
    or not record.position
    or not record.velocity
    or time < record.observedAt
    or time < record.positionAt
    or time - record.positionAt > CONFIG.MAX_SAMPLE_GAP
  then
    return nil
  end
  local elapsed = time - record.observedAt
  local remaining = math.max(0, PROFILES.normal.duration - elapsed)
  return {
    ability = record.normalConfirmed and "normal" or (record.kind == "wind" and "wind" or "unknown"),
    observedAt = record.observedAt,
    sampledAt = record.positionAt,
    signalActive = record.signalActive,
    position = record.position,
    velocity = record.velocity,
    observedDisplacement = (record.position - record.observedPosition).Magnitude,
    guaranteedRemainingDistance = 0,
    normalModel = record.normalConfirmed and {
      duration = PROFILES.normal.duration,
      elapsedSinceObserved = elapsed,
      estimatedRemaining = remaining,
      estimatedRemainingDistance = record.velocity.Magnitude * remaining,
      estimatedEndPosition = record.position + record.velocity * remaining,
    },
  }
end
local function emit(player, record, position, velocity, previous, time, confirmed)
  local newConfirmation = confirmed and record.confirmedSignalAt ~= record.signalAt
  if not newConfirmation and time - (record.lastDetection or -math.huge) < CONFIG.DETECTION_GAP then
    return
  end
  if confirmed then
    record.confirmedSignalAt = record.signalAt
  end
  record.lastDetection = time
  if handler then
    handler({
      player = player,
      userId = player.UserId,
      detectedAt = time,
      position = position,
      velocity = velocity,
      confirmed = confirmed,
      signalAt = record.signalAt,
      signalActive = record.signalActive,
      previousPosition = previous,
      estimate = estimate(record, time),
    })
  end
end

-- sampling
local function resetCharacter(record, character)
  record.kind, record.normalConfirmed, record.windUntil = nil, false, nil
  record.character = character
  record.root, record.position, record.positionAt = nil, nil, nil
  record.lastDetection, record.signalAt, record.signalActive, record.confirmedSignalAt = nil, -math.huge, false, nil
  record.observedAt, record.observedPosition, record.velocity = nil, nil, nil
end
local function observe(player, record, time, suppliedRoot)
  local character = player.Character
  if record.character ~= character then
    resetCharacter(record, character)
  end
  if record.positionAt and time >= record.positionAt and time - record.positionAt < CONFIG.TICK_INTERVAL then
    return
  end
  if not character or not character.Parent then
    return
  end
  local root = suppliedRoot or rootOf(player, record)
  if suppliedRoot then
    record.root = suppliedRoot
  end
  if not root then
    record.position, record.positionAt = nil, nil
    return
  end
  local position, velocity = root.Position, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  local previous, previousAt = record.position, record.positionAt
  local delta = previousAt and time - previousAt
  if previous and delta and delta > 0 and delta <= CONFIG.MAX_SAMPLE_GAP then
    local measured = (position - previous) / delta
    if measured.Magnitude > velocity.Magnitude and measured.Magnitude < CONFIG.MAX_MEASURED_SPEED then
      velocity = measured
    end
  end
  local signal = gameInfo.isPlayerDashing(player)
  if signal and not record.signalActive then
    record.signalAt, record.observedAt, record.observedPosition = time, time, position
  end
  record.signalActive = signal
  local speed = velocity.Magnitude
  local kind, proof = gameInfo.getPlayerDashKind(player)
  if kind == "wind" or (signal and speed > 140) then
    record.windUntil = time + CONFIG.WIND_BLOCK_TIME
  end
  if record.windUntil and time < record.windUntil then
    kind = "wind"
  end
  record.kind = kind
  record.normalConfirmed = signal
      and kind == "normal"
      and speed >= CONFIG.MIN_SPEED
      and speed <= 140
      and (proof == "native" or (record.observedAt and time - record.observedAt >= CONFIG.NORMAL_CONFIRM_TIME))
    or false
  record.position, record.positionAt, record.velocity = position, time, velocity
  if record.normalConfirmed then
    emit(player, record, position, velocity, previous, time, true)
  end
end

-- player-tracking
local function removePlayer(player)
  local record = records[player]
  if not record then
    return
  end
  local index, last = record.index, recordList[#recordList]
  if index then
    recordList[index] = last
    recordList[#recordList] = nil
    if last and last ~= record then
      last.index = index
    end
  end
  resetCharacter(record, nil)
  disconnect(record.characterConnection)
  records[player] = nil
end
local function addPlayer(player)
  if records[player] then
    return
  end
  local record = { player = player, index = #recordList + 1, signalAt = -math.huge }
  records[player] = record
  recordList[#recordList + 1] = record
  record.characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    if records[player] == record then
      resetCharacter(record, character)
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(record.characterConnection)
end

-- setup
function Dash.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" then
    return false, "dependências ausentes: Utils ou GameInfo"
  end
  Dash.teardown()
  utils, gameInfo, players = deps.Utils, deps.GameInfo, deps.Utils.getPlayers()
  if not players then
    return false, "Players indisponível"
  end
  local token = generation
  connections.added = players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    if token == generation then
      addPlayer(player)
    end
  end)
  connections.removing = players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    if token == generation then
      removePlayer(player)
    end
  end)
  utils.trackGlobal(connections.added)
  utils.trackGlobal(connections.removing)
  for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
    addPlayer(player)
  end
  return true
end
function Dash.setHandler(callback)
  handler = type(callback) == "function" and callback or nil
  return true
end
function Dash.tick(time, excludeLocal, center, radius)
  if not players then
    return
  end
  time = type(time) == "number" and time or now()
  if time ~= time or math.abs(time) == math.huge then
    return
  end
  if type(center) == "number" then
    local player = players:GetPlayerByUserId(center)
    local record = player and records[player]
    if record and player.Parent and (not excludeLocal or player ~= players.LocalPlayer) then
      observe(player, record, time)
    end
    return
  end
  local limit = typeof(center) == "Vector3" and type(radius) == "number" and radius > 0 and radius * radius or nil
  for i = 1, #recordList do
    local record = recordList[i]
    local player = record.player
    if player.Parent and (not excludeLocal or player ~= players.LocalPlayer) then
      if not limit then
        observe(player, record, time)
      else
        local root = rootOf(player, record)
        if root and root.Parent then
          local delta = root.Position - center
          if delta:Dot(delta) <= limit then
            observe(player, record, time, root)
          else
            record.position, record.positionAt, record.signalActive, record.signalAt = nil, nil, false, -math.huge
            record.observedAt, record.observedPosition, record.velocity = nil, nil, nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
function Dash.resetState()
  generation += 1
  disconnect(connections.added)
  disconnect(connections.removing)
  connections = {}
  while next(records) do
    removePlayer(next(records))
  end
  table.clear(recordList)
  players = nil
end
function Dash.teardown()
  Dash.resetState()
  utils, gameInfo, handler = nil, nil, nil
end

-- public-api
function Dash.getProfiles()
  return {
    normal = {
      speed = PROFILES.normal.speed,
      duration = PROFILES.normal.duration,
      nominalDistance = PROFILES.normal.speed * PROFILES.normal.duration,
    },
  }
end
function Dash.getEstimate(userId)
  local player = players and players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
  local record = player and records[player]
  if not record then
    return nil
  end
  return estimate(record, now())
end
function Dash.getStatus()
  local count = #recordList
  return {
    schema = utils and utils.apiVersion and utils.apiVersion() or 1,
    players = players ~= nil,
    detecting = players ~= nil,
    playerCount = count,
  }
end

-- contract
Dash.__contract = {
  requires = { Utils = "utils", GameInfo = "gameinfo" },
  requiresMethods = {
    Utils = { "apiVersion", "getPlayers", "now", "trackGlobal", "untrackGlobal" },
    GameInfo = { "isPlayerDashing", "getPlayerDashKind" },
  },
  provides = { "setup", "setHandler", "tick", "resetState", "teardown", "getStatus", "getProfiles", "getEstimate" },
}

return Dash

-- [[ deflectgeometry ]]
--!optimize 2
--!native

-- code
local Geometry = {}
local gameInfo
local players
local world
local CONFIG = {
  WINDOW_BASE = 0.85,
  WINDOW_SPREAD = 0.65,
  RANGE_BASE = 8.5,
  RANGE_BONUS_SPAN = 7.5,
  RANGE_BONUS_STEP = 0.225,
  RANGE_WINDOW_BONUS = 0.12,
  AUTO_PARRY_TRIGGER_PADDING = 0,
  AP_WINDOW_LOW_SPEED = 0.45,
  AP_WINDOW_HIGH_SPEED = 0.25,
  TRAINING_BASE_SPEED = 16,
  TRAINING_MAX_SPEED = 600,
  TRAINING_DEFLECT_DISTANCE = 8.5,
  TRAINING_TRIGGER_PADDING = 2,
  TRAINING_MAX_PING = 0.25,
  TRAINING_MAX_LEAD_FACTOR = 0.8,
  TRAINING_WINDOW_SLOW = 0.85,
  TRAINING_WINDOW_FAST = 0.2,
  TRAINING_WINDOW_FACTOR = 0.3,
  FRAME_BASE = 1 / 60,
}

local EMPTY_OPTIONS = {}
local function finite(value) return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge end
local function vector(value) return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z) end
local function validBallSpeed(value) return finite(value) and value >= 0 and value <= 1000 end
local function sharedLayout() return gameInfo.usesSharedLayout() end
local function projectParts(range, speed, window, factor, latency, extraRange, latencyFactor, padding)
  speed = finite(speed) and math.max(0, speed) or 0
  range = finite(range) and range or 0
  extraRange = finite(extraRange) and extraRange or 0
  window = finite(window) and math.max(0, window) or 0
  factor = finite(factor) and math.max(0, factor) or 1
  latency = finite(latency) and math.max(0, latency) or 0
  latencyFactor = finite(latencyFactor) and math.max(0, latencyFactor) or 1
  padding = finite(padding) and padding or 0
  local windowRadius, pingRadius = speed * window * factor, speed * latency * latencyFactor
  return range + extraRange + windowRadius + pingRadius + padding, windowRadius, pingRadius, window * factor + latency * latencyFactor
end
function Geometry.setup(deps)
  if type(deps) ~= "table" or type(deps.GameInfo) ~= "table" or type(deps.Utils) ~= "table" then
    return false, "GameInfo ou Utils ausente"
  end
  local nextPlayers, nextWorld = deps.Utils.getPlayers(), deps.Utils.getWorkspace()
  if not nextPlayers or not nextWorld then
    return false, "Players ou Workspace ausente"
  end
  gameInfo, players, world = deps.GameInfo, nextPlayers, nextWorld
  return true
end
function Geometry.getDeflectRangeParameters() return CONFIG.RANGE_BASE, CONFIG.RANGE_BONUS_SPAN, sharedLayout() and 0.1125 or CONFIG.RANGE_BONUS_STEP end
function Geometry.getDeflectRange()
  local player = players.LocalPlayer
  local range = player and player:GetAttribute("DeflectRange") or nil
  if sharedLayout() and player then
    return Geometry.getPlayerDeflectRange(player.UserId)
  end
  return range
end
function Geometry.getPlayerDeflectRange(id)
  local player = type(id) == "number" and players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
  if not player then
    return nil
  end
  local range = player:GetAttribute("DeflectRange")
  if not finite(range) then
    return CONFIG.RANGE_BASE
  end
  range = math.clamp(range, CONFIG.RANGE_BASE, CONFIG.RANGE_BASE + CONFIG.RANGE_BONUS_SPAN)
  if sharedLayout() and range > CONFIG.RANGE_BASE and type(gameInfo.getClashContext) == "function" then
    local context = gameInfo.getClashContext()
    local own = players.LocalPlayer
    if context and own and (id == own.UserId or id == context.partnerId) then
      local distance = gameInfo.getPlayerDistance(context.partnerId)
      if finite(distance) and distance <= math.max(20, range + 8) then
        return CONFIG.RANGE_BASE
      end
    end
  end
  return range
end
function Geometry.getPlayerRawRadius(id, speed, includePing)
  local range = Geometry.getPlayerDeflectRange(id)
  if not range then
    return nil
  end
  local latency = includePing and gameInfo.getAveragePing() or 0
  if not finite(latency) or latency < 0 then
    latency = 0
  end
  return range + (finite(speed) and math.max(0, speed) * latency or 0)
end
function Geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, includeResilience, playerId)
  local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
  local gameBall = gameInfo.getDefenseSource()
  if not finite(speed) then
    local sync = gameInfo.getSyncData()
    if sync and finite(sync.Speed) then
      speed = sync.Speed
    end
  end
  if not finite(speed) or high <= low then
    return nil
  end
  local window = CONFIG.WINDOW_BASE - CONFIG.WINDOW_SPREAD * math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
  local player = playerId and players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId) or players.LocalPlayer
  local inClash = false
  if gameBall and player and type(gameBall.IsInClash) == "function" then
    inClash = gameBall:IsInClash(player) == true
  end
  if inClash and type(gameBall.GetClashMinWindow) == "function" then
    local minimum = gameBall:GetClashMinWindow(speed)
    if finite(minimum) then
      window = math.max(window, minimum)
    end
  end
  if includeResilience ~= false and not sharedLayout() then
    local range = Geometry.getDeflectRange()
    if finite(range) then
      window += math.clamp((range - CONFIG.RANGE_BASE) / CONFIG.RANGE_BONUS_SPAN, 0, 1) * CONFIG.RANGE_WINDOW_BONUS
    end
  end
  if inClash and type(gameBall.ApplyClashPressure) == "function" then
    window = gameBall:ApplyClashPressure(window, player)
  elseif inClash and type(gameBall.GetClashWindowScale) == "function" then
    local scale = gameBall:GetClashWindowScale()
    if finite(scale) and scale > 0 then
      window *= scale
    end
  end
  return window
end
function Geometry.getDefensePhysics()
  local gameBall = gameInfo.getDefenseSource()
  local player = players.LocalPlayer
  local ping = gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  if not finite(ping) or ping < 0 then
    ping = 0
  end
  local grace, cap = ping + 0.075, 0.35
  local press = player and player:GetAttribute("PressDelay")
  if finite(press) then
    grace = math.max(grace, press + 0.05)
    cap = math.clamp(press + 0.05, 0.35, 0.45)
  end
  grace = math.clamp(grace, 0.075, cap)
  local inClash = gameBall and player and type(gameBall.IsInClash) == "function" and gameBall:IsInClash(player) == true
  if inClash and type(gameBall.ApplyClashPressureGrace) == "function" then
    grace = gameBall:ApplyClashPressureGrace(grace, player)
  end
  local kill = gameBall and type(gameBall.GetKillDistance) == "function" and gameBall:GetKillDistance() or 4
  return {
    killRadius = kill,
    grace = grace,
    ping = ping,
    uplink = ping,
    serverNow = world:GetServerTimeNow(),
    inClash = inClash == true,
    clashKnown = gameBall ~= nil and player ~= nil and type(gameBall.IsInClash) == "function",
  }
end
function Geometry.getDeflectGeometry(speed, window, factor, _scaleBase, latencyOverride, options)
  if not validBallSpeed(speed) then
    return nil
  end
  options = type(options) == "table" and options or EMPTY_OPTIONS
  local includeResilience = options.resilience ~= false
  local range = includeResilience and Geometry.getDeflectRange() or CONFIG.RANGE_BASE
  if not finite(range) or range <= 0 then
    range = CONFIG.RANGE_BASE
  end
  if window == "ap" then
    local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
    if not finite(low) or not finite(high) or high <= low then
      return nil
    end
    local fraction = math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
    local actual = Geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, includeResilience)
    if not finite(actual) then
      return nil
    end
    window = math.max(
      0,
      actual
        + (CONFIG.AP_WINDOW_LOW_SPEED - CONFIG.WINDOW_BASE) * (1 - fraction)
        + (CONFIG.AP_WINDOW_HIGH_SPEED - (CONFIG.WINDOW_BASE - CONFIG.WINDOW_SPREAD)) * fraction
    )
  elseif not finite(window) then
    window = Geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, includeResilience)
    if finite(window) then
      local minimum = finite(options.minimumWindow) and math.max(0, options.minimumWindow) or 0
      window = math.max(window, minimum)
    end
  end
  if finite(window) then
    window = window * (finite(options.windowScale) and math.max(0, options.windowScale) or 1)
    window += finite(options.windowOffset) and options.windowOffset or 0
    if options.speedWindowBonus == true then
      local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
      if finite(low) and finite(high) and high > low then
        window += CONFIG.WINDOW_SPREAD * 0.20 * math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
      end
    end
  end
  if not finite(window) or window < 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local latency = options.ping == false and 0 or (finite(latencyOverride) and latencyOverride or gameInfo.getAveragePing())
  if not finite(latency) or latency < 0 then
    latency = 0
  end
  factor = finite(factor) and math.max(0, factor) or 1
  local base = range
  local pingFactor = finite(options.latencyFactor) and math.max(0, options.latencyFactor) or factor
  local full, windowRadius, pingRadius, effectiveWindow = projectParts(base, speed, window, factor, latency, nil, pingFactor)
  return {
    fullRadius = full,
    baseRadius = CONFIG.RANGE_BASE,
    windowRadius = windowRadius,
    latencyRadius = pingRadius,
    pureRadius = CONFIG.RANGE_BASE,
    noWindowParryRadius = range,
    resilienceBonus = range - CONFIG.RANGE_BASE,
    pingRadius = pingRadius,
    deflectWindow = window,
    effectiveWindow = effectiveWindow,
    leadTime = window + latency,
    windowFactor = factor,
  }
end
function Geometry.getAutoParryGeometry(speed, factor, frameLead, latencyOverride, playerId)
  if not validBallSpeed(speed) then
    return nil
  end
  local low, high = gameInfo.getBallSpeedLimits()
  if not finite(low) or not finite(high) or high <= low then
    return nil
  end
  local window = Geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, false, playerId)
  local range = playerId and Geometry.getPlayerDeflectRange(playerId) or Geometry.getDeflectRange()
  if not finite(range) or range <= 0 then
    range = CONFIG.RANGE_BASE
  end
  if not finite(window) or window < 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local latency = finite(latencyOverride) and math.max(0, latencyOverride) or gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  if not finite(latency) then
    latency = 0
  end
  local factorValue = finite(factor) and math.clamp(factor, 0, 1) or 0.3
  local frame = finite(frameLead) and math.clamp(frameLead, 0, 0.15) or 1 / 60
  local networkLead = latency + frame
  local lead = latency + math.min(window * factorValue + frame, window * 0.95)
  return {
    fullRadius = range + CONFIG.AUTO_PARRY_TRIGGER_PADDING + speed * lead,
    pureRadius = CONFIG.RANGE_BASE,
    noWindowParryRadius = range,
    resilienceBonus = range - CONFIG.RANGE_BASE,
    pingRadius = speed * latency,
    deflectWindow = window,
    effectiveWindow = lead,
    leadTime = lead,
    serverLeadTime = window + latency,
    windowFactor = factorValue,
    triggerPadding = CONFIG.AUTO_PARRY_TRIGGER_PADDING,
    networkLead = networkLead,
    uplinkLead = latency,
    frameLead = frame,
    autoParry = true,
    killRadius = 4,
  }
end
function Geometry.getParryTiming(value, own, options)
  options = type(options) == "table" and options or EMPTY_OPTIONS
  if type(value) ~= "table" or not vector(value.position) or not vector(own) or not vector(value.velocity) then
    return nil
  end
  local speed = value.syncSpeed ~= nil and value.syncSpeed or value.speed
  if not validBallSpeed(speed) or speed < (value.mode == "training" and 1 or 16) then
    return nil
  end
  local ping = finite(options.ping) and math.max(0, options.ping) or gameInfo.getAveragePing()
  local factor = finite(options.factor) and math.max(0, options.factor) or 1
  local training = value.mode == "training"
  local window = finite(options.window) and math.max(0, options.window) or nil
  local g = training and Geometry.getTrainingGeometry(speed, factor, window)
    or Geometry.getDeflectGeometry(speed, window or Geometry.getDeflectWindow(speed, false), factor, false, ping, { latencyFactor = 1 })
  if not g then
    return nil
  end
  local frame = finite(options.frameLead) and math.max(0, options.frameLead) or 0
  local lead = g.effectiveWindow + frame + (training and Geometry.getTrainingLatency(ping) or 0)
  if finite(options.maxWindowLead) then
    lead = math.min(lead, ping + math.max(0, options.maxWindowLead))
  end
  local distance, closing, _, entry = Geometry.getTrajectory(value.position, value.velocity, own, speed, g, nil, options.rootVelocity)
  local killRadius = Geometry.getKillRadius(Geometry.getDefensePhysics())
  local danger = Geometry.getDanger(value.position, value.velocity, own, speed, killRadius, 0, options.rootVelocity)
  local timing = table.clone(g)
  timing.speed, timing.velocity, timing.distance, timing.closingSpeed = speed, value.velocity, distance, closing
  local _, cap, step = Geometry.getDeflectRangeParameters()
  timing.resilience = {
    size = g.resilienceBonus,
    cap = cap,
    perParry = step,
    stack = math.floor(g.resilienceBonus / step + 0.5),
    maxStack = math.ceil(cap / step),
    source = "DeflectRange",
  }
  timing.fullRadius = g.noWindowParryRadius + (g.triggerPadding or 0) + math.max(0, closing) * lead
  timing.parryRadius, timing.triggerDistance, timing.effectiveWindow = timing.fullRadius, timing.fullRadius, lead
  timing.timeToRange, timing.predictionTimeToRange, timing.tti = entry, entry, entry
  timing.timeToTrigger = math.max(0, entry - lead)
  timing.timeToKill, timing.killRadius = danger and danger.entryTime or math.huge, killRadius
  timing.ready = entry == 0 or (closing > 0 and entry <= lead)
  timing.approaching, timing.targeted = closing > 0, value.targeted == true
  timing.distanceToParryRadius, timing.adaptiveWindowFactor = distance - timing.fullRadius, factor
  timing.defenseRadius, timing.radiusGateLead = Geometry.getGuaranteedRadius(g, speed, ping), g.deflectWindow
  timing.predictionSource, timing.training = value.predictionSource or "visual_fallback", training
  return timing
end
function Geometry.getProjectedDeflectRadius(geometry, closingSpeed)
  if type(geometry) ~= "table" or not finite(geometry.noWindowParryRadius) or not finite(geometry.effectiveWindow) or not finite(closingSpeed) then
    return nil
  end
  return geometry.noWindowParryRadius + math.max(0, closingSpeed) * geometry.effectiveWindow
end
function Geometry.getTrainingGeometry(speed, factor, windowOverride)
  speed = finite(speed) and math.max(speed, CONFIG.TRAINING_BASE_SPEED) or CONFIG.TRAINING_BASE_SPEED
  local span = CONFIG.TRAINING_MAX_SPEED - CONFIG.TRAINING_BASE_SPEED
  local progress = span > 0 and math.clamp((speed - CONFIG.TRAINING_BASE_SPEED) / span, 0, 1) or 1
  local blockWindow = CONFIG.TRAINING_WINDOW_SLOW + (CONFIG.TRAINING_WINDOW_FAST - CONFIG.TRAINING_WINDOW_SLOW) * progress
  local deflectDistance = CONFIG.TRAINING_DEFLECT_DISTANCE
  if finite(windowOverride) and windowOverride >= 0 then
    blockWindow = windowOverride
  end
  factor = finite(factor) and math.max(0, factor) or CONFIG.TRAINING_WINDOW_FACTOR
  local effectiveWindow = blockWindow * factor
  return {
    fullRadius = deflectDistance + speed * effectiveWindow + CONFIG.TRAINING_TRIGGER_PADDING,
    pureRadius = deflectDistance,
    noWindowParryRadius = deflectDistance,
    resilienceBonus = 0,
    pingRadius = 0,
    deflectWindow = blockWindow,
    effectiveWindow = effectiveWindow,
    leadTime = blockWindow,
    windowFactor = factor,
    triggerPadding = CONFIG.TRAINING_TRIGGER_PADDING,
    training = true,
  }
end
function Geometry.isBallWithinDeflectRadius(factor)
  local snapshot = gameInfo.getSnapshotAt()
  if not gameInfo.isSnapshotValid(snapshot) or snapshot.teleported then
    return false
  end
  local player = players.LocalPlayer
  local root = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root or not root.Parent then
    return false
  end
  local speed = tonumber(snapshot.syncSpeed)
  if not finite(speed) or speed <= 0 then
    speed = snapshot.speed
  end
  if not finite(speed) or speed <= 0 then
    return false
  end
  local geometry = Geometry.getDeflectGeometry(speed, nil, factor, false)
  return geometry ~= nil and (snapshot.position - root.Position).Magnitude <= geometry.fullRadius
end
function Geometry.resolve(speed, options)
  options = type(options) == "table" and options or EMPTY_OPTIONS
  if options.profile == "training" then
    return Geometry.getTrainingGeometry(speed, options.factor)
  end
  if options.profile == "autoParry" then
    return Geometry.getAutoParryGeometry(speed, options.factor, options.frameLead, options.latency)
  end
  return Geometry.getDeflectGeometry(speed, options.window, options.factor, false, options.latency, options)
end
function Geometry.getRadius(speed, options)
  local result = Geometry.resolve(speed, options)
  if not result then
    return nil
  end
  local component = type(options) == "table" and options.component or "full"
  if component == "base" then
    return result.pureRadius
  end
  if component == "raw" then
    return result.noWindowParryRadius
  end
  if component == "resilience" then
    return result.resilienceBonus
  end
  if component == "ping" then
    return result.pingRadius
  end
  if component == "window" then
    return result.fullRadius - result.noWindowParryRadius - result.pingRadius - (result.triggerPadding or 0)
  end
  if component == "full" then
    return result.fullRadius
  end
  return nil
end
function Geometry.getGuaranteedRadius(value, speed, ping) return value.noWindowParryRadius + math.max(0, speed) * math.max(0, ping) end
function Geometry.withAutoParryFactor(value, factor, closingSpeed, ping)
  local result = table.clone(value)
  local uplink = finite(value.uplinkLead) and value.uplinkLead or ping
  local frame = finite(value.frameLead) and value.frameLead or math.max(0, (value.networkLead or 0) - uplink)
  result.windowFactor = factor
  result.effectiveWindow = uplink + math.min(value.deflectWindow * factor + frame, value.deflectWindow * 0.95)
  result.leadTime = result.effectiveWindow
  result.fullRadius = value.noWindowParryRadius + (value.triggerPadding or 0) + math.max(0, closingSpeed) * result.effectiveWindow
  return result
end
function Geometry.getTrainingTrigger(value, closingSpeed, ping, frameAllowance, retryFactor)
  if finite(retryFactor) then
    return value.noWindowParryRadius + math.max(0, closingSpeed) * value.deflectWindow * retryFactor
  end
  local latency = finite(ping) and math.clamp(ping, 0, CONFIG.TRAINING_MAX_PING) or 0
  local lead = math.min(value.deflectWindow * CONFIG.TRAINING_MAX_LEAD_FACTOR, value.effectiveWindow + latency + CONFIG.FRAME_BASE + frameAllowance)
  return value.noWindowParryRadius + CONFIG.TRAINING_TRIGGER_PADDING + math.max(0, closingSpeed) * lead
end
function Geometry.getTrajectory(position, velocity, rootPosition, nominalSpeed, geometry, rangeOverride, rootVelocity)
  local delta = rootPosition - position
  local distance = delta.Magnitude
  local ballVelocity = velocity
  if finite(nominalSpeed) and nominalSpeed > 0 and ballVelocity.Magnitude > nominalSpeed * 1.1 then
    ballVelocity = ballVelocity.Unit * nominalSpeed * 1.1
  end
  if typeof(rootVelocity) ~= "Vector3" or not finite(rootVelocity.X) or not finite(rootVelocity.Y) or not finite(rootVelocity.Z) then
    rootVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local relative = ballVelocity - rootVelocity
  local closing = distance > 0 and relative:Dot(delta) / distance or 0
  if not finite(closing) then
    closing = 0
  end
  local padding = finite(geometry.triggerPadding) and math.max(0, geometry.triggerPadding) or 0
  local range = rangeOverride or (geometry.noWindowParryRadius + padding)
  local threshold = range + math.max(0, closing) * geometry.effectiveWindow
  local entry = math.huge
  local c = delta:Dot(delta) - range * range
  if c <= 0 then
    entry = 0
  else
    local a = relative:Dot(relative)
    local b = delta:Dot(relative)
    if a > 0.000001 and b > 0 then
      local discriminant = b * b - a * c
      if discriminant >= 0 then
        entry = c / (b + math.sqrt(discriminant))
      end
    end
  end
  return distance, closing, threshold, entry
end
function Geometry.getDanger(position, velocity, targetPosition, speed, range, responseTime, targetVelocity)
  if not vector(position) or not vector(velocity) or not vector(targetPosition) or not validBallSpeed(speed) then
    return nil
  end
  if not finite(range) or range <= 0 or not finite(responseTime) or responseTime < 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local g = { noWindowParryRadius = range, effectiveWindow = responseTime }
  local distance, closing, _, entry = Geometry.getTrajectory(position, velocity, targetPosition, speed, g, range, targetVelocity)
  local ballVelocity = velocity
  if speed > 0 and ballVelocity.Magnitude > speed * 1.1 then
    ballVelocity = ballVelocity.Unit * speed * 1.1
  end
  local relative = ballVelocity - (vector(targetVelocity) and targetVelocity or Vector3.zero)
  local delta = targetPosition - position
  local squaredSpeed = relative:Dot(relative)
  local closestAt = squaredSpeed > 0.000001 and math.max(0, delta:Dot(relative) / squaredSpeed) or 0
  local closestDistance = (delta - relative * closestAt).Magnitude
  local alignment = distance > 0 and squaredSpeed > 0.000001 and math.clamp(closing / math.sqrt(squaredSpeed), -1, 1) or 0
  local score = entry == 0 and 100 or (finite(entry) and responseTime > 0 and 100 * math.clamp(1 - entry / (2 * responseTime), 0, 1) or 0)
  return {
    score = score,
    ready = entry == 0 or (closing > 0 and entry <= responseTime),
    distance = distance,
    closingSpeed = closing,
    entryTime = entry,
    responseTime = responseTime,
    alignment = alignment,
    closestDistance = closestDistance,
    closestAt = closestAt,
    range = range,
  }
end
function Geometry.getTrainingLatency(ping) return finite(ping) and math.clamp(ping, 0, CONFIG.TRAINING_MAX_PING) or 0 end
function Geometry.getProjectedTriggerRadius(value, closingSpeed) return Geometry.getProjectedDeflectRadius(value, closingSpeed) + (value.triggerPadding or 0) end
function Geometry.addLatencyRadius(range, speed, latency) return range + math.max(0, speed) * math.max(0, latency) end
function Geometry.withSpeedWindowBonus(value, speed, low, high, factor)
  local result = table.clone(value)
  if finite(low) and finite(high) and high > low then
    local bonus = CONFIG.WINDOW_SPREAD * 0.20 * math.clamp((speed - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
    result.deflectWindow += bonus
    result.effectiveWindow += bonus * factor
    result.fullRadius += speed * bonus * factor
    result.leadTime += bonus
  end
  return result
end
function Geometry.projectRadius(...)
  local fullRadius = projectParts(...)
  return fullRadius
end
function Geometry.compose(parts)
  if type(parts) ~= "table" then
    return nil
  end
  local full, windowRadius, pingRadius, effectiveWindow =
    projectParts(parts.range, parts.speed, parts.window, parts.factor, parts.latency, parts.extraRange, parts.latencyFactor, parts.padding)
  return { fullRadius = full, windowRadius = windowRadius, pingRadius = pingRadius, effectiveWindow = effectiveWindow }
end
function Geometry.getWindow(speed, options)
  local value = Geometry.resolve(speed, options)
  if not value then
    return nil
  end
  if type(options) == "table" and options.raw == true then
    return value.deflectWindow
  end
  return value.deflectWindow * value.windowFactor
end
function Geometry.getKillRadius(value) return type(value) == "table" and finite(value.killRadius) and value.killRadius or 4 end
Geometry.__contract = {
  access = { default = "internal.read" },
  requires = { GameInfo = "gameinfo", Utils = "utils" },
  requiresMethods = {
    GameInfo = {
      "usesSharedLayout",
      "getDefenseSource",
      "getBallSpeedLimits",
      "getSyncData",
      "getAveragePing",
      "getClashContext",
      "getPlayerDistance",
      "getSnapshotAt",
      "isSnapshotValid",
    },
    Utils = { "getPlayers", "getWorkspace" },
  },
  provides = {
    "setup",
    "getDeflectRangeParameters",
    "getDeflectRange",
    "getPlayerDeflectRange",
    "getPlayerRawRadius",
    "getDeflectWindow",
    "getDefensePhysics",
    "getDeflectGeometry",
    "getAutoParryGeometry",
    "getParryTiming",
    "getProjectedDeflectRadius",
    "getTrainingGeometry",
    "isBallWithinDeflectRadius",
    "resolve",
    "getRadius",
    "getGuaranteedRadius",
    "withAutoParryFactor",
    "getTrainingTrigger",
    "getTrajectory",
    "getDanger",
    "getTrainingLatency",
    "getProjectedTriggerRadius",
    "addLatencyRadius",
    "withSpeedWindowBonus",
    "projectRadius",
    "compose",
    "getWindow",
    "getKillRadius",
  },
}

return Geometry
sources.hubs/registry.luau:
-- [[ registry ]]
--!strict
--!optimize 2

-- code
export type ModuleEntry = { name: string, path: string, hash: string? }
export type HubProfile = {
  id: string,
  title: string,
  version: string?,
  developers: { string }?,
  author: string?,
  notification: string?,
  placeIds: { number }?,
  universeIds: { number }?,
  modules: { ModuleEntry }?,
  permissions: boolean?,
  checkPermissions: boolean?,
  permissionPolicy: { [string]: any }?,
  dataFolder: string?,
}

local Registry = {}
function Registry.select(profiles: { HubProfile }, placeId: number, universeId: number?): HubProfile
  for _, profile in ipairs(profiles) do
    if table.find(profile.placeIds or {}, placeId) then
      return table.clone(profile)
    end
  end
  for _, profile in ipairs(profiles) do
    if universeId and universeId ~= 0 and table.find(profile.universeIds or {}, universeId) then
      return table.clone(profile)
    end
  end
  return {
    id = "universal",
    title = "Universal",
    author = "deltapolinha_2915",
    notification = "Universal carregado.",
  }
end
function Registry.merge(common: { ModuleEntry }, profile: { ModuleEntry }?): { ModuleEntry }
  local result: { ModuleEntry } = {}
  local positions: { [string]: number } = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(common) do
    assert(type(entry.name) == "string" and not positions[entry.name], "Duplicate base module")
    positions[entry.name] = #result + 1
    result[#result + 1] = table.clone(entry)
  end
  local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(profile or {}) do
    assert(type(entry.name) == "string" and type(entry.path) == "string" and not seen[entry.name], "Invalid or duplicate hub module")
    assert(entry.path:match("^hubs/[%w%-]+/") and not entry.path:find("..", 1, true), "Invalid hub path")
    assert(entry.name ~= "permissions" and entry.name ~= "gamecontext" and entry.name ~= "hubapi", "Reserved base module")
    assert(not positions[entry.name], "Game module duplicates shared module: " .. entry.name)
    seen[entry.name] = true
    local index = positions[entry.name] or #result + 1
    positions[entry.name] = index
    result[index] = table.clone(entry)
  end
  return result
end

return Registry
